About the Role

Join an expert network supporting AI training projects as an annotation specialist. You will label diverse data types to help improve how AI systems learn, with project assignments matched to your background.

What You'll Do

  • Classify images, video, audio, and documents according to detailed guidelines.

  • Annotate 2D and 3D data using boxes, polygons, masks, cuboids, and segments.

  • Track objects across video frames and label actions and temporal events.

  • Tag entities in text, including names, places, products, and dates.

  • Transcribe audio, extract text from scans and photos, and label sounds and speakers.

  • Annotate satellite and geospatial imagery and link records across sensors.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in annotation, labeling, transcription, GIS, quality assurance, or similar detail-oriented work. Relevant experience may include visual or language data tasks, mapping, subtitling, editing, or linguistic coding.

  • Ability to follow lengthy written guidelines and maintain accurate, consistent labels.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Label Studio, CVAT, Labelbox, Supervisely, ELAN, or QGIS.

  • Background in linguistics, geography, GIS, computer science, media, or a related field is helpful.

  • Experience with OCR correction, audio transcription, entity tagging, geospatial or sensor-data labeling, or AI training data projects is helpful.

  • Reliable internet access and a desktop or laptop computer.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation is $15 to $35 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Payment is based on hours worked.

jobs.description:
Director, Operations Instructional Design

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a fully remote role.

Role Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

College Board Operations Division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, emerging technologies, and integrated products to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support.


The Knowledge, Learning & Operational Effectiveness team collaborates across all operational functions to design and deliver integrated solutions that power our core operations. Our mission is to create a connected ecosystem that supports College Board digital experiences, enabling operational efficiency and exceptional customer outcomes. From backend systems to educator-facing content, every solution we deliver is purposefully crafted to enhance the customer journey, ensuring seamless, intuitive, and impactful interactions at every stage.  

About the Opportunity

The Operations Division is modernizing how we deliver learning solutions to enable high-impact, user-centered experiences. We are seeking a Director of Operations Instructional Design to lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of digital learning experiences that prepare both our internal Operations teams and our external partners, including test administration partners, as they prepare to do their operational activities across the customer journey.


This role will establish and lead a Learning Experience Design Center of Excellence (COE) within Operations, responsible for building best-in-class design standards, templates, and tools that elevate the quality and impact of all learning experiences. You’ll collaborate across Operations, Product, Program, and Technology to ensure that every learning program is both engaging and measurable in its impact on performance, readiness, and customer experience.


You use instructional design to drive innovation in digital learning through evidence-based practices, human-centered design, and the thoughtful application of learning science. You bring experience with Adobe Captivate, Articulate Storyline 360, SCORM Cloud, Global Meet, and PowerPoint to create lessons and modules, and coding skills with JavaScript extensions and other tools to produce interactive elements.


In this role, you will:

Strategize Learning Journeys, Develop and Deliver Training, Templates, and Artifacts (40%)

  • Create detailed design principles and templates for the team to use in creating individual training artifacts like webinars, live learning, async lessons and modules.
  • Create complex training experiences and deliverables using tools like JavaScript extensions, xAPI, cmi5, and Blender.
  • Plan, script, and build engaging, interactive, targeted, and efficient learning artifacts for internal Operations staff who support the delivery of College Board products and assessments.
  • Create visual elements like graphics, exercises, videos, printables, and assessments to make artifacts engaging to learners.
  • Use Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Review SCORM Cloud, and PowerPoint to create and update training artifacts.

Learning Strategy and Standards (30%)

  • Establish the Learning Experience Design COE to define standards, templates, and processes for learning design excellence.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure learning programs are measurable and linked to performance outcomes and customer experience improvements.
  • Anticipates future learning needs by staying current with design trends and research. Balances prioritization and delivery of new strategies and approaches with current business needs.
  • Leverage AI technologies to develop learning solutions that deliver high business value to materially transform Ops learning experiences
  • Make necessary adjustments and add required elements (like closed-captioning) to ensure all artifacts are ADA compliant when required.
  • Ensure final artifacts are compatible with organization’s LMS and broader knowledge management infrastructure.

Continuous Improvement and Evolve Content (30%)

  • Deliver strategies that connect learning programs to business results using data and evaluation models to prove the impact and value of learning initiatives.
  • Establish and monitor key learning performance metrics to measure and enhance business impact, using data to drive continuous improvement
  • Implement feedback loops to gather user insights and measure satisfaction, leveraging this data for iteratively refining learning solutions
  • Maintain governance processes for content updates in collaboration with SMEs and overall Knowledge and Learning Operations team.

About You

  • Expertise in digital learning with 5+ years designing and creating digital training programs. Experience providing digital learning to K-12 educators is preferred but not required.
  • Outstanding knowledge of emerging trends and best practice in digital learning
  • Expertise in authoring and publishing systems, including Articulate Storyline 360, Adobe Captivate, and SCORM Cloud to create multimedia solutions is required.
  • Proven capabilities to develop complex learning materials, including simulations, JavaScript extensions, and multimedia.
  • Expertise in instructional technologies is required; operational experience with LMS technologies and capability to maintain expertise with emerging technologies and standards, xAPI, and cmi5.
  • Adept problem-solving skills, including using data to inform decisions and actions   
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence others to action
  • A passion for supporting educational and career opportunities for millions of students   
  • Excellent PowerPoint, Word, and Excel skills
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.
  • Authorization to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000 to $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DOTruvani is a health and wellness brand that has one clear mission: create products people use in their daily lives with CLEAN, simple ingredients.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

Truvani is a health and wellness brand that has one clear mission: create products people use in their daily lives with CLEAN, simple ingredients.

Many companies claim it. We actually mean it.

As a leading provider of high-quality supplements, protein powders, and snack bars, we are committed to transparency, purity, and sustainability. Our mission is to provide products you can trust, with ingredients you can pronounce, and to inspire healthier living for all.

If you’re a talented, ambitious person who wants to create the best health and wellness products, apply to join our team!

ABOUT THE POSITION

Truvani is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to support our growing logistics and distribution operations. In this role, you will work closely with the Director of Logistics to coordinate inventory movements between vendors and third-party logistics (3PL) warehouses, as well as transfers between warehouse locations.

This role requires strong communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and moving pieces simultaneously. You'll play an important part in ensuring inventory moves efficiently, shipment records remain accurate, and our internal teams have clear visibility into inventory movements and shipment statuses.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, stays ahead of potential issues, and understands that accuracy and follow-through are critical to successful logistics operations.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS/IS

  • Has at least 3 years of experience in transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple shipments, deadlines, and priorities at once.
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows tasks through to completion without needing constant oversight.
  • Has hands-on experience with NetSuite, preferably with at least 1 year of experience.
  • Is proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Google Sheets, including basic formulas and pivot tables.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is comfortable working directly with external partners, including 3PL warehouses and freight forwarders, to coordinate shipments, request updates, and resolve issues.
  • Is proactive and resourceful when it comes to identifying problems and finding solutions.
  • Understands the importance of accurate data entry, documentation, and timely follow-through.
  • Works well independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

  • Coordinate Inventory Movements: Work with the Director of Logistics to execute distribution plans, including inventory transfers from vendors to 3PL warehouses and between 3PL warehouse locations.
  • Manage Shipment Setups: Access 3PL partner platforms to create and manage inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring all required shipment details are entered accurately.
  • Coordinate Freight Transportation: Work directly with freight forwarders to arrange transportation once inventory is staged and ready for shipment. Provide all necessary warehouse details and shipment information to facilitate timely pickups and deliveries.
  • Maintain Accurate Inventory Records: Record all inventory movements and transfers in NetSuite, including processing fulfillment transactions when shipments are initiated and receiving transactions once inventory arrives at its destination. Accuracy and timeliness in this process are essential.
  • Resolve Inventory Issues: Collaborate with internal Truvani team members to troubleshoot and resolve inventory discrepancies or allocation issues within NetSuite, including SKU and lot availability.
  • Troubleshoot Shipment Issues: Communicate with warehouses and freight forwarders to proactively address transportation challenges, including delays, missed pickups, missed deliveries, and other shipment-related issues.
  • Track Open Shipments: Maintain an up-to-date shipment tracker that provides Truvani team members with clear visibility into outstanding shipments and their current statuses.
  • Organize Shipment Documentation: Maintain organized records of all shipment-related documentation, including packing lists, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and other relevant paperwork.
  • Take on additional logistics and operational responsibilities as needed.

THE NITTY GRITTY

  • Full time market-based compensation based on experience
  • Fully remote with flexibility and autonomy
  • Collaborative and innovative team culture
  • Health (medical, dental, vision) benefits and 401k benefits offered after 60 days
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Remote Work and Education Stipend
  • Truvani Monthly Store Credit
  • Position is available immediately and will remain open until filled
  • This is a permanent position with an opportunity to grow within the company (so we would like to hire someone that is awesome and is excited about being a part of our team).

jobs.description:
Packetlabs was built by an ethical hacker after seeing vulnerability assessments presented as penetration tests. Our slogan "Ready for more than a VA scan?" drives at the importance of not providing our clients with a false sense of security.

We are a passionate team of highly trained, proactive, penetration testers. We provide expert-level penetration testing services that are thorough and tailored to help foster a safe digital space where everyone has the right to privacy and security. Packetlabs consultants find weaknesses others overlook and continuously learn new ways to evade controls. We hold ourselves to a very high standard.

To do so, we only hire individuals with the same drive and passion.

Who we are looking for

  • Core values:
    • You have a customer-first mentality. Is a great communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. Rapid responses and on time.
    • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence.
    • You dig deeper into every finding. Doesn't stop until impact is proven.
    • You are comfortable being uncomfortable. Goes towards obstacles, not away from them. Consulting isn't your typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
    • You are always learning. Cybersecurity is changing every day, and you need to keep up or want to keep up. Be deeply aware of your skillset and be willing to improve.
    • You are Self-motivated and dependable.
    • You are humble. Egos don't have a place at Packetlabs.
  • Education and experience:
    • We are looking for an experienced developer/application security tester to join our team:
      • Solid working knowledge of programming languages, including C, C#, Python, Objective-C, Java, JavaScript, SQL, and frameworks like AngularJS.
      • Familiarity with web services and data exchange formats such as XML, JSON, SOAP, REST, and AJAX.
      • Understanding of AI/LLM weaknesses and flaws in applications.
      • Extensive experience/expertise in using an attack proxy (e.g. Burp Suite)
    • Preferred if you have 3 - 5 years of experience working in penetration testing and consulting
    • A graduate of a post-secondary college or university degree program.
    • Has at least two years of experience dealing with information security-related tasks.
    • Has professional qualifications (one or more): OSCP, OSWE, BSCP.
      • OSCP or Burp is mandatory for our organization.

What you’ll be doing

  • Your primary role is to perform penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, thick clients, and APIs.
  • Source code review and whitebox penetration testing to prove the impact of application flaws.
  • Reverse engineering of mobile and thick client applications.
  • You sometimes chain application flaws to other areas, such as cloud and on-prem AD infrastructure. Opportunities for lateral movement into the infrastructure teams are limited and given at the manager's discretion.
  • Develop detailed reports on findings and remediations for impactful findings. You will learn to debrief these findings at both a technical and executive level.
  • Perform SAST and DAST on enterprise, SaaS, and custom in-house applications.
  • Experience in using scanners and knowledge of validation and elimination of false positives.
  • A strong understanding of OWASP in Web, API, Mobile, and AI/LLM is necessary, but you will be asked to go beyond.

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes hardware engagements where your judgment and bench skills genuinely matter
  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Play a key role in shaping the growth, direction, and methodology of Packetlabs' expanding hardware practice
  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
  • GRRSP with corporate matching in Canada
  • Participation in corporate benefit plans within Canada
  • Flexible work environment that empowers employees to do their best work
  • Fully remote within Canada

jobs.title: Senior Patient Experience Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, the patient experience is an important part of how telehealth businesses operate. We value thoughtful communication, attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and people who can help patients navigate administrative and technical challenges while respecting the responsibilities of licensed healthcare professionals.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Patient Experience Specialist to help deliver a clear, responsive, and supportive experience for patients using telehealth services powered by Bask Health.

This role focuses on patient communication, administrative assistance, service-related troubleshooting, and coordinating the resolution of complex patient experience issues.

You'll help patients navigate supported platform workflows and understand the next steps in their service experience.

Our platform supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses by connecting patient experiences, online questionnaires, checkout processes, clinical workflows, and pharmacy-related operations.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how these workflows connect and where patients may encounter confusion, delays, or technical difficulties.

You'll respond to patient questions through approved communication channels and provide accurate information within established support guidelines.

You'll assist patients with nonclinical questions related to account access, platform navigation, questionnaire completion, checkout processes, and administrative status updates.

You'll help patients understand what information they need to provide and where they can find relevant instructions.

You'll investigate reported platform difficulties and work with internal teams to identify appropriate next steps.

As a senior member of the patient experience function, you'll take ownership of more complex service cases that require additional coordination or careful communication.

You'll help resolve situations involving multiple teams, unclear responsibilities, or repeated patient contacts.

You'll be expected to remain organized and communicate clearly when patients are frustrated or uncertain about what happens next.

You'll coordinate with technical support teams when patients encounter software errors or difficulties completing supported platform workflows.

You'll work with authorized clinical or pharmacy stakeholders when a case involves medical, prescription, medication, or dispensing-related questions.

You'll understand that patient experience specialists do not provide medical advice, make clinical decisions, determine treatment eligibility, or independently resolve prescription-related clinical concerns.

You'll follow established procedures for escalating safety concerns, urgent clinical questions, and other matters outside the patient support team's scope.

You'll provide administrative updates only when the information is verified and appropriate to share.

You'll maintain accurate records of patient communications, reported issues, actions taken, and follow-up commitments.

You'll use approved systems and follow internal privacy and security procedures when handling patient information.

You'll help identify recurring patient questions, common points of confusion, and workflow challenges that affect the overall experience.

You'll share those findings with customer success, product, technical support, and operations teams.

You'll contribute to improvements in patient-facing instructions, support resources, and communication templates.

You'll help develop clear responses to frequently asked questions and identify where additional guidance may reduce unnecessary support contacts.

You'll support quality improvement efforts by reviewing common service issues and recommending practical changes to support processes.

You'll assist with identifying cases that require escalation because of repeated delays, unresolved technical problems, or communication breakdowns.

You'll coordinate follow-up activity so patients receive consistent information and understand the status of their administrative requests.

You'll help establish consistent standards for case documentation, escalation, and communication quality.

You'll also support the training and guidance of less-experienced patient support team members when appropriate.

You'll be expected to demonstrate sound judgment when deciding whether an issue can be resolved through standard support procedures or requires specialist involvement.

You'll work closely with internal stakeholders while maintaining clear boundaries between administrative support and licensed healthcare responsibilities.

You'll contribute to a patient experience that is organized, respectful, and responsive without making promises about medical outcomes, prescriptions, treatment timelines, or pharmacy fulfillment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for complex patient experience cases and support process improvement.

It is not a licensed clinical position, pharmacy position, or formal people-management role.

We're looking for someone with strong customer or patient support experience, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to manage sensitive situations professionally.

Experience supporting healthcare-related services, digital health platforms, or other complex service environments is particularly valuable.

You should be comfortable working with multiple systems, managing detailed case records, and coordinating across teams.

Success in this role means helping patients receive accurate administrative support, reducing avoidable confusion, improving issue resolution, and identifying opportunities to strengthen the overall service experience.

What You'll Do

  • Provide high-quality administrative and technical support to patients through approved communication channels.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex patient experience cases.
  • Help patients navigate supported telehealth platform workflows.
  • Assist with account access, platform navigation, and general usability questions.
  • Support patients experiencing difficulties with online questionnaires.
  • Help investigate checkout and other nonclinical platform-related issues.
  • Provide accurate administrative status information when authorized and available.
  • Identify when patient questions require clinical, pharmacy, or specialist involvement.
  • Escalate medical and treatment-related questions to authorized healthcare professionals.
  • Route prescription and dispensing concerns to the appropriate authorized teams.
  • Follow established procedures for urgent or safety-related concerns.
  • Coordinate with technical support teams on patient-facing software issues.
  • Work with operations stakeholders to resolve administrative service challenges.
  • Take ownership of assigned complex cases and coordinate appropriate follow-up.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with patients experiencing frustration or uncertainty.
  • Maintain accurate records of patient communications and support actions.
  • Follow privacy and security procedures when handling sensitive patient information.
  • Use approved support systems to track cases and escalation activity.
  • Identify recurring patient questions and sources of confusion.
  • Recommend improvements to patient-facing instructions and help resources.
  • Assist with developing and updating support communication templates.
  • Support quality reviews of patient experience interactions.
  • Help improve case documentation and escalation procedures.
  • Coordinate internal follow-ups to reduce repeated or unresolved patient contacts.
  • Track recurring service issues and share findings with relevant teams.
  • Collaborate with product teams on patient-facing usability concerns.
  • Work with customer success teams when patient experience issues affect merchant operations.
  • Help develop internal patient support knowledge resources.
  • Provide guidance to less-experienced support specialists when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service consistency and communication quality.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between administrative support and clinical responsibilities.
  • Take ownership of patient experience issues through appropriate resolution or handoff.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in customer support, patient experience, healthcare administration, customer service, or a closely related service role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer or patient support cases.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with people experiencing frustration or uncertainty.
  • Experience resolving service-related issues through established support processes.
  • Ability to identify when a case requires escalation to another team.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience maintaining accurate customer or patient case records.
  • Ability to manage multiple active cases and follow-up commitments.
  • Experience using customer support, ticketing, or case management systems.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating software platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic account access and platform navigation issues.
  • Strong judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information.
  • Understanding of the importance of patient privacy and appropriate data handling.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures and communication guidelines.
  • Ability to distinguish administrative support from clinical decision-making.
  • Willingness to escalate medical, prescription, and pharmacy-related concerns to authorized professionals.
  • Ability to communicate accurate information without making unsupported promises.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple internal teams.
  • Ability to document recurring problems and recommend process improvements.
  • Comfortable handling challenging conversations professionally.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Commitment to consistent service quality and appropriate follow-through.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, or healthcare technology.
  • Background supporting patients through online healthcare services.
  • Experience working in healthcare customer service or patient coordination.
  • Familiarity with patient intake and online questionnaire workflows.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based healthcare services.
  • Familiarity with customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or similar tools.
  • Experience handling escalated or high-priority service cases.
  • Experience developing patient support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare privacy considerations.
  • Experience coordinating with clinical or pharmacy operations teams.
  • Experience supporting online checkout or payment-related administrative issues.
  • Experience working with customer success or technical support teams.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance reviews for customer support interactions.
  • Experience tracking support metrics and recurring service issues.
  • Experience improving escalation workflows or case management processes.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior support specialists.
  • Familiarity with patient experience improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working in a fast-changing SaaS or healthcare services environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse patient populations.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to reduce repeat support contacts.

jobs.description:
À propos de ShareGate

ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.

Il offre l’approche la plus simple, fiable et abordable pour migrer les données d’entreprise sur Microsoft 365.

Que ce soit Google Workspace, les disques réseaux, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, ou d’un tenant à l’autre, ShareGate s’en occupe et offre la paix d’esprit. D’une transition vers le cloud à l’intégration d’une nouvelle entreprise, il garde les choses vraiment simples.

ShareGate est aussi l’outil de prédilection pour garder le contrôle des données une fois que la migration est complétée. Ses fonctionnalités de gouvernance permettent d'évaluer rapidement les environnements M365, détecter les problèmes et apporter les correctifs nécessaires, pour que tout reste ordonné, sécurisé et optimisé. ShareGate est développé par Workleap Technologies, une entreprise de logiciels basée à Montréal.

Ton rôle

Microsoft 365, c'est là que le travail se fait. Et ça devient chaque jour plus gros, plus chargé et plus difficile à garder sous contrôle. ShareGate aide plus de 100 000 pros de l'informatique à migrer, comprendre et gouverner leurs environnements Microsoft 365 en toute confiance. Avec l'IA, on construit plus vite que jamais. La vraie question, c'est : est-ce qu'on construit les bonnes choses ? On cherche un.e gestionnaire du développement logiciel pour faire le pont entre les deux : une personne qui avance vite avec tous les outils disponibles et qui garde l'équipe concentrée sur ce qui fait une vraie différence pour nos clients.

Ton impact :

  • Propulser la valeur client en t'assurant que ce que l'équipe livre améliore l'expérience client, et remettre en question le travail qui ne le fait pas.

  • Élever les standards en pratiques de développement et chez les gens qui les portent, du coaching à l'embauche de développeur.euse.s qui rendent l'équipe plus forte.

Ton équipe

L'IA change la façon dont on construit des logiciels. Nos développeur.euse.s utilisent déjà des agents pour concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir le produit, et on livre plus vite que jamais. Le prochain défi, ce n'est pas d'aller plus vite. C'est de s'assurer que cette vitesse se traduit en plus de valeur pour nos clients : de meilleures expériences, des insights plus pertinents et des problèmes réglés avant même qu'ils deviennent des problèmes. Sous le capot, une plateforme d'ingestion de données lit en continu les environnements Microsoft 365 pour que nos clients voient toujours ce qui s'y passe vraiment.

Tu vas diriger 12 développeur.euse.s réparti.e.s en 3 squads, chacune responsable de sa partie du produit. On travaille main dans la main avec Produit et Design, on prend des décisions vite et on les ajuste encore plus vite. On est en télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.

Ce que tu apportes

  • De l’expérience en gestion d’une équipe de développement de 5+ personnes, de l’embauche au coaching, avec le courage managérial d’avoir les conversations difficiles sur la performance, de donner du feedback direct et de maintenir des standards élevés pour faire grandir les gens autour de toi ;
  • Un fort mindset produit : tu pars du problème client et tu es à l'aise de dire non au travail qui ne le règle pas ;
  • Une solide connaissance des pratiques modernes de développement logiciel et d'architecture, assez pour challenger les décisions techniques ;
  • Un historique concret d'amélioration de la façon de travailler d'une équipe grâce à l'IA et à l'automatisation, en mesurant l'impact ;
  • De l'aisance avec l'ambiguïté et avec les décisions rapides et réversibles ;
  • La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 155 000 $ - 185 000 $. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme de bonus annuel.

  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

On construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

  • Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

  • Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

  • Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

  • Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

  • Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

  • Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

  • A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

  • Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

  • The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

  • Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

  • A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

  • Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

  • Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

  • 12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Marketing Intern to support product marketing initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.

This internship is an opportunity for someone interested in technology, business, customer research, and marketing to gain hands-on experience working with a software product team.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together merchant tools, website creation, clinical and pharmacy workflows, AI-enabled features, analytics, and monetization capabilities.

As a Product Marketing Intern, you'll help our team communicate what Bask Health's products do, how they work, and why they're valuable to customers.

You'll work with product marketing and collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, sales, customer success, and other internal stakeholders.

A major part of this internship will involve learning about our platform and helping turn product information into clear, useful marketing materials.

You'll support the development of feature descriptions, product overviews, presentations, launch announcements, and customer education resources.

You'll help research the businesses that use Bask Health, including entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, healthcare providers, and organizations building direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

You'll learn how customers evaluate software products, which problems influence their decisions, and how product marketing communicates value.

You'll conduct competitive research on SaaS, e-commerce, and healthcare technology platforms.

You'll help identify how competitors describe their products, which capabilities they emphasize, and how they differentiate themselves.

You'll organize research findings into summaries, spreadsheets, and presentation materials that the team can use.

You'll assist with product launches by preparing draft content, organizing deliverables, tracking deadlines, and gathering feedback.

You'll work with product managers to understand upcoming features and help document their intended use cases.

You'll collaborate with technical stakeholders when additional product information is needed.

You'll help create materials that sales teams can use to explain features and answer common customer questions.

You'll also support customer success teams by developing educational content that helps customers understand and adopt new capabilities.

You'll receive direction on your assignments and have opportunities to take increasing ownership as you develop your skills.

  • Support the development of product positioning materials.

Job Title: Admin Assistant (Bookkeeping & Inventory Management)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Admin Assistant to support the financial and operational backbone of a creative, service-driven business. This role plays a critical part in maintaining accuracy across bookkeeping, payroll, inventory tracking, and vendor management while ensuring day-to-day operations remain organized, efficient, and reliable.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role ideal for someone who enjoys working with systems, numbers, documentation, and operational processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, and capable of independently managing multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

You will help create operational clarity by ensuring financial records, inventory systems, vendor relationships, and reporting processes are consistently maintained with precision and professionalism.

Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

  • Manage daily bookkeeping activities and maintain organized, accurate financial records
    • Process invoices, expenses, reconciliations, and transaction tracking
    • Support payroll calculations and ensure timely and accurate payment processing
    • Prepare and organize required financial and tax documentation
    • Assist in maintaining compliance with financial processes and reporting standards
    • Support implementation and optimization of accounting systems and workflows
    • Maintain organized digital records for financial reporting and audit readiness

Inventory Management

  • Monitor inventory levels, stock movement, and usage trends
    • Coordinate inventory ordering and restocking processes
    • Maintain accurate inventory tracking systems and documentation
    • Identify shortages, overstocking, or inefficiencies and proactively recommend solutions
    • Generate inventory reports and cost tracking summaries as needed

Vendor & Expense Management

  • Build and maintain professional vendor relationships
    • Track vendor invoices, contracts, payment schedules, and obligations
    • Execute expense management and vendor optimization initiatives
    • Coordinate vendor communications regarding orders, billing, or service issues
    • Support cost control and operational efficiency efforts

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Maintain organized documentation across bookkeeping, inventory, and vendor systems
    • Create and update spreadsheets, trackers, and operational reports
    • Support internal process consistency and administrative workflows
    • Ensure data accuracy across reports, systems, and operational records
    • Assist leadership with administrative and operational support tasks as needed

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly detail-oriented with strong accuracy and organizational discipline
    • Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment
    • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities calmly
    • Enjoys creating structure, maintaining systems, and improving operational processes
    • Communicates professionally and effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
    • Process-driven with strong ownership and follow-through

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting support, or financial administration
    • Hands-on experience with inventory management and vendor coordination
    • Strong proficiency with QuickBooks, Square, or similar accounting/payment systems
    • Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, analysis, and tracking
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage workflows independently

Preferred Experience & Tools

  • Previous experience supporting small businesses, creative agencies, or service-based businesses
    • Familiarity with U.S. small business tax processes and compliance requirements
    • Experience with inventory management systems and operational reporting
    • Exposure to payroll processing and vendor contract management
    • Experience creating operational SOPs or process documentation

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
    • Relevant certifications or bookkeeping/accounting training are a plus

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

An Admin Assistant in this role focuses on maintaining operational accuracy and supporting efficient business workflows. You will:

  • Manage and reconcile financial transactions and bookkeeping records
    • Process payroll-related tasks and maintain compliance documentation
    • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate restocking activities
    • Communicate with vendors and manage payment tracking
    • Update spreadsheets, reports, and operational documentation
    • Support process organization and improve administrative efficiency

In essence: you ensure financial accuracy, operational consistency, and organized systems that help the business run smoothly every day.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of bookkeeping and payroll processing
    • Inventory accuracy and stock availability
    • Vendor performance and expense optimization
    • Compliance with reporting and documentation requirements
    • Organization and reliability of operational systems and records
    • Timely completion of administrative and financial workflows

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Recruiter

  • Practical Assessment (Bookkeeping or Inventory Management Scenario)
    • Final Interview

Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.

We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. Position Overview

Mashgin is seeking a technically skilled, resourceful, and customer-focused Sales Engineer to support both prospective and existing customers throughout their journey with Mashgin. This is a full-lifecycle, customer-facing technical role spanning discovery, solution design, technical demonstrations, integrations, pilot execution, deployment readiness, and complex technical initiatives.

  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Sales and existing account teams to understand customer workflows, technical requirements, infrastructure, and expansion opportunities.

  • Coordinate escalations with Support, Product, Engineering, and partners; communicate findings, workarounds, and next steps.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

  • Translate customer needs and field observations into actionable technical requirements and product feedback.

  • Help prioritize technical dependencies and communicate feasibility, tradeoffs, and customer impact across teams.

  • Create and maintain integration guides, testing procedures, troubleshooting notes, and reusable implementation documentation.

  • Share technical knowledge with internal teams and contribute to scalable Sales Engineering processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Technical ownership: independently move complex technical work toward a clear outcome.

  • Integration quality: validate workflows thoroughly and surface issues before customer impact.

  • Communication: provide timely, accurate, actionable updates and dependable handoffs.

Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Growth & Development

Growth may include greater ownership of strategic integrations, technical mentorship, Senior Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Sales Engineering leadership responsibilities. jobs.description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.

What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.

  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

jobs.description:
About RemotePass
RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries. Recognised as one of G2’s Top 100 Fastest Growing Software Products, we’re on a mission to break down geographical barriers and create a world where exceptional talent can thrive anywhere.

From hiring and onboarding to payroll, compliance, and financial services, we give organisations everything they need to build high-performing global teams, and give workers worldwide access to opportunities that were once out of reach.

We’re backed by world-class investors including EBRD Venture Capital, 500 Global, Endeavor Catalyst, BECO Capital, Wamda Capital, 212 VC, Oraseya Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Access Bridge Ventures.

About the Role
Every month, employees across the GCC rely on us to pay them accurately and on time, mostly through our network of EOR partners. We’re hiring a Senior Payroll Specialist to own payroll operations across the GCC, led by Saudi Arabia and the UAE, along with Egypt and Jordan. You’ll report to our Payroll Team Lead for APAC & GCC.

This isn’t a pure payroll processing role. GCC payroll is simple on paper, with no income tax and limited statutory contributions. The real complexity sits around it: managing several EOR partners per country, reviewing invoices, handling immigration costs for a largely expat workforce, and making sure partners are funded before payday.

You’ll be the main point of contact for your partners and work closely with Payroll, Finance, Employee Experience, Customer Success, and EOR Partnerships.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle. Collect client inputs by the cutoff, send them to partners, and get outputs and invoices back on a tight timeline. Deliver accurate client invoice breakdowns to Finance by their monthly deadline.
  • Manage partners, don’t wait on them. Set clear timelines with each EOR partner, chase early, and push back when needed. Some countries have more than one partner, so you’ll often handle several payroll outputs for the same market.
  • Keep invoicing accurate. Review partner invoices, payroll outputs, and immigration-related costs. Reconcile them, spot errors, and resolve them before anything is billed or paid.
  • Plan funding backwards from payday. Work with Finance so partners receive funds in time, accounting for cross-border transfer times.
  • Resolve issues fast, and escalate early. Own discrepancies and employee queries through to resolution. Flag blockers to your Team Lead as soon as they appear, not on deadline day.
  • Get employees payroll-ready. Make sure banking details, payroll profiles, and visa and immigration requirements are in place before an employee’s first pay run.
  • Improve how payroll runs. Spot recurring partner issues and workflow gaps, share them with Product and Operations, and help document processes that scale as headcount grows.

Requirements

  • 5 years+ in payroll operations, ideally including at least 2 years in an EOR or global payroll environment.
  • A clear understanding of how EOR works: the partner is the legal employer, funds must reach them before payday, and timelines run backwards from there.
  • Hands-on experience managing EOR partners or third-party payroll providers.
  • Experience reviewing payroll outputs and payroll invoices for accuracy.
  • Highly organised, able to prioritise when every deadline lands in the same week.
  • Independent: you own your countries without needing every step checked.
  • Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical payroll topics in plain language.
  • Willing to work Gulf Standard Time (Dubai) hours.

Nice to Have

  • Arabic, which is a strong plus.
  • Payroll experience in the GCC or APAC, including visa and immigration costs.
  • Experience in a high-volume, multi-client payroll environment.
  • Experience with payroll platforms, HRIS, or operational systems.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If

  • You’d rather set a partner’s deadline than wait on it.
  • You tackle the hardest work first instead of leaving it to the last day.
  • You raise your hand early when something looks off.
  • You like fixing the process, not just the one-off error.

Benefits

Why Join RemotePass?

  • See every side of global payroll, from partner management and invoicing to funding and product, not just processing.
  • Shape how payroll scales across the GCC, one of our highest-volume regions.
  • Profitable, and still scaling fast. We reached profitability in 2025 and just raised a $17.4M Series B led by EBRD, with 500 Global joining. You get the pace of a scale-up with the stability of a business that works.
  • Real global scale. We support 35,000+ workers in 150+ countries and have processed over $800M in cross-border payroll for companies like Logitech, Tata Group, and Careem.
  • Big bets ahead. We’re expanding across Europe and the US, building financial products for distributed teams, and investing heavily in AI. There’s a lot to build, and room to grow with it.
  • Remote-first, for real. We don’t just sell remote work, we live it. Work from anywhere.
  • Inclusion matters. We value different perspectives and empower everyone to bring their authentic self to work.

About From Day One:

The business landscape is changing fast. From Day One is a media outlet and conference series that helps companies navigate all that change in ways that put people first.

Since our beginning in 2018, we've reached over 150,000 attendees, hosted over a thousand speakers, and produced conferences in more than 20 major U.S. cities–and counting. We take a unique, cross-disciplinary approach, convening leaders in CSR, HR, marketing, and communications, as well as civic leaders, authors, and journalists, to share business strategies that benefit workers, customers, and communities.

We also publish reporting and opinion pieces by a network of notable journalists, led by the company's editor in chief, veteran journalist Stephen Koepp.

At From Day One, we hire people who have a high degree of self-motivation and the potential to grow into active leaders. We call team members like these "drivers". If you are a passenger, From Day One will not be a good fit for you.

As you apply, think about whether these attributes describe you:

  • You motivate and energize colleagues rather than waiting for inspiration.
  • You're relentlessly resourceful and take ownership rather than seeking excuses. .
  • You look to consistently deliver great outcomes, and work to improve processes as you engage with them.
  • You are excited about your work and bring urgency to your mission.
  • You approach challenges with enthusiasm and optimism.

Our work is driven by our mission to improve the relationship between business and society, and our efforts are intended to contribute to a brighter future. By maintaining this optimistic outlook, we not only motivate ourselves but also uplift those around us. We believe that believing that the future will be better is the first step towards making it better -- for others, and for ourselves personally.

Please note that diversity and inclusion are absolutely core to our mission, and we are committed to those values in our hiring process.

About This Role:

The Event Production & Client Success Manager manages the logistical needs of our production calendar for both live and virtual events, and owns the relationships with the sponsors who attend them.

Production is the larger share of the job, and volume is what defines it. In the next twelve months we are producing thirteen live conferences and a virtual conference every month. Several events sit at different planning milestones at once, and you would carry them without being told what is due next.

Key tasks include managing A/V teams on visual and audio production needs, review and management of rental orders, vendor requirements and temporary staff hiring, creation of venue layouts and detailed run-of-show schedules, execution of vendor contracts, and construction of the event budget. Much of the work is reconciliation — the A/V order against the current slate of content, the final catering guarantee against the projection it came from, the printed program against the website and the run of show.

Alongside production you would be the point of contact for a roster of our sponsors, administering their deliverables and making sure their experience on site earns a renewal. Producing the event and serving the client are the same job here, done by the same person, which is what makes both halves work.

This is a remote position, and also includes regular travel to other cities for in-person events.

Responsibilities:

Event Production

  • Run the full production process for assigned conferences from the 180-day milestone through post-event wrap-up, and lead the milestone production meetings along the way
  • Create detailed run-of-show schedules and venue layouts, and manage room capacity against the final slate of content and expected attendance
  • Manage A/V teams on visual and audio production needs, walking the order line by line as content changes
  • Review and manage rental orders and vendor requirements, and hire and coordinate temporary event staff
  • Own vendor contracts across venue, catering, A/V, rentals, video, and photography, including deadlines and certificates of insurance
  • Manage catering selections and final guarantees, and compare final numbers against projections
  • Build and maintain the event budget from signed contracts and estimates, and track costs against it as scope changes
  • Place badge, program, and signage orders against their drop-dead dates, and coordinate shipping and staff travel
  • Produce our virtual events on platforms such as Zoom — setting up templates, managing schedules, and ensuring staffing of key roles

Client Success

  • Act as point of contact for a roster of sponsors on their event logistics, escalating as needed
  • Administer all sponsor deliverables — advance materials, shipping of display items, presentation media
  • Assign sponsor table locations, and confirm sponsor and speaker registrations against the production plan
  • Conduct post-event feedback calls, and contribute to renewal rate and customer satisfaction scores

Requirements

  • This position requires a 4-year college/university degree at minimum
  • Candidates should have a strong academic background and a minimum of 3 years of full-time, professional post-graduation experience
  • Direct experience producing complex events — corporate or marketing events, executive gatherings, conferences, trade shows, festivals, or arts events — where you were accountable for the event coming off
  • Experience as a named point of contact for external clients, sponsors, or partners
  • Experience working in-house at a corporation at some point in your career, in any function. Our sponsors are corporate leaders, and the people who serve them best here have worked inside that environment themselves.
  • Experience carrying many concurrent events against fixed deadlines, and owning event budgets and vendor contracts
  • Comfort with project management software such as ClickUp, Asana, or Monday as a daily working tool
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills, and excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Willingness to travel regularly for events

Benefits

  • This is a full-time salaried position. Starting salary is $75,000 CAD per year with opportunities for regular advancement and raises.
  • This position is remote, but please be available to meet with stakeholders based in or near the greater Toronto area if requested.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Risk Governance Officer to help strengthen and embed effective risk management across Our Future Health.

Working closely with the Risk Governance Manager, you'll play an important role in identifying, assessing, monitoring and reporting on strategic, enterprise and organisational risks that could affect our ability to achieve our objectives.

This role focuses on the bigger picture of organisational risk, including financial sustainability, data security, delivery of strategic objectives, funding, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and reputational risks. You'll work with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure risks are understood, appropriately managed and considered in decision making.

Despite big improvements in healthcare in our lifetimes, today millions of people in the UK still live in poor health as they get older. Diseases like cancer, dementia, diabetes, and heart disease affect the lives of many people in our communities. Our goal is to create a world-leading resource for health research, to improve our understanding and spot the patterns of how and why common diseases start, so treatments can begin sooner and be more effective.

Our Future Health is the UK’s largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent, and treat diseases. We are a charity, supported by the UK Government, in partnership with charities and industry. We work closely with the NHS and with public authorities across all nations and regions of the UK.

This is a Fixed Term contract position for 18 months.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role, you’ll work collaboratively with colleagues across Our Future Health to coordinate risk governance processes and help embed a positive and pragmatic approach to risk management.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Coordinating day-to-day risk governance activities and regular risk review and reporting cycles.
  • Working with risk owners and stakeholders to maintain accurate risk information, monitor agreed actions and follow up on progress.
  • Supporting the implementation and ongoing embedding of Our Future Health’s Risk Management Framework.
  • Facilitating risk identification, assessment and review workshops with teams and stakeholders.
  • Coordinating the development, maintenance and review of organisational and operational risk registers, including tracking actions and escalating risks through the appropriate governance routes.
  • Reviewing risk information for completeness, consistency and alignment with the Risk Management Framework, providing constructive challenge where appropriate.
  • Producing clear, high-quality risk reporting, analysis and management information to support governance forums and decision making.
  • Supporting assurance activities and maintaining accurate governance records and documentation.
  • Building effective relationships across the organisation and helping colleagues take a pragmatic and proportionate approach to risk.
  • Supporting continuous improvement across risk governance and the wider Assurance function.

What this role is not focused on:

This is a risk governance role, not a specialist health and safety or clinical safety assessment role. It does not primarily involve carrying out technical assessments such as COSHH or infection prevention and control assessments, workplace safety inspections or site-level assessments.
