jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer success plays an important role in helping businesses get value from the platform. We value clear communication, strong customer relationships, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of customer outcomes.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts to build and manage long-term relationships with some of Bask Health's most important merchant customers.

This role is responsible for helping strategic accounts successfully adopt the platform, achieve their business goals, maintain healthy relationships, and identify opportunities for continued growth.

You'll serve as the primary post-sale relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic customers using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, business owners, and healthcare businesses that rely on our platform to support important parts of their operations.

You'll develop a strong understanding of each customer's business model, goals, operational challenges, and priorities.

You'll build relationships with founders, executives, business owners, and other key stakeholders.

You'll help customers understand how Bask Health's platform can support their businesses and improve their operational workflows.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a working understanding of these features so you can help customers adopt and use the platform effectively.

You'll guide strategic customers through onboarding and coordinate with internal teams to support successful implementation.

You'll help customers establish clear goals and develop account success plans aligned with their business objectives.

You'll maintain regular communication with strategic accounts to understand their progress, challenges, and future priorities.

You'll conduct structured account reviews to evaluate adoption, discuss business outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll proactively monitor customer engagement, product usage, and account health.

You'll identify early signs of dissatisfaction, operational difficulties, or potential churn.

You'll work with customers and internal teams to address those concerns before they become larger retention issues.

You'll help prepare accounts for renewals and participate in renewal discussions within Bask Health's approved commercial processes.

You'll also identify opportunities for account expansion when additional platform capabilities align with customer needs.

You'll collaborate with sales and leadership when expansion opportunities require additional commercial involvement.

You'll be expected to understand the business impact of customer issues and prioritize communication accordingly.

You'll coordinate with technical support and customer success engineering teams when customers encounter complex platform problems.

You'll work with product and engineering teams to communicate recurring customer challenges and product feedback.

You'll help customers understand product updates and how new features may support their goals.

You'll manage customer escalations while maintaining clear communication and accountability.

You'll follow through on commitments and keep customers informed about relevant updates and next steps.

You'll maintain accurate records of customer conversations, account health, renewal timelines, and outstanding action items.

You'll use CRM and customer success tools to organize your portfolio and track important account information.

You'll work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure strategic customers receive coordinated support.

You'll help identify recurring challenges across strategic accounts and recommend improvements to customer success processes.

You'll contribute to customer education resources, account management playbooks, and retention initiatives.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to recognize when a concern requires involvement from the appropriate clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or technical team.

You'll coordinate communication and follow-up without making clinical or pharmacy decisions outside your responsibilities.

You'll work in a remote, cross-functional environment where clear communication, initiative, and accountability are important.

We're looking for someone with meaningful post-sale customer success experience and recent, substantive experience supporting e-commerce businesses or merchant-facing software.

You should be comfortable working directly with entrepreneurs, business owners, and executive stakeholders.

You'll need to be organized, proactive, commercially aware, and capable of managing important customer relationships independently.

Success in this role means helping strategic customers adopt Bask Health effectively, maintain healthy accounts, renew their relationships, and find additional value in the platform over time.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of strategic merchant accounts throughout the post-sale lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned strategic customers.
  • Build strong relationships with founders, executives, and business decision-makers.
  • Guide strategic customers through onboarding and platform adoption.
  • Coordinate customer transitions from sales to customer success.
  • Develop account success plans aligned with customer business goals.
  • Understand each customer's business model, workflows, and priorities.
  • Help customers navigate Bask Health's platform and available capabilities.
  • Support adoption of merchant storefront and checkout features.
  • Help customers understand questionnaires and other supported workflows.
  • Conduct regular strategic account check-ins and business reviews.
  • Monitor customer engagement, product adoption, and account health.
  • Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or churn risk.
  • Develop proactive retention plans for at-risk strategic accounts.
  • Support customer renewals and related account conversations.
  • Identify appropriate account expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate with sales on strategic commercial opportunities.
  • Coordinate technical troubleshooting with support and engineering teams.
  • Manage customer escalations and maintain clear follow-up communication.
  • Communicate product updates and relevant feature improvements.
  • Gather customer feedback and share insights with internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and strategic account documentation.
  • Track customer goals, renewal timelines, and outstanding action items.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to improve platform utilization.
  • Collaborate with product teams on recurring strategic account challenges.
  • Recommend improvements to customer onboarding and education materials.
  • Support customer success process improvements and account management playbooks.
  • Use available customer data to prioritize outreach and account activities.
  • Coordinate with appropriate operations stakeholders when necessary.
  • Escalate clinical and pharmacy concerns to authorized teams.
  • Maintain professional communication with customer executives and stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of strategic account outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant customer success, strategic account management, or closely related post-sale experience.
  • At least 2 full years of genuine post-sale customer success ownership.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, or expansion.
  • Recent, substantive experience working directly with e-commerce businesses, online merchants, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • E-commerce experience within approximately the past 4 years.

  • Experience using CRM or customer success management tools.
  • Ability to maintain accurate account notes and customer records.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and proactive communication.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Strong ownership mentality and commitment to customer outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing high-value or strategic merchant accounts.
  • Experience working at an e-commerce SaaS company.

  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, Yotpo, or similar tools.

  • Experience working with customer success engineering teams.

jobs.excerpt: World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a creative and community-minded Livestream Fundraising Intern to help grow and support our network of streamers and online creators.
jobs.description:
World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a creative and community-minded Livestream Fundraising Intern to help grow and support our network of streamers and online creators. The intern will focus on building relationships, providing campaign resources, and fostering engagement across platforms like Discord, Twitch, and YouTube, helping creators inspire their audiences to protect nature and wildlife.

Responsibilities

  • Community Engagement: Support the growth and day-to-day engagement of WWF’s livestream fundraising community on Discord and other social platforms. Help foster a safe and welcoming space where streamers can connect, share ideas, and celebrate their impact.
  • Streamer Outreach & Support: Assist in identifying, onboarding, and supporting streamers participating in WWF’s fundraising campaigns on platforms such as Twitch and YouTube. Provide resources, answer questions, and help participants feel connected to WWF’s mission.
  • Campaign Coordination: Contribute to planning and coordination for WWF’s 2027 livestream fundraising campaigns, including timelines, communications, and activation events. Support fundraisers before, during, and after campaigns. Ensure community members have a positive experience and see the impact of their participation.
  • Content Development: Help create digital materials such as campaign toolkits, graphics, and promotional assets that support streamers and highlight their fundraising efforts.
  • Data & Insights: Track and analyze community engagement and campaign performance metrics to inform strategy and identify areas for improvement.

Minimum Requirements

  • Pursuing either an Associate’s or Bachelor’s or Graduate Degree program in communications, marketing, digital media, or a related field. Those studying outside these areas are still encouraged to apply.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; proficiency with Discord, Twitch and livestreaming tools (i.e. Streamlabs), basic graphic design and video editing skills.
  • Excellent research skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Organized and self-motivated
  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:
    • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.
    • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability, and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.
    • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.
    • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

Preferred Qualifications

Highly knowledgeable in online streaming platforms, including but not limited to:

  • Twitch
  • Discord
  • YouTube / YouTube Live
  • Twitter/X
  • Instagram
  • TikTok
  • Facebook Live

Benefits:

  • Gain hands-on experience in digital marketing and livestreaming.
  • Contribute to meaningful conservation efforts.
  • Work with a passionate and supportive team.
  • Opportunity for mentorship and professional development.

Location:

Washington, DC based or US Remote – WWF employs in all states with the exception of: Hawaii, Kentucky, Nevada, Oklahoma.

Compensation:

$21-$23 per hour full-time at 35 hours per week. Must be available after normal working hours (campaign calls tend to be at 6pm ET on Mondays) and available during streams (usually later afternoon/evening/late evening).

How to apply:

Please submit a resume & cover letter through our Careers page. If selected for the role, you will need to provide 1 letter of recommendation as part of the WWF application process.

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.  In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

WWF does not provide VISA sponsorship to interns.

World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Founded in 1961, WWF works to help people and nature thrive. As a global conservation organization, WWF operates in more than 100 countries, partnering with communities, companies, and governments to protect wildlife, conserve vital habitats, and advance sustainable solutions. Grounded in science and driven by collaboration, WWF works to help nature by conserving biodiversity, supporting resilient communities, and addressing climate change. Nearly 1 million people in the United States and more than 5 million globally are WWF members.

Field marketing and sales enablement are where you must be great; product marketing is a close second.

  • Field marketing: You treat conferences and webinars as revenue channels. You pick events based on where buyers actually are, book meetings weeks ahead, get Infilla onto panels, follow up within 48 hours, and report meetings and deals, not badge scans.

  • Product marketing and positioning: You translate features into the outcomes government buyers care about. “AI-powered search” becomes “fewer counter calls.” You know what the planning director, the building official, and the counter clerk each need to hear, and you can take a launch from “shipped” to “sales can pitch it” with one clear message.

  • Writing for buyers: You lead with the point, use real numbers instead of adjectives, and write in a plain, calm, nonpartisan tone government buyers trust. You can write a one-pager, a landing page, an event invite, and a case study, each in the right register.

  • Sales partnership: You hold yourself to pipeline and revenue. You ship materials sales actually uses, check whether they use them, and treat pushback from the field as input.

  • Scrappy, AI-leveraged execution: You’re a team of one who ships a good-enough version and iterates. You handle light design (Canva, Figma) and CRM hygiene yourself, and you say no to good ideas that won’t move pipeline this quarter.

NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED

  • Experience as the first marketer at seed or Series A vertical SaaS company

  • Public sector or GovTech experience, especially selling to cities, counties, or states

  • Familiarity with planning, permitting, housing, or building codes

  • Webinars or content programs that generated pipeline

  • Led a new product launch, not just feature launches

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don’t meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we’re ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

DETAILS

  • This is a remote US-based role. We prefer to start on a part-time or full-time contract-to-hire basis.

    • You will be expected to travel to US conferences 1-2 times a quarter

  • You will join the GTM team and report to the CEO

  • Full-time benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays.

  • We cannot sponsor visas at this time

THE PROCESS

We aim to make this happen in 1-2 weeks:

  1. Initial call with Savanna, our recruiter, to assess mutual fit (20 min)

  2. Field marketing deep dive with Jeff, our founding account executive, to assess field marketing skills (45 min)

  3. Artifact review & messaging exercise with Jenny, the CEO, to assess product marketing and positioning skills (60 min)

  4. Roadmap jam with Jenny to assess sales partnership and execution (60 min)

  5. 3+ reference checks

HOW WE WORK

  • Ideas > Hierarchy - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

  • Kind > Nice - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

  • Courage > Comfort - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

  • Hours > Weeks - Solve it in hours, not “eventually.” Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

  • Fix > Flag - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don’t wait for someone else to.

WHAT THIS ROLE ISN’T

  • You won’t own the core company narrative. You’ll carry it into every product and channel.

  • You won’t be our designer. Light one-pagers and booth materials, yes. Anything beyond that can be handled by design.

  • You won’t need to find case study customers. We’ll make the intros, and you’ll turn them into great stories.

LEGAL

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we’ll make it work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Verticals (AI Native)
jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products.

You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets.

You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket.

Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side.

In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands.
  • Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality.
  • Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and incident response.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards.
  • Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own.
  • Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs.
  • Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling.
  • A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner.
  • A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale."
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers.
  • Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it.
  • Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar.
  • Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems.
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms.
  • Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog).

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

  • Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner.
  • Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.excerpt: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company.
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Windows Device Engineer builds the endpoint agent that sits closest to the user. It runs on every Windows machine, sees the traffic, makes decisions locally, and never gets in the way.

You will own the Windows agent end to end, from the C# service and the filter-driver layer to the local TLS proxy and the on-device ONNX models that make real-time decisions. Your agent has to run on enterprise machines that already have Zscaler or Netskope installed, without breaking them or being broken by them.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are not hiring someone who has read about WFP. We are hiring someone who has shipped a network-layer agent to thousands of enterprise endpoints and has the debugging scars to prove it.

Job Description:

  • Own the Windows endpoint agent: You design, build, and maintain the agent as a production-grade Windows service in C#/.NET. You own its installation, auto-updates, resilience, and performance footprint on the end user’s machine.
  • Build the network interception layer: You work with the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) and filter drivers to intercept, redirect, and inspect traffic at the right layer. You know when to use a callout driver, when a user-mode redirect is enough, and what each choice costs.
  • Run a local TLS proxy: You build and harden the local proxy that terminates and inspects TLS traffic on the device. You handle certificate trust, pinning exceptions, and protocol edge cases without degrading the user’s browsing or application experience.
  • Ship on-device AI: You integrate and optimize ONNX models that run locally on the endpoint. That means real-time inference under tight CPU, memory, and latency budgets, with no round trip to the cloud for every decision.
  • Coexist with the enterprise security stack: You make sure the agent works alongside Zscaler, Netskope, and other SSE/SASE and EDR agents already on the machine. That covers proxy chaining, WFP filter priorities, certificate stores, and the conflicts nobody documents.
  • Own quality in the field: You debug real customer environments using ETW traces, WinDbg, and packet captures. You harden the agent against crashes, network drops, and OS updates, and you report reliability in numbers, not anecdotes.

Requirements

  • Seasoned Windows systems engineer: 5+ years of experience building Windows desktop or system-level software in C#/.NET. You are comfortable with Windows services, the Win32 APIs, P/Invoke, and the line between user mode and kernel mode.
  • Deep network-layer experience: You have built with the Windows Filtering Platform or filter drivers in production. You understand TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.2/1.3 well enough to intercept them without breaking them. You have built or maintained a local proxy.
  • Shipped alongside Zscaler or Netskope: You have shipped an endpoint product that had to coexist with Zscaler, Netskope, or a similar SSE/SASE agent on enterprise devices. You know what goes wrong when two agents fight over the same traffic, and how to fix it.
  • On-device ML experience: You have integrated ONNX Runtime, or a similar inference engine, into a client application and tuned it for performance on real user hardware. Experience with DirectML or quantized models is a strong plus.
  • Proof of shipping: You can walk us through an endpoint agent you shipped to production: its architecture, the hardest bug you chased, and what you would do differently. Enterprise deployment experience with MSI/MSIX, Intune or SCCM, and code signing is a plus.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain a driver-level trade-off to a product manager and a deployment issue to a client’s IT team in plain English. You have worked with US or Western teams.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Discovery to help build intelligent systems that make information easier to find, understand, and use across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health brings together patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools. As the platform grows, users and internal teams need efficient ways to locate relevant information, navigate complex workflows, and discover the resources they need.

You'll help develop machine learning-powered search and discovery capabilities that improve how information is retrieved, ranked, and presented across our applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines information retrieval, machine learning, backend development, and modern AI technologies. You'll work with search indexes, embeddings, vector databases, ranking algorithms, APIs, and structured application data to build reliable search experiences.

Your work may include semantic search, hybrid keyword and vector retrieval, intelligent filtering, query understanding, search relevance improvements, and retrieval systems that support AI-powered assistants.

You'll collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, applied AI engineers, and other machine learning specialists to understand user needs and translate them into measurable search improvements.

You'll also help establish evaluation methods for search quality, including relevance testing, ranking metrics, query analysis, and performance monitoring. You'll use real-world usage patterns and evaluation results to identify opportunities to improve retrieval accuracy and user experience.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, search systems must respect appropriate access controls, data privacy requirements, and tenant boundaries. You'll help ensure users only retrieve information they are authorized to access.

This position emphasizes practical implementation and continuous improvement. You'll work with senior engineers on more complex architectural decisions while independently delivering search features, retrieval services, and ranking improvements.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys solving information retrieval problems, understands the tradeoffs between search relevance and system performance, and wants to build search experiences that are genuinely useful.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain intelligent search and discovery capabilities across Bask Health's applications.
  • Develop search services that retrieve relevant information from approved platform data sources.
  • Implement semantic search using embeddings and vector-based retrieval.
  • Build hybrid search systems that combine keyword matching with semantic retrieval.
  • Develop ranking and reranking approaches that improve search result relevance.
  • Implement query processing, normalization, and understanding capabilities.
  • Build search indexes and data pipelines that keep searchable information accurate and up to date.
  • Develop APIs that expose search and retrieval functionality to other applications.
  • Integrate search capabilities into merchant-facing and internal platform tools.
  • Support information retrieval for AI assistants and retrieval-augmented generation systems.
  • Implement filtering and metadata-based retrieval for structured application information.
  • Develop search functionality that respects user permissions and tenant boundaries.
  • Build automated tests for search behavior, retrieval quality, and ranking performance.
  • Create evaluation datasets that represent realistic search queries and expected results.
  • Measure search relevance using appropriate retrieval and ranking metrics.
  • Analyze search failures, missing results, and low-quality rankings.
  • Improve search quality through experimentation and iterative model or algorithm changes.
  • Evaluate embedding models and retrieval configurations for different use cases.
  • Implement monitoring for search latency, availability, and retrieval performance.
  • Optimize search infrastructure for efficient indexing and query execution.
  • Work with backend engineers to integrate search services into existing application architecture.
  • Collaborate with product teams to identify high-value search and discovery use cases.
  • Develop tools for debugging search results and understanding ranking behavior.
  • Support search-related experimentation and controlled feature rollouts.
  • Improve the reliability and maintainability of search pipelines and services.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and architecture discussions.
  • Document search configurations, evaluation methods, and implementation decisions.
  • Own assigned search and discovery projects from development through deployment and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, search engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience building and maintaining production software applications or data-driven systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with information retrieval and search system fundamentals.
  • Experience developing backend services and application APIs.
  • Understanding of search indexing, query processing, and ranking concepts.
  • Familiarity with machine learning methods used for search or information retrieval.
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Understanding of database queries and application data models.
  • Familiarity with embeddings and vector-based similarity search.
  • Experience integrating search functionality into software applications.
  • Understanding of search relevance and retrieval quality evaluation.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and production software development practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting application performance and data quality issues.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure data access.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Ability to analyze search results and identify relevance problems.
  • Understanding of system performance, latency, and scalability considerations.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into technical search functionality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers and engineers.
  • Ability to independently own assigned technical projects.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building semantic search or hybrid search applications.
  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or comparable search technologies.
  • Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector.
  • Experience implementing retrieval-augmented generation systems.
  • Familiarity with embedding models and vector similarity techniques.
  • Experience with learning-to-rank or neural reranking approaches.
  • Understanding of BM25 and traditional information retrieval algorithms.
  • Familiarity with search evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG.
  • Experience building search relevance evaluation datasets.
  • Experience with query rewriting, expansion, or intent classification.
  • Familiarity with large language models and AI-powered search applications.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Experience building search features for SaaS or e-commerce platforms.
  • Familiarity with product catalogs, merchant data, or operational knowledge systems.
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with AWS or serverless infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines and event-driven indexing.
  • Experience implementing permission-aware retrieval in multi-tenant applications.
  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Help train AI for smart TVs. You'll film a short video of your face, then a series of short videos in your living room while a set clip plays on your TV. Step-by-step instructions on YouTube show you exactly what to do, and you upload everything through the Mindrift app.

We're looking for US-based participants to record a short set of videos at home for a smart TV AI project. There is no prior experience required: you follow the video instructions and record with your own iPhone. On this project, participants will:

  • Record a short video of their face;
  • Record a series of short videos in their living room while a set clip plays on the TV, following the step-by-step YouTube instructions (sitting on the couch, moving in front of the TV, using a few everyday items);
  • Set up the phone on a tripod or phone holder and keep the whole setup within about 10 ft of the TV;
  • Upload all recordings through the Mindrift app over Wi-Fi.

It's a one-time task: once your recordings are approved, you're done and you get paid.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Record and upload the videos → Get paid

This is a one-time task. Recording takes about 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time on Wi-Fi. You choose when to record. Recordings need to follow the instructions and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical architecture and delivery of our Home Design Experience application, a browser-based 3D tool that lets anyone design a home. You’ll report to the VP of Engineering and serve as the primary technical partner to the team’s product/UX lead.

As the HDE team’s most experienced engineer, you’ll make consequential technical decisions, write production code, and help other engineers deliver. Your immediate focus will be getting the application into customers’ hands. Along the way, you’ll partner with our platform team to establish shared foundations and patterns that other Higharc applications can reuse.

What You'll Do

You’ll need to move fast, make good calls under ambiguity, and turn rough product ideas into working software that customers can pick up and use without a manual. You'll work across the primary UI as well as AI-supported and agentic experiences, and you'll partner with the other staff-level engineers at Higharc to give the company's technical strategy real shape.

Expect to:

  • Rapidly prototype new home design workflows and turn the ones that land into customer-ready software

  • Lead development of interactive 3D home design workflows, connecting the application UI, design data, and real-time 3D scene into a responsive experience. Build AI-supported and agentic interactions that help users design their homes.

  • Own application architecture and technical delivery from early prototypes through production. Make decisions across the frontend, application state, and service integration, including performance, reliability, and testing.

  • Be an independent technical partner to the product/UX lead: challenge assumptions, identify risks early, propose alternatives, and help decide what to build next.

  • Turn ambiguous goals into concrete implementation plans, resolve technical unknowns through working code, and implement the critical pieces yourself to keep delivery moving.

  • Partner with the platform team to use and improve shared application foundations. Identify which patterns should be reused across Higharc and help implement and document them, keeping immediate product delivery central to those decisions.

  • Help less experienced engineers take ownership through pairing, code review, and clear technical guidance. Establish patterns they can confidently extend.

About You

You've shipped products that solve genuinely hard problems in a way that feels effortless to the end user, and you know how much unglamorous work sits behind that kind of simplicity. You're comfortable being the most senior engineer in the room without needing everything decided before you start building, and you know how to narrow scope, ship useful increments, and make technical decisions that support continued delivery.

You have:

  • A track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping substantial web applications, with responsibility for technical decisions from initial implementation through production use.

  • Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, and modern web application architecture, including application state, API integration, performance, and maintainability.

  • A strong plus: hands-on experience with Three.js and browser-based 3D applications, especially design or CAD tools. You’ll be helping people design homes in 3D, so experience making complex spatial interactions intuitive is particularly valuable.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-forward development and for building AI-supported or agentic product experiences

  • Experience making technical decisions independently in partnership with a product or design lead. You can explain tradeoffs, challenge a proposed approach constructively, and commit to a path forward.

  • Sound judgment about what to build for the immediate product and what to generalize for reuse, with experience collaborating across application and platform teams.

  • Experience helping less experienced engineers deliver through implementation, mentoring, and technical guidance.

  • A growth mindset and real ease with ambiguity, on a team and product area that's still being defined

  • Strong instincts for design and craft, even though you're not the designer on the team

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

We’re looking for a hands-on strategist with strong direct-response fundamentals, visual creative instincts, and experience evaluating Meta creative at scale. You should be able to explain why an ad converts, show how you helped make it work, and identify what to test next. Success means discovering new sources of growth and increasing the profitable spend supported by what’s already working.

What You'll Own

Build Deep Customer Intelligence That Drives Creative

The creative portfolio is only as good as the customer understanding behind it. You'll own that understanding for every lane you're assigned.

  • Establish a research foundation for each lane using customer reviews, interviews, surveys, comments, competitor analysis, and performance insights.
  • Develop specific personas grounded in real desires, fears, objections, buying triggers, necessary beliefs, and actual moments where our products matter to customers.
  • Translate research into actionable creative opportunities, with clear customer insights and hypotheses behind every new concept direction.

Discover New Angles and Open New Acquisition Opportunities

You'll build new sources of acquisition growth while systematically expanding proven winners.

  • Continuously identify and test new customer segments, purchase motivations, use cases, and creative territories that aren't yet represented in the portfolio.
  • Produce new winning angles that can sustain meaningful spend within lane-specific acquisition targets.
  • Maintain a deliberate discovery pipeline that broadens the portfolio's sources of growth rather than concentrating on the same angles until they exhaust themselves.
  • Personally develop angles, hooks, and scripts using direct-response fundamentals: consumer psychology, awareness levels, market sophistication, necessary beliefs, mechanisms, proof, and storytelling. Compress the core promise into clear, compelling hooks.

Develop Winning Visual Formats and Executions

You'll own how an idea is packaged visually, from the opening hook through the proof that makes it persuasive.

  • Identify, adapt, and develop visual formats that make customer insights compelling across UGC, native content, demonstrations, animation, creator-led storytelling, and static creative.
  • Define how each concept comes to life through opening visuals, demonstrations, shot direction, pacing, on-screen text, and editing direction.
  • Reverse-engineer successful paid and organic creative from competitors, other brands, and adjacent industries. Understand why it works and adapt the underlying approach to Freebird's customers and products.
  • Partner with creators, editors, and production to carry the strategic intent through the finished ad.

Build and Maintain a Diversified Creative Portfolio

You'll own a living creative territory map for every assigned lane. That map is not a filing system. It's the strategic view that tells us where we are, what we know, and where we need to go.

  • Track what is winning, declining, promising, under-tested, and unexplored across each lane.
  • Ensure purposeful coverage across priority personas, angles, awareness stages, formats, ad frameworks, and creator demographics.
  • Identify portfolio concentration and coverage gaps, then direct testing toward the opportunities most likely to improve acquisition performance.

Turn Strategy Into Clear, Executable Sprint Plans

Strategy that doesn't translate into production-ready direction is not strategy. It's ideas.

  • Build monthly Creative Portfolio Sprint Plans supporting 30 concepts per month per active lane.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on customer evidence, performance learnings, business needs, and production capacity.
  • Give writers and production clear direction on audience, awareness level, customer tension, angle, hypothesis, mechanism, proof, visual format, and opening execution.
  • Deliver on time and resolve strategic questions quickly enough to support the sprint cadence.

Systematically Expand Winning Creative

  • Identify what is actually driving a winner's performance: the customer insight, message, proof, or execution that's making it work.
  • Build expansion plans across relevant personas, hooks, formats, creators, proof, scripts, stories, and demonstrations.
  • Increase the profitable spend supported by winning territories while continuing to develop new opportunities alongside them.
  • Recognize declining performance early and direct the next wave of expansion or discovery before the territory runs dry.

Build a Reliable Performance Learning Loop

  • Partner with Paid Media and Analytics to evaluate creative by CAC, purchase volume, and profitable spend potential across lanes, personas, angles, concepts, and formats.
  • Understand how Meta testing and delivery affect results. Distinguish proven winners, clear losses, and inconclusive tests by considering spend, purchase volume, distribution, and execution quality.
  • Use hook, hold, click, and engagement metrics to diagnose performance alongside acquisition outcomes.
  • Turn completed tests into clear decisions: expand, revise, retest, deprioritize, or explore further.
  • Feed findings back into territory maps, briefs, and sprint priorities so the portfolio actually improves with each cycle rather than repeating the same tests.

Raise the Strategic Quality of the Creative Team

  • Give writers, creators, and production a shared understanding of who we are speaking to, what we need them to believe, and why a concept should work.
  • Coach writers on customer insight, angle development, persuasion, and strategic coherence.
  • Partner with creator leadership to identify the talent, demonstrations, stories, and footage needed to execute the portfolio strategy.
  • Build reusable briefs, examples, and decision rules that help the team make stronger decisions independently over time.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months:

  • You have a strategy with clear coverage across personas, angles, formats, and awareness stages.
  • Sprint plans are running on time with clear strategic direction that writers and production can execute without ambiguity.
  • You've discovered multiple new angles or customer segments that weren't in the portfolio before and have shown evidence of scaling.
  • Proven winners are supporting more profitable spend through systematic expansion across hooks, formats, creators, proof, and scripts.
  • Your visual and messaging decisions are producing creative that meets lane-specific CAC targets and supports meaningful purchase volume.
  • The performance learning loop is working: completed tests are turning into clear decisions, not just data.
  • Writers and creators are producing stronger work because the briefs are better.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated success developing performance creative strategy for DTC or ecommerce brands, with real acquisition results you can speak to specifically.
  • A demonstrated record of both discovering new winning angles and expanding proven creative into additional profitable spend.
  • Hands-on experience conducting customer research: reviews, interviews, surveys, VOC analysis. You know how to get beneath surface-level demographics to actual motivations and beliefs.
  • Experience directing writers and collaborating with creators, editors, production, and paid media teams. You can translate strategy into clear direction.
  • Evidence of managing creative strategy across multiple products, audiences, or acquisition portfolios simultaneously.
  • Strong commercial judgment: you understand how creative performance connects to CAC, contribution economics, and business results, not just engagement metrics.
  • Hands-on experience developing and evaluating Meta acquisition creative at meaningful spend levels.
  • Strong visual creative judgment and hands-on direct-response copywriting skills, supported by examples of ads you helped develop and scale.
  • AI fluency and a resourceful approach to workflow improvement, using modern tools to accelerate research, ideation, scripting, and execution while maintaining quality.

Benefits

Why Freebird

  • Remote-first & flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy, trust, and meaningful overlap with US working hours.
  • Competitive compensation & benefits. Competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) with company match, and unlimited PTO.
  • A profitable, high-growth brand. Join a 9-figure DTC brand with significant ad spend, an established creative operation, and plenty of opportunities to grow and make an impact.
  • Real ownership & accountability. Own your creative strategy, make decisions, and be directly accountable for performance and acquisition results.
  • Move fast and make an impact. We measure what matters, keep things simple, and turn great ideas into action without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • High autonomy, low politics. We trust people to do great work, make data-driven decisions, and take ownership without micromanagement.
  • A kind, people-focused culture. We communicate openly, collaborate, support each other, and celebrate wins together.
  • Always growing and improving. We embrace change, challenge ourselves to do better, and innovate without fear.

Lead the Delivery of the Army's Next-Generation Network!

Leidos is seeking an experienced Integration & Delivery Manager to establish and lead the Integration & Episodic Deployment Services organization supporting the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program through the CHS-6 contract vehicle.

This is an exciting opportunity to build and lead a technical delivery organization responsible for integrating, deploying, and supporting modern network infrastructure across U.S. Army environments worldwide.

In this role, you'll oversee technical teams, deployment operations, subcontractors, budgets, and resources while ensuring network integration and installation projects are delivered successfully.

We're looking for a proven leader with strong technical program management experience, enterprise networking knowledge, and the ability to manage complex deployments across multiple locations.


This is a leadership position focused on building a high-performing delivery organization—not simply managing individual projects.


What You'll Do

  • Establish and lead the AGUN Integration & Episodic Deployment Services organization, including staffing, processes, and performance expectations.
  • Manage multidisciplinary technical teams, including personnel development, workload management, and resource allocation.
  • Develop standardized, repeatable processes for network integration, installation, and deployment.
  • Oversee the development and delivery of standardized AGUN network node packages and related services.
  • Manage deployment activities from requirements and planning through installation, testing, and operational acceptance.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Logistics, Operations, Configuration Management, Contracts, and Business Development teams.
  • Develop deployment schedules, staffing plans, and resource strategies for projects across multiple locations.
  • Oversee installation subcontractors, ensuring quality, schedule compliance, and successful delivery.
  • Manage budgets, cost estimates, resource forecasts, and delivery performance.
  • Track KPIs related to deployment progress, schedule performance, costs, resource utilization, and operational readiness.
  • Identify and resolve technical, operational, financial, and organizational risks.
  • Ensure deployments meet DoD cybersecurity, configuration management, and contractual requirements.
  • Collaborate with Army stakeholders and program leadership to align delivery priorities with mission requirements.
  • Support customer engagements, technical demonstrations, and future modernization opportunities.
  • Lead process improvements to increase efficiency and support scalable deployment operations.
  • Coordinate with Operations leadership to ensure deployed network capabilities transition successfully into ongoing support.
  • Provide executive-level updates on delivery progress, staffing, budgets, risks, and overall program performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Management, or a related field with 10–12 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of management or leadership experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II qualification, as applicable to the assigned role and contract requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Experience managing technical integration, enterprise IT deployments, or large-scale technology modernization programs within DoD or federal environments.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams, managing personnel, and developing organizational capabilities.
  • Experience overseeing multiple concurrent deployments, subcontractors, and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, SD-WAN, systems integration, and IT infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, delivery schedules, resource forecasts, and performance metrics.
  • Ability to coordinate across engineering, logistics, operations, and program management teams.
  • Experience working directly with government customers and senior program leadership.
  • Strong leadership, strategic planning, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver against technical, contractual, and operational commitments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army network modernization or large DoD infrastructure programs.
  • Familiarity with the CHS-6 contract vehicle or similar DoD acquisition and integration contracts.
  • PMP certification.
  • Experience building or expanding technical integration and deployment organizations.
  • Experience developing standardized technical solutions, service offerings, and scalable deployment models.
  • Experience managing complex budgets, cost models, staffing forecasts, and subcontractor performance.
  • Experience overseeing simultaneous deployments across multiple geographic locations.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity, configuration management, and operational acceptance requirements.
  • Experience collaborating with Business Development, Contracts, and program leadership on new opportunities.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to build and lead a team that plays a critical role in modernizing the U.S. Army's global network infrastructure.

You'll work with experienced technical professionals, collaborate with government leadership, and drive large-scale integration and deployment initiatives that directly support military readiness.

If you're an experienced technical delivery leader who enjoys building teams, managing complex deployments, and driving mission-critical results, we want to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help deliver the future of Army network modernization. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

jobs.description:
About 8020REI

8020REI is a predictive data and marketing intelligence platform for acquisition-driven businesses. We started in real estate investing, grew into home services, and keep expanding wherever customer acquisition runs on data.

Using machine learning and the 80/20 principle, we help our clients know exactly who to target, how to reach them, and what to do next across direct mail, cold calling, SMS, and digital channels. We are a lean, remote-first team that works side by side with AI, with a world-class team at our core.

Our Core Values

  • Find a Better Way:We dig until we understand the real problem, then improve or innovate to solve it. Focused on the 20% that drives the biggest result.

  • Have Each Other's Back:We work as a team. We support, step in, and go the extra mile to create a great experience for each other and our clients.

  • Honor Your Word:We honor our promises, hold ourselves accountable, and do the right thing even when nobody’s looking.

  • Own Your Growth:We're obsessed with personal growth and take pride in the work we deliver. Intrinsically motivated, we hold ourselves to a high standard and never coast.

  • Bring Your A-Game:We take care of our recovery, health, and family time, and that’s why we show up focused, energized, and ready to perform at our best.

🎯 Role Overview

As an Engineering Manager, you will own the whole platform behind our product, back end and front end: everything that takes the data our data team publishes and puts it in front of every client. You make it reliable, fast, secure and worth what it costs, and you make sure we see a failure before a client does.

You are a strategic architect and an independent thinker who leads people well. You shape what we build, not just how: you question every request against the client's real need, propose the simplest design and avoid complexity that turns into debt. You lead a small team that uses AI to do more with less: we would rather have two great engineers using AI than a bigger team.

At least half your time is hands-on: architecture, design, reviewing code (including AI-written code) and building with AI agents. The rest is leading the team.

💡 Key Responsibilities

  • Own the platform end to end. Design and evolve the architecture of our whole platform, back end and front end, that takes the data our data team publishes and serves it to every client. Write down each major decision and why, and remove old shortcuts instead of rebuilding them.

  • Catch failures before clients do. Set up the alerts, testing and monitoring that surface problems before a client notices. After a serious failure, run a no-blame review, find the root cause (a missing test, alert, skill or owner) and fix it so it never repeats.

  • Keep critical services up, fast and current. Run our critical services to clear targets for uptime and response time, and make sure every client gets newly published data within a day.

  • Protect client data. Give every login only the access it needs, keep each client’s data apart, close security findings on time, and work with security specialists where it counts.

  • Own cloud cost. Keep the platform bill within budget and bring the cost per paid client down every quarter, without slowing anything down.

  • Challenge every request. Partner with Product to test each request against the client’s real need and its running cost, propose the simplest design, and put numbers on the tradeoffs. If Product uses 50 columns, we don’t serve 500.

  • Build hands-on with AI. Spend at least half your time on architecture, design and code review, including AI-written code. Design and supervise the AI-agent workflows that let a small team ship more, and track how often releases ship and break.

  • Lead a small, strong team. Coach instead of fixing it yourself, talk about performance in every 1:1, give honest feedback and address performance issues directly. Build the smallest team that can deliver.

  • Plan well and deliver on your commitments. Keep a clear roadmap of validated work so the team always knows what to build next. Estimate realistically and set dates you can stand behind. If a deadline is at risk, flag it early and come with a plan to get back on track.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients never find our failures first: we catch problems before they do, and none repeats.

  • Critical services stay up, fast and current for every client.

  • Infrastructure cost per paid client falls every quarter, within budget and without slowing anything down.

  • Client data stays safe.

  • The team always knows what to build next, and only builds work that has been validated.

  • You plan well and keep your commitments. If a deadline is at risk, you flag it early and come with a plan.

✅ Qualifications

We look at what you have done, not your job title.

  • You are an engineer: a degree in engineering or computer science (e.g. software, computer, or civil industrial engineering with IT). A master's degree is a plus.

  • You have owned a system in production and run it: you have lived through failures, fixed them and stopped them from coming back.

  • You build with AI coding agents today and review what they produce.

  • You have led a team of at least two engineers for at least two years, as a manager or a tech lead, and given them honest, direct feedback.

  • You are curious: you have become an expert in something on your own, because you wanted to, not because someone asked you to.

  • You question how things are done, you spot risks before anyone asks, and you only call a problem solved once you have proved the fix works.

  • You plan and estimate well, and you keep your commitments.

  • Fluent English.

Nice to Have

Experience with a software product that serves many clients from one platform (B2B or B2C), working next to a data team, managing a cloud budget, working with security specialists, or real estate, proptech or fintech. Your technology stack does not matter.

Why Join Us?

At 8020REI, you’ll help shape how real estate investors and home services businesses find their next customers. You’ll own meaningful work, use the latest AI tools, and grow alongside a high-performing team that gives honest feedback and celebrates wins together.

📝 What We Offer

  • Competitive Base Compensation

  • Performance Bonus (Profit Share)

  • Flexible Time Off (up to 26 days per year)

  • Home Office Upgrade Bonus

  • HMO Bonus

  • Fully Remote Work

  • Impact Moments: build homes for families in need, side by side with the team

  • Opportunities to grow with the company

  • Ongoing support and budget to develop new skills

Ready to help us build what’s next? Apply now. We’d love to hear from you.

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Merchant Platform & Growth to lead product positioning, go-to-market strategy, and merchant-focused growth initiatives at Bask Health.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

The Healthcare Data Solutions Architect role is ideal for an experienced data professional eager to put their domain knowledge and engineering expertise to work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment. Your efforts to organize, transform, and automate the flow of healthcare data will unlock actionable insights for our clients, enabling them to move from raw data to meaningful analysis in hours rather than weeks. You'll interpret and integrate client payer claims, ADT, clinical/EMR, provider billing, and other operational datasets into the Ursa Core Data Model, building reusable, enduring data models that clients rely on to drive clinical, operational, and financial decisions.

You will work closely with Ursa colleagues across analytics engineering, product development, and customer success, as well as directly with client teams including data architects, analysts, clinicians, and other healthcare professionals to understand their data and their needs. You'll leverage Ursa Health's data platform to design and build integration pipelines, data models and increasingly, work alongside AI-assisted tooling that accelerates the process.

About You

  • You're looking for a role that will allow you to apply your experience to a "blank canvas" to design and create elegant and enduring data models.
  • You have great attention to detail and enjoy the process of investigating and interpreting raw data. You anticipate dataset-specific inconsistencies and edge cases before they become problems.
  • You are a consultative partner by nature, comfortable working directly with a range of stakeholders (clinical, operational, data/technology, and actuarial) to understand how data was generated, what its limitations are, and how it will be used.
  • You are looking to join a collaborative team that is passionate about healthcare and strives to build best in class healthcare analytics.
  • You're curious by nature and excited to use technologies that allow you more time to explore, test, and iterate on the data model you design rather than worry about maintaining fragile code.
  • You have a deep understanding of health information systems, medical claims and/or billing data across payors and/or clinical data from your experience as a data architect and/or engineer.
  • You balance technical rigor with pragmatic elegance building solutions that are durable without being overcomplicated.
  • You've worked with AI tools and have developed a clear-eyed sense of where they help and where they don't especially in a domain where the cost of a wrong answer is high.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the integration of healthcare data packages including medical claims, pharmacy claims, revenue cycle billing, ADT, clinical/EMR, FHIR and value-based care financial datasets into custom or Ursa Studio standard data models through collaboration with client and Ursa Health teams.
  • Own end-to-end data solution architecture for ingesting, transforming, standardizing, and integrating complex healthcare datasets from multiple sources.
  • Design and maintain scalable, standardized healthcare data models.
  • Operationalize rigorous validation checks that preserve data integrity, prevent analytics degradation, and maintain client trust.
  • Engage with clients to understand their data, its limitations, and analytical use cases, enabling actionable insights and informed business decision making.
  • Collaborate with analytics engineers, customer success, and product teams to align delivery with client expectations and to surface product opportunities informed by client needs and data behavior.
  • Partner with customer's leadership team to define and execute strategic roadmaps for enterprise data architecture, integration modernization and AI adoption.
  • Thoughtfully leverage AI-assisted tooling to accelerate and improve delivery, applying domain knowledge and human judgment to ensure sound output.
  • Keep your knowledge current regarding data security and privacy procedures and policies. Comply with HIPAA procedures and collaborate with the Incident Response Team as directed.

Qualifications

Required 

  • Bachelor’s degree. 
  • 4+ years of experience working with any of the healthcare data domains ( e.g. claims, provider billing, clinical or pharmacy).
  • Familiarity with healthcare data integration concepts, common data sources (payer data files or clinical/ EMR systems), data formats (claims, provider billing or HL7 ADT/ FHIR).
  • 4+ years implementing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and processes. 
  • 4+ years of experience in end-to-end data integration (data discovery, scoping, data cleansing and curation, analysis, transformation, validation and maintenance). 
  • Demonstrated expertise in SQL, relational database technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL), enterprise data modeling with a strong focus on designing scalable, optimized and reusable data architectures.
  • Availability to work during U.S. Eastern (EST) or Central Time (CST) business hours.

Preferred 

  • Knowledgeable in healthcare interoperability / integration engines.
  • Experience with ELT or workflow orchestration tools such as Fivetran, dbt, SQLMesh, Dagster, or Airflow. While this role applies those concepts within Ursa Studio rather than using those tools directly, the ability to think in systems is a plus.
  • Experience building data models that support healthcare outcome measurement. Familiarity with value-based care data and financial models a plus.
  • Working understanding of Python or JavaScript to manipulate and transform large datasets and data science fundamentals.
  • Experience working with AI tools in a professional context, with the judgment to apply them appropriately in healthcare data environments where output accuracy is critical.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive organizational change, influence leadership, communicate effectively across technical and business stakeholders, deliver measurable business value through strategic technology initiatives.

Location

  • United States, Position is Remote

About the Role:

Reporting to the Customer Success & Engineering, the Customer Success Engineer's responsibilities include resolving customer concerns, creating and improving internal tooling, and engineering solutions to help Bask customers get the most out of the platform.

To be successful in this role, you must be an excellent communicator who's able to earn our customers' trust and understand technical problems quickly.
