Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.

  • Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.

  • Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.

Requirements

  • You understand modern web architecture, frontend frameworks like Next.js and React, cloud technologies, serverless computing and DNS.
  • You comprehend how metered usage and subscriptions work in a complex SaaS product.
  • You enjoy engineering solutions to resolve root causes of recurring problems.

  • You possess exceptional communication skills.
  • You have an inquisitive mind and lead by example.
  • You are comfortable working with a fully remote, globally distributed team.
  • You have a passion to deliver a customer experience second to none.
  • Availability to work within a weekend on-call rota.

Bonus If You:

  • Prefer to work a Saturday to Wednesday or Wednesday to Sunday schedule.
  • Have experience with SAAS and a good understanding of telehealth and e-commerce.
  • Work with monorepos and/or custom, complex CI/CD pipelines.

Benefits

Great compensation package and stock options.

Culture Focused. We prioritize building a high-performance culture of top talent. At Bask, you'll work with a team of smart, motivated and happy people who like to have fun.

Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

Overview

Overview:

HealthEdge is scaling its BPaaS operations and must demonstrate quantifiable returns on its product investment decisions. This role exists to own that proof.

The Sr. Business Operations Manager, Product Value Realization owns collaboration and value creation between HealthEdge's product organization (structured by product line) and its delivery organization (structured by function). This role drives high-priority delivery-originated requests through the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), ensuring that enhancement opportunities are properly framed, prioritized, and delivered, and that the value they were projected to create is rigorously validated after the fact.

Following delivery, the Sr. Business Operations Manager, Product Value Realization compares estimated vs. realized value to sharpen future assessments and inform prioritization. Requestors whose value estimates prove inaccurate will face heightened scrutiny on future submissions, creating accountability for credible business cases.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Product Governance & Initiative Execution
    • Own end-to-end PDLC governance for Delivery-originated requests across all phases: Articulate & Prioritize → Discovery → Solution & Size → Design & Build → Test → Release & Validate

    • Translate strategic themes into initiative plans with detailed milestones, deliverables, and accountable owners
    • Lead end-to-end execution across multiple workstreams, guiding cross-functional teams through delivery
    • Apply PDLC governance standards consistently; track progress, risks, issues, and outcomes with structured methods
    • Own the weekly Product + Delivery alignment forum and deployment readiness cadence; deliver executive-ready status reporting
  • Value Measurement & Realization

    • Quantitatively validate the value delivered by new functionality after release; compare actuals against the estimates that drove prioritization
    • Reinject realized value data back into the prioritization process to continuously improve the quality of the enterprise enhancement pipeline
    • Identify performance gaps and lead course correction when initiatives fall short of projected impact
    • Own the continuous improvement agenda for value assessment frameworks, execution processes, and tooling
  • Strategic Structuring & Problem Framing
    • Pressure-test assumptions and problem definitions to ensure initiatives are outcome-driven and value-accretive

    • Identify cross-functional trade-offs and present structured options to executive stakeholders

jobs.excerpt: Help Build the Next Chapter of Product Development at Fresh PrintsHi, I’m Andy, the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.
jobs.description:
Help Build the Next Chapter of Product Development at Fresh Prints

Hi, I’m Andy, the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.

Before Fresh Prints, I spent five years with a national fashion retail group in the Philippines, working my way from graphic designer to creative lead. When I joined Fresh Prints as a graphic designer in September 2024, I wanted to focus on designing again. Building a department wasn’t exactly the plan.

I was thrown into it pretty quickly. I’d expected to be designing email newsletters. Within my first month, I was in China meeting manufacturers and sourcing fabrics. Soon after, I became the first dedicated person in Product Development, figuring out how to build the function from the ground up.

Fresh Prints already had successful garments, but there was no established playbook for the department. I worked across Creative and Logistics, built our tech pack template, mapped development timelines, and brought in technical support. Together with the wider team, we expanded beyond a single supplier and launched products like our mock neck, which has sold over 40,000 units in less than two years.

I also had to learn what American college students wanted. Through our Fashion Council conversations, I learned to push past “that’s cute.” Was it the fit, fabric, or color? Would they actually buy it? Those answers shaped our products. Clear specs, careful sample reviews, and consistent follow-through helped bring them to life.

That’s what I value about working here. You can question a process, propose something better, and take responsibility for making it happen. My role grew because there was room to contribute beyond what I was hired to do.

Now, we’re looking for a Product Development Associate who enjoys the technical side of bringing garments to life. Someone who cares about the details, catches inconsistencies, and thinks about how their work affects the next person in the process:

  • Can a supplier follow these specs without guessing?
  • Do the sample, tech pack, art proof, and website information agree?
  • What needs to be resolved before this moves into production?

If you enjoy solving problems, getting the details right, and seeing your work become something people wear, I’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll work closely with our Product Development Team Lead to turn product ideas and revisions into clear, accurate technical information. Your day-to-day work will include:

  • Create and update tech packs for assigned new products, existing garment revisions, and Collab or client requests, including measurements, construction details, and fabric specifications.
  • Review samples and document feedback, including QA findings, technical issues, and required revisions.
  • Check art proofs and briefs for garment accuracy, print compatibility, and production limitations.
  • Support supplier development by preparing technical specifications, reviewing supplier submissions, and coordinating follow-ups with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Keep product information accurate across technical records and website descriptions, specifications, colorways, and imagery.
  • Support new product development through tasks assigned by the Team Lead, flagging missing information, discrepancies, and potential production issues.

Your focus is to make sure other teams have complete, accurate product information they can confidently use.

Key Skills & Personal Attributes:

  • Commercial awareness and ability to execute within defined brand and market direction.
  • Advanced Adobe Illustrator skills (print design + garment CADs).
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop.
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, materials, and fit.
  • Confident English communication for factory and cross-team coordination.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong ownership of documentation and QA accuracy.

Qualifications:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in fashion design, apparel technical design, or product development.
  • Proven experience creating prints, CADs, and production-ready tech packs for apparel.
  • Experience communicating with manufacturers and managing sampling revisions.
  • Portfolio showcasing printed garments and technical design work (CADs + tech packs required).
  • Strong organization skills with clear production and timeline awareness.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Design, or a related field preferred.

Job Location: Work From Home / Remote

jobs.description:
About G2

G2 Capital Advisors () is a multi-product, sector-focused investment bank and financial advisory firm. Founded on the belief that middle-market advisory firms can do more, G2 partners with clients to navigate opportunities for growth, address operational or financial challenges, and execute complex capital markets transactions. What sets us apart? We’re not your typical investment bank or restructuring advisory firm. Our team brings together a balanced mix of operational insight, executive leadership, investment acumen, and financial advisory expertise. This diverse experience allows us to deliver tailored solutions that align with our clients’ strategic and financial goals, ensuring a well-rounded and impactful partnership. At G2, we thrive on collaboration, innovation and impact. We seek entrepreneurial, driven and intellectually curious individuals to join us in delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients.

Location: Flexible, with preference for Boston, New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, or Dallas

Overview

The Managing Director is an executive position responsible for expanding and growing G2’s Buy-Side Advisory practice within your industry vertical (Consumer & Retail, Transportation & Logistics, Technology & Business Services, Industrials & Manufacturing, Healthcare, or Financial Services). G2’s Buy-Side Advisory practice partners with clients to develop and execute tailored M&A strategies, serving as an extension of their teams and leveraging deep industry and operational insights to identify and engage acquisition targets aligned with their strategic objectives. Through this approach, we help clients execute transactions that accelerate growth and create shareholder value. In this seat, you will have access to a dedicated Buy Side team to support execution, access to private equity sponsors covered by G2’s Sponsor Coverage team, and the full G2 platform, including Sell-Side, Capital Markets, and Restructuring, to bring to your clients.

Responsibilities include:

Sourcing and Origination - 40%

  • Source and originate Buy-Side mandates from private equity sponsors (add on programs for portfolio companies) and strategic acquirers in your sector, alongside G2’s Sponsor Coverage team.
  • Bring G2’s full platform to your relationships, including Sell-Side, Capital Markets, and Restructuring.
  • Use one’s track record of success and network, as well as G2’s transaction history and network, to maximize referrals and overall relevancy.
  • Deliver on ambitious sales goals to make a substantial contribution to overall firm growth.
  • Coordinate with Marketing to develop industry segment communications, including newsletters, marketing campaigns, etc.
  • Identify opportunities to promote both G2 and personal industry expertise through such activities as speaking engagements, article publication, panel/conference participation, and serving on boards.

Execution - 40%

  • Overall responsibility for each transaction and successful execution of one’s engagements.
  • Lead engagements within a small, collaborative team environment, as well as ensure all aspects of engagements are delivered with the highest quality standards.
  • Support acquisition target engagement through direct outreach in conjunction with your deal team
  • Ensure transaction success on one’s client engagements by appropriately identifying risks and developing strategies and plans to mitigate those risks on a proactive basis.
  • Manage all critical client and stakeholder communications to an effective outcome while maintaining the highest level of professionalism.
  • Apply your M&A expertise and senior executive experience to advise sponsor deal teams, portfolio company leaders, and corporate clients in your sector.

Organization Development - 20%

  • Provide input on the strategic direction of the group as well as professional development of the team.
  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain G2’s resources, building on their business development capabilities, deepening their M&A knowledge, and strengthening their understanding of your sector and industry trends.
  • Partner with G2’s Industry and product teams to jointly originate and deliver cross platform mandates.

The ideal candidate will have had meaningful prior experience in a senior management role with in-depth experience in Buy-Side strategy and execution. Prior experience providing senior-level advice and counsel to business owners, C-Suite executives, private equity sponsors, and investors will be critical in this role. The ideal candidate will use sponsor, industry, and G2 relationships to source, originate, and lead the execution of Buy-Side engagements. The right person understands that M&A and financial advisory transactions are as much emotion and personality driven as financial, and can provide the leadership necessary to help G2’s Buy-Side clients achieve their goals. They will deploy both strategic and transaction skills to get things done. Candidates in this role will be a hands-on leader with superior business development experience and an appetite to support and drive growth within a highly dynamic and entrepreneurial organization. They will also have room to broaden their platform by sourcing across the G2 platform.

Skills and Characteristics:

  • Established relationships across the private equity community and a track record of sourcing and originating Buy Side mandates from sponsors.
  • Senior executive, Corporate Development or Managing Director level experience in leading Buy-Side engagements within your sector of expertise.
  • Proven ability to manage complex business issues during all stages of the business lifecycle, including growth, downturn, and distress, and leading team members to successful outcomes during times of uncertainty.
  • 10+ years of executive-level experience within your sector, with significant transaction experience in Buy-Side advisory.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to facilitate critical conversations at all levels and with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of success building high-performance teams and businesses in both local and remote team environments.
  • Strong sales and marketing experience with hands-on experience in business development, including tangible experience and results in direct sales.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen (P&L responsibility, M&A experience, financial analysis, business analysis)
  • Extensive professional network and ability to leverage your professional reputation and historical career footprint.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced and diverse environment and can manage multiple work streams.
  • Professional experience within your industry verticals and in non-advisory roles is a plus.
  • Strong educational background

What we value

While our team members come from a wide range of backgrounds, we are united by shared core principles. Explore our values here.

Total annual earnings typically range from $1,000,000-$3,000,000, depending on sourcing, origination & execution performance.

G2 is unable to offer employment sponsorship for our roles. As such, candidates must have authorization to work in the U.S. to qualify for consideration.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at G2 without regard to race; creed; color; religion; national origin; sex; age; disability; sexual orientation; gender identity or expression; genetic predisposition or carrier status; veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or any other status protected by law.

This National Account Manager will have a strong focus on the VA, DOD, TRICARE, and IHS. Other responsibilities will include managing strategic relationships in the Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Pharmacy Distribution channels including Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), specialty and retail pharmacy networks, Health Plans, and related access stakeholders. This individual will lead contract negotiations, manage access strategies, and drive execution with a focus on pharmacy benefit access, pull-through, and data-driven performance. The role requires cross-functional collaboration, value-based selling, and field sales partnership to ensure broad patient access and business growth.

The NAM at Tandem is also responsible for:


  • Access Strategy & Contracting
    • Leads contract negotiation and execution with the VA, DOD, TRICARE, IHS, PBMs, and Health Plans.
    • Delivers tailored value propositions using financial modeling, claims analytics, medical information, and health economic data.
    • Secures pharmacy formulary coverage, distribution agreements, and reimbursement pathways aligned to product lifecycle and channel strategy.
    • Maintains Durable Medical Equipment relationships and contracts.
    • Partners with internal legal, pricing, and finance teams to structure pharmacy agreements that balance growth and profitability.
  • Pull-Through & Execution
    • Drives execution of pharmacy access strategies through collaboration with field sales, inside sales, marketing, and market access teams.

    • Develops and executes training, playbooks, and co-branded resources in partnership with marketing and sales training.

  • Relationship Management

    • Represents the organization in business reviews, renegotiation cycles, and quarterly performance meetings with assigned accounts.
    • Collaborates with patient services, reimbursement, and distribution teams to optimize pharmacy fulfillment through limited distribution channels.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy
    • Monitors market trends, competitor access, and policy shifts that impact pharmacy distribution and reimbursement and Durable Medical Equipment contracts.
    • Informs Market Access Strategy with insights into payer mix, pharmacy benefit adoption, step-edits, and tiering.
    • Provides strategic input into brand planning and pricing.
    • Supports the evolution of hybrid (medical + pharmacy) access models as the landscape shifts toward simpler, scalable solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Collaborates with Trade & Distribution, Reimbursement, Patient Support, Legal, Marketing, and Medical Affairs to align and implement pharmacy strategy.
    • Partners with sales leadership to ensure timely and coordinated pull-through across geographies.
    • Serves as subject matter expert in internal working groups and field-facing strategy sessions.

  • Bachelor degree, preferably in a life science, business or marketing or a combination of equivalent education and applicable job experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in Market Access, National Accounts, or Managed Markets within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating pharmacy/formulary contracts
  • Prior experience working in a company with a strong pharmacy-first or limited distribution model preferred.
  • Familiarity with digital health and connected medical technologies (preferred but not required).
  • Deep understanding of the pharmacy benefit landscape, pharmacy reimbursement, VA, DOD, TRICARE, IHS, PBM, and DME contracting.
  • Strong analytical acumen with the ability to leverage data sets and turn them into actionable account strategies.
  • Proven negotiation and influencing skills with C-suite and senior executives.
  • Experience in patient access programs, co-pay assistance models, and limited distribution networks.
  • Skilled communicator with the ability to translate formulary placement and utilization management criteria into field-ready messaging.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, evolving access model environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% as required and work from a home office; must maintain valid driver’s license and required auto insurance as well as good driving record, per company policy.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote with Travel: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $174,000 - $221,000 annually plus incentive compensation (commission-based compensation is based on the achievement of goals). Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP:

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:

As a Senior Manager of Strategic Finance supporting the College Readiness Assessments (CRA) division (SAT and PSAT examinations), you are an adept translator between program priorities and the organization's financial strategy. You are your portfolio’s budget expert – masterfully tracking and telling the stories behind the investments, regularly adjusting projections to reflect new trends and inputs, and consistently using your financial modeling and analytical superpowers to provide actionable insights and recommendations to drive executive decision-making. Budgeting & Forecasting (40%)

  • Own volume and volume-related forecast logic — registrations, ancillary fees, and honoraria — continuously evaluating what’s driving forecast accuracy and refining the underlying models, not just producing a forecast on a cycle
  • Own expense forecast logic — continuously evaluating what’s driving total expense forecast accuracy and refining underlying cost assumptions each cycle, not just producing a forecast on a cycle
  • Monitor and quantify the financial impact of emerging, often unforeseen risks and opportunities (e.g., state policy changes, competitive shifts) against budget and forecast, keeping leadership ahead of swings rather than explaining them after they’ve landed

Systems & Reporting (35%)

  • Proactively surface and communicate actionable financial insights for senior leadership

  • 2–4 years in accounting, audit, or financial systems prior to moving into FP&A
  • Experience with financial planning systems preferred, e.g. Workday Adaptive Planning     
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills and the proven ability to move forward multiple projects in concert, both independently and as a member of the team 
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including extensive experience in financial modeling  
  • Strong communication and customer service skills, including experience summarizing complex financial analyses and presenting key findings to senior management  
  • Solid understanding of corporate finance   
  • Advanced MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word skills  
  • A passion for supporting educational and career opportunities for millions of students  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related technical field preferred 
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business 

All roles at College Board require:

jobs.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

Job Summary

Aerospike is hiring a Principal Value Engineer to help enterprise customers build a clear, defensible case for investing in Aerospike. This person will translate technical change into measurable business impact using the customer’s priorities, operating data, and financial assumptions.

Operating as a strategic overlay on selected opportunities, you will partner closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, and customer executives. While the Solutions Engineer owns technical discovery, architecture, and technical proof, you will own the value hypothesis, economic discovery, cost of inaction, financial model, executive business case, and value-realization handoff.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who moves comfortably between technical architecture discussions and executive investment reviews. The strongest candidate brings the technical credibility of an experienced Solutions Engineer alongside the financial discipline to build ROI, TCO, NPV, payback, and risk models that customers can validate and defend internally.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prioritize & Strategize: Partner with Sales leadership to prioritize Value Engineering engagement based on opportunity size, complexity, and executive access. Research customer business priorities and industry pressures upfront to build testable value hypotheses.
  • Lead Value Discovery: Facilitate business outcome workshops with technical leaders, business owners, Finance, and procurement. Establish current-state baselines, target future states, and the cost of inaction—clearly separating customer facts from external benchmarks and assumptions.
  • Align Technical Proof to Business Value: Partner with Solutions Engineers to define proof-of-value success criteria and baseline metrics before evaluations begin. Translate technical improvements (latency, throughput, infrastructure footprint, resilience, developer effort) into measurable business outcomes.
  • Build & Defend Business Cases: Develop customer-specific financial models (ROI, TCO, NPV, payback, risk exposure) and concise executive summaries. Present and defend the economic case with senior stakeholders, revising models as new customer evidence emerges.
  • Support Deal Strategy: Advise on proposal, pricing, and negotiation strategy by linking investment to expected value, timing, and risk—relying strictly on validated customer evidence.
  • Ensure Post-Sale Continuity: Create a Value Realization Plan at close documenting approved baselines, target outcomes, and measurement dates. Hand off the plan to Customer Success and participate in select executive value reviews.
  • Scale the Discipline & Enable the Field: Build reusable financial models, discovery guides, and benchmark libraries without turning engagements into generic calculator exercises. Coach AEs, SEs, and CS teams on economic discovery, and feed recurring customer evidence back to Product, Marketing, and GTM leadership.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology across Solutions Engineering, value consulting, management consulting, business transformation, or strategic pre-sales.
  • Proven track record building, presenting, and defending customer-specific business cases for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise software investments.
  • Experience with real-time data, NoSQL databases, cloud economics, AI infrastructure, or mission-critical workloads (e.g., fraud prevention, payments, real-time decisioning, customer 360, personalization, or adtech).
  • Strong financial modeling skills (ROI, TCO, NPV, payback period, cost of inaction, sensitivity analysis) with rigorous, transparent treatment of assumptions.
  • Technical fluency in enterprise data platforms, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure, with the ability to grasp architectural tradeoffs without replacing the Solutions Engineer.
  • Exceptional workshop facilitation, executive presence, and data-storytelling skills—able to distill complex analyses into crisp executive narratives.
  • Comfort building a new function in a growing company, including defining engagement rules, reusable assets, and impact metrics.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for customer workshops, executive meetings, and company events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success to track post-sale realized value for executive reviews, renewals, and expansions.
  • MBA, graduate degree, or equivalent practical experience in business, finance, economics, or engineering.
  • Advanced spreadsheet modeling skills and familiarity with Salesforce or comparable CRMs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Targeted Impact: Value Engineering is deployed selectively where it materially improves decision quality and deal outcomes, rather than acting as a checkbox in every sales cycle.
  • Defensible Rigor: Business cases rely on customer-validated baselines, withstand Finance and executive scrutiny, and clearly quantify the cost of delay.
  • Outcome-Driven Evaluations: Technical proofs measure the exact metrics required for the buyer’s decision, and final readouts translate technical wins into business terms.
  • Seamless Handoffs: Closed-won deals transition to Customer Success with a documented Value Realization Plan, clear measurement milestones, and named customer owners.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

We're looking for a Backend Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain hands-on experience building software for our telehealth platform.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers on backend services, APIs, databases, and internal tools that support patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant-facing applications.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLECincom is bringing Level 1 support, hosting support and infrastructure together into one 24/7 Service Operations function, reporting directly to the COO.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Cincom is bringing Level 1 support, hosting support and infrastructure together into one 24/7 Service Operations function, reporting directly to the COO. It covers all of our main product lines, including CPQ, Eloquence, Cincom Smalltalk, Mantis, Supra and Control, along with the customer environments we host and manage and the infrastructure they run on.

Today, these areas work differently from one product to the next. Processes, tools and standards vary in many cases, and too much depends on a few people who know a product or a platform inside out. We want one modern, professional operation that runs around the clock and that customers experience the same way, whichever product they use and wherever/however it is deployed.

We are looking for someone to build this team and lead it. You will set the operating model, lead the three teams, own escalations through to resolution, and put the tooling, processes and measures in place to run Service Operations as a true 24/7 managed service. You will sit on the COO’s leadership team and take on wider operational responsibility as the function matures. It is a senior leadership role, but you will need to stay close enough to the work to know what good looks like and to step in when it counts.

WHY THIS ROLE

This is a new function with a direct line to the COO. You will shape it from the start, with real backing to change how we work and a clear mandate to build a professional service that customers value. It is also a role with room to grow: as the function matures, we expect you to take on wider operational responsibility across the business.

The role is remote and the location is open. Because Service Operations runs 24/7, you will take part in senior escalation cover for major incidents, and potentially travel occasionally to meet the team and customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead the three teams that report to you, specifically, Level 1 Support, Hosting Support and Infrastructure Management, and build and retain Level 2 knowledge over time.
  • Build out the Level 1 team, starting with a new team being established, and make sure it works hand in hand with our existing product support specialists in the Cincom business.
  • Hire, develop and coach the team, and cross-skill people across products and platforms so we are not reliant on any one person.
  • Set clear objectives, give regular feedback, and build a team that takes ownership of the customer’s problem.

Operational Leadership

  • Sit on the COO’s leadership team and contribute to decisions across engineering, delivery and operations.
  • Deputise for the COO on operational matters when needed, and take on wider operational responsibility as the function matures.
  • Own the Service Operations budget, including hosting and infrastructure costs, and help deliver against the business’s cost and efficiency targets.
  • Manage key operational suppliers and contracts, working with the COO and PartnerOne Group procurement and IT where Group agreements apply.

Building a 24/7 Service Operations Function

  • Design and run Service Operations as a true 24/7 service, with coverage, rotas and on-call arrangements that match our customer commitments.
  • Build out-of-hours models that make good use of the team, without burning people out.
  • Replace product-by-product ways of working with one consistent model for intake, triage, severity and prioritisation.
  • Bring in modern support practice, including ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management and knowledge-centred support.
  • Build a proper Managed Services approach for our hosted platforms, working across the Hosting Support and Infrastructure teams and with the Client Success Team for our key accounts.

Escalation Management to Level 2 and 3

  • Own the escalation process from Level 1 into Level 2/3: product engineering teams for product issues, and Services consultants for issues in project deliverables, where necessary.
  • Set clear criteria for when and how issues escalate, so they arrive with the right information, and nothing gets lost in the handover.
  • Track every escalated issue through to resolution, keep customers informed, chase when timescales slip.
  • Review escalation trends with the product heads, push recurring issues back for permanent fixes and inclusion in roadmaps and make sure what we learn is captured in the smart knowledge base.

Hosting Support

  • Hold overall accountability for the customer environments Cincom hosts and manages, delivered through the Hosting Support team, and stay engaged with customer hosted deployments and associated metrics.
  • Make sure hosted services meet their commitments on availability, monitoring, backups, patching, disaster recovery and incident response, around the clock, providing a true Managed Service.
  • Turn hosting into a consistent, repeatable managed service that our commercial team can understand and sell with confidence.

Infrastructure

  • Lead the Infrastructure team and own the hardware and deployment design for hosted and on-premise customer environments. Software design stays with the product engineering teams.
  • Set infrastructure standards and reference architectures for each product, covering capacity, resilience, security and cost.
  • Plan capacity and sizing with the product and project delivery teams, so customer environments are built right first time.
  • Keep our cloud and infrastructure estate, including Azure and Kubernetes, secure, patched, documented and cost-effective.

Tooling, Automation & AI

  • Make Zoho Desk the single platform for support, configured properly and used consistently across every product, with integrations into other Cincom operational platforms as required.
  • Build and maintain a knowledge base (working with Cincom designated AI tools) that customers and the team actually use and expand self-service and automation where it saves everyone effort.
  • Work with our AI team to explore and develop AI-assisted Level 1 support, including local-language support, with validation before answers reach customers.

Performance, Reporting & Compliance

  • Set and track SLAs and internal service levels for response and resolution, by severity.
  • Report on ticket trends by product, customer, region, severity and SLA tracked resolution time, alongside hosting availability and infrastructure cost, not just ticket status, and review them monthly with the COO.
  • Lead the response to major incidents, with clear and timely communication to customers following a well-documented process.
  • Make sure support, hosting and infrastructure processes provide the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and support our obligations to customers in regulated sectors.

Requirements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential Experience

  • Experience leading support, hosting or infrastructure operations for enterprise software customers, ideally across more than one product.
  • Experience leading several teams through team leads, at senior management level.
  • A track record of building or reshaping a support or operations function, not only running an existing one.
  • Experience running or building a 24/7 support operation, including on-call and potential follow-the-sun models.
  • Experience managing escalations into engineering teams and holding them to agreed timescales.
  • Experience running SLA-based support for business-critical customer systems.
  • Experience owning an operational budget, including hosting and infrastructure costs.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong grounding in incident, problem and change management (ITIL or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of hosted and cloud infrastructure, Azure or similar, including monitoring and alerting, high availability, backup and disaster recovery, and management of guaranteed up-time.
  • Familiarity with containerised deployments such as Kubernetes, and with infrastructure-as-code.
  • Comfortable with service desk platforms, reporting and automation.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

  • Calm and clear with customers and senior colleagues, especially when things go wrong.
  • Uses data to manage performance and to make the case for change.
  • Builds trust across Engineering, Delivery and Client Success, and gets things done without relying on authority.
  • Thinks beyond their own function, and is comfortable representing operations at leadership and Group level.
  • Fluent Business English communication.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with Zoho Desk or a comparable service desk platform.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted support, knowledge-centred support or self-service.
  • ITIL 4 certification.
  • Additional languages, particularly French, German, Italian.
  • Experience supporting customers in regulated sectors such as financial services and insurance, and familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Experience with cloud cost management or FinOps practices.

Benefits

  • Independent Contractor (Contractor is responsible for applicable taxes and statutory obligations, subject to the agreement and local law)
  • Full-time role
  • Availability for occasional short travels
  • Payment in USD
  • Equipment provided by the company
  • Contractor fee range - $3,900–$6,000 USD per month

Equal Opportunity Employer

PartnerOne is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

AI Use Disclosure

These tools support our recruiting team and do not replace human decision-making. Where required, candidates will receive additional information about the tool and applicable rights.

About Social Driver:

Social Driver is a modern communications agency that turns big ambitions into breakthrough results. Since 2011, we’ve brought together strategists, creatives, and technical experts who work across nonprofits, associations, B2B, healthcare, technology, influence, and highly regulated industries. We build long-term partnerships and help organizations understand potential and unlock what’s next, whether it’s creating something new or re-envisioning what’s already there.

About this Position:

The Director of Project Management leads Social Driver's project management practice within Client Engagement. Reporting to the Vice President, Client Engagement, this leader manages our team of project managers and our PM Administrator across a book of roughly 100 active clients. They are the delivery-side peer to our Directors of Engagement and to the leaders of our production teams in Creative Services.

This is a build role. Client Engagement is moving from individually managed client work toward a more team-based, flexible, and scalable way of delivering, and parts of that model are still being defined. The Director will help shape it, then make it run: how complex, multidisciplinary work is set up from the start, how work is sequenced across departments, how PM capacity is planned and shared, and the standards every project is held to.

Day to day, the Director runs the delivery side of our cross-functional operating cadence, so clients experience one Social Driver: clear plans, predictable timelines, early warning on risk, and fast responses. They partner closely with Sales on the move from contract to kickoff, with Directors of Engagement on client priorities, and with Creative Services leadership on capacity, resourcing, and timing.

The right person has led a team of project managers at an integrated agency. They built the cadence and standards themselves rather than inheriting them, and they have negotiated capacity and priorities with production leaders as a peer. They are energized by building inside a model that is still forming. This is a practice-leadership role: the Director stays close to the work and leads select complex engagements directly, but their primary job is making the team and the system work while ensuring operational consistency.

Objectives & Responsibilities:

Lead and develop the project management team

  • Manage, mentor, and develop project managers at every level and the PM Administrator, building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Set clear expectations by level: reliable delivery at volume for a Project Manager, owning an account end to end for a Senior PM, and sound judgment under real ambiguity for a Principal PM. Use them for feedback, growth plans, and promotion recommendations.
  • Recruit, onboard, and retain strong PMs, and make delivery a career with its own path.
  • Advocate for the team's needs, including staffing, tools, training, recognition and professional development.

Set up and orchestrate complex work

  • Own how complex, multidisciplinary engagements are set up from the start: the plan, the roles, the sequencing across departments, and what has to be true for commitments to hold.
  • Set cross-department sequencing standards with production leaders, and resolve conflicts with the relevant production leader when a PM and a production team can't agree on the order of work.
  • Make sure every project and retainer runs from a clear plan tied to the client's goals and to the documented direction set by the Director of Engagement where one is assigned.
  • Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues, bringing in the Director of Engagement or the VP when client direction or the relationship is at stake.

Own PM capacity and workload

  • Own PM assignment and capacity: who runs which account, at what level, and when to rebalance.
  • Run a weekly capacity review of what the book demands against what the team can carry. Turn over-allocation into decisions (what moves, what waits, what we won't take on) rather than silent absorption.
  • Partner with Creative Services leadership on capacity, resourcing and timing across delivery, and help shape how project management and production allocation work together as our model matures.
  • Build a blended staffing model: a full-time core plus contract and freelance PM support for surge, leave coverage, and specialist needs.
  • Make sure every account has a primary and a backup, with coverage plans for PTO, leave, and unexpected absences.

Run the operating cadence, standards, and systems

  • Run the delivery side of our daily cross-functional portfolio cadence, so client priorities, risks, and staffing needs surface early and leave with an owner and a next step.
  • Own the shared PM inbox and its response-time standards, so clients get speed and predictability without depending on any one person.
  • Own PM standards and playbooks: project setup, kickoffs, timelines, status reporting (including client sentiment), retrospectives, and close-out.
  • Strengthen our existing tools and shared records (Asana, Harvest, Google Workspace, Slack) rather than building parallel workflows, and lead the PM Administrator in keeping them accurate.
  • Use data on budget burn, utilization, on-time delivery, and escalation trends to improve how the team plans and delivers.

Partner on sales, scope, and finance

  • Partner with Sales on the move from contract to kickoff, confirming work is ready before it starts: deliverables named, a start window agreed, client inputs and approvers identified, budget approved, and a PM with room assigned.
  • Give Sales and Directors of Engagement the delivery picture (burn, scope history, capacity and risk) for renewals, change orders and next phases. Sales owns the commercial conversation.
  • Make sure out-of-scope requests are named when they arrive and routed the right way, not quietly absorbed.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Mixed-Methods Researcher to help Bask Health make better product decisions by combining qualitative user insights with quantitative behavioral evidence.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Mixed-Methods Researcher, you'll investigate how people interact with these experiences, why they behave the way they do, and which product improvements are most likely to address meaningful user problems.

This is a hands-on research role that combines qualitative methods, quantitative analysis, usability testing, survey research, and product discovery. You'll select and combine research methods based on the questions product teams need to answer.

Your work will span merchant-facing and patient-facing experiences. You may investigate how merchants complete onboarding, where users encounter friction during configuration, how patients navigate questionnaires, or why certain workflows have lower completion rates than expected.

You'll conduct interviews and usability studies to understand user motivations, expectations, and challenges. You'll then connect those findings with available behavioral data, survey results, and product metrics to develop a more complete picture of the user experience.

For example, product analytics may reveal that users frequently abandon a particular workflow. Your research could combine funnel analysis, interviews, and usability testing to understand whether the problem involves confusing instructions, unnecessary steps, technical issues, or unmet expectations.

You'll work closely with product managers to define research questions, identify appropriate methods, and establish what evidence is needed to support decisions.

You'll collaborate with product designers and content designers to evaluate proposed solutions and understand how design changes affect user comprehension, task completion, and overall usability.

You'll also partner with engineers and analytics stakeholders to understand what product data is available, identify measurement limitations, and recommend additional instrumentation when appropriate.

A key part of this role will be distinguishing meaningful patterns from incomplete or misleading evidence. You'll help teams understand the strengths and limitations of different research methods, including sample size, participant selection, statistical uncertainty, and potential bias.

You'll present findings in a way that connects user observations with measurable product outcomes, helping teams prioritize improvements based on evidence rather than assumptions.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll conduct research with appropriate attention to privacy, participant consent, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help develop repeatable research practices, maintain organized findings, and improve how qualitative and quantitative insights are shared across the company.

We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating complex product questions, is comfortable working with both people and data, and can translate research findings into practical recommendations that improve software experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Lead mixed-methods research projects across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to investigate user needs and product performance.
  • Partner with product managers to define research questions, hypotheses, and study objectives.
  • Design research plans that incorporate appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Conduct user interviews to understand behaviors, motivations, and challenges.
  • Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.
  • Develop surveys to measure user perceptions, satisfaction, comprehension, and experience.
  • Analyze survey results and identify meaningful response patterns.
  • Examine product funnels, workflow completion, and behavioral trends using available analytics.
  • Investigate differences between observed user behavior and reported user experiences.
  • Research merchant onboarding, storefront configuration, and administrative workflows.
  • Evaluate patient onboarding, questionnaires, and other multi-step experiences.
  • Identify friction points affecting task completion and workflow efficiency.
  • Develop research hypotheses based on behavioral data and user feedback.
  • Apply appropriate statistical methods to quantitative research findings.
  • Evaluate sample quality, potential bias, and limitations in research conclusions.
  • Collaborate with analytics and engineering stakeholders to understand product event data.
  • Recommend measurement improvements that support future product research.
  • Design and evaluate concept tests for proposed product improvements.
  • Support experiment design and interpretation when product teams conduct controlled tests.
  • Collaborate with product designers to validate proposed interaction changes.
  • Work with content designers to evaluate comprehension and interface terminology.
  • Develop research summaries that connect qualitative insights with quantitative evidence.
  • Create journey maps, behavioral findings, and opportunity assessments.
  • Present research findings and recommendations to product, design, engineering, and leadership teams.
  • Help teams prioritize improvements based on user needs, evidence quality, and expected impact.
  • Maintain organized research documentation, datasets, and reusable findings.
  • Independently manage mixed-methods research initiatives from planning through analysis and communication.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in UX research, mixed-methods research, product research, behavioral research, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating the use of qualitative and quantitative methods to answer product questions.
  • Experience independently planning and conducting research for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative research methods, including interviews and usability testing.
  • Experience designing and analyzing user surveys.
  • Working knowledge of quantitative research methods and statistical reasoning.
  • Ability to combine qualitative findings with behavioral or survey data.
  • Experience defining research questions, hypotheses, and study objectives.
  • Ability to select appropriate research methods based on product needs.
  • Experience evaluating complex digital workflows and user journeys.
  • Familiarity with product analytics and behavioral measurement.
  • Ability to interpret user behavior, task completion, and workflow performance data.
  • Understanding of sampling, research bias, and limitations of quantitative findings.
  • Experience synthesizing research findings into actionable product recommendations.
  • Ability to distinguish correlation from causation and communicate uncertainty appropriately.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and product designers.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and iterative product development.
  • Ability to communicate quantitative findings to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating research reports and presenting evidence-based recommendations.
  • Understanding of research ethics, informed consent, and responsible data handling.
  • Familiarity with participant recruitment and screening.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and research quality.
  • Ability to independently manage research projects involving multiple data sources.

Nice to Have

  • Experience conducting mixed-methods research for SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with B2B software and merchant-facing applications.
  • Experience researching e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience analyzing onboarding funnels and workflow completion.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or comparable product analytics platforms.
  • Experience using SQL to explore product or research data.
  • Familiarity with Python, R, or statistical analysis tools.
  • Experience designing controlled experiments or A/B tests.
  • Understanding of statistical significance, confidence intervals, and practical effect sizes.
  • Experience developing and analyzing structured survey instruments.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or comparable survey platforms.
  • Experience using Dovetail, UserTesting, Maze, or comparable research tools.
  • Familiarity with Figma prototypes and concept testing.
  • Experience conducting segmentation or cohort-based research.
  • Understanding of accessibility research and inclusive study practices.
  • Familiarity with white-label or multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Experience evaluating AI-assisted product experiences.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy considerations and sensitive data handling.
  • Experience developing research repositories and repeatable measurement frameworks.

The Patient Journey Director CEERJ enables journey from first symptom to diagnosis, referral and appropriate care outcomes faster, clearer and fairer for people living with C3G/IC-MPGN and severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) across CEERJ.

The role is driven by a genuine passion for improving the patient journey. It identifies where patients are delayed, missed or lost, partners with country medical and commercial teams to understand why, and turns those barriers into practical, compliant and measurable initiatives. This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

The role operates in a fast-moving, changing environment. The holder works in an agile way: sets few clear priorities, adapts quickly as launches, access and evidence evolve, and turns insight into executive-ready plans that are communicated clearly to the Brand Teams, Leadership Teams and Core Medical Team.

Main responsibilities:

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

Partner with countries to map and clear barriers & opportunities. Work alongside country leaders and field teams to map country-specific barriers (awareness, testing access, laboratory and biopsy pathways, referral fragmentation, expert centre availability, non-pharmaceutical therapy optimization opportunities)

Build & resource executive plans. Develop concise, prioritized patient journey improvement projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and KPIs. Resource and adjust them rapidly as conditions change. Report progress to senior leadership in Core Medical Team, CEERJ LT and Brand Team forums.

Lead projects and matrix teams: drive relevant Patient Journey projects and allocated matrix teams from kick off to close out ensuring clear planning, budgeting, delivery and reporting on time and within budget

Lead integration of medical devices and enabling platforms. Lead integration of Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics and pipeline tools into patient journey frameworks across CEERJ. Ensure stakeholder value, country readiness and compliant use. Track adoption, escalate barriers and propose solutions.

Generate and act on patient journey insights. Interact with external community to enable systematic collection and synthesis of insights from HCPs, KOLs, diagnostic initiatives, patient organisations and country teams. Turn them into clear recommendations that change plans and decisions.

Mastery of the landscape. Keep current knowledge of C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG science, diagnostic pathways, competitive and customer landscape, Tier 1 KOLs and patient advocacy groups, and related areas such as PNH and haemophilia.

  • University degree such as M.D., Pharm. D., or PhD preferably with biological sciences background.
  • Academic, clinical or industry experience in therapeutic areas such as nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology or immunology
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in commercial field role or medical affairs at a local level from larger country, with recognized success internally and externally. Experience in Patient Access, Community Engagement or Diagnostics will be a plus
  • Strong business acumen and presentation / communication skills across all levels of organization within and outside country
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver results on time and within budget
  • Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point and other Microsoft Office programmes

  • Highly motivated and self-driven with ability to think innovatively & strategically, skillfully plan, manage and prioritize multiple projects independently; demonstrates resilience and flexibility
  • Ability to work independently, while still maintaining a team and corporate approach to the function
  • Proactive, open minded, experienced leader, able to identify and carry out strategic initiatives with high patient impact in launches and life-cycle management

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day.

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of rare disease patients and our edge comes from our team of people.

Sobi offers the opportunity to work at an international pharmaceutical company focused on specialty pharmaceuticals meeting the high medical needs of rare disease patients and providing treatment and services to them. Our employees come from a variety of backgrounds within research, healthcare, industry and the academic sphere.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX Writing Intern to join Bask Health and gain hands-on experience creating clear, intuitive, and useful content for digital products.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a UX Writing Intern, you'll work alongside product designers, content designers, product managers, and engineers to help improve how users understand and interact with our software.

This internship is designed for students, recent graduates, and aspiring UX writers who want to develop practical skills in interface writing, content design, and user-centered communication.

You'll support writing projects across different parts of the platform, including merchant onboarding, patient questionnaires, account settings, administrative dashboards, and other product features.

Your work will involve writing and refining interface content such as button labels, form instructions, helper text, tooltips, error messages, confirmation messages, and empty states.

You'll learn how UX writing differs from traditional marketing or editorial writing, with a focus on helping users complete tasks and understand what to do next.

You'll work with experienced team members to understand how content fits into the overall product experience.

You'll learn how interface language, visual design, and interaction patterns work together to make software easier to use.

You'll also develop an understanding of how different audiences interact with Bask Health's platform.

For example, merchants configuring their businesses may need clear explanations of software settings, while patients completing questionnaires may need straightforward instructions that help them understand each step.

You'll learn how to write concise content, maintain consistent terminology, and communicate complex information in plain language.

You'll participate in content reviews and have opportunities to refine your writing based on feedback.

You'll also learn how usability research and customer feedback can reveal confusing language or unclear instructions.

You'll become familiar with content guidelines, reusable writing patterns, and the documentation practices used by product teams.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn why accuracy, privacy, accessibility, and appropriate review processes are especially important for patient-facing content.

You'll receive guidance on assigned writing projects and have opportunities to take increasing ownership of clearly defined tasks as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone who enjoys writing, pays close attention to detail, asks thoughtful questions, and wants to build a career in UX writing or content design.

What You'll Do

  • Support UX writing projects across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with writing interface copy for web-based product features.
  • Create button labels, navigation text, and interface headings.
  • Help develop clear instructions for digital forms.
  • Support content improvements for merchant onboarding experiences.
  • Assist with writing content for patient questionnaires.
  • Help create helper text and explanations for account settings.
  • Write draft error messages and validation instructions.
  • Assist with confirmation messages and next-step guidance.
  • Develop tooltips and contextual help for product features.
  • Review existing interfaces to identify confusing or inconsistent language.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve interface comprehension.
  • Work with experienced content designers to understand writing standards.
  • Participate in content reviews and feedback sessions.
  • Apply feedback to improve clarity, tone, and consistency.
  • Learn and apply plain-language writing principles.
  • Help maintain consistent terminology across product experiences.
  • Support the documentation of reusable UX writing patterns.
  • Contribute to content guidelines and terminology references.
  • Learn how accessibility principles apply to interface writing.
  • Collaborate with product managers to understand feature requirements.
  • Work with engineers to understand how interface copy is implemented.
  • Assist with reviewing implemented content for accuracy and consistency.
  • Learn how user research informs content design decisions.
  • Help identify opportunities to simplify complex instructions.
  • Support content quality assurance before product releases.
  • Maintain organized writing files and documentation.
  • Complete assigned writing tasks with guidance and regular feedback.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in writing, communications, English, UX design, content design, journalism, human-computer interaction, or a related field, or equivalent independent learning and project experience.
  • No prior professional UX writing experience required.
  • Writing samples, academic projects, or personal work demonstrating clear communication skills.
  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading abilities.
  • Ability to communicate information in simple, understandable language.
  • Interest in UX writing and content design.
  • Basic understanding of user-centered design concepts.
  • Familiarity with digital products and web applications.
  • Willingness to learn interface writing principles.
  • Ability to write concise instructions and messages.
  • Strong attention to grammar, consistency, and terminology.
  • Interest in how language affects product usability.
  • Willingness to learn Figma or comparable product design tools.
  • Basic awareness of accessibility and inclusive communication.
  • Ability to follow writing guidelines and established standards.
  • Willingness to receive feedback and revise written content.
  • Ability to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Curiosity about how people interact with software.
  • Interest in solving communication and usability problems.
  • Ability to explain writing choices clearly.
  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Enthusiasm for developing a career in UX writing or content design.

Nice to Have

  • Previous internship or project experience involving UX writing.
  • Coursework in content design, UX design, or digital communication.
  • Experience writing content for websites or mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with Figma.
  • Portfolio projects involving interface copy or content design.
  • Experience writing instructions for forms or onboarding flows.
  • Interest in healthcare technology or telehealth products.
  • Familiarity with SaaS platforms or administrative software.
  • Understanding of e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Experience developing writing guidelines or style references.
  • Familiarity with plain-language writing principles.
  • Understanding of information architecture.
  • Experience collaborating with designers on academic or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with usability testing concepts.
  • Basic understanding of WCAG accessibility principles.
  • Experience writing for different user audiences.
  • Familiarity with localization and internationalization concepts.
  • Experience using content management or documentation tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted writing tools while reviewing outputs for accuracy.
