jobs.excerpt: About AccentureAccenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries.
jobs.description:
About Accenture

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

The Role

As Senior Manager, Pre-Sales you support complex software sales cycles by delivering compelling product demonstrations, responding to technical and functional requirements, and building reusable pre-sales assets. You combine solid product knowledge with strong client-facing skills to accelerate pipeline conversion — working across direct client engagements, partner-supported opportunities and industry events.

What You Will Do:

Pre-sales support and solution delivery

  • Support the end-to-end pre-sales process for assigned opportunities: discovery, demos, RFP responses, solution scoping and proposal preparation.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations to mid-level and senior client stakeholders, translating features into business value.
  • Facilitate client workshops to identify requirements, validate fit and shape the solution approach.
  • Prepare written responses to RFPs, RFIs and security questionnaires in coordination with product, legal and delivery teams.
  • Support proof-of-concept engagements; document outcomes and feed learnings back into the pre-sales playbook.

Partner and event support

  • Support channel and technology partners in pre-sales engagements: provide product demonstrations and technical guidance, build their confidence in positioning the solution, and assist on partner-led opportunities when additional pre-sales depth is required.
  • Support the business at industry events and trade shows: deliver product demonstrations for event audiences, engage prospects and clients on-site with relevant use cases, and document leads and follow-up actions promptly after each event.

Asset development and enablement

  • Develop and maintain reusable pre-sales materials: demo scripts, solution blueprints, proposal modules, competitive battle cards and ROI templates.
  • Stay current on product updates, competitive landscape and industry trends; share insights with the broader sales team.
  • Contribute to the onboarding of new team members on product and solution knowledge.

Collaboration and reporting

  • Work closely with the sales lead and AD Pre-Sales to align on opportunity strategy and solution approach.
  • Maintain accurate records of pre-sales activities and solution configurations; support pipeline reporting as required.
  • Participate in win/loss reviews and apply learnings to improve proposal quality and demo effectiveness.

PRODUCT AND INDUSTRY FIT

  • Deep functional understanding of AI-native architecture beyond agents: Ability to articulate and demonstrate the foundational AI concepts that make SCOS technically differentiated, not just as an agentic platform, but as an AI-native system grounded in structured intelligence. This includes hands-on familiarity with Ontologies (the formal supply chain entity and relationship models that agents reason over), Knowledge Graphs (how SCOS traverses multi-hop relationships across suppliers, inventory, demand, and logistics nodes using semantic graph queries), and Semantics (how meaning and context are embedded into data so agents can reason over intent, not just retrieve records). Ability to demonstrate why agents without a semantic foundation produce brittle, unexplainable decisions, and how SCOS's living ontology, which agents actively write back to with decision nodes and confidence weights, produces decisions that are auditable, improvable, and enterprise-grade.
  • Deep functional knowledge of Supply Chain OS: Demand sensing and forecasting, inventory optimization, supply planning, procurement orchestration, logistics management, supplier collaboration and supply chain control tower.
  • Ability to demonstrate SCOS across a representative supply chain scenario: Skill to run a compelling, end-to-end product demonstration across a realistic supply chain scenario: demand signal ingestion, forecast generation, inventory recommendation, supply plan creation, exception alert surfacing, and the management dashboard, tailored to the buyer's industry and pain points. Ability to handle live questions and pivot the demo in real time.
  • Experience scoping proof-of-concept engagements: Skill to scope a credible supply chain AI PoC: defining product families and planning horizon, configuring forecast models, running a retrospective accuracy test, and presenting results to a supply chain and finance evaluation panel.
  • Design and present a SCOS deployment architecture: Ability to design and present a full solution architecture for SCOS deployment, including integration with ERP (SAP, Oracle), WMS, TMS, supplier portals, IoT sensors, and financial planning systems. Competency to translate architecture diagrams into business value narratives for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Supply chain data requirements & quality: Understanding of supply chain data requirements: demand history, BOM, lead times, supplier performance data, IoT telemetry, and the data quality remediation typically needed before AI planning models can run reliably. Ability to scope a data readiness assessment.
  • SAP IBP integration patterns & migration: Familiarity with SAP IBP integration patterns and migration approaches: how SCOS coexists with or replaces SAP IBP, data synchronisation design, and transition planning for supply planning teams — a critical objection-handling topic.
  • Supply chain planning methodology: Understanding of statistical forecasting, machine learning demand sensing, multi-echelon inventory optimization (MEIO), constraint-based scheduling, and the S&OP process, enabling credible conversations with supply chain practitioners, not just technology buyers.
  • Agentic supply chain decision-making: Familiarity with agentic supply chain design: autonomous replenishment agents, dynamic safety stock agents, carrier selection agents, including goal definition, tool use, constraint handling, and human-in-the-loop approval design for enterprise governance.
  • Target Personas: Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder technical evaluations where IT leadership, enterprise architects, and supply chain systems owners all have a vote. Ability to meet each persona at their level, from API integration detail with architects to planning methodology with supply chain teams to data governance with CDOs.

Travel may be required for role - 0-80% depending on client and business needs

Here's what You Need:

  • Minimum 8+ years of pre-sales, solution consulting or technical sales support experience in enterprise software including a track record of contributing to complex sales opportunities, including RFP responses and solution demonstrations.
  • Minimum 8+ years of enterprise software delivery models (SaaS, license, managed services) and integration approaches.
  • Minimum 12 months of demonstrated experience supporting pre-sales for AI-native software products — solutions built on LLMs, agentic workflows or machine learning platforms — with evidence of demos delivered or RFP contributions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Skills:


  • Experience presenting technical solutions to mid-level and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce high-quality proposal content under time pressure.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; comfortable managing multiple concurrent opportunities.
  • Self-motivated and resilient; able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Points if You have:


  • AI certifications (e.g. Microsoft AI-900/AI-102, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, AWS Certified ML Specialty, DeepLearning.AI specializations) are valued.

jobs.description:
Nemours is seeking a Coding and Billing Specialist in Orlando, FL

Assesses documentation for each service rendered in the hospital’s place of service, in order to accurately code principal diagnoses (i.e. preponderance of care sequence), secondary conditions, procedures, and social determinant codes using American Hospital Association guidelines, Current Procedural Terminology guidelines, payer specific rules for commercial and/or Medicaid insurance, and drug administration for specified service lines impacting Florida’s enhanced ambulatory grouping. This includes excellent working knowledge of revenue charge capture and the impact to hospital billing (i.e. soft vs. hard coded charges),working knowledge of revenue codes, relevant grouper function and financial impact; assessment and entry of surgical charges (i.e. supplies, implants), and pharmacy charges (i.e. contrast, patient supplied, etc).

Essential Functions

  1. Ability to comprehend medical record documentation to accurately assign codes for both concurrent and discharged accounts across multiple specialties.

  2. Meets minimum requirements for production and quality monthly.

  3. Requires a working knowledge of code sequencing for grouper-related payers with attention to detail to avoid rework and waste with charge capture assessment component.

  4. Requires understanding and application of M.E.A.T. criteria (i.e., monitoring, evaluation, assessment, treatment) using ICD 10 CM transaction data set to capture diagnoses.

  5. Analyzes high-risk encounters for accurate and/or missing charges gaps prior to encounter completion (i.e., missing charges from anesthesia, surgery) when manual charge capture occurs.

  6. Understand complexity of billing requirements and incorporates payer specific trends into day-to-day reviews to reduce “take backs” associated with un-clear, or un-substantiated care rendered. (i.e., varying modifier assignment for EAPG vs. Non-EAPG payer specificity)

  7. Requires excellent coding knowledge of ICD 10 CM, CPT 4, and modifier application, with expectations to maintain certification (i.e., CCS, CPC, RHIT, or RHIA) and apply ICD 10 CM Coding Guidelines specific to both inpatient and outpatient encounters.

  8. Facilitate modifications to clinical documentation through query interaction to ensure that the information captured supports the level of service rendered, with attention towards chronic conditions, hierarchical condition categories (HCC), and risk adjustment factors (RAF).

  9. Demonstrates an excellent working knowledge of hospital information systems to retrieve data specific information (i.e., order diagnosis, patient type) within a complicated filing schema including non-hospital data (i.e., Media Tab, Office Visits etc)

jobs.title: Peer Group Leader (Director)
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryNeuGroup is seeking an accomplished, entrepreneurial Peer Group Leader (PGL) to build, lead and grow exceptional executive communities across the Office of the CFO.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

NeuGroup is seeking an accomplished, entrepreneurial Peer Group Leader (PGL) to build, lead and grow exceptional executive communities across the Office of the CFO. These communities may include FP&A leaders, regional and business CFOs, chief accounting officers, chief audit executives, enterprise risk leaders and other senior finance professionals.

At its core, this is a role about bringing the right people together, creating exceptional peer exchanges and turning those relationships into enduring member value and network growth.

The PGL is not simply a meeting facilitator or community manager. This individual is an executive convener, trusted advisor, strategic connector and skilled facilitator who understands what matters to senior finance leaders and can persuade them that NeuGroup is a community worth joining, contributing to and returning to.

Successful PGLs combine financial credibility with strong relationship-building skills, intellectual curiosity and commercial instinct. They know how to identify the executives who belong in a room together, engage them around compelling issues and create an environment where candid exchanges produce insights and connections that members cannot easily find elsewhere.

The role requires both a deep understanding of today's finance challenges and a point of view about what comes next. AI, automation, data and emerging technologies are reshaping finance organizations, operating models and leadership expectations. The PGL will help members navigate these changes by connecting them with relevant peers, practical examples and opportunities to learn from one another's experiences.

The PGL will also help members address challenges that cross traditional functional boundaries, including finance, technology, procurement, global business services, supply chain and corporate development.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in business finance or the broader Office of the CFO, along with the confidence, presence and relationship-building ability to engage senior executives. We are looking for someone who can build a community, not simply manage one, and who takes genuine satisfaction in making connections that create value for others.

Key Responsibilities

Build Exceptional Executive Communities

  • Identify, attract and engage senior finance executives whose participation will strengthen the quality, relevance and value of NeuGroup's peer communities.
  • Develop a clear point of view about who should be part of each community, why their participation matters and what will motivate them to engage.
  • Build personal relationships with members and prospective members, understanding their priorities, challenges, professional ambitions and potential contributions to the network.
  • Take an active role in driving attendance and participation, personally encouraging the right executives to join meetings, contribute to discussions and invite relevant peers.
  • Create a sense of community and belonging that makes members want to return, deepen their involvement and advocate for NeuGroup.
  • Partner with NeuGroup's member growth team to identify qualified prospects, referrals, membership expansion opportunities and potential new communities.

Serve as a Trusted Advisor and Chief Connector

  • Establish credibility with senior finance leaders through informed conversations, sound judgment and a strong understanding of the issues shaping their roles.
  • Maintain an ongoing understanding of members' strategic priorities, transformation initiatives and professional objectives.
  • Proactively make high-value introductions within and across peer groups, connecting members with people who can help them solve problems, validate decisions or explore new opportunities.
  • Recognize connections that may not be obvious to members themselves, including opportunities to learn across functions, industries and career paths.
  • Help members navigate complex challenges by asking thoughtful questions, offering relevant perspectives and connecting them to the expertise of the network.
  • Serve as relationship manager for assigned member accounts, working to strengthen engagement, satisfaction, retention and the value members receive throughout the year.

Design Compelling, Forward-Looking Programs

  • Develop distinctive, relevant agendas that give senior executives compelling reasons to prioritize NeuGroup gatherings.
  • Combine member priorities, market developments, research and network intelligence to identify the issues finance leaders should be addressing today and preparing for tomorrow.
  • Bring a proactive editorial perspective to programming, introducing important emerging topics rather than relying solely on members to identify what they want to discuss.
  • Curate the right mix of participants, member case studies, outside expertise and perspectives to create unusually valuable peer exchanges.
  • Frame sessions around specific challenges, questions and decisions, with a clear understanding of the value members should take away.
  • Work with members, hosts, sponsors and internal colleagues to develop differentiated in-person and virtual experiences.

Facilitate Exceptional Peer Exchanges

  • Lead candid, highly interactive discussions among approximately 25 to 35 senior finance executives.
  • Establish the trust and credibility needed for members to share sensitive challenges, difficult decisions, failures and lessons learned.
  • Create a dynamic environment in which members contribute actively, challenge assumptions and learn from different perspectives.
  • Draw out the most relevant experiences and insights, making connections between participants and ideas in real time.
  • Balance thoughtful preparation with the ability to adapt to the needs, interests and energy of the room.
  • Move discussions beyond information sharing toward practical conclusions, stronger relationships and meaningful next steps.

Turn Connections and Insights into Lasting Value

  • Identify opportunities for members to continue valuable conversations and collaborate on shared challenges between formal meetings.
  • Facilitate targeted introductions, focused follow-ups and small-group collaboration that help members apply what they have learned.
  • Recognize when a member challenge would benefit from a more structured approach, such as a Continuation Circle or Execution Sprint, and help connect the right participants and resources.
  • Capture important member priorities, commitments and opportunities for further engagement.
  • Work with NeuGroup's Content and Intelligence team to distill valuable exchanges into practical insights, member-validated frameworks, research and other reusable resources.
  • Help members recognize and articulate the business value generated through their participation in NeuGroup.

Advance Finance Transformation and Thought Leadership

  • Maintain a strong understanding of how AI, automation, data and emerging technologies are changing finance functions, leadership roles and operating models.
  • Engage members in substantive conversations about practical adoption, implementation challenges, governance, scaling and business value.
  • Identify relevant use cases, successful approaches and common challenges across companies and industries.
  • Connect members who are exploring similar transformation priorities, including opportunities for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Contribute ideas and member intelligence that inform NeuGroup's broader research, programming and strategic direction.

Contribute to Network Growth and Continuous Improvement

  • Take ownership of the health, participation and long-term value of assigned communities.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen relationships with existing member companies and expand participation across the Office of the CFO.
  • Generate qualified introductions and referrals in partnership with NeuGroup's member growth team, which leads the membership sales and conversion process.
  • Use member feedback, engagement signals and outcomes to continuously improve community relevance and the member experience.
  • Leverage NeuGroup's shared operations, research resources, digital platform and AI-enabled tools to focus time on high-value relationships, executive engagement and program quality.
  • Share successful approaches, ideas and innovations with other PGLs to strengthen the overall network.
  • Collaborate with Events, Marketing, Content and Intelligence, and sponsor-facing colleagues to deliver a consistent, high-value member experience.

About NeuGroup

NeuGroup is the premier membership network for forward-looking leaders across the Office of the CFO, including treasurers, heads of FP&A, chief accounting officers, chief audit executives and other senior finance executives at the world's most iconic companies and those shaping what comes next.

For more than three decades, we have brought together senior practitioners in trusted peer communities where they exchange ideas, challenge conventional thinking, validate decisions and solve problems that matter.

Through curated peer forums, meaningful connections, research, benchmarking and execution-oriented follow-ups, we help members move from insight to outcomes. Our value comes not simply from bringing executives together, but from bringing the right people together and creating exchanges that lead to lasting relationships and measurable business value.

Why Join NeuGroup?

NeuGroup is entering a new chapter as we expand our reach across the Office of the CFO, strengthen our research and intelligence capabilities, and use technology to create more valuable connections and outcomes for members.

This is an opportunity to play a central role in that growth by building communities of influential finance executives, shaping the conversations that matter to them and creating relationships that lead to lasting business value.

For someone who combines finance expertise with a natural ability to connect people, engage executives and build something meaningful, the Peer Group Leader role offers an unusual opportunity to make an impact across some of the world's most influential companies.

Requirements

Required

  • Significant professional experience in business finance, FP&A, accounting, audit, risk, treasury, corporate finance or another Office of the CFO function, or equivalent experience demonstrating strong finance expertise and credibility with senior executives.
  • Ability to engage confidently in substantive discussions with CFOs and other senior finance leaders, understanding their business priorities and the decisions they face.
  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining high-value professional relationships and networks.
  • Strong executive presence, interpersonal skills and the ability to attract, engage and influence accomplished senior leaders.
  • Exceptional facilitation, presentation and communication skills, including the ability to lead dynamic discussions among experienced executives.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to recognize opportunities to build relationships, strengthen communities and grow a professional network.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a strong point of view about the future of finance, including the impact of AI, automation, data and emerging technologies.
  • Sound judgment, discretion and the ability to build trust in confidential, high-level discussions.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to connect ideas, identify emerging themes and translate complex discussions into useful insights.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. Master's degree preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within the United States.

Preferred

  • Experience in a senior finance leadership role, management consulting, executive advisory, professional services or a related field.
  • Experience convening executive audiences, developing professional communities or building influential business networks.
  • An established network of senior finance executives and relevant industry relationships.
  • Experience leading or advising on finance transformation, technology implementation, AI adoption or cross-functional business initiatives.
  • Experience developing executive programming, research, benchmarking or thought leadership.
  • Familiarity with membership organizations, executive peer networks or other relationship-driven business models.
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or sharing best practices across a team.

Benefits

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Paid vacation, sick leave and holidays
  • Flexible remote-work arrangements
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
  • Employee recognition and performance-based incentive programs

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

Your new role

Strategic Pursuits team. Building on strong research, writing, coordination and document management skills, the Pursuit Coordinator will help pursuit teams find, develop, organise and refine content needed for winning bids, tenders and proposals. The role will support all stages, from early client and competitor insight through submission, interviews and lessons learned.

You will work closely with Pursuit Consultants, fellow pursuit and proposal specialists, and technical teams across the full pursuit lifecycle. At Ramboll, our ambition is to be The Partner for Sustainable Change, and we are committed to creating innovative solutions that will contribute to accelerating the ongoing sustainable transition. Working for Ramboll means working for a company that strives to make a difference for our employees, clients and society. Combining local presence with global reach, we offer you a strong platform for continuous professional growth. The successful applicant for this role will have the opportunity to contribute to our strategy to close the gap to a sustainable future. 

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Strong research skills, with the ability to source business, client, competitor and stakeholder information
  • Strong organisational and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple information requests, deadlines and review cycles
  • As this is a global role, you will be comfortable working remotely and with teams based internationally
  • Confidence using Microsoft 365 collaboration tools, particularly Teams, SharePoint, Word and PowerPoint
  • Ability to build effective relationships across technical and support teams and to work collaboratively, using your own initiative
  • This role offers opportunities to grow within a new and evolving process so a desire to learn new skills and input into new processes is essential
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to challenge unclear or incomplete instructions
  • Experience of using AI systems is desirable
  • In-Design skills will be desirable
  • APMP foundation certification desirable but not required

What we can offer you

  • Meaningful, high-impact work
  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Professional development and leadership opportunities
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $65,000- $75,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. You may also join us from time to time for in-person collaboration at our Toronto office. Preference will be given to candidates in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). If you live outside the GTA and can travel for these meetings, we’d still like to hear from you!

Responsibilities

AI integration development

  • Design and build MCP servers and AI integrations using the official TypeScript MCP SDK.

  • Connect MCP tools to existing APIs and services, handling data mapping, pagination, retries, idempotency and rate limits.

AI tool design and evaluation

Security and access

  • Implement authentication and authorization for MCP servers, including OAuth 2.1, so agents can reach only what their user can reach.
  • Treat content returned by tools as untrusted, and guard against prompt injection and over-broad permissions.
  • Log which agent called which tool, without exposing sensitive customer data in logs or responses.

Delivery and engineering excellence

  • Write clean, well-tested code, with unit and integration tests, and take part in code reviews.
  • Deploy and run services on AWS through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Monitor tool latency, failure rates and usage, not just overall server health.
  • Write clear setup guides and technical documentation.
  • Build with accessibility in mind, so what you ship works well for people who use assistive technology.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to deliver quickly while keeping quality high.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional backend development experience, building and running production services and APIs.

  • Experience designing, building and integrating REST APIs in production.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building with AI, including:

    • Integrating large language models (LLMs) into applications.
    • Tool calling (function calling) and structured outputs.

    • Experience with Express.js and the Serverless Framework.
    • Experience with AWS services, such as Lambda, ECS or API Gateway, and with Docker.
    • Experience with MongoDB.

    • Experience with AI agent frameworks and SDKs.
    • Experience with JSON-RPC or other real-time communication protocols.
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code.
    • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms.
    • Experience building integrations with third-party SaaS tools.
    • Knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG) or experience with assistive technology.

Our values

To lead, listen first

You amplify voices that are less often heard and create space for those voices to grow. The quality of an idea doesn't correlate with the loudness of someone's voice.

The brain is a muscle

If you're going to do something, you will do it well. Practice often and rest when needed. Give your mind what it needs to thrive.

Unlearn to learn

What did we learn growing up, and what do we need to unlearn? It's essential to understanding our personal bias and position so that we can grow.

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager – Singapore to own the end-to-end customer experience for OPSWAT customers in the Singapore market.

This role will be responsible for managing the local customer support team while acting as a trusted customer-facing leader throughout the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and deployment to adoption, expansion, and ongoing technical engagement.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and customer-facing skills with the ability to build relationships with customers, drive successful outcomes, manage escalations, and work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Global Customer Experience teams.

This is a customer-facing leadership role with responsibility for coordinating technical support and Professional Services for OPSWAT customers in Singapore. The role operates in a matrix organization: you will lead local customer engagement and outcomes while working through global Support, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to align priorities, mobilize the right expertise, and deliver a consistent customer experience. Success requires influence without relying solely on direct reporting lines, strong ownership, and the ability to stay hands-on with complex technical issues.

We are specifically looking for a hands-on, technically strong, customer-facing leader who can manage technical support and Professional Services in a matrix organization. The successful candidate will engage directly with customers on complex technical issues, guide and coach support engineers, coordinate Professional Services delivery, personally drive critical escalations, and work closely with Product and Engineering to resolve root causes. This is a player-coach role that combines practical technical depth, customer ownership, and the ability to influence and align global teams without relying solely on direct reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience & Success

  • Own the overall customer experience and satisfaction for OPSWAT customers in Singapore.
  • Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and become a trusted technical advisor.
  • Ensure customers successfully onboard, deploy, configure, and adopt the OPSWAT Platform.
  • Proactively monitor customer adoption, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to improve platform utilization.
  • Understand customers’ security challenges and identify opportunities to leverage additional OPSWAT capabilities and use cases.
  • Conduct regular customer reviews and technical/business discussions with strategic customers.

Local Support Team Management

  • Lead and manage the local customer support team in Singapore.
  • Ensure effective case management, prioritization, SLA adherence, and customer communication.
  • Coach and mentor support engineers to continuously improve technical capability and customer engagement.
  • Monitor team performance, customer satisfaction, escalations, and operational KPIs.
  • Collaborate with global support teams to ensure consistent processes and 24×7 customer coverage where required.

Escalation Management

  • Own critical and high-priority customer escalations in Singapore.
  • Act as the primary point of coordination between customers, Support, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.
  • Drive escalations to timely resolution while maintaining clear and proactive communication with customers.
  • Identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to eliminate root causes.

Product Adoption & Customer Advocacy

  • Identify new customer use cases and help customers maximize the value of the OPSWAT Platform.
  • Capture customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps and communicate them effectively to Product Management and Engineering.
  • Represent the voice of the customer within OPSWAT.
  • Identify opportunities for customers to expand their use of OPSWAT products and capabilities.
  • Develop customer references, success stories, and advocacy opportunities where appropriate.

Hands-on Technical Leadership

  • Remain actively involved in troubleshooting complex customer issues and critical incidents, partnering with engineers as needed.
  • Lead technical triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution planning for high-impact cases; ensure follow-through on corrective and preventive actions.
  • Review case trends and technical escalations to identify product gaps, recurring defects, and opportunities to improve support effectiveness.
  • Provide technical coaching, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to strengthen the capability and independence of the local team.

Matrix Leadership Across Support & Professional Services

  • Coordinate customer-facing technical support and Professional Services activities, ensuring customers receive joined-up guidance from issue resolution through deployment, implementation, and ongoing optimization.
  • Operate effectively in a matrix organization by aligning priorities, resources, and commitments with global Support and Professional Services leaders, even where teams do not report directly to this role.
  • Act as the local customer-facing owner for communication, expectations, and outcomes while engaging the appropriate global technical specialists and service delivery teams.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to align customer needs, service plans, escalations, and strategic account priorities.
  • Maintain clear ownership, action tracking, and communication across functions to avoid handoff gaps and deliver a consistent customer experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on customer strategy, renewals, expansion, and strategic opportunities.
  • Work with Professional Services to ensure successful deployments and project handoffs.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering on customer requirements, feature requests, and product improvements.
  • Work with the global Customer Experience organization to share best practices and continuously improve customer experience.

Key Success Metrics

  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Customer retention and renewal success
  • Successful onboarding and deployment
  • Platform adoption and utilization
  • Support SLA and escalation performance
  • Reduction in recurring customer issues
  • Customer engagement and executive relationships
  • Number and quality of customer use cases identified
  • Customer feedback and product improvement contributions
  • Team performance, capability, and employee engagement

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Support, Professional Services, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience managing or leading a technical support/customer-facing team.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT and cybersecurity environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and managing complex technical escalations.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Strong business-level English communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex enterprise and cybersecurity issues rather than relying solely on team escalation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead from the front during critical customer incidents, including technical triage, root-cause analysis, and coordination of resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cybersecurity products, enterprise security platforms, or critical infrastructure protection.
  • Experience with SaaS/platform deployments and enterprise adoption programs.
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers in Singapore.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as malware protection, file security, email security, data security, network security, cloud security, or endpoint security.
  • Experience managing strategic accounts and executive-level customer relationships.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the Customer Experience Manager will establish a strong local customer experience organization in Singapore, build trusted relationships with key customers, improve onboarding and platform adoption, create an effective escalation management process, and establish a strong feedback loop between local customers and OPSWAT’s global Product and Engineering teams.

The ultimate goal is simple: ensure every OPSWAT customer in Singapore realizes maximum value from the platform and views OPSWAT as a trusted security partner—not simply a technology vendor.

Hilo is looking for an experienced Human Factors Project Manager to own all of our human factors and usability work. Right now that work is split across Product, Design, Clinical Operations, QARA and outside agencies, and no single person is accountable for it. You'll be that person. You'll coordinate the specialists, keep work moving between teams and make sure every deliverable meets the quality and regulatory standard. That frees our domain teams to get back to their own work.

What you'll own

  • Usability studies: You'll own the study calendar, protocols and relationships with external labs such as Sage Research.   • Packaging: You'll own packaging briefs from start to finish and coordinate agencies (ARD, Superhuit, Carac Design) and freelance packaging designers. You'll keep the work aligned with regulatory, cost and manufacturing constraints.
  • Clinical studies: You'll connect the human factors evidence from ClinOps-run trials with the human factors evidence for the product we ship to customers.
  • Roadmap and reporting: You'll keep a single human factors roadmap and manage dependencies, resourcing and budgets across teams. Each month you'll report confidence levels and raise any risks to leadership.

This is a part time contractor role of up to three days per week, with a total fee of CHF 17,500 for the initial engagement. We would like to start as soon as possible, with a review after three months.

  • Human factors or usability engineering experience in medical devices, ideally with wearables or connected health

  3. Get a decision on the content split for the QSG "5-minute sheet" redesign

Nice to have: FDA submission experience, a UX research background, and familiarity with InDesign/Figma localisation workflows

Benefits

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly.

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones.

Position: Infrastructure Engineer
Location: Poland/Europe - Remote
Type: This can be structured as a B2B contract or Employment Contract with full benefits
Poland B2B Annual Rate: $102,000 - $117,500 depending on experience + stock options
Portugal Salary Band: €60,000 - €72,000 depending on experience + stock options

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are a Silicon Valley-based startup headquartered in San Francisco, with operations in Canada, the UK, multiple EU countries and a tech hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning-first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world, processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of stores globally.

We were recently named Confluent's inaugural Data Streaming Startup of the Year, a recognition of how seriously we take the engineering challenges at the core of our business.

We seek smart, creative, and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a Platform Engineer to own the platform that every image from every store passes through: ingestion, Kafka streaming, Python services, GPU model inference, databases, storage, and the GCP and Kubernetes layer underneath. The team is small, so there is no separate SRE, DBA or release team. When a pipeline slows down, you find out whether the cause is a Kafka consumer, a MySQL query, an autoscaler or a node pool, and you fix it, including in the application code. The role is cloud-only, with no on-prem or datacenter hardware, and CI/CD pipelines are a small part of it.

The core challenge is scale. We are processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of retail locations globally, and that number is growing fast. Load will grow by an order of magnitude, and your job is to make sure cost and operational effort do not grow with it.

What You Will Do

  • Own the design, operation and cost of Focal's production platform on GCP: Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, object storage.
  • Drive measurable reductions in COGS and latency, for example lowering GPU inference cost per store through machine types, batching, autoscaling or scheduling, and report the numbers.
  • Read, debug and change Python (FastAPI, Kafka consumers) backend services. Platform problems are often fixed in application code, for example a MySQL query that ran fine at 1,000 stores and times out at 10,000.
  • Fix throughput bottlenecks such as consumer lag at store opening, whether the cause is partition count, consumer throughput, a downstream database or autoscaling reaction time.
  • Rework metrics, alerts and dashboards so the on-call engineer can tell which stores and regions are affected when an alert fires. Take part in incident response, postmortems and capacity planning.
  • Build tooling that gives engineers access to data across regions and storage systems in minutes instead of days.
  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and the deployment path to production, and work with the backend, deep learning and edge teams so the platform keeps up with new products and models.

What You Need to Be Successful

Must have

  • Python as a software engineer, not only for scripting. You will contribute to backend code every week.
  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems on a cloud platform. GCP preferred; deep AWS or Azure experience is fine.
  • Hands-on production experience operating at least one stateful system under load: Kafka or another streaming platform, MySQL/PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. We mean partitioning, replication, lag, slow queries and failover, not only provisioning.
  • Kubernetes in production, including scheduling, resource limits, autoscaling with KEDA, GPU node pools and debugging misbehaving pods.
  • Debugging production incidents across layers (application, messaging, database, orchestration, network), with examples you can walk us through.
  • Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Grafana Mimir and Sentry, or equivalent: instrumenting code, writing useful alerts.
  • Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.

Nice to have

  • MySQL query tuning; Kafka internals (consumer group rebalancing, partition strategy, throughput tuning), Confluent Cloud and Kafka Connect.
  • GPU workloads or ML inference serving in production (Ray/KubeRay or similar), and cloud cost optimization with measured results.
  • Go, Snowflake, Airflow, CircleCI, Helm, and blue/green or canary releases.

About you

  • You take ownership of problems end to end and follow them into whichever layer they lead.
  • You make decisions from data (profiles, metrics, query plans, cost reports) and prioritize well in startup/scaleup environments.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable coordinating across time zones with a global team.
  • Comfortable with a shared on-call rotation.

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with some of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

What we offerWe care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
  • Paid Time Off
  • Team Retreats
  • Education grants

Note: Our pay bands are driven by market benchmarks in the target geography for hiring. Our posted ranges typically include multiple job levels. A candidate's level is determined by their performance throughout our talent acquisition process including technical screens, behavior interviews, presentations, work samples, and references. We will communicate transparently with the candidate at final stages regarding how we have leveled them, and what salary range that places them into. Placement within range is equally determined by education, general experience in your profession, specific experience in our domain, and your performance in the talent acquisition process. It is rare to receive an offer at the top of the range for a role.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical account engineering helps customers maintain reliable, effective operations as their businesses grow. We value strong technical judgment, proactive problem-solving, clear communication, and people who take ownership of resolving technical challenges that affect customer success.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Account Engineer to help Bask Health's merchants maintain reliable technical operations, resolve complex platform challenges, and make effective use of our software.

This role combines ongoing technical account ownership, integration troubleshooting, platform configuration guidance, and cross-functional problem-solving.

You'll work with an assigned group of customer accounts to understand their technical environments, operational workflows, and recurring challenges.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll develop a detailed understanding of Bask Health's platform and how its technical capabilities support customer operations.

Our software brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll help customers maintain working configurations and address technical issues that interfere with their use of the platform.

You'll serve as a technical point of contact for assigned accounts when they need deeper guidance or investigation.

You'll work closely with customer success managers to understand each customer's business priorities and the technical challenges affecting their experience.

You'll develop familiarity with customer configurations, supported integrations, and important operational workflows.

You'll identify recurring technical issues and help customers address underlying causes rather than repeatedly relying on temporary fixes.

You'll investigate problems involving APIs, webhooks, authentication, configuration settings, and data exchange.

You'll use available logs, browser diagnostic tools, and technical documentation to understand reported problems.

You'll reproduce technical issues when possible and document relevant findings.

You'll distinguish between customer configuration errors, integration failures, product defects, and broader platform incidents.

You'll coordinate with technical support teams when issues require structured escalation or additional investigation.

You'll collaborate with software engineers when a problem requires code-level analysis, infrastructure expertise, or a product fix.

You'll provide clear technical evidence, reproduction steps, customer impact information, and troubleshooting history when escalating issues.

You'll work with product managers when recurring customer challenges indicate product limitations or opportunities for improvement.

You'll help customers understand supported configuration options and technical alternatives.

You'll participate in technical account reviews to discuss recurring issues, integration health, platform usage, and upcoming technical needs.

You'll provide recommendations that help customers maintain stable and effective workflows.

You'll assist customers with technical changes that affect existing integrations or platform configurations.

You'll help customers understand relevant product updates and any technical actions required to continue using supported features.

You'll coordinate with internal teams when customers need help preparing for significant configuration changes.

You'll support technical validation of customer workflows after relevant platform updates or issue resolutions.

You'll help identify technical risks that may affect important customer operations.

You'll communicate those risks to the appropriate internal teams and help coordinate preventive action.

You'll maintain clear communication with customers during technical investigations and escalations.

You'll explain technical findings in language that both technical contacts and business stakeholders can understand.

You'll keep customer success managers informed about issues that may affect account health or customer satisfaction.

You'll document customer technical environments, recurring issues, troubleshooting history, and outstanding action items.

You'll contribute to internal technical knowledge bases and customer-facing documentation.

You'll help create reusable troubleshooting guidance for common integration and configuration problems.

You'll identify patterns across customer accounts and recommend improvements to support procedures or product functionality.

You'll collaborate with customer success engineers on technical onboarding handoffs and post-implementation support.

You'll work with technical support teams to improve escalation quality and reduce repeated investigations.

You'll contribute to discussions about customer-facing platform reliability and technical service quality.

You'll help ensure that customer technical commitments are accurately documented and communicated.

You'll avoid promising custom development, unsupported integrations, or product changes without appropriate internal approval.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to follow internal security and privacy requirements when investigating customer technical issues.

You'll recognize when a request involves clinical, pharmacy, or compliance responsibilities that must be handled by authorized specialists.

You'll provide technical guidance about software functionality without making clinical or pharmacy decisions.

You'll work in a remote, cross-functional environment where technical judgment, initiative, and accountability are important.

We're looking for someone with strong SaaS troubleshooting experience and the ability to manage ongoing technical relationships with customers.

You should be comfortable discussing integrations, configuration, reliability, and technical risks with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

You'll need to be organized, proactive, analytical, and capable of managing several customer technical priorities simultaneously.

Experience supporting merchant-facing SaaS platforms, e-commerce systems, or other transaction-heavy applications is particularly valuable.

Success in this role means helping customers maintain reliable platform operations, reducing recurring technical issues, improving technical account health, and strengthening long-term customer confidence in Bask Health.

What You'll Do

  • Develop an understanding of each customer's technical environment and workflows.
  • Support ongoing technical account health after initial implementation.
  • Help customers maintain supported platform configurations and integrations.
  • Investigate recurring technical issues affecting customer operations.
  • Troubleshoot REST API, webhook, and authentication-related problems.

  • Reproduce customer-reported technical problems and document findings.
  • Distinguish configuration issues from integration failures and product defects.

  • Recommend supported configuration changes and preventive improvements.
  • Participate in technical account reviews and customer discussions.

  • Collaborate with customer success managers on account health concerns.
  • Coordinate with customer success engineers on post-implementation technical needs.

  • Identify recurring technical patterns across customer accounts.
  • Recommend improvements to technical support and escalation processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer technical requests and follow-up activity.
  • Coordinate technical issue resolution across internal stakeholders.

  • Ability to reproduce software defects and document troubleshooting steps.
  • Experience explaining technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate customer technical concerns into actionable internal requests.
  • Experience collaborating directly with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with technical escalation and incident management processes.
  • Ability to identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Finland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Finland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

jobs.description:
Symetra offers a thrilling chance to become part of our team as a Medical Risk Process Improvement & Training Consultant!

About the role

Responsible for developing and delivering training, supporting team member development, and improving processes to promote quality, consistency, and efficiency within the Medical Risk Consultant (MRC) team. This role combines clinical nursing expertise with process ownership and quality oversight to strengthen medical risk assessment practices. The position also performs medical risk reviews to support Underwriting in evaluating potential risks associated with Stop Loss coverage.

What you will do

  • Medical Risk Assessment Training and Education Develop, maintain, and oversee a structured MRC training framework that supports onboarding, role-specific learning, competency development, and ongoing refresher education. Design, facilitate, and continually improve training through virtual instructor-led sessions, interactive case-based discussions, guided practice, and self-directed learning resources. Create a supportive and engaging remote learning environment that encourages active participation, open communication, collaboration, and accountability. Establish and consistently reinforce clear expectations for professionalism, preparedness, participation, and engagement throughout the training process. Promote effective virtual learning practices, including appropriate use of cameras, interactive discussions, knowledge checks, and regular opportunities to assess understanding, in alignment with company policies and individual accommodation needs. Apply clinical expertise and adult learning principles to help trainees understand how medical information, claims experience, and other available reporting contribute to the evaluation of potential risk within a Stop Loss underwriting environment. Recognize the unique challenges of remote learning and adapt training approaches to individual needs while maintaining consistent expectations for competency, quality, and readiness for independent production. Identify learning needs through trainee assessments, operational trends, quality review findings, and evolving business priorities. Provide training and educational support to Claims, Underwriting, Sales, third-party administrators, and other business partners when knowledge or process gaps are identified. Translate complex clinical, insurance, and operational information into clear, practical learning materials, including procedures, job aids, reference guides, and other resources that support understanding and consistent application. Coordinate appropriate review of specialized content. Maintain organized training resources and documentation, including curriculum maps, job aid libraries, assessment materials, trainer guides, and training records. Pilot new or significantly revised training content before broader implementation and evaluate effectiveness through competency assessments, time to independent production, and post-training quality results. Review the overall training framework at least annually to ensure it continues to meet the needs of the MRC team and the organization.
  • Process Ownership and Continuous Improvement Serve as the primary resource and designated owner for assigned MRC processes, procedures, standards, and supporting documentation. Regularly evaluate existing workflows to identify opportunities to strengthen quality, efficiency, consistency, internal controls, documentation, and the customer experience. Develop and implement routine process improvements within the MRC function that align with established policies, regulatory requirements, business objectives, and the responsibilities and authority of the role. Share proposed changes through the established leadership review process, outlining the identified need, recommended approach, anticipated impact, implementation plan, and measures of success. Recognize opportunities for team member learning and professional growth by identifying improvements that may be appropriate for other Medical Risk Consultants or colleagues to lead. In these situations, provide supporting analysis, guidance, resources, and coaching to help the assigned individual successfully develop and present the proposed change. Obtain appropriate leadership and stakeholder approval before implementing changes that materially affect other departments, customer experience, systems, contractual obligations, regulatory or compliance requirements, staffing, financial controls, or significant business risk. Guide approved improvements from initial identification through implementation, including gathering requirements, evaluating potential impacts, coordinating with stakeholders, maintaining documentation, communicating changes, providing education, and assessing outcomes. Support team members leading assigned improvement initiatives by helping define the scope, providing clinical and technical guidance, and offering appropriate oversight. Investigate recurring operational challenges and process breakdowns to understand contributing factors and identify sustainable solutions. Maintain documentation of significant decisions and approvals, monitor outcomes following implementation, and recommend additional adjustments, escalation, or reversal when results do not meet expectations or introduce unintended risks.
  • Clinical Risk Review and Production Support Apply a strong foundation of clinical nursing knowledge, professional experience, and critical thinking to medical risk assessment. Develop and maintain proficiency in Medical Risk Consultant methodology, including the ability to interpret medical and claims-related information, identify potential areas of concern, and communicate findings that support informed underwriting decisions. Partner with Underwriting to evaluate paid claims reports, claimant disclosures, and other available medical and claims-related information to identify individuals with complex, catastrophic, or potentially high-cost medical conditions that may present increased risk under a Stop Loss contract. Use clinical knowledge, research skills, and sound professional judgment to evaluate diagnoses, treatment patterns, anticipated healthcare utilization, emerging therapies, and potential future medical costs. Bring together relevant information to develop clear, well-supported claimant assessments that help Underwriting understand the medical circumstances, potential financial exposure, and considerations relevant to underwriting decisions. Prepare accurate and timely written medical risk assessments in accordance with established procedures and service expectations. Remain engaged in medical risk reviews to strengthen and maintain knowledge of MRC practices, support meaningful training, evaluate process and system changes, and assist with production during periods of increased volume. Sustained production volume remains the primary responsibility of the Medical Risk Consultant role. Serve as a knowledgeable clinical resource by providing professional opinions, second opinions on complex risk assessments, and education to Medical Risk Consultants, Claims Examiners, Underwriters, and other internal and external partners. Coordinate additional clinical or underwriting review support when specialized expertise is needed.
  • Trainee Development and Readiness Assessment Evaluate trainee progress through observation, knowledge assessments, case-based learning, practice reviews, and other established methods that measure understanding and skill development. Review work completed during the training period to assess application of procedures, documentation quality, clinical reasoning, interpretation of medical and claims information, and readiness to perform medical risk reviews independently. Provide timely, thoughtful, and constructive feedback that reinforces strengths, supports learning, and clearly identifies areas where additional development may be beneficial. Create individualized coaching plans, practice opportunities, job aids, or other learning resources when additional reinforcement is needed. Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous learning by establishing clear training expectations and consistently reinforcing established quality standards. Balance an encouraging and supportive coaching approach with thoughtful assessment of each trainee’s demonstrated knowledge, clinical reasoning, engagement, and ability to work independently. Address learning gaps promptly and constructively, ensuring recommendations for training completion and production readiness are supported by documented competencies and established expectations. Maintain accurate documentation of completed training, assessment results, demonstrated competencies, and areas identified for continued development. Communicate trainee progress, strengths, learning needs, and readiness recommendations to the trainee’s manager at established checkpoints, supporting a collaborative approach to successful onboarding and transition into independent production. Make recommendations regarding training completion and production readiness. Final decisions regarding work assignments, performance management, formal counseling, corrective action, or discipline remain with management. Conduct structured quality reviews of each Medical Risk Consultant’s work during the established post-training monitoring period, providing meaningful feedback and reinforcement as appropriate. At the conclusion of that period, transition ongoing performance monitoring to the employee’s manager and the applicable quality assurance process.
  • Quality Review and Continuous Learning Develop, maintain, and carry out a structured quality audit and feedback process that promotes consistent medical risk assessment practices and supports ongoing learning within the MRC function. Establish quality review methodology, including file selection and sampling, scoring criteria, review frequency, and documentation expectations. Conduct scheduled reviews of medical risk assessments and supporting documentation completed by Medical Risk Consultants within the post-training monitoring period. Facilitate periodic calibration discussions to promote shared understanding and consistent application of medical risk assessment methods, documentation standards, and quality scoring criteria. Evaluate audit findings to identify patterns, contributing factors, and opportunities for improvement. Use these insights to enhance procedures, job aids, and educational content, and conduct follow-up reviews to confirm that changes have achieved the intended results. Share quality findings, recurring error trends, and training effectiveness measures with Underwriting leadership and the designated quality assurance function at established intervals. Obtain appropriate management or quality assurance validation when findings may affect processes owned by this role. Use quality findings to guide education, coaching, and process improvements. You'll work on backend services that support prescription routing, pharmacy order processing, fulfillment updates, and the reliable exchange of information between Bask and external systems.

jobs.description:
OutcomesAI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.

Our core product suite includes:

● Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow-ups.
● Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena.
● AI-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis).
Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text-to-speech (TTS) — fine-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first AI + nurse hybrid workforce, improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.

About the Role

OutcomesAI is seeking skilled and compassionate Registered Nurses to join our clinical team as Clinical AI Triage Testers. In this specialized per diem role, you will play a vital part in the development and validation of our conversational agentic AI triage workflows. Your focus is dedicated to clinical quality assurance, ensuring that our triage technology is grounded in clinical excellence. You will use your deep triage expertise and clinical assessment skills to stress-test and evaluate AI components for accuracy, appropriate acuity determination, safety, and context. This position blends the art of nursing judgment with the science of advanced technology, ensuring our AI enhances triage care and maintains the highest safety standards before it ever reaches a patient.

What You’ll Do

  • Test Conversational Nurse Triage AI: Interact with AI navigators and agentic triage workflows across varied clinical scenarios to evaluate their ability to gather relevant symptom histories and provide clinically accurate responses.

  • Audit Triage Accuracy: Review AI-generated symptom assessments, acuity levels, and care dispositions to ensure they align with evidence-based triage protocols (such as Schmitt-Thompson) and sound nursing judgment.

  • Identify Safety Risks: Stress-test AI triage logic to identify potential "hallucinations," missed red flags, or clinical errors that could lead to under-triaging or compromise patient safety.

  • Assess Context and Empathy: Evaluate the AI’s ability to communicate clearly, calmly, and empathetically with patients experiencing acute or concerning symptoms, maintaining the "human connection" in a digital environment.

  • Document Findings: Accurately document testing interactions, detailing where the AI succeeds and where it requires refinement in its clinical questioning, reasoning, or final disposition.

  • Collaborate on Triage Optimization: Participate in team-based improvement initiatives to refine triage pathways and bridge the gap between intelligent technology and clinical care.

What We're Looking For

  • Active, unrestricted RN license.

  • Minimum of 3 years of dedicated triage nursing experience (e.g., telephone triage, nurse advice line, ambulatory triage, or virtual triage).

  • Prior experience using Schmitt-Thompson Clinical Content (triage protocols) is required.

  • Strong Triage Assessment Skills: Proven ability to rapidly evaluate patient-reported symptoms, identify clinical red flags, and spot when an AI's logic deviates from safe triage practice.

  • Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance standardized protocol adherence with independent critical thinking during the testing process.

  • Tech-Savvy: Highly comfortable using virtual care platforms, clinical decision-support tools, digital documentation systems, and emerging AI tools.

  • Clear Communicator: Able to convey complex clinical feedback and triage nuances to technical teams calmly and concisely.

  • Reliability: Ability to commit to a minimum of 10 hours per week of remote testing.

Why Join Us

  • Pioneer Virtual Triage: Be part of a clinical team redefining patient navigation and triage through safe, AI-enabled workflows.

  • Flexibility: Work fully remote with a per diem model designed to fit your lifestyle.

  • Mission-Driven Impact: Help patients access timely, appropriate levels of care by ensuring the triage tools they interact with are safe, reliable, and grounded in clinical excellence.

  • Supportive Culture: Collaborate with an organization built by nurses and clinicians who value the clinical leadership you bring to the forefront of virtual care.

  • Startale's products handle user funds and on-chain transactions so security work has tangible impact.

  • Threat Modeling: Build threat models for new services and features — especially Strium's trading engine, order book, and transaction flows. Identify attack surfaces, model adversary behavior, and define what needs to be hardened before launch.
