jobs.description:
Job Title: Vice President, Applied AI and Data Science

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Revision Date: 11/2026

Role Type: Remote or Hybrid (Jacksonville/Nashville)

About Mosai

Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at​

Position Summary

The Vice President, Applied AI and Data Science leads the design, delivery, and ongoing quality of the AI solutions at the core of Mosai's product suite. These include generative AI and large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and the machine learning and statistical models that complement them. This leader manages a team and is accountable for results that matter to customers: better clinical decisions, more efficient care coordination, and measurable improvements in patient outcomes and clinician productivity.

This role requires a technical AI leader with deep grounding in clinical intelligence and healthcare data & informatics. This role does not need to be a licensed clinician, but must understand clinical data, clinical workflows, and how care is delivered well enough to build AI that clinicians trust and use. The VP will ensure that every model and AI-enabled feature is clinically credible, evaluated, safe, and valuable to the providers and organizations who rely on it as a part of their work. This role will continually evaluate the needs and outcomes and select, leverage a suite of language models (commercial and open-source) against the needs of each use case, and will apply classical machine learning where it is the right tool. The VP must balance Mosai's entrepreneurial culture with the discipline required to deliver production-grade AI in a highly regulated environment.

Job Duties:

Leadership and Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the Applied AI and Data Science organization.
  • Set the vision, roadmap, and operating model for applied AI, aligned to Mosai's product strategy, customer needs, and value-based care objectives.
  • Create a culture of innovation, experimentation, and accountability that encourages smart risk-taking on ambiguous problems while holding a high bar for quality.
  • Serve as a trusted executive voice on AI, translating complex technical concepts into business value and customer impact for executives, clinical leaders, customers, and the board.

Customer Value and Outcomes

  • Own delivery of AI and data science solutions (GenAI, machine learning, and statistical) powering Mosai's products, with clear linkage to customer outcomes such as avoidable utilization, care quality, patient risk stratification, workflow efficiency, and clinician experience.
  • Partner with product and clinical stakeholders to define success metrics for each solution, track realized customer value after deployment (not just model performance), drive adoption, gather feedback, and prioritize improvements that increase value.
  • Apply clinical intelligence and informatics expertise to ensure AI features fit real home-based & hospice care workflows and to support frontline clinicians.

AI Technology Strategy

  • Drive the strategy for a suite of language models, including selecting, benchmarking, and routing across frontier commercial LLMs, open-source and fine-tuned models, and small language models (SLMs) and other specialized models based on accuracy, safety, cost, latency, and data privacy requirements, favoring SLMs where they deliver sufficient quality at lower cost and latency.
  • Lead the adoption of modern GenAI techniques, with particular emphasis on designing, building, and managing agentic workflows, as well as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and structured extraction from clinical notes and other unstructured data.
  • Drive the buildout and requirements for the MosaiAI platform, such as skill libraries, prompt repo, labeling studio, etc.
  • Continue to apply classical machine learning (predictive modeling, risk stratification, time-series, causal inference) where it is the right tool, and apply sound judgment on when to use GenAI and when not to.
  • Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape, bringing in new methods, models, and tooling where they deliver measurable value, and leverage open-source technologies and scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) to accelerate delivery and control cost.

AI Quality and Evaluation

  • Establish and enforce clear standards for model and AI development, validation, and release, including clinical validity, calibration, subgroup performance, bias and fairness assessment, and explainability.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive evaluation frameworks for LLM, GenAI, and agentic workflow solutions, including benchmark and golden datasets, end-to-end testing of multi-step agent behavior and tool use, automated and clinician-in-the-loop evaluation, hallucination and factuality testing, safety and red-teaming, and regression testing across model and prompt changes.
  • Implement production monitoring for drift, performance degradation, data quality, cost, and latency, with defined thresholds, alerting, and remediation processes.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, guardrails, and transparency for AI-assisted clinical and operational decisions.

Governance, Compliance, and Responsible AI

  • Establish and lead AI governance practices, including model documentation, versioning, approval processes, audit trails, and responsible AI principles, and ensure solutions comply with HIPAA and applicable healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, including considerations for clinical decision support and emerging AI regulation.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, Legal, and Clinical leadership to manage risk in the use of PHI, third-party model providers, and AI vendors.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, IT, Data Engineering, Clinical, and Customer teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions and share ownership of customer adoption and growth objectives.
  • Collaborate on data pipelines, MLOps/LLMOps, and platform infrastructure to enable repeatable, production-grade deployment.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Health Informatics, or a related quantitative field required.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data science, machine learning, AI, or advanced analytics roles.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing AI, machine learning, and/or data science teams, including leaders of managers.
  • Proven track record of delivering production-grade AI, GenAI, and ML solutions within commercial products or platforms, with demonstrated customer impact.
  • Experience operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment (SaaS or healthcare technology strongly preferred).

Clinical Intelligence and Healthcare Domain Expertise

  • Demonstrated background in clinical intelligence and/or clinical informatics, with experience building AI or analytics that support clinical decision-making, care management, or care coordination.
  • Working knowledge of clinical data (EHR, claims, assessments, clinical notes) and healthcare standards and terminologies (e.g., FHIR, HL7, ICD-10, SNOMED, RxNorm).
  • Understanding of care delivery workflows, how clinicians interact with decision support, and healthcare regulatory environments (HIPAA, clinical decision support, emerging AI regulation), with the ability to partner credibly with clinical leaders.

AI and Technical Expertise

  • Hands-on, demonstrated experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and NLP, including deploying and evaluating multiple language models (commercial and open-source) in production.
  • Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, safety, and quality methods, including RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, agentic patterns, hallucination mitigation, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Deep expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics, with strong proficiency in Python (or R), ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn), and modern LLM tooling.
  • Experience building scalable solutions with open-source technologies in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with solid understanding of data engineering, model deployment, and MLOps/LLMOps, including monitoring, versioning, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with model governance, bias and fairness assessment, explainability, and responsible AI practices.

Leadership and Communication

  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing AI and data science teams, and to set vision and strategy for AI initiatives aligned to business goals.
  • Proven ability to foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement while maintaining high standards of quality.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering with product, engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into business value and customer impact, influence executive stakeholders, and present to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills in ambiguous environments.

Work Environment

  • Remote or Hybrid (Jacksonville/Nashville)

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) preferred, ideally in a quantitative field or in health or clinical informatics.
  • Experience in home-based care, hospice, post-acute, or value-based care preferred.

Physical Demands of Our Work Environment

This position uses a computer and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The in-office noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office. Frequent interruptions may be encountered throughout the workday.

The employee is required to either stand or sit, talk and hear frequently required to use repetitive keying or hand motions.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, merchant success is about helping business owners build lasting, successful relationships with our platform. We value people who understand how e-commerce businesses operate, take responsibility for customer outcomes, and know how to build teams and processes that help merchants succeed at scale.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Merchant Success to lead our merchant-facing customer success strategy and help businesses using Bask Health achieve long-term success.

This role is responsible for leading customer success operations, developing a high-performing team, improving merchant retention, and creating opportunities for sustainable account growth.

You'll oversee how Bask Health supports merchants throughout the post-sale customer lifecycle, from onboarding and activation through adoption, renewals, retention, and expansion.

Our merchants include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using our platform to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce operations and the challenges businesses face when launching and growing online.

You'll establish a merchant success strategy that aligns customer outcomes with Bask Health's broader business priorities.

You'll define how the team engages merchants at different stages of their relationship with the platform.

You'll build clear expectations for onboarding, account ownership, customer communication, escalation management, and renewal preparation.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer success managers and other merchant-facing team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll establish performance standards and help team members develop stronger account management, commercial judgment, and problem-solving skills.

You'll help create an environment where team members take initiative, follow through on commitments, and understand the businesses they support.

You'll work with leadership to define the appropriate customer segmentation model and determine how resources should be allocated across merchant accounts.

You'll help develop account coverage strategies for strategic customers, growing merchants, and smaller businesses.

You'll establish processes for monitoring merchant engagement, platform adoption, account health, and retention risk.

You'll develop reporting that helps leadership understand the performance of the merchant success function.

You'll track relevant indicators such as customer retention, churn, renewals, expansion, onboarding progress, and account engagement.

You'll identify patterns in merchant behavior that indicate opportunities for improvement or potential account risk.

You'll create proactive strategies to address customer dissatisfaction, operational friction, and declining engagement.

You'll oversee important merchant escalations and ensure the appropriate teams are involved in resolving them.

You'll build relationships with key merchant stakeholders, including founders, executives, and business owners.

You'll participate in strategic account conversations when leadership involvement can help strengthen relationships or resolve difficult issues.

You'll help the team conduct effective business reviews and maintain meaningful conversations about merchant goals and performance.

You'll work closely with sales leadership to coordinate customer transitions, renewal preparation, and appropriate expansion opportunities.

jobs.description:
Description

Company Profile

The Solar Energy Industries Association (SEIA) is the national trade association for the solar and storage industry and represents more than 1,000 member companies and an industry workforce of more than 255,000 across the United States. SEIA is leading the transformation to a clean energy economy and is creating the framework for solar to reach 30% of U.S. electricity generation by 2030. We work with our member companies and strategic partners to advocate for policies that create jobs and shape fair market rules that promote competition and the growth of reliable, low-cost solar power.

SEIA does this by supporting pro-solar policies at the state and federal level, developing cutting-edge market research, hosting educational events and webinars, and serving as the voice of the solar and storage industry.

SEIA employees are passionate, forward-thinking leaders who start every day knowing that their work makes a difference. SEIA fosters an inclusive, lively company culture that values our employees’ varied backgrounds and experiences and celebrates team success. The Association has earned numerous awards for its work and company culture and was named The Washington Post as a Top Workplace in 2023 and 2024 and by the Nonprofit Times as one of the “Best Nonprofits to Work For” in America in April 2022

Position Summary

The Director, Midwest is responsible for the development and implementation of SEIA’s policies and positions in the dynamic and growing solar markets in the Midwest. The position reports to the Vice President of State Affairs and will work in close collaboration with other SEIA departments, including Research, Communications, and Membership.

The ideal candidate should have the desire and demeanor to build a strong network within the solar and clean energy industries and will have had professional exposure to energy policy and/or markets, and be familiar with topics such as storage, demand response, virtual power plants, distribution management systems, and interconnection policies. The successful candidate must be able to build relationships and be a natural collaborator. They should be able to manage project teams effectively and facilitate dialogue with both internal and external colleagues.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Candidates will have experience with the regulatory and legislative processes in the region, in the traditional or renewable energy sector.

  • Oversees regulatory & legislative activity in SEIA priority states in the Midwest US, with a particular focus on Illinois, Michigan, and Minnesota.
  • Manages the SEIA Midwest Region Committee and day-to-day activities in collaboration with company leads. This includes facilitating regular calls/meetings with SEIA members.
  • Participates in legislative/lobbying initiatives.
  • Works with outside counsel, contract lobbyists, and technical consultants as needed.
  • Collaborates with other associations, SEIA state affiliates, other stakeholders and parties, consultants, etc.
  • Participates as available/necessary in other states and overall SEIA activities as time permits.

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Minimum 5-8 years’ experience with clean energy research, energy policy, utility program/policy development, or related fields
  • Regulatory experience in Illinois, Michigan, or Minnesota is preferred, and legislative experience is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage challenging and diverse views of members.
  • Self-starter – can work independently and remotely.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and is able to perceive when to lead and when to build consensus.

Working Conditions

  • Work is in an office environment or a remote-office environment suitably equipped with internet and telephone access.
  • The successful candidate will preferably be located in the greater Chicago area. Consideration will be given to candidates based in Springfield, IL, or Lansing, MI.

﻿Compensation Range

  • $115,000--$125,000 annually, based on experience and excellent benefits package.

Working at SEIA

SEIA welcomes different perspectives, identities, and backgrounds, working collaboratively in support of our mission, regardless of job function. SEIA envisions an industry that is committed to fostering a culture of inclusivity and respect for all.

SEIA complies with applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we employ staff. jobs.description:
Proteger as aplicações e os produtos financeiros da RecargaPay de ponta a ponta, do design da feature à correção da vulnerabilidade. A pessoa atua na base de Application Security do time, sendo dona do ciclo de vulnerabilidades junto às squads, e aprofunda em Adversarial Security, conduzindo pentests internos de aplicações, APIs e mobile com foco em lógica de negócio e risco financeiro. Trabalha em um time AI-first, usando automação e agentes de IA para escalar segurança para toda a engenharia.

RESPONSABILIDADES
Ser dono do ciclo de vida das vulnerabilidades de aplicação: triagem, priorização por risco de negócio (perda financeira e exposição de dados de clientes), negociação de prazos com as squads, acompanhamento e validação da correção.

Conduzir threat modeling e design review de features críticas, como Pix, crédito, cartões e onboarding, antes do desenvolvimento.

Fazer code review de segurança e evoluir os controles de SAST e SCA no pipeline, aumentando a cobertura e reduzindo falsos positivos.

Planejar e executar pentests de aplicações web, APIs e mobile, com foco em lógica de negócio, autenticação e autorização, transformando achados em correção e em testes de regressão.

Definir o escopo técnico dos pentests externos e do ciclo anual de PCI DSS, e triar os achados que chegam de fora (bug bounty, consultorias e reportes externos), validando explorabilidade, severidade real e dono antes de levar às squads.

Apoiar o programa de Security Champions, orientando as squads e elevando a maturidade de desenvolvimento seguro.

Usar e construir automações e agentes de IA para escalar code review, triagem e testes de segurança. Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar os analistas plenos do time.

Requirements

Experiência sólida em Application Security em empresa de produto, incluindo gestão de vulnerabilidades de ponta a ponta com times de desenvolvimento e priorização por risco de negócio.

Experiência em pentest de aplicações web e APIs (REST/GraphQL), incluindo lógica de negócio, autenticação e autorização (IDOR/BOLA).

Code review de segurança em pelo menos uma linguagem de backend (Java, Kotlin, Go, Python ou Node.js). Experiência com threat modeling e com ferramentas de SAST e SCA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.

Desenvolvimento de scripts e automações em Python ou Go. Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação, advisories e pesquisas.

Formação em tecnologia e áreas afins, ou experiência equivalente.

Diferencial: pentest mobile Android e iOS (Frida, objection, Burp Suite).

Diferencial: segurança de LLMs, agentes e MCPs, ou uso de agentes de IA em fluxos de segurança.

Diferencial: vivência em ambiente financeiro regulado (PCI DSS, LGPD, BACEN).

Diferencial: certificações como OSWE, BSCP, OSCP ou equivalentes.

COMPETÊNCIAS

Ownership: acompanha a vulnerabilidade até a correção, sem parar no relatório. Julgamento de risco: separa o que é explorável e relevante para o negócio do ruído, sem inflar severidade.

Influência com engenharia: convence squads com evidência e negocia prazo e mitigação quando a correção imediata não é possível.

Comunicação em dois níveis: explica impacto para a liderança e o passo de correção para quem desenvolve.

Mentoria: eleva o nível técnico dos plenos por revisão, pareamento e feedback direto.

Mentalidade AI-first: usa IA para escalar o trabalho, com senso crítico sobre falsos positivos.

Ética e discrição no uso de acessos privilegiados e dados sensíveis.

Benefits

  • Salário competitivo e alinhado ao mercado.
  • Trabalho remoto — esteja onde estiver, você faz parte do time!
  • Auxílio home office com um depósito mensal no app RecargaPay.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico sem coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Vale-refeição flexível (via Flash).
  • TotalPass para cuidar da sua saúde

Diversidade & Inclusão na RecargaPay

No RecargaPay, você tem liberdade para ser quem você é. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas e experiências nos tornam mais criativos, inovadores e fortes. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas para se expressar de forma autêntica. Valorizamos cada trajetória e as múltiplas formas de enxergar o mundo, sem distinções.

Sobre o uso dos seus Dados

Ao compartilhar seu currículo conosco, você autoriza o uso de seus dados para análise durante o processo seletivo e, possivelmente, para outras oportunidades dentro do grupo RecargaPay. Você pode solicitar a atualização ou exclusão de suas informações a qualquer momento, conforme a LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados).

jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for an Applied ML Engineer, Agents & Automation to design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that automate complex workflows across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

Bask Health brings together merchant operations, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools. Many of these processes involve multiple applications, structured information, business rules, and repetitive tasks. You'll help build AI-powered systems that can coordinate these steps while operating within clearly defined permissions and reliability requirements.

This role focuses on developing production AI agents that use large language models, application tools, retrieval systems, and workflow orchestration to complete approved tasks. You'll work on the technical infrastructure that allows agents to retrieve information, select appropriate tools, execute actions, handle failures, and maintain context throughout multi-step processes.

You'll combine applied machine learning with strong software engineering practices. Depending on the use case, this may involve model selection, fine-tuning, task-specific evaluation, or other machine learning techniques that improve agent performance. You'll also recognize when deterministic software and conventional automation are more reliable than model-driven decisions.

Your work may support merchant operations, internal administrative processes, patient-related coordination, and pharmacy workflows. You'll collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, applied AI engineers, and operational stakeholders to identify opportunities where automation can reduce manual work and improve consistency.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, agents must be designed with appropriate safeguards, access controls, auditability, and human approval requirements. You'll help ensure that automated systems operate within approved business and clinical boundaries and do not independently perform actions that require licensed professional judgment.

This is a hands-on engineering position with meaningful ownership over agent behavior, automation architecture, and production reliability. You'll build reusable systems, measure their performance, and improve them based on real-world results.

We're looking for someone who understands both the potential and limitations of AI agents and enjoys building systems that are useful, measurable, secure, and dependable.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate approved workflows across Bask Health's platform.
  • Develop agent architectures that combine large language models, tools, APIs, and application logic.
  • Build multi-step automation systems that coordinate tasks across multiple services.
  • Implement reliable tool-calling and function-execution capabilities.
  • Develop agent orchestration logic for task planning, execution, and completion.
  • Build reusable components for agent state management, context handling, and workflow execution.
  • Integrate AI agents with internal APIs, databases, and approved external services.
  • Develop retrieval capabilities that provide agents with relevant information and application context.
  • Design structured outputs and validation systems for agent-generated actions.
  • Implement permission checks and authorization controls for automated tool execution.
  • Build human approval and confirmation steps for sensitive or consequential actions.
  • Develop safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized actions, and unreliable model behavior.
  • Implement retry logic, error recovery, timeouts, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Build monitoring and tracing systems that make agent behavior observable and debuggable.
  • Create automated tests for tool selection, workflow execution, and task completion.
  • Develop evaluation datasets and benchmarks for agent accuracy and reliability.
  • Measure agent success rates, task completion, latency, and operational costs.
  • Investigate agent failures and improve prompts, tools, models, and orchestration logic.
  • Evaluate whether model adaptation, fine-tuning, or alternative ML approaches improve task performance.
  • Collaborate with product teams to identify repetitive workflows suitable for automation.
  • Develop AI-powered automation for merchant configuration and operational tasks.
  • Support approved administrative workflows involving patient and pharmacy coordination.
  • Work with backend engineers to integrate agent systems into production infrastructure.
  • Design event-driven automation triggered by approved application events.
  • Optimize agent performance, infrastructure usage, and model inference costs.
  • Build internal tools that help engineers inspect, test, and troubleshoot agent workflows.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering planning.
  • Own assigned automation initiatives from technical design through deployment and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience building and deploying production software applications.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications or intelligent automation systems.
  • Familiarity with large language models and modern generative AI development techniques.
  • Experience integrating model APIs into production software.
  • Understanding of tool calling, function calling, and AI application orchestration.
  • Experience building backend services and application APIs.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous programming and distributed application workflows.
  • Understanding of workflow state management and multi-step process execution.
  • Experience integrating internal services, databases, and third-party APIs.
  • Familiarity with structured model outputs and schema validation.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and model behavior evaluation.
  • Ability to identify and troubleshoot unreliable AI-generated outputs.
  • Experience designing automated tests for production software.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure API design.
  • Ability to implement error handling, retries, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment.
  • Understanding of data pipelines and structured application data.
  • Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs between AI-driven automation and deterministic software.
  • Experience working with Git, code review, and collaborative engineering practices.
  • Ability to translate operational requirements into reliable technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently own engineering projects and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building production AI agents or agent-based automation systems.
  • Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar model APIs.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent workflows or coordinated agent execution.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and vector search.
  • Experience building AI applications with persistent state or long-running workflows.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and workflow engines.
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable cloud services.
  • Experience with Temporal or similar durable workflow orchestration platforms.
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, supervised learning, or task-specific model adaptation.
  • Familiarity with machine learning evaluation methodologies and experiment tracking.
  • Experience developing benchmarks for agent task completion and tool-use accuracy.
  • Experience with agent observability and tracing tools.
  • Familiarity with human-in-the-loop approval systems.
  • Experience implementing sandboxed tool execution or restricted automation environments.
  • Understanding of prompt injection risks and agent security practices.
  • Experience building automation for SaaS platforms or e-commerce operations.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, telehealth, or pharmacy-related workflows.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

The Role

Lumen’s Black Lotus Labs is seeking a Lead Site Reliability Engineer and join our US-based Information Security / Big Data team. This small team of passionate security researchers works on vast, unique information security related data sets using our distributed computing cluster. The team is looking for a knowledgeable Linux admin with a passion for learning, running distributed systems, and an interest in the security domain. This is a team of people that love to be creative, learn new things, and innovate using their expertise to make an impact in the information security world. If you enjoy being at the cutting edge of technology and making the Internet a safer place, then this is the job for you.

This position will work within the platform and infrastructure of Black Lotus Labs, supporting the ongoing operations of a big data infrastructure that is used to ingest, parse, store, and analyze cyber threats, as well as supporting the operations of other systems to facilitate cyber security research and analysis. The work effort of the role is focused on the ongoing operational support of on-premises and cloud hosted Linux (Ubuntu) systems that support our Hadoop ecosystem (HBase, HDFS, Spark, Kafka, etc.), Elasticsearch and Redis clusters, Docker using Docker Swarm, a malware environment, and a network of honeypots.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Join a small research and engineering team at a digital trust and security startup. You will develop and evaluate AI methods for synthetic media detection and fraud prevention, translating research into reliable product capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate methods for deepfake detection, synthetic media analysis, and fraud prevention.

  • Read and reproduce research, then identify approaches with potential for practical development.

  • Design experiments, establish baselines, and evaluate models on realistic data.

  • Implement research ideas and collaborate with engineering to bring effective methods into production.

  • Analyze failures and improve model reliability, generalization, and computational efficiency.

  • Document findings and contribute to research papers and technical writing.

  • Work with team leadership to prioritize research around practical customer problems.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 3 years of experience training deep learning models with PyTorch, including taking at least one model from concept to production.

  • An MS or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

  • Strong machine learning foundations and experience building, training, and evaluating models.

  • Computer vision knowledge, including CNNs, vision transformers, and their tradeoffs at small parameter counts.

  • Experience in at least one relevant area: synthetic media detection, image or video forensics, audio spoofing detection, generative models, or adversarial robustness.

  • Ability to critically assess research papers, design experiments, and clearly communicate findings.

  • Evidence of research and engineering ability through shipped systems, publications, open-source contributions, or substantial applied projects.

  • Experience deploying models with real-world latency and reliability constraints is valuable.

  • Comfort taking ownership of open-ended work in a small team.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is flexible based on experience and candidacy. The package includes a performance bonus and 0.25% to 1% equity. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

On-site in New York, New York.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to own the full email execution cycle across campaign builds, automations, A/B testing, segmentation, and performance reporting inside Klaviyo for a data-first growth marketing agency serving a focused roster of e-commerce and DTC brands.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to own the full email execution cycle across campaign builds, automations, A/B testing, segmentation, and performance reporting inside Klaviyo for a data-first growth marketing agency serving a focused roster of e-commerce and DTC brands.

This is a hands-on execution role with real ownership of campaign performance. You will be in Klaviyo every day, building flows, running A/B tests, managing segmentation, and turning performance data into clear, client-ready reporting. This is not a strategy-from-a-distance role. If you are a detail-obsessed email marketer who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and takes pride in clean, error-free deployments that actually move metrics, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work inside a data-first agency with a rigorous analytical culture and a focused, high-quality e-commerce client roster
  • High-ownership email execution role with direct impact on campaign performance across multiple client accounts

What You'll Work On

Campaign Building and Deployment

  • Build, test, QA, deploy, and monitor Klaviyo email and SMS campaigns including batch sends, behaviorally triggered messages, and automated lifecycle journeys
  • Schedule campaigns accurately across multiple client accounts and ensure nothing launches late or with incorrect assets
  • Configure dynamic content blocks and conditional logic within campaigns to improve relevance and personalization
  • Support creative and layout needs by selecting images, formatting text, and ensuring final output aligns with brand standards

Flow and Automation Management

  • Build and manage email flows and automations including triggers, conditions, content, and timing
  • Support and execute SMS sends within Klaviyo
  • Troubleshoot flow issues and ensure automations are running correctly across all client accounts
  • Document flow logic and changes clearly for full team visibility

Segmentation and List Management

  • Build targeted audience segments using Klaviyo filters, conditions, and custom attributes based on user behavior, lifecycle stage, and other attributes
  • Maintain list hygiene and segmentation across client email databases
  • Leverage segmentation to improve campaign relevance and performance

A/B Testing and Optimization

  • Set up and run A/B tests across campaigns and flows to continuously improve engagement and conversion metrics
  • Track and optimize email performance by proactively flagging trends at the campaign and journey level
  • Surface actionable insights to internal stakeholders and clients based on test results and performance data

Reporting and Client Communication

  • Deliver regular email performance reporting with historical comparisons, channel benchmarks, and recommendations
  • Create client-ready slides and presentations translating key metrics and learnings into simple charts and bullets
  • Maintain a clear understanding of key performance metrics including open rates, CTR, conversion rate, and deliverability and use them to guide optimization decisions

What You Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on email marketing execution experience, ideally in a fast-paced agency or DTC e-commerce environment
  • Deep expertise in Klaviyo for campaign setup, flow building, segmentation, and analytics
  • 2 or more years of experience working with Shopify
  • Demonstrated experience creating and launching A/B tests and reporting clearly on their impact
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills including data export, templates, basic formulas, and clean formatting
  • Comfortable turning performance data into simple, client-ready slides with charts and bullets
  • Strong understanding of segmentation and how to apply it to improve campaign performance
  • Detail-oriented with a proven ability to QA work thoroughly before every deployment
  • Fluent written and spoken English with the confidence to explain performance trends and next steps clearly
  • Available Monday through Friday during US business hours with occasional flexibility for time-sensitive updates

Nice to Have

  • Experience building and launching SMS campaigns within Klaviyo or Postscript
  • DTC or e-commerce specific background
  • Experience with loyalty programs and lifecycle strategy tied to loyalty segmentation
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for light edits and resolving formatting issues in email templates
  • Google and Meta ad platform familiarity for broader agency coverage

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your Klaviyo experience, and walking through one campaign or flow you built including the results it produced

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a detail-obsessed email marketer who takes pride in clean deployments and wants to own campaign performance across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Principal Engineer, CSRE

Location: Remote, United Kingdom, with travel to London for meetings when required.

Division: Ticketmaster UK

Contract Terms: Permanent


THE TEAM

This position will be part of Ticketmaster's global CSRE team. The team is responsible for building and maintaining core components of Ticketmaster's infrastructure, focusing on resilience and maintainability. CSRE work streams currently include release engineering, provisioning and maintenance, building and maintaining custom components, and developer enablement.


THE JOB

You will be responsible for designing, building, rolling out and supporting key components across Ticketmaster's estate. Current projects include replacing our incident handling and alerting systems, reviewing and enhancing telemetry, and moving our Jira and Confluence infrastructure to the cloud.


You will provide engineering leadership, and be responsible for defining architecture and delivery strategy to high quality standards. You will also be taking existing components and raising them to comply with those standards.


You will think in systems—not just the software, but the people, processes, and pressures around it.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Building the frameworks, libraries, and tools that make other engineers faster.
  • Untangling and improving legacy systems, from characterising current behaviour through to shipping changes.
  • Designing for failure; building in fault tolerance, self-healing, and clear paths to scale.
  • Designing to interfaces, not vendors. Building components that speak open standards.
  • Evaluating, prototyping, and benchmarking new approaches before betting on them.
  • Adopting and developing new software development techniques, leveraging LLMs and associated technologies.
  • Ensuring work is visible, and that value delivered is clear.
  • Mentoring fellow engineers.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Deep expertise in at least one programming language, and experience of applying that knowledge in other scenarios.
  • Exposure to strongly typed languages and functional programming.
  • A sense of taste; you can tell good design from bad, and articulate why.
  • Able to design at the systems level and work effectively with complex legacy constraints.
  • Open-minded about how LLMs change the craft of software engineering.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • At home in a SAFe process—PI objectives, ARTs, the cadence of reporting—and able to satisfy it while keeping the team lean and fast underneath.
  • Humble and kind, with a supportive nature that encourages and fosters a positive environment for team members.
  • Strong opinions lightly held—opinionated but not dogmatic.
  • Skilled in managing relationships both upwards and downwards, effectively handling expectations and fostering collaboration across all levels of the organisation.
  • Listening and coaching skills, capable of mentoring and teaching, with a strong ability to synthesize information and connect disparate ideas.
  • Ability to own a problem end-to-end and finish it.
  • Takes real pride in the work, holding others to the same bar.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER


We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.


Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.


We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.


Our work is guided by our values:


Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.


Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team


Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent


Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive


EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.


HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.


Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

The In-Store Technology organization at DoorDash is committed to building products that help restaurants create magical experiences every day. We are a small, but rapidly growing team of engineers, scientists and builders who are on a mission to fundamentally transform the hospitality industry.

About the Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to manage and solve client support cases by leveraging technology and software to solve problems and maximize productivity and efficiency for our clients. You'll work closely with our engineering team to provide exceptional technical support while becoming a product expert who contributes to our technical knowledge base and support documentation. This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge hospitality technology while directly impacting client success and satisfaction.

This role is remote eligible and we are ideally looking for candidates located within the EST or PST time zone.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Manage client support cases on a daily basis and document customer interactions. Handle payments cases from investigation to resolution while owning Payment Processor knowledge and contributing to organizational readiness.
  • Partner with internal teams including Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. Identify and resolve Tier 2 product, feature, and integration issues while providing customer feedback to inform the product roadmap.
  • Perform detailed QA of application and customer environment issues. Become a product expert and contribute to our technical knowledge base and support documentation.
  • Assist with coding and producing out-of-box and custom client projects. Research, diagnose, troubleshoot and identify solutions to resolve system issues using your technical expertise.
  • Provide extraordinary customer experiences with tenacity to drive issues to resolution. Author and administer documents for training and knowledge bases while maintaining strong analytical problem-solving abilities.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a technical support role with B2B and/or SaaS experience preferred, plus solid understanding of Javascript
  • You have knowledge and experience in APIs (required) with payment-focused technical support experience being a plus
  • You have experience in JSON, HTML, Python, including the ability to inspect and diagnose issues in web applications, mobile and data-intensive applications
  • You have experience using Zendesk, Jira, and Salesforce (a plus) with commitment to providing extraordinary customer experiences
  • You have strong analytical, problem-solving ability paired with excellent organizational skills, verbal and written communication, and experience authoring training documentation

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$115,000—$169,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM EST, with occasional overtime based on event schedules and business needs.

About the Role

We’re looking for a driven and self-motivated Account Executive to own the full sales cycle for a SaaS field service management platform serving mid-market general contractors.

This is a hunter-style sales role where you’ll be responsible for generating your own leads, building a pipeline, conducting product demos, and closing new business. You’ll take ownership of your sales activities from the first interaction through the signed deal, using proactive outreach, networking, industry events, and AI tools to accelerate your results.

This opportunity is ideal for an ambitious, early-career sales professional or recent graduate who is competitive, resourceful, and eager to build a career in SaaS sales. Drive, initiative, and work ethic matter more than years of experience.

What You’ll Own

Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Generate new leads through cold outreach, networking, referrals, and industry events.
  • Build, manage, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
  • Identify and qualify potential customers, focusing on opportunities with strong conversion potential.
  • Keep prospect information, activities, and pipeline stages organized in the CRM.

Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Manage the entire sales process, from initial outreach and discovery calls to product demonstrations and closing deals.
  • Deliver engaging product demos tailored to the needs and challenges of general contractors.
  • Clearly communicate product value and address prospect questions and objections.
  • Maintain consistent follow-ups and build relationships that convert into new business.
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to research prospects, personalize outreach, and improve sales productivity.

Events & Industry Representation

  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows, both independently and alongside the Marketing & Events Specialist.
  • Build relationships through industry associations, including ABC (Associated Builders and Contractors) and AGC (Associated General Contractors).
  • Attend events primarily across Central Florida, with occasional travel to larger national trade shows.
  • Identify new prospects, generate leads, and turn event connections into sales opportunities.

Requirements

  • A self-starter with strong drive, competitiveness, and the ability to take ownership of sales goals.
  • Comfortable with cold outreach and initiating conversations with unfamiliar prospects through phone, email, and in-person networking.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Confident presenting products to business audiences or willing to learn and develop product demonstration skills quickly.
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude for prospect research, personalized outreach, and everyday productivity.
  • Personable and persuasive, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust.
  • Willing and able to travel to industry events, primarily throughout Central Florida, with occasional national travel.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying organized and accountable.
  • A degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent hands-on experience.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in sales, retail, business development, or another customer-facing role.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or other CRM platforms.
  • Interest in SaaS, construction, or field service management.
  • Experience with prospecting, cold calling, networking, or product demonstrations.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding and winning new business rather than relying on an existing pipeline.
  • You are proactive, competitive, and motivated by measurable results.
  • You are comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone to start conversations and build relationships.
  • You use technology and AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and improve your performance.
  • You thrive with autonomy and take responsibility for your own success.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

jobs.description:
At Makeready we are searching for curious self-starters with a genuine interest in people. These hard-working individuals have always had a natural bend toward hospitality, no matter where they work, because they’ve always seen themselves as part of something bigger.

The Senior Business Development Analyst plays an integral role in supporting Makeready’s growth strategy and the evaluation of new business opportunities across the portfolio. This position supports new management opportunities, acquisitions, new developments, conversions, repositionings, and other strategic growth initiatives through thoughtful financial analysis, market research, and operating insight.

Working closely with Business Development, Operations, Finance, Revenue Management, Sales, Food + Beverage, Design + Construction, and other functional leaders, the Senior Business Development Analyst develops financial underwriting, evaluates market and operating assumptions, and translates complex information into clear recommendations for senior leadership, ownership groups, investors, and business partners.

Requested Tasks

  • Build and maintain detailed hotel operating pro formas for new management opportunities, acquisitions, new developments, conversions, repositionings, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Develop revenue, expense, labor, GOP, NOI, and cash-flow projections utilizing market intelligence, comparable hotel performance, historical results, and operating assumptions.
  • Analyze historical hotel financial statements to identify operating trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities.
  • Perform valuation and investment analyses utilizing DCF, IRR, NPV, capitalization rates, and other relevant hospitality and real estate metrics.
  • Evaluate management fees, incentive management fees, franchise fees, key money, owner priority structures, and other deal economics.
  • Build sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate alternative operating, development, financing, and transaction assumptions.
  • Evaluate renovation, repositioning, and capital investment requirements and the anticipated return on incremental investment.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen projected profitability, operating efficiency, and long-term asset performance.
  • Conduct hotel market, feasibility, and competitive research utilizing STR, CoStar, industry reports, market studies, and other relevant resources.
  • Analyze market supply and demand, historical and projected performance, new supply, segmentation, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and competitive positioning.
  • Evaluate brand alternatives, conversions, independent positioning, and potential changes in affiliation.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, transaction activity, and industry developments that may impact existing or prospective opportunities.
  • Develop appropriate competitive and aspirational hotel sets based on positioning, market dynamics, product, and guest profile.

    Prepare penetration, market-share, and performance analyses and translate findings into informed underwriting assumptions.

Requested Capabilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Administration, Finance, Real Estate, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in hotel business development, development, acquisitions, hospitality consulting or feasibility, asset management, hospitality real estate, investment analysis, or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of hotel operating statements, hotel industry terminology, and key performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated experience developing hotel operating pro formas and financial models.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to develop polished, executive-level presentations.
  • Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics in handling financial data.
  • Understanding of hospitality valuation concepts including NOI, capitalization rates, DCF, IRR, and NPV.
  • Familiarity with hotel management agreements, franchise agreements, and hotel ownership structures preferred.
  • Experience evaluating independent, lifestyle, luxury, branded, and/or full-service hotels preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.

As part of the Makeready collection, we proudly offer a variety of thoughtful benefits and perks for eligible team members including accommodating PTO/PTO exchange, medical/dental/vision benefits, maternity/paternity leave, pet insurance, company-matched dependent care & 401k, student loan repayment program and a wide range of additional ancillary benefits. The health, happiness and well-being of our team is our top priority.

We take pride in our Guiding Principles to help define how we successfully work together. We follow them not out of duty but live by them instinctively.

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!

deine position

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. Great go-to-market starts with understanding our customers, and the best way to do that is to talk to them.

As a Customer Engagement Working Student on the Go-to-Market team, you reach out by phone to customers at key moments in their journey, check in on how things are going, and find out whether there is anything we can do to help. This is not a sales role. It is a listening and support role, where your conversations give the Go-to-Market team a first-hand view of the customer experience across our markets. You will support initiatives end to end, and your insights will directly feed decisions that go to Product, Sales, and Marketing, helping us sharpen our positioning, messaging, and customer journey.

  • You support Heartbeat AI GTM efforts across multiple markets by calling customers to check in, understand how their experience is going, and gather first-hand feedback

  • You listen carefully and document what customers tell you, turning individual conversations into clear and structured insights for the GTM team

  • You identify where we can add value, whether that means answering a question on the spot, coordinating support with the right team, or connecting the customer with a colleague who can help further

  • You help customers who are interested in taking the next step find their way to the right team, always with a supportive and pressure-free approach

  • You log every conversation accurately in our CRM and keep customer records current, so every customer receives consistent and joined-up support

  • You spot patterns across calls, markets, and customer groups, and turn them into short, usable summaries that can be compared across countries and inform positioning, messaging, and journey improvements

  • You coordinate logistics and follow-ups with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders across regions, and join relevant syncs to learn how those conversations happen

  • You help maintain performance dashboards and trackers on customer outreach and outcomes across multiple markets, keeping data current so the team can see quickly where we can improve the customer experience, wherever it shows up

  • You take ownership of clearly scoped tasks and small projects end to end, checking in proactively when priorities are unclear

  • You report into the Go-to-Market Director but work closely with all the Go-to-Market team members across the globe

dein profil

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme, ideally in Business, Energy Economics, Communications or a related field, and can work around 15 to 20 hours per week alongside your studies

  • You are curious about GTM, customer journeys, or customer insight, and want to learn how a scaling tech company listens to its customers and turns what it hears into better decisions

  • You are comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with customers, and you enjoy building rapport with people from all kinds of backgrounds

  • You are a genuine listener: you ask thoughtful follow-up questions and know when to speak and when to stay quiet

  • You are empathetic and patient, and you stay calm, warm, and professional in every conversation

  • You are structured and reliable: you follow through on tasks without being chased, keep accurate notes, and flag early when something’s blocked, even when juggling requests from more than one market team

  • You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM tools, and data, and you’re keen to spot patterns in customer feedback rather than just running through a call list

  • You communicate clearly and aren’t afraid to ask questions or push back when something doesn’t add up, even when talking to more senior stakeholders

  • You are a fast learner who’s comfortable picking up new tools and adapting to a fast-changing environment, and to working with different teams and cultures across markets

Job Summary

Your Career

You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

Pindrop is looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to help our go-to-market (GTM) teams plan smarter, forecast with confidence, and sell more efficiently.

Reporting to the Director, Revenue Operations, you'll be the analytical and operational partner behind RevOps initiatives across GTM planning, forecasting, compensation, systems, and partner operations. You'll work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, Deal Desk, and Finance to gather the data, uncover what's working and what isn't, and bring the analysis that informs the department’s decisions. You'll support initiatives from discovery and analysis through design, build, and enablement.

This is a Manager-level individual contributor role. As you build expertise in our business, your impact will grow, from improving the data and reporting our teams rely on every day to shaping the analysis behind key GTM decisions.

We’re looking for someone who brings three strengths: the drive to find what’s slowing our teams down and build better processes to fix it, the ability to build trusted relationships with the teams RevOps supports, and strong analytical skills that turn data into clear recommendations.

GTM Planning, Capacity, and Compensation

  • Partner with cross-functional teams on annual and in-year GTM planning, building the processes and running the analysis behind territory design, books of business, account scoring, segmentation, and pipeline modeling
  • Deliver analyses that inform our headcount and capacity models, including rep ramp, productivity, and coverage assumptions, and create the executive dashboards that show where we have capacity gaps and need to hire
  • Own day-to-day sales compensation administration, including plan documents, new-hire setup, attainment tracking, and payout support
  • Provide the attainment and productivity analysis that informs compensation plan design, quota methodology, and rules of engagement

Forecasting, Pipeline, and Performance Insights

  • Own data preparation, meeting materials, and follow-up for weekly forecast and pipeline reviews
  • Own forecast data quality for net-new and renewal business, identifying and driving cleanup with sales managers, and help develop clear rules for pushing or closing deals
  • Own the reporting and dashboards that reps, managers, BDRs, and executives use to run the business, and deliver analyses on funnel conversion, velocity, attribution, and productivity
  • Help develop and maintain standard definitions for core GTM metrics and objects, such as customer, pipeline stages, and ARR, so every team works from the same numbers

Systems, Process, and Partner Operations

  • Proactively identify process gaps and issues across the GTM lifecycle, and develop solutions to correct them, including the system requirements, user experience, and plan for maintaining the data
  • Own Salesforce data quality, and help design and implement improvements across the sales cycle, including stage gates, lead routing, approvals, and Deal Desk workflows
  • Support partner operations across referral, reseller, marketplace, and alliance motions, including deal registration, approval processes, partner attribution, and field enablement on partner types
  • Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders and their teams, representing RevOps in working sessions and bringing the feedback and data that help the Director prioritize RevOps initiatives
  • Support GTM tool and vendor management, RevOps request intake, and the rollout and enablement of new tools and processes, including analysis for new tool and process investments
  • Work with Deal Desk, Legal, and Customer Success on process improvements that shorten the path from quote to close

Who you are

  • You take ownership and do the things you say you'll do
  • You dig into the data, spot what doesn't add up, and come back with a recommendation, not just a report
  • You enjoy building processes and infrastructure from the ground up, not just maintaining what already exists
  • You think about how a change lands with the reps, managers, and partners who have to live with it
  • You manage multiple projects at once and prioritize by business impact
  • You use AI responsibly to improve processes and work more efficiently, and you take full ownership of the final output

Your skill-set

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred
  • 3-5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, or GTM Analytics, preferably at a high-growth B2B SaaS company
  • Admin-level Salesforce experience, including reports and dashboards, objects and fields, validation rules, and Flows (Salesforce Administrator certification a plus)
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including the analysis and modeling that support planning, capacity, or compensation decisions
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics and the B2B sales cycle, including pipeline coverage, conversion rates, ramp, attainment, ARR, and retention
  • Experience with Gong, Outreach or Salesloft, LeanData, Gainsight, Highspot, Coefficient, DocuSign, Unifyr, or Tackle.io is a plus
  • Experience with SQL, BI/visualization tools, or data warehouses such as Databricks or Snowflake is a plus

What’s in it for you

  • Build the foundation, not just maintain it. RevOps at Pindrop has high-impact work ahead in planning, forecasting, compensation, and partner operations, and you'll help decide how it gets done.
  • See how a scaling revenue organization is run. You'll work directly with the Director of Revenue Operations and alongside Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Finance leaders, with visibility into how GTM decisions get made.
  • Support a business with real market urgency. AI-driven fraud and deepfakes are now a board-level concern for large enterprises, and your work will help the teams bringing Pindrop into those conversations operate at their best.
  • Work inside an AI-first organization. Pindrop is investing in AI across the business, and you’ll use AI to automate reporting, data cleanup, and systems work, and help define what an AI-enabled RevOps team looks like.
  • Grow your impact. As you build expertise, you’ll have more opportunities to shape how our GTM teams plan, forecast, and operate.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

Submit your resume and answer the application questions. Qualified applicants are invited to a short one-way video interview on HireFlix, answered in English and Spanish.

Healthy legs. Happier lives.
