jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Enterprise is our composable observability platform focused on large-scale operators with security and regulatory requirements who need to self-operate their observability solutions. Grafana Enterprise features are also part of our Grafana Cloud service. Grafana Cloud is an integrated suite of observability applications offered as a service. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining, and scaling their own observability stack.

The Grafana Enterprise team is a diverse team of expert technologists working remotely from around the globe. The team focuses on innovative solutions to large-scale customer challenges and developing solutions that improve security, robustness, flexibility, multitenancy, and interoperability on behalf of our customers. We work across the larger Grafana Labs organisation and directly with external customers, including major cloud service providers and global enterprises running observability and build infrastructure at massive scale, to solve their most demanding distributed systems challenges. Our customers include software engineers, site reliability engineers, and platform operators at medium, large, and global enterprises.

As a company we are remote-only and global; we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our meetings tend to happen between 14:00 and 17:00 UTC, but we are flexible and responsive to the needs of our engineers and our customers. We measure ourselves by our openness, helpfulness, and our shared successes.

We are looking for experienced software engineers who are passionate about distributed systems and building reliable, scalable backend infrastructure to join our growing team. Our backend is Go, and we build tools for people operating some of the world's largest observability and software delivery stacks. Backend Engineers at Grafana also contribute to open source communities.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Earning the trust of our large-scale operator customers to further Grafana's "big tent" philosophy of data accessibility and to meet clear business objectives
  • Designing and leading the development of backend services, distributed systems, and enterprise features at scale
  • Driving continuous improvement of our engineering culture through words and actions
  • Driving projects from initial ideation through the development lifecycle to production
  • Contributing to the scalability, reliability, security, and multi-tenancy of the Grafana platform trusted by some of the world's largest operators
  • Owning the operational health of our platform by participating in weekday 12h x 5d and separate weekend 24h x 2d on-call rotations. (Yes, we prioritize ops load reduction.)
  • Hiring and developing the best engineers to build the future of Grafana
  • Developing your skills as a thought leader to drive continuous improvement of engineering and operational practices across Grafana Labs
  • As we are remote-first, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so strong teamwork and excellent written and interpersonal communication skills are a must.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

You’ll also have access to frontier models (e.g., GPT-Codex 5/3, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3 Pro).

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You work well as a communicative member of a team of engineering professionals.
  • You earn trust by saying what you mean and doing what you say.
  • You are customer focused and especially attuned to the needs of large-scale operators who rely on Grafana as critical infrastructure. You start with their needs and work backwards.
  • You insist on the highest standards and work to develop the skills and knowledge of your fellow team members.
  • You take on complex distributed systems challenges, break them down into digestible problems, and leverage your team and organization to deliver.
  • You design modular solutions, deliver minimum loveable products, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively.

What will you be doing? (Role specifics)

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will design and build the backend systems powering Grafana Enterprise — the platform trusted by the world's largest operators to run their observability and software delivery infrastructure.

  • Hiring and developing the best engineers we can to deliver the future of Observability.
  • Architecting and implementing distributed backend services in Go, with a focus on correctness, observability, and performance at scale
  • Designing APIs and service contracts used by thousands of enterprise operators and cloud service providers
  • Collaborating with Product and UX to shape features and partnering with frontend engineers to ship complete, end-to-end solutions
  • Driving scalability and reliability improvements that matter to large-scale operators running Grafana in regulated, high-availability environments
  • Engaging directly with large enterprise customers and cloud service providers to understand their requirements and translate them into robust engineering solutions
  • Advocating for our customers at every stage of the development lifecycle

What technical competencies are we looking for?

  • Deep professional experience writing production services, from ideation through to production operations at scale
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals: replication, consistency models, partitioning, fault tolerance, and the trade-offs that come with operating at scale
  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating systems for large-scale, high-traffic, high-availability, or multi-tenant environments, ideally in the context of infrastructure, observability, or software delivery platforms
  • Professional experience building and consuming gRPC/protobuf APIs and designing clean service contracts across service boundaries
  • Strong database skills, such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL; including schema design, query optimisation, and schema migrations at scale
  • Experience with large-scale CI/CD systems and build tooling, designing, operating, or integrating with continuous delivery pipelines that serve large engineering organisations or external operators at scale
  • Comfort working with Kubernetes and containerised deployment environments, including patterns for operating stateful workloads and multi-tenant clusters
  • Experience with observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing
  • Familiarity with dependency injection patterns (e.g., Google Wire) and clean, testable service architecture

What are your "nice to have" technical competencies?

  • Experience with TypeScript and React for contributing to frontend features and collaborating closely with frontend engineers
  • Experience with Grafana's LGTM+ observability stack (Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope, Alloy)
  • Prior experience at or building for large-scale cloud service providers, IaaS providers, or global enterprises with demanding SLA requirements
  • Experience designing or operating large-scale build infrastructure artifact registries, distributed build caches, hermetic build systems (e.g., Bazel), or developer platform tooling

In the United States, the compensation range for this role is $174,986 - $209,983 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Have you always wanted to work for a company with a real social mission? This is your chance! AssistiveWare’s mission is to support people with communication disabilities. We provide products and services that address the barriers they face and contribute to a more inclusive society.

We are looking for a Support Specialist who is passionate about changing the world and has the experience and expertise to contribute to our mission. This is the perfect role for you if you enjoy working collaboratively, transparently, and putting the users first in all aspects of creating solutions.

We are not just a worldwide market leader in apps for people who cannot speak. Our users are at the heart of what we do. Many of them are autistic, have cerebral palsy, Down syndrome and/or fine motor, vision or cognitive disabilities. We are proud to collaborate with them and their families, educators, and therapists to ensure our products best serve their needs.

We are a small but diverse company—we are over 40 people representing 19 nationalities and we’re spread around the world. Our business challenges are unique and in order to keep innovating, we need people with different perspectives to join us—people like you. So no matter where you’re from originally, who you love, what you believe in, or what disability you live with, we welcome you to be your true self at AssistiveWare.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a Support Specialist to join our Support team. You are passionate about changing the world and have the experience and expertise to contribute to our mission, because providing quick and caring customer support is exactly what helps our users be successful.

We are looking for someone who speaks Dutch, is located in Western Europe, and is part of the AAC community. You don’t need to be an expert in the field - you could, for example, be a carer for someone who uses AAC, or an AAC user yourself. What matters is that you are enthusiastic about making the world a better place by helping people on their AAC journey.

What you’ll do

The Support team is one of AssistiveWare’s most critical teams. We take pride in how we listen to our users and help them with technical and AAC implementation questions. Our Support team is there and available for our customers seven days a week.

As a Support Specialist at AssistiveWare, you are often the first person our users turn to. You respond to inquiries and resolve issues through a range of channels, such as email, in-app messenger, and social media. You listen, you troubleshoot technical problems, and you provide guidance, making sure every user has a positive experience. You also collaborate with internal teams to improve our processes, report bugs, and make sure we communicate consistently about our products.

With a special focus on the Dutch-speaking market, you help identify the specific needs of this audience and explore ways to improve access to AAC. You become co-moderator of one or more of our Facebook groups, and you collaborate with support colleagues around the world as well as regularly with product managers, AAC specialists, and others.

Your main tasks:

  • Provide customer support by email, in-app messenger, and social media for English- and Dutch-speaking markets
  • Help develop AssistiveWare’s presence in the Dutch-speaking market
  • Help our customers resolve their account-related issues
  • Contribute to community management on our Facebook pages and groups
  • Contribute to support and training material for our apps and website

Requirements

  • A good communicator and a good listener, who knows how to ask the right questions and wants to help others
  • Member of the AAC community
  • Approachable, friendly, and flexible
  • Independent, but also enjoys working in a team and sharing knowledge
  • Fluent in English and Dutch, with excellent oral and written skills
  • Tech-savvy (iOS) and active on social media
  • An understanding of AAC best practice and a willingness to learn even more
  • Knowledge about Proloquo, Proloquo2Go, Proloquo4Text, and simPODD is a plus
  • Available 15 to 20 hours per week, ideally spread over five mornings a week, and occasional weekend coverage

Benefits

  • 15 - 20 hours a week (spread over weekdays and, occasionally, the weekend)
  • An interesting and multifaceted job where your personal input is appreciated and expected
  • Working from home with the possibility to work from to the office in Amsterdam
  • Being part of a close, considerate and motivated team spread-out across 5 timezones
  • Salary between 2800 - 3100 Euros on a full time (40 hour per week) basis

jobs.description:
Billing Specialist

Location: West Bengal, Maharashtra, Gujarat (Remote)

About MediaRadar

MediaRadar equips marketing, sales and analytics leaders with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. Our platform delivers always-on, AI-enabled Creative, Competitive, Commercial and Market Intelligence—spanning ad strategy, media spend, creative assets and brand messaging across 30+ media channels and five million brands.

With deep insights into more than 35 million ad and campaign assets and $280 billion in media spend, MediaRadar provides a single, interoperable source of truth that plugs seamlessly into enterprise analytics and AI systems. The result: faster, cleaner and more actionable intelligence that drives competitive advantage.

About the Role

We are looking for a Billing Specialist to join our team and own accurate, timely billing for our global customer base. This role is critical to our order-to-cash process: ensuring customers are invoiced correctly out of NetSuite, sales tax and VAT are applied as expected across the jurisdictions we serve, and new customers are onboarded smoothly. You will work closely with our Commercial, Revenue Operations (RevOps), Order Management, Collections, and Revenue Recognition teams. If you’re detail-oriented, systems-savvy, and experienced in SaaS subscription billing, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:

  • Generate, review, and issue customer invoices out of NetSuite, including recurring subscription billings, renewals, upsells, and one-time charges, in line with signed contracts and billing schedules.
  • Bill customers across multiple countries, including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union, applying the correct entity, currency, and invoicing requirements for each.
  • Review invoices to confirm sales tax, GST/HST, and VAT have been applied as expected for each customer and jurisdiction, and escalate any discrepancies, such as missing exemption certificates or VAT registration numbers, to the team member responsible for sales tax.
  • Own customer onboarding from a billing perspective, including KYC and customer verification and collecting billing contacts and tax information.
  • Manage customer invoice submission through customer AP portals (e.g., Coupa, Ariba, and similar), including vendor registration, purchase order matching, and resolving portal rejections.
  • Partner with the Commercial, RevOps, and Order Management teams to confirm order and contract details before billing, and resolve discrepancies between Salesforce, NetSuite, and signed agreements.
  • Collect purchase orders to ensure timely billing. Work with the Collections team to resolve billing-related disputes, issue credit memos and invoice corrections, and support timely cash collection.
  • Coordinate with the Revenue Recognition team to ensure billing aligns with revenue schedules and supports an accurate month-end close.
  • Respond to internal and customer billing inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Contribute to billing process documentation and continuous improvement efforts, including automation and controls.

Requirements

Qualifications

What You’ve Done:

  • 2–4 years of experience in billing, invoicing, or order-to-cash operations.
  • Hands-on experience billing customers in NetSuite is required.
  • Experience billing in a SaaS or subscription-based company is required, including recurring billing, renewals, and mid-term changes.
  • Experience billing customers in multiple countries, including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union.
  • Working knowledge of sales tax and VAT in those jurisdictions, including exemptions and reverse charge, sufficient to recognize when tax has not been applied as expected.
  • Experience with customer onboarding, KYC, and invoice submission through customer AP portals.
  • Experience with Avalara is a plus.
  • Salesforce experience is preferred; comfort cross-referencing data between Salesforce and NetSuite is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with a track record of catching and resolving billing errors before they reach customers.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams across time zones.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet billing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits

Working Arrangements

This is a remote role based in India. Given the cross-functional nature of the position and our customers across North America, the UK, and Europe, some overlap with US Eastern or Central time zones may be required for collaboration with Commercial, RevOps, Order Management, Collections, and Finance teams.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Polish-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Polish Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $16 - $19 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.
    • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Polish Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Polish and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inPolish and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.

This role is responsible for ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality services, driving utilization of workflow and practice management tools, standardizing processes, and serving as the primary technical resource for the team.

jobs.description:
What is Reach Financial?

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

About the role

As a Senior Data Engineer at Reach, you’ll work alongside our existing Data Engineering team on our data platform modernization effort. You’ll be a key contributor to our broader data practice, building and maintaining pipelines, data models, and transformations as we modernize Reach’s data stack. You’ll help establish scalable, reliable, and consistent data engineering practices across the organization, ushering in a new era of cohesive data design and management within the broader Engineering organization.

What you'll do

  • Develop and manage data pipelines, data models, schemas, and data artifacts as a core contributor to our data squad.
  • Champion data engineering best practices, including data quality, version control, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Data, Software, and Platform Engineers to evolve and improve existing engineering practices, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with data scientists, analysts, stakeholders, and cross-functional data teams across the organization to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Stay up to date on emerging data engineering tools and technologies, and help evaluate new solutions to optimize our data ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers to ensure seamless integration and deployment of data pipelines using shared CI/CD tools and Infrastructure as Code solutions, such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure data quality, reliability, and availability.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines, data models, and engineering processes.

What you should have

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, working with dbt (Core or Cloud), Snowflake, Fivetran, Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, etc
  • Strong proficiency in dbt development best practices and coding conventions, with hands-on experience designing and implementing Medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) in a production environment.
  • Extensive knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar platforms
  • Experience implementing automated data quality checks, dbt testing, and data validation frameworks
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and automated deployment processes for data engineering workflows
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing Snowflake performance, dbt models, SQL queries, and data warehouse costs
  • Production experience working with and managing a Snowflake deployment
  • Experience extracting information from SaaS systems like Salesforce using ETL tools like FiveTran
  • Production experience using dbt Cloud or other source-driven transformation management tools
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Database Change Management tooling
  • Experience with operational database management, including backup, recovery, tuning, data modeling, scaling
  • Demonstrated experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
  • Must be self-motivated, focused, and highly committed to delivering value
  • Must be a collaborative team player with strong communication skills, a willingness to share knowledge, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves

  • Experience preparing data for analysis in Tableau or other BI tools
  • Experience with Tableau CRM Analytics Data Pipelines
  • Experience with Sigma Computing
  • Experience with Fivetran Activations
  • Experience working in the Financial Services industry and familiarity with working in a SOC2 and PCI-DSS environment.

What is it like working at Reach Financial?

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

What benefits will you receive?

  • Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
  • Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
  • Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
  • Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)

Combined with a collaborative culture rooted in radical candor and innovation, we empower our people to do their best work every day while helping to shape our future.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Loss Mitigation to join our team. This role The Director is responsible for overseeing the Loss Mitigation function to ensure all processes, loan quality standards, and regulatory requirements are consistently met for loans in loss mitigation or for borrowers experiencing financial hardship. The Director provides direction and guidance, establishes department policies, and ensures timely, compliant, and accurate decision-making.

Successful candidates extensive experience in mortgage underwriting, a strong leadership background, and hold a Direct Endorsement (DE) designation for FHA loans and proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment. If you feel this is the right opportunity, apply today!

What You'll Do

  • Oversee the review and underwriting of loans in loss mitigation, ensuring compliance with FHA, VA, USDA, FNMA, FHLMC, and company guidelines.

  • Monitor team performance, workload, and turnaround times, ensuring timely decision-making and adherence to investor and regulatory timelines.

  • Collaborate with Servicing, Collections, Legal, and other departments to ensure coordinated and compliant loss mitigation efforts.
  • Track and report department metrics, including loan volumes, approval rates, and turnaround times, providing regular updates to executive leadership.
  • Ensure team members receive ongoing training and development to maintain knowledge of industry regulations, investor guidelines, and company policies.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in loss mitigation.
  • Additional responsibilities assigned due to business needs.

What You Bring

  • High school diploma required; college degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of mortgage underwriting experience required, preferably within a wholesale lending environment.
  • 3+ years management experience.
  • Recent experience in loss mitigation preferred.
  • Must hold a Direct Endorsement (DE) designation for FHA loans.
  • Deep knowledge of home loans, residential mortgages, and loss mitigation processes, including conventional, VA, FHA, USDA, Non-QM loans, and investor guidelines.
  • Expert understanding of compliance standards, including federal regulations (e.g., RESPA, TILA, Dodd-Frank) and company policies.
  • Proven leadership and management skills with the ability to mentor, motivate, and develop team members.
  • Strong decision-making, analytical, and problem-solving skills, particularly in complex loss mitigation scenarios.

  • Technologically proficient and able to implement new tools or processes to improve efficiency and compliance, Proficiency with Encompass LOS required.
  • Ability to manage high volumes of work while maintaining accuracy and regulatory compliance.

Job Role: Salesforce Technical Consultant

Compensation range: $3,000 AUD - $4,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: The client partners with individuals going through sensitive family-related legal issues by covering legal expenses upfront. Their models looks at the strengths of each case rather than someone’s financial background, allowing them to provide support quickly.

Role Overview: This is a key role in our team building our new core business platform on Salesforce. You will help shape our future, with an immediate focus on improving functionality, delivering enhancements, fixes, debugging, support and crucial data analysis. By investigating issues and strengthening our current system, you’ll lay the groundwork for our next phase of innovation. You engage directly with key business stakeholders, learn from a high-performing team in a supportive environment and manage your work directly through Jira. As a Salesforce technical consultant, you will be part consultant, part developer, be comfortable working with business stakeholders and understanding the underlying requirements, and be very familiar with the Salesforce platform, common patterns and best practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements for platform enhancements and fixes.
  • Perform debugging, root cause analysis, and resolve technical issues on the Salesforce platform.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies to ensure data integrity.
  • Deliver solutions using declarative Salesforce tools (Flow, Validation Rules, Permissions).
  • Undertake light Apex and customisation as needed.
  • Support and troubleshoot system integrations.
  • Manage your workload and priorities using Jira.
  • Document fixes, technical findings, and best practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years proven experience in a Salesforce support, analyst, or consultant role.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging skills and communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating directly with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations and share findings.
  • Anticipate business needs beyond what’s explicitly specified in the requirements.
  • Proficient with Salesforce declarative tools, especially Flow.
  • Basic to intermediate skills in Apex and/or Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • Familiarity with our wider tech stack is highly regarded, including CI/CD (e.g. Gearset), version control (e.g. GitHub), OmniStudio, JotForm, HubSpot, Slack, AWS S3 and Dialpad.
  • A proactive learner, keen to grow your career in a collaborative team.
  • Salesforce Certifications including Platform Developer II (PD2) and related certifications are very highly regarded.


Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Benefits

    • 13th-Month Pay (Pro-Rata): Contractors who remain actively engaged with the company as of December 20 each year, and are not under notice of termination, are eligible for a pro-rata 13th-month payment based on their period of engagement during the year.
    • Liquidity Event Bonus (LEB): Contractors accrue a cash bonus of AUD $5,000 for each completed year of service, capped at AUD $30,000 per contractor. This is paid within 30 days of a liquidity event, such as a company sale or IPO, provided the contractor is actively engaged with the company at that time.
    • Paid NSW Public Holidays: Filipino contractors are paid for the 9–10 days each year when the company is closed for New South Wales public holidays.
    • Equipment: New contractors are provided with a laptop of their choice (Mac or PC), which will be shipped to them before their start date, subject to completed paperwork and background checks.

jobs.excerpt: Are you a digital marketing professional who loves combining creativity, technology, and strategy to make an impact?
jobs.description:
Are you a digital marketing professional who loves combining creativity, technology, and strategy to make an impact? Innovetive Petcare is looking for an Integrated Marketing Specialist to join our growing marketing team!
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on digital marketer who enjoys managing websites, optimizing content, improving search engine visibility, and bringing digital projects to life. You'll play an important role in strengthening the online presence of more than 80 veterinary hospitals across our network of specialty, emergency, and general practices.
If you're comfortable working in WordPress, understand SEO best practices, enjoy exploring new digital and AI tools, and have a knack for keeping projects organized and moving forward, we'd love to hear from you!

About Innovetive Petcare

Innovetive Petcare is an Austin-based veterinary management company supporting a growing network of 80+ specialty, emergency, and general practice veterinary hospitals. We provide business management resources, marketing expertise, and operational support that empower veterinary teams to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to pets and their families.
Our mission is simple: Excellent pet care comes from exceptional teams. We believe in supporting our hospitals while preserving the unique identities and cultures that make each practice special.

What You'll Do

As our Integrated Marketing Specialist, you'll help execute digital marketing initiatives that strengthen our hospitals' online presence, improve the user experience, and support business growth across multiple veterinary brands.
Website Management & Digital Content
  • Manage and maintain multiple WordPress websites using Beaver Builder and Elementor.
  • Create, edit, optimize, and publish website content, including landing pages, service pages, and reusable page templates.
  • Ensure website content is accurate, engaging, user-friendly, and aligned with brand standards.
  • Apply on-page SEO best practices to improve organic search visibility, website traffic, and content performance.
  • Maintain accurate hospital information, service details, and location content across websites and Google Business Profiles.
  • Conduct website audits to identify opportunities for improvements in content, functionality, technical performance, and search visibility.

    SEO & Digital Optimization
  • Research and implement SEO recommendations using tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other digital marketing platforms.
  • Monitor website performance and identify opportunities to improve search rankings, engagement, and user experience.
  • Evaluate SEO recommendations against Google guidelines, analytics, and actual performance data.
  • Leverage AI tools to support content development, research, optimization, and workflow efficiency while ensuring accuracy and quality.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, SEO developments, website best practices, and emerging technologies.
Project Coordination & Execution
  • Coordinate website updates and digital marketing projects from initial assignment through completion.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and creative teams, hospital leadership, external vendors, and digital partners.
  • Support website launches, quality assurance testing, and troubleshooting of website functionality, integrations, widgets, and online forms.
  • Manage project timelines, track deliverables, communicate progress, and proactively address potential roadblocks.
  • Ensure digital projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with established priorities and brand standards.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve consistency across multiple hospital websites and brands.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented digital marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership of projects, solving problems, and balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on digital marketing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing WordPress websites, including working knowledge of Beaver Builder and Elementor.
  • Working knowledge of SEO principles, including on-page optimization, keyword research, metadata, content structure, and organic search best practices.
  • Experience using SEO platforms such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or comparable tools.
  • Strong digital content writing, editing, publishing, and optimization skills.
  • Proficiency with AI tools and the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy, quality, and relevance.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a desire to continuously improve processes and results.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Looker Studio.
  • Familiarity with creative and design tools such as Canva, Figma, Adobe Photoshop, or Adobe Illustrator.
  • Experience with Asana, Microsoft Office, or similar project management and productivity platforms.
  • Experience supporting veterinary, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.
  • Familiarity with local SEO and Google Business Profile management.
  • Experience coordinating website launches, redesigns, or multi-site digital marketing initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means helping our veterinary hospitals put their best digital presence forward. You'll make an impact by:
  • Keeping hospital websites accurate, current, engaging, and optimized for search engines
  • Improving website content, usability, and organic search performance.
  • Managing digital projects efficiently while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.
  • Identifying website issues and opportunities before they become bigger challenges
  • Maintaining consistent brand presentation and accurate hospital information across digital platforms.
  • Finding smarter ways to work through technology, AI, and process improvements.
  • Building strong working relationships with internal teams, hospital stakeholders, and external partners.

Work Environment & Schedule

  • Location: Austin, Texas, with Texas-based candidates preferred.
  • Work Arrangement: Primarily a professional office or remote work environment, depending on business needs and approved work arrangements.
  • Schedule: Generally standard business hours, with occasional flexibility needed to support website launches, project deadlines, or time-sensitive initiatives.
  • Travel: Occasional travel to veterinary hospitals or company meetings may be required.
  • Technology: Regular use of computers, WordPress, digital marketing platforms, project management systems, and virtual collaboration tools.

Why Innovetive Petcare?

At Innovetive Petcare, you'll be part of a growing organization where your work directly supports the teams caring for pets and their families every day.

We believe in creating an environment where talented people can bring ideas forward, collaborate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact. You'll have the opportunity to work across a diverse network of veterinary hospitals, contribute to exciting digital initiatives, and help shape how our practices connect with the communities they serve.

Our benefits and perks may include:
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • Continuing education and professional development opportunities
  • Employee discounts on veterinary services
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement
  • A collaborative team environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're a digital marketing professional who enjoys the intersection of website management, SEO, content strategy, technology, and project coordination, we'd love to meet you!

Apply today to join Innovetive Petcare as our Integrated Marketing Specialist and help strengthen the digital presence of veterinary hospitals across our growing network.

About the Job



Summary

Corporate FP&A is an important function for Ovation Healthcare, sitting at the center of the broader finance team to support the CFO and other business leaders to run and grow the business—and to ensure Ovation Healthcare’s leadership and board gain financial visibility and insights on the business. This team runs Ovation Healthcare’s financial processes, including our Strategic and Annual Planning process and quarter forecasts, and helps architect the information flow and methodologies we need for dynamic business partnership. This leader establishes processes on return on investment for critical investments for the business. Sales operations builds and supports sale pipelines, salesforce compensation and supports and sets up and runs Ambulatory surgery center accounting/finance.
Corporate FP&A sets the parameters and forecast processes for the finance team and partners with other key operational teams on the moving pieces that impact our financial outlook. You will work with partners across finance and the leadership team.

Job Duties

  • Manage key financial processes, including strategic planning, budget planning, forecasting and performance reporting.
  • Perform monthly analysis of actual compared to budget/forecast for the income statement by line of business and for cash flow and balance sheet accounts.
  • Architect financial commentaries and documents to support key financial deliverables.
  • Develop new processes or improve existing processes relating to financial planning/reporting.
  • Develop key metrics to track team-specific and company-wide trends, identify opportunities, provide recommendations, and collaborate across all levels.
  • Support ad hoc projects and help define systems improvements to support the company’s growth.
  • Apply an analytical approach to influence strategic decision-making, with a focus on capital allocation decisions and long-term financial planning.
  • Establish ROI reporting and evaluation of significant investments to drive decision making on key investments.
  • Provide financial analysis and commentary to important partners including Ovation Healthcare’s board and management team.
  • Provide guidance and reporting on sales pipeline, contract renewals, sales performance, and critical opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewOverview:We are looking for a self-directed BI Analyst to join our growing HealthEdge Business Intelligence team.
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

We are looking for a self-directed BI Analyst to join our growing HealthEdge Business Intelligence team. In this role you will own the end-to-end design and delivery of business intelligence dashboards in Tableau and Amazon QuickSight, working in close partnership with internal HealthEdge stakeholders to turn data into clear, actionable insight.

You will collaborate daily with our onshore and offshore data engineers, who build and maintain the AWS-based lakehouse and analytics-ready data sources you will consume. Your focus is on the analytical and visual layer: understanding what business teams need to decide, modeling the data into intuitive dashboards, and delivering a polished, usable experience that holds up to executive and operational scrutiny.

The ideal candidate operates independently, has strong opinions about usability and visual design, and is relentless about working efficiently — shipping high-quality dashboards quickly and iterating with users rather than disappearing for weeks at a time.

Core Responsibilities

Dashboard Design and Development

  • Build, publish, and maintain Tableau and Amazon QuickSight dashboards that serve internal HealthEdge operational and executive audiences.
  • Translate business questions into well-modeled QuickSight datasets and Tableau data sources, applying appropriate joins, calculated fields, parameters, and filters.
  • Apply strong visual design principles — clear hierarchy, intentional use of color, consistent layout, and accessible typography — so dashboards are immediately usable by their intended audience.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, evaluating SPICE vs. Direct Query in QuickSight and live vs. extract connections in Tableau, and managing refresh schedules.
  • Maintain a clean, well-organized portfolio of published assets across both BI platforms, retiring stale content rather than letting it accumulate.

Stakeholder Partnership and Insight Delivery

  • Engage directly with internal business stakeholders across the organization to understand the decisions they need to make and what evidence would change those decisions.
  • Distill findings into clear narratives and recommendations; package insights so non-technical stakeholders can act on them without translation.
  • Maintain lightweight documentation describing what each dashboard answers, what it does not, and who owns the underlying data.

Collaboration with Data Engineering

  • Partner with onshore and offshore data engineers to define and refine the analytics-ready data sources that power dashboards.
  • Write your own SQL for ad-hoc analysis, prototyping, and data validation; surface gaps, quality issues, or modeling changes back to the data engineering team.
  • Help prioritize the data engineering backlog by clearly articulating which new data, columns, or refresh frequencies are needed to unlock business value.

Quality, Iteration, and Continuous Improvement

  • Validate dashboard numbers against source systems and surface discrepancies promptly.
  • Monitor usage and gather feedback from end users; retire or rework dashboards that are not earning their place.
  • Identify and propose opportunities to consolidate redundant reports, improve refresh cadence, or migrate legacy Tableau or Excel content into QuickSight (or vice versa) as the platform strategy evolves.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience building production BI dashboards in Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, Looker, or comparable modern BI tooling — with at least one tool used at deep, hands-on proficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to design clean, usable dashboards with strong visual hierarchy, intentional use of color, and a clear point of view. Portfolio or work samples preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL — comfortable writing your own queries to explore data, prototype, validate dashboards, and prepare datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data warehouse and lakehouse concepts: dimensional modeling, joins, granularity, slowly changing dimensions, and the difference between transactional and analytical data.
  • Strong sense of ownership and self-direction. Comfortable managing your own prioritization across multiple internal stakeholders and asking for help when blocked.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication. Able to translate ambiguous business questions into a sharp set of dashboards and to explain results clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in a quantitative, analytical, design, or business field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with both Tableau and Amazon QuickSight, including dataset creation, calculated fields, parameters, row- and column-level security, and dashboard publishing in each.
  • Healthcare or health plan domain experience (claims, membership, provider, care management, or customer support data).
  • Experience translating workbooks and reports between BI platforms (Tableau ↔ QuickSight, Excel → BI tool).

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape the analytical and visual layer of a greenfield AWS-native BI platform.
  • A collaborative, small-team environment where your dashboards land in front of HealthEdge leadership and operational teams and directly inform decisions.
  • Exposure to a broad technology stack spanning analytics, data engineering, and modern cloud infrastructure.
  • A collaborative team that values quality, usability, visual design, and efficient delivery.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical customer success is about helping businesses successfully implement, understand, and use our software. We value technical curiosity, clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of complex customer challenges.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Engineer to help Bask Health's customers successfully implement, integrate, troubleshoot, and adopt our software platform.

This role combines technical problem-solving with customer-facing communication and long-term customer success.

You'll work directly with merchants, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

Our platform supports storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and other business-critical capabilities.

You'll serve as a technical point of contact for customers who need help with complex implementations, integrations, platform configuration, and advanced troubleshooting.

You'll investigate customer-reported issues, reproduce problems when possible, and identify likely causes using available technical tools and documentation.

You'll work with engineering teams to resolve issues that require code changes, infrastructure investigation, or deeper product expertise.

You'll be responsible for communicating technical findings and next steps in a way customers can understand.

You'll help customers troubleshoot API integrations, webhooks, authentication issues, data flows, and other supported technical connections.

You'll also assist with platform configuration challenges involving storefronts, questionnaires, checkout, and workflow automation.

You'll help customers understand technical requirements, supported configurations, and implementation limitations.

As a senior member of the team, you'll take ownership of particularly complex technical customer situations.

You'll be expected to investigate issues independently, organize relevant evidence, and involve the appropriate teams when necessary.

You'll help distinguish between configuration issues, product defects, integration problems, and requests for new functionality.

You'll document your findings so customers and internal teams have clear records of technical issues and resolutions.

You'll proactively identify recurring technical challenges that may be affecting multiple customers.

You'll recommend improvements to onboarding processes, troubleshooting documentation, and technical customer education.

You'll work with product managers to communicate customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve usability and technical reliability.

You'll also work with customer success managers to identify technical risks that could affect retention or expansion.

You'll participate in technical customer meetings when specialized knowledge is needed.

You'll be comfortable speaking with both nontechnical business owners and technically experienced customer stakeholders.

You'll translate technical information into practical guidance without overwhelming customers with unnecessary complexity.

You'll maintain awareness of security, privacy, and appropriate handling of sensitive information when investigating issues involving healthcare-related workflows.

You'll recognize when clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or patient-related questions require involvement from the appropriate authorized teams.

You'll contribute to internal technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and repeatable support processes.

You may also mentor less-experienced customer success engineers and share approaches for investigating complex issues.

This is a senior individual-contributor position with substantial technical ownership, not a formal engineering management role.

We're looking for someone with strong technical troubleshooting skills, experience supporting customer-facing SaaS products, and the ability to build trust through clear communication.

Experience supporting e-commerce merchants, online storefronts, payment workflows, or merchant-facing platforms is particularly valuable.

You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning new systems, and taking responsibility for driving technical issues toward resolution.
