jobs.title: Founding Go-to-Market Lead, Wholesale Distribution
jobs.excerpt: Wholesale distributors still take a large share of their customer orders by email: a PDF from a contractor, a spreadsheet from a plant, a photo of a handwritten list, a few lines typed into the email body.
jobs.description:
Wholesale distributors still take a large share of their customer orders by email: a PDF from a contractor, a spreadsheet from a plant, a photo of a handwritten list, a few lines typed into the email body. Someone on the order desk reads each one and keys it into the ERP (the distributor's core system: Prophet 21, Eclipse, Infor, and others). Ten minutes and forty clicks per order, six people doing it all day, and every mistyped part number is a return. We are building software that reads those orders in any format, matches them to the distributor's catalog and contract pricing, and creates the order in the ERP itself, with a person reviewing only the exceptions. We are at the validation stage: before we build the full product, we want to talk to twenty distributors and run three paid pilots on real order flow. Your job is to make that happen.

Who we are

DeepSense is an AI-native company builder headquartered in Cyprus. We build software businesses with small teams and a lot of AI agents doing the routine work, and we are starting a new venture for the US wholesale distribution industry. This role is our first person on the ground in the United States.

What you will do in the first 90 days

  • Weeks 1–2: build a target list of about 100 distributors in one vertical (plumbing and HVAC) with $20–100M in revenue, using association and buying-group membership and your own network. Our agents do the research and draft the outreach; you put your name on it and pick up the phone.
    - Weeks 3–8: book and lead 20 conversations (45 minutes each) with owners, presidents, and directors of operations. The goal is to learn, not to sell: how orders come in today, how many people touch them, what breaks, what they have tried, why they said no to the vendors who called before us, whether their ERP has an API license. Our founder joins most calls; an agent takes notes.
    - Weeks 9–12: convert the best conversations into three paid pilots ($3,000–5,000 for 60 days) on live email order flow, and help define what "success" means for each one.
    - Throughout: tell us the truth about what you hear, including "nobody wants this." That answer is worth as much to us as a yes.

How we will measure the work

Three to four booked conversations per week; most of them with the person who owns the P&L or operations; three signed pilots by the end of the contract.

Who you are

- 8–15 years in US wholesale distribution, on one of two sides: you ran operations, customer service, or inside sales at a distributor with $30–200M in revenue, or you sold or implemented software for distributors (Epicor Prophet 21 or Eclipse, Infor CloudSuite Distribution or SX.e, Conexiom, DCKAP, Unilog, Proton, or similar).
- You have personally sat on, or managed, an order desk, and you know what a bad part-number match costs.
- You can name twenty distributors you would call tomorrow, and some of them would take the call.
- You are comfortable hearing no fifteen times in a row and writing down exactly why.
- You can travel to two industry events during the contract.
- You are based in the US, ideally within reach of Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta, or the Ohio Valley.

Nice to have

- Relationships inside a buying group (Affiliated Distributors, IMARK) or an association (ASA, HARDI, NAED, NAW).
- An earlier stint at an early-stage company, or a distributor that went through an ERP migration.
- You have already used AI tools in your own work and have opinions about what they get wrong.

Who this is not for

Enterprise software sellers who have never been on a warehouse floor. People who want to build a sales team before there is a product. Consultants who advise but do not make calls. Anyone who needs a finished product and a price list before they can start a conversation.

How we work

Small team, no middle management. AI agents do the list building, research, drafting, note taking, and follow-up scheduling; you do the part that needs a human who speaks the industry's language. Weekly written updates instead of status meetings. Decisions on the product are made from your call notes, so we will read every one of them.

Process

1. A 30-minute intro call with the founder.
2. A paid trial task ($1,000, five working days): book three conversations with directors of operations at distributors in the target vertical and send us notes from the first one.
3. Contract offer within 48 hours of the trial.

Contract-to-hire · Remote, US (Midwest or South preferred) · ~20% travel
$10,000–14,000 per month for a 3-month full-time contract; conversion to a founding full-time role at $130,000–170,000 base, pilot bonus, and 0.5–1% equity

Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.

Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Own

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
  • Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
  • Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs

SQL & Data Management

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
  • Extract and combine data from multiple sources
  • Work with relational databases and structured datasets
  • Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar BI platforms
  • Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
  • Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards

Data Pipelines & Integrations

  • Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
  • Help connect business systems and reporting environments
  • Support reliable movement of data between platforms
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
  • Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows

Reporting Automation

  • Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
  • Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
  • Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Monitor and improve data accuracy
  • Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
  • Validate reporting outputs against source data
  • Improve processes that support reliable reporting
  • Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
  • Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
  • Strong hands-on SQL skills
  • Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar tools
  • Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Professional working English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems
  • Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
  • Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
  • Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
  • Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting

Tools & Technologies

SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
  • Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
  • Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
  • Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
  • Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
  • Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.

Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.

In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and reliability of reporting
  • Quality and usability of dashboards
  • Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
  • SQL query and reporting efficiency
  • Reduction in manual reporting processes
  • Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
  • Improvement in overall data quality
  • Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Data / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Customer Support Operations
jobs.excerpt: College Board – Operations – Customer Support Operations Location: This is a remote role.
jobs.description:
College Board – Operations – Customer Support Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board’s Operations division leads all aspects of customer support, learning and delivery for the organization’s digital product portfolio of assessments and classwork products. We are comprised of ~130 professionals supporting millions of students and thousands of test centers each year. Our three functional areas—Assessment Delivery Operations, Customer Engagement & Experience, and Knowledge, Learning and Operational Effectiveness—work together as “One Ops” to deliver against our ambitious priorities:

  • Clean Delivery+: Deliver assessments and support with the consistency and quality that sustain the trust of students, educators, and partners, while continuously improving how we work.
  • Build for the Future: Invest in digital tools, data strategy, and AI to modernize assessment delivery and support, and to help more students prepare and succeed.
  • Customer Experience: Design a seamless end-to-end journey for students, parents, educators, and our state and district partners, using data to represent the voice of the customer across the organization.

Our Customer Support Operations team is a combination of vendor management and delivery, specialized technical and Tier 3 support teams, program/product SMEs and forecasting and planning operations to deliver all aspects of a multi-channel support model to ensure success for users, including students, parents, educators, and our state/district partners. We oversee approximately 1.5 million contacts per year across phone, email, and chat and a vendor budget of ~20 million. Our integrated team plays a critical role in leveraging data to advocate for the voice of the customer, partnering across the organization to provide a positive and effective overall customer experience.

About the Opportunity

As the Executive Director, Customer Support Operations, you are a customer operations leader who has run support at scale and is ready to reinvent it. You’ll lead all aspects of customer support and service and call center vendor operations for College Board’s customers, from students and parents to educators and our state and district partners. You lead a team of leaders who own their numbers, drive performance across large external vendors, and use AI to advance access to support and the accuracy of guidance.

This role is central to that work, driving measurable gains in cost efficiency, contact containment, and customer experience quality across voice, chat, and emerging digital channels. As a key contributor to our Operations leadership team, you will help optimize our digital testing operational structures and support models and build for the future. Behind every contact is a student, parent, or educator who needs an answer, and you make sure they get a good one.

In this role, you will:

Set Vision & Strategy (40%)

  • Set the overarching vision and direction for Customer Support Operations as part of the enterprise Operations division, aligning with division priorities and pairing best-in-class support strategies with a strong customer experience differentiated by customer needs and expectations.
  • Foster a customer centric mindset and framework for processes, products and decision-making, including AI-assisted self-service and in-app support pathways that reduce friction for students, educators, and state partners.
  • Develop a deep understanding of College Board’s customer base and work with stakeholders across the organization to provide strong service and address the root of the problem. Bring the voice of the customer, including AI-generated insights from voice and chat interactions, to policy, product, and communication decisions.
  • Define clear measurements of success. Develop, monitor, and report on critical measurements and metrics that drive high levels of customer satisfaction. Go beyond service levels, FCR, AHT, and CSAT to measure customer success and the quality of agent guidance, and drive FCR improvements and AHT reductions.
  • Set a strategic vendor management and optimization strategy for a wide range of customer support models, including generative AI-powered voice/chat bots, digital platforms insights management, and SaaS in-app support tools, with a focus on access, efficiency, and quality of customer experience.

Provide Team Leadership & Management (40%)

  • Lead and develop a remote team of ~4 direct reports, building a high-performing leadership team with shared expectations, candid feedback, and clear accountability. Model a service and team-first mindset that makes psychological safety, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning the norm.
  • Set vision and priorities for the team, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles.
  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work.
  • Partner with Operations leadership peers to drive a One Ops culture, align on shared priorities and critical dependencies, ensure alignment across teams, and establish a presence as an enterprise leader.
  • Establish critical forecasting and workforce planning capabilities, including planning models for call center vendors. Manage work volumes and a vendor budget of ~$25M based on data, and equip Customer Engagement & Experience (CEE) leaders to own their numbers and drive vendor performance.
  • Enhance the customer support vendor management function, including forecasting and quality improvements, effective diversification strategies, and oversight of AI-powered support vendors to ensure performance standards and cost targets are met. Anticipate vendor readiness and quality risks and put mitigation plans in place before issues reach customers.

Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation (20%)

  • Provide actionable intelligence and insights through analysis and assessment of all escalation data that comes into the team.
  • Advance real-time, executive level reporting disciplines, including test administration insights and analysis of variances, and establish reporting protocols to monitor performance data and drive continuous improvement.
  • Analyze escalation data to find and solve for root causes; elevate key trends with leadership and field teams. Make data-driven decisions on continuous improvement for our escalations programs to advance visibility for leadership and field teams with a focus on transparency.
  • Foster an innovative culture and champion the use of AI insights to drive evidence-based recommendations that measurably improve cost efficiency, customer experience, and program outcomes.
  • Lead the technical and agent readiness infrastructure required to support new product and program launches (e.g., Bluebook Platform pilots), including IVR configuration, agent training requirements and quality measures, agent-AI assistance, and support readiness and escalation structures. Ensure tools, products, and systems deliver the capabilities support teams need.
  • Define Customer Service Support requirements for new program and product pilots, and convert pilot learnings into scalable requirements for full launch/es

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 15+ years leading customer experience or customer support functions, with some related product management, budgeting and forecasting, and workforce management expertise.
  • Financial acumen and experience managing a vendor budget at scale, including oversight of large external call center vendors.
  • Deep understanding of industry best practices, trends, and technologies related to customer operations and support, support platforms, and in-app support delivery models.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI to advance efficiency or deliver actionable product, program, and policy improvement insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex customer escalations.
  • A track record of driving operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer experiences, including leading high-visibility projects from start to finish with measurable results.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes, and dynamic environment and lead teams and stakeholders through transformational change.
  • Fluency with data and confidence in making data-driven decisions, paired with strategic thinking and planning skills to build a strategy, connect the dots, and build towards the future.
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style:you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging.
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth:you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact.
  • Demonstrated experience building high-performing, collaborative teams, including coaching, developing, and retaining top talent and empowering others through delegation with accountability.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, including ability to work with product leads and technologists to drive business requirements and to influence and build relationships across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree (required), Master’s/MBA degree (preferred).
  • The ability to travel at least once a month to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resumé and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $152,000 - $225,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Lithuania

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Lithuania. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

This role ensures the company has reliable, cost-effective, and scalable access to various types of OEM vehicle data used in the processing of data for JD Power products and analytics solutions.

The Director works closely with Data Operations leadership, Procurement, Legal, Technology, and Commercial teams to oversee data supplier relationships, licensing, sourcing coverage, and supply continuity. The role requires a strategic and proactive approach to data acquisition while maintaining strong governance, cost discipline, and risk mitigation across the data supply ecosystem.

In this role, you will:

Data Sourcing & Acquisition

  • Lead the sourcing and acquisition strategy for Data Operations, building on its existing network foundation to meet future needs.
  • Identify and evaluate new data sources and various acquisition approaches that improve Data Operations sourcing coverage and operational requirements.
  • Partner with Data Operations and Product leaders to understand evolving data needs and priorities.

  • Grow the team's relationship network across data assets, including OEM, data supplier, and digital data relationships.
  • Coach team members on negotiation, supplier management, and governance practices, and build backup coverage for critical supplier relationships.

Supplier & Licensing Management

  • Manage relationships with external data suppliers and strategic partners.
  • Lead supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, renewals, and performance reviews.
  • Oversee data licensing, usage rights, and contractual obligations.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Data Governance to ensure effective oversight.

Supply Management & Resiliency

  • Establish contingency and backup sourcing plans for critical data assets.
  • Monitor supplier risk and develop mitigation strategies to ensure uninterrupted data access.

Cost & Performance Management

Governance & Continuous Improvement

About Fusemachines
Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.

jobs.description:
Flexcompute is the physics company. We tackle multi-scale, multi-physics problems with simulators that combine numerical methods and AI models. We are GPU-native and support agentic workflows for the fastest path to physics insight. We scale first-principles physics into foundational physics models to eliminate the latency to physical insights. Our platforms help teams design and optimize products from electric aircraft and wind turbines to photonic chips and quantum hardware. Built by engineers from Stanford University and MIT and backed by top VC firms, we are growing fast across aerospace, automotive, semiconductors, photonics, and beyond.

About the Role

We're looking for an Agentic Photonic Design Engineer to join the PhotonForge team. This is a software development role at the intersection of photonic design automation, EDA integration, and agentic AI. You'll extend our end-to-end platform for photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design, working in Python and navigating a C++ codebase to ship production integrations and AI-native workflows.

PhotonForge unifies component simulation, circuit simulation, compact modeling, layout generation, PDK integration, and foundry handoff into a single platform backed by Flexcompute's GPU-accelerated Tidy3D multi-physics solvers. You'll build EDA tool integrations, develop physics-driven application workflows, and design agentic tools that make photonic design faster and more accessible.

This is a remote role based in Singapore.

What You’ll Do

Build Interfaces & Connectors to EDA Tools

• Develop and maintain integrations between PhotonForge and industry-standard EDA tools for layout, DRC, LVS, and schematic-driven design, such as Cadence Virtuoso (through our Cadence connector), KLayout and Siemens Calibre.

• Enable seamless round-trip workflows between EDA environments, PhotonForge, and Tidy3D simulation.

• Build Python-based APIs and automation scripts that connect PhotonForge to existing toolchains (GDSII and OASIS layouts, Touchstone S-parameters, SPICE netlists, and Verilog-A models for SPICE simulators); read, debug, and extend C++ components where integrations touch the core platform.

Design Agentic & AI-Native Workflows

• Build agentic tools and automation that help engineers set up layout, simulation, and verification with less manual friction.

• Prototype and ship AI-powered features inside PhotonForge and adjacent developer experiences (e.g., scripted flows, assistants, workflow agents).

Drive Physics & Application Workflows

• Work with end users on real-world design challenges in quantum photonics, RF photonics, co-packaged optics, or silicon photonics.

• Develop application workflows and reference designs across component simulation, circuit simulation, compact modeling, and layout.

• Leverage Flexcompute’s GPU-accelerated Tidy3D multi-physics solvers (tackling optical, RF, charge, and thermal physics) to build fabrication-aware simulation pipelines.

Requirements

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain practical experience developing machine learning models, working with real application data, and supporting production ML systems.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As we expand our machine learning capabilities, we're looking for motivated individuals who want to learn how intelligent systems are developed, evaluated, and integrated into real software products.

You'll work alongside experienced machine learning engineers, applied AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to contribute to machine learning projects across the platform.

This internship is designed to provide hands-on engineering experience. Rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical research, you'll learn how machine learning models are developed, tested, improved, and prepared for use in production applications.

Your work may include preparing datasets, exploring model architectures, implementing training scripts, evaluating model performance, and helping integrate machine learning capabilities into existing software systems.

You'll gain exposure to practical machine learning workflows, including feature engineering, experiment tracking, model validation, performance monitoring, and reproducible development practices.

You'll also learn how engineering teams evaluate whether a machine learning solution is appropriate for a product problem, compare model approaches, and balance accuracy with reliability, latency, and operational cost.

You'll receive guidance from experienced engineers while contributing to appropriately scoped projects. As you develop your skills, you'll have opportunities to take greater ownership of technical tasks and communicate your findings to the team.

We welcome candidates who have developed machine learning skills through university coursework, independent projects, research, internships, hackathons, or self-directed learning. Previous professional machine learning engineering experience is not required.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An AI Infrastructure Architecture leader who is ready to make sure our clients have the foundation to run AI in customer service at scale. You lead teams of platform engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who design, implement, and govern the compute, deployment infrastructure, and tooling AI depends on, and you tune how those workloads run, so a virtual agent answers in real time on the busiest day of the year and the cost per interaction still makes business sense.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams include FDEs, hybrid practitioners who embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You may have been one yourself; now your job is to lead them, set the standard for how they work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee AI platform programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across leads and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as availability, latency, throughput, and cost per interaction.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Own the design and governance of AI platform infrastructure for service, including model serving and inference, deployment pipelines, environments, and tooling across cloud and hybrid estates.
  • Give your FDEs a platform path from prototype to production, with environments, platform-native tooling, CI/CD, and observability that make hardening a solution a standard step rather than a rebuild.
  • Lead performance and capacity engineering for real-time service workloads: latency budgets for voice and chat, concurrency planning for seasonal and event-driven peaks, load testing, and scaling strategies.
  • Bring cost discipline to AI at scale through inference and token economics, model routing, caching, and right-sizing, with FinOps reporting that leaders can act on.
  • Shape the data foundations behind service intelligence, including service data lakes, pipelines, and the platforms that power reporting, dashboards, and analytics agents.
  • Stand up AI platform operations with clear SLOs, observability, and incident management, and run models that hand over cleanly to client teams.
  • Set performance targets around what customers actually feel, like the pause before a voice agent responds, and give design and engineering teams clear constraints to design and build against.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships and proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, shaping platform modernization and scale-up proposals that win work and fuel future demand.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on running AI economically and reliably at scale in customer service, opening doors to new conversations with client technology leaders.
  • Strengthen relationships with cloud, data, and AI platform partners to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow Forward Deployed Engineers and platform engineers and architects, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: hire the right hybrid profiles, define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify platform blueprints, performance benchmarks, and operating playbooks that make delivery repeatable across clients.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.
  • Experience leading FDEs or similar client-embedded technical teams, such as solutions architects, sales engineers, or technical consultants; a hands-on FDE or engineering background yourself is a strong plus.
  • Deep experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure at enterprise scale on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
  • Experience running AI and ML workloads in production, including model serving, inference optimization, accelerator capacity, and managed AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, or Databricks Mosaic AI.
  • A track record in performance engineering, observability, and site reliability for latency-sensitive, high-volume systems.
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience supporting high-volume contact center operations on platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, etc., including voice and telephony infrastructure (SIP, WebRTC), real-time speech services (speech-to-text and text-to-speech), and peak-volume capacity planning.
  • Experience building service data and analytics foundations, including interaction data such as calls, chats, and transcripts, workforce and quality data, and the reporting and dashboards service leaders run on.
  • A track record of leading business development by shaping proposals, scoping programs, and presenting to clients in a way that builds confidence and closes deals.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to hold difficult conversations with senior client stakeholders, guiding them to outcomes that strengthen the relationship while setting expectations that protect our delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and influence cross-functional decision making.

jobs.title: Performance Creative Editor (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: We sell mushroom coffee direct to consumers.  Paid ads on Meta and Google are how we grow, and the creative is the variable that decides whether it works.
jobs.description:
We sell mushroom coffee direct to consumers. Paid ads on Meta and Google are how we grow, and the creative is the variable that decides whether it works. We test continuously and we measure what wins, so the feedback you get here is specific rather than taste-based.

Our creative strategists write the scripts and own the angle. You own the execution and, specifically, the first five seconds. You will ship 15 to 25 finished ads a month, deliberately fewer than most performance shops expect, because we would rather you spend the hours deciding what to change than cutting another variant nobody learns from.

What you will do

  • Cut paid ads for Meta and Google from scripts and angles handed to you by a strategist. Vertical, sound-on, short, fast-paced.
  • Own the hook. The script arrives written; the first five seconds are your call. We have firm views, built from our own account data, about which openers work for this product and which quietly kill a good ad. You will learn them in week one, apply them without being asked, and argue when one is wrong.
  • Iterate winners, not only originate. Most of your month is making something that already works work harder, which in our testing beats originating from scratch by a wide margin.
  • Build variants that change one thing on purpose. We have burned whole quarters on same-day copies that duplicated instead of testing. A variant that teaches us nothing is worse than no variant.
  • Read your own numbers. You get access to our creative analytics and attribution tools, and your output is measured. You bring reads to the weekly creative review rather than waiting to be told what lost.

Requirements

What we are looking for

Three or more years cutting ads that ran on a paid account. We care about what you have shipped, not your title.

Required

  • Paid ads as the spine of your work. You can name a brand that spent money distributing something you cut.
  • A performance number you personally moved on a specific piece of creative, before and after.
  • You know which metrics decide and which mislead. An ad is judged on spend and acquisition cost over its first week, not on thumbstop or hold rate. Plenty of good editors optimise for retention and engagement because those are the numbers they are shown. We will ask you which metrics you have actually been held to and what you think they do and do not predict. There is a right answer and it is not the obvious one.
  • AI creation, fluently and invisibly. Generative tooling is how you hit variant volume at this cadence: image and video generation, voice, upscaling, automated captioning and reframing. The bar is output nobody can tell was generated. We are not buying AI-looking content, we are buying your speed.
  • Premiere or DaVinci to a professional standard, plus After Effects or CapCut. You finish your own sound.
  • English good enough to argue with a media buyer about why a hook is wrong.
  • Your own machine, reliable internet, a quiet place to take a call.

Strongly preferred

  • Supplements, wellness, beverage, beauty or DTC subscription. Our claims language is regulated.
  • Range across the formats direct response actually runs on: offer-led creative, objection and confession openers, and one person talking to camera. Tell us which you are strongest in.
  • Creative analytics tooling such as Motion, Triple Whale or Northbeam.
  • Cutting from creator and UGC footage, including the unglamorous work of making mediocre raw material perform.

Not required: a degree, a cinematic showreel, agency names on your resume, or managing anyone.

Before you apply

We decline a lot of genuinely skilled editors who have never cut a direct-response ad. That wastes everyone's time, so, plainly:

Not a fit if your portfolio is mainly corporate or internal communications, brand films, weddings and events, news or broadcast, documentary, event recaps and sizzle reels, music videos, real estate, podcast production, long-form YouTube, or B2B training. Those are real crafts and close to the opposite problem: a beautiful 90-second brand film and an ad that holds a stranger for three seconds and sells coffee are not the same skill.

The test: can you name a brand that paid to distribute something you cut, and the metric you were judged on? If the honest answer is that you have made great videos but nobody bought media against them, this seat will not work, and we would rather say so now than after two interviews.

One more thing. A cover letter that repeats this posting back to us reads exactly as it sounds. Tell us about your work instead.

Benefits

Engagement

Independent contractor, ongoing, invoiced monthly. Not employment.

Location

Remote, anywhere in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, or Uruguay. You are responsible for your own taxes and any local registration.

Hours

Async by default. We ask for 2-3 hours of daily overlap with Austin, Texas (Central Time) for the creative review and buyer conversations. You choose which hours.

Commitment

Full-time equivalent effort. We are not looking for someone fitting this between three other clients.

Equipment

Yours. We provide software seats (Adobe CC, Motion, Frame.io) and all footage, product and creator assets.

Start

As soon as the right person is found.

Our customers run real-time pipelines that cannot stop: fraud detection, payments, telemetry, recommendations. When something breaks, you are the engineer who gets it running again.

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will solve real production problems on Kubernetes, in the cloud and inside Flink itself. You will work side by side with the engineers who build Flink, so every hard ticket is a chance to learn how a distributed system works under the hood.

This role suits someone who enjoys a good puzzle, likes helping people and wants to grow into a stream processing expert.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2+ years in technical support or a similar hands-on role, ideally with cloud-based products.
  • Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
  • Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes. Our product runs on Kubernetes, so this matters.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You enjoy finding out why something fails.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and the patience to explain technical ideas to any audience.
  • A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay calm when a customer is under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.
  • Curiosity and a drive to keep learning.
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE

No one ticks every box. If you have some of these, tell us.
  • Experience with stream processing, Apache Flink or Apache Kafka.
  • Scripting or programming skills in Shell, Python, Java or SQL.
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring and observability tools.
  • Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator.

LOCATION AND WORKING HOURS

This is a remote role for someone based between UTC-4 and UTC-7. That covers US and Canadian Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific time, plus Latin American countries in the same range.
  • Your core hours follow customers' business day in the Americas.
  • You will work closely with our EMEA support team to give customers follow-the-sun coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Be the first technical point of contact for customers using Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform.
  • Diagnose and fix issues across the stack, from Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure to Flink jobs, connectors and SQL.
  • Reproduce tricky problems, dig through logs and metrics, and find the root cause.
  • Escalate to Engineering and Product with clear, well-documented cases, and help shape fixes and product improvements.
  • Explain solutions and best practices clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • Keep accurate records of cases and resolutions in our ticketing system.
  • Turn what you learn into knowledge base articles, tutorials and runbooks that help customers and teammates.
  • Keep sharpening your skills in cloud technologies and stream processing, and share them with the team.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation: salary, equity and performance bonus
  • Remote-first culture with flexible hours
  • Direct access to Flink core developers and a global open-source community
  • A clear path to grow into senior support, Technical Account Manager or engineering roles
  • Generous vacation, personal leave and wellness benefits

At Ververica, we believe innovation starts with diverse perspectives. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you are passionate about helping customers succeed with real-time data, we would love to hear from you.

Apache Flink® is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Virtual Assistant (VA) to provide reliable executive, administrative, CRM, and operational support.

This is not a passive administrative role. You’ll serve as an execution partner, helping keep calendars, communication, records, projects, and day-to-day priorities organized and moving forward.

You’ll work across multiple business functions and may support founders, executives, clients, vendors, and internal teams.

If you’re someone who takes initiative, communicates professionally, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Calendar, Inbox & Executive Support

  • Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and scheduling across multiple time zones.
  • Monitor and organize inboxes.
  • Prioritize important emails and flag time-sensitive requests.
  • Draft professional:
    • Emails
    • Memos
    • Documents
    • Internal communications
  • Prepare meeting agendas and notes.
  • Track action items and follow-ups after meetings.
  • Help executives stay organized and focused on their highest-priority work.

CRM & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records within CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
  • Update contacts, activities, notes, and relevant business information.
  • Maintain spreadsheets using Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
  • Review records for missing, duplicate, or outdated information.
  • Ensure business data remains accurate, organized, and accessible.

File & Document Management

  • Maintain organized digital filing systems using:
    • Google Drive
    • Dropbox
    • Microsoft SharePoint
  • Create consistent folder structures and naming conventions.
  • Keep documents organized, searchable, and up to date.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and business documents when needed.

Research & Task Execution

  • Conduct online research related to:
    • Competitors
    • Vendors
    • Market opportunities
    • Business initiatives
  • Organize findings into clear summaries, spreadsheets, or presentations.
  • Handle ad hoc administrative and operational requests.
  • Support small projects from assignment through completion.

Client & Vendor Communication

  • Respond to routine client inquiries or route them to the appropriate person.
  • Follow up with vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • Track outstanding requests and ensure timely completion.
  • Maintain professional and responsive communication across stakeholders.

Operations & Project Support

  • Maintain project and task trackers using tools such as:
    • Asana
    • Trello
    • Notion
    • Monday.com
  • Track deadlines, priorities, and outstanding action items.
  • Support invoicing and expense tracking.
  • Assist with light bookkeeping when required.
  • Help maintain organized operational workflows.
  • Identify missing information, overdue tasks, or potential bottlenecks and follow up proactively.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Take initiative instead of waiting for constant instructions.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally.
  • Follow through until tasks are fully completed.
  • Can manage multiple responsibilities without losing track of details.
  • Learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Are comfortable working independently.
  • Understand the importance of confidentiality and professionalism.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–2+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or Operations Support professional.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Microsoft Office
  • Experience managing calendars, meetings, and professional communication.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks or Xero.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting:
    • Founders
    • Executives
    • Startups
    • U.S.-based businesses
    • Remote teams
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or clients simultaneously.
  • Basic reporting, spreadsheet, or operational tracking experience.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing the executive’s calendar and inbox, identifying urgent requests, confirming meetings, and organizing priorities.

Throughout the day, you’ll update CRM records, prepare documents or reports, conduct research, coordinate meetings, follow up with clients and vendors, and keep project trackers current.

Before finishing, you’ll review outstanding tasks and make sure priorities and follow-ups are organized for the next day.

In short: you keep communication, administration, and operations organized so the people you support can stay focused on higher-value work.

Interview Process

  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Administrative / Operations Task

Apply Now

Bennie () is an employee benefits services and technology firm that helps companies create a healthier workplace. Bennie provides services and technology that are beyond what growing companies typically receive, yet exactly what they need.

Bennie’s team members use the platform and its data to supplement their market knowledge and bring innovative solutions to Bennie’s customers.

Bennie is headquartered in Stamford, CT, and is a remote-first company with employees across the U.S.

Core Values at Bennie

As an organization, we value our team members who are Optimistic, Accountable, Thoughtful, and Healthy. We believe these values, known as our O.A.T.H., are essential for our collective success. The ideal candidate for this role will embody these values by:

  • Maintaining a positive attitude throughout our journey of building our company.
  • Being responsible for the quality of their work and for meeting their goals.
  • Respecting our differences and looking out for one another.
  • Believing in living complete lives that balance our work and personal time.

About the role:

The Enterprise Senior Benefits Analyst is responsible for supporting Enterprise Consultants and strategic account teams in delivering ongoing customer strategy, service and retention tasks for enterprise-segment customers (500+ lives). This includes but is not limited to claims data analysis, complex cost modeling, stop-loss reporting, RFP consolidation, customer deliverable preparation, and strong partnership with the Bennie Data Operations and Product teams. This individual should have experience working in benefits consulting or healthcare analytics with advanced expertise in data modeling and financial exhibits. The ideal candidate is someone excited to leverage technology and data to deliver high-touch strategic insights for large employer customers.

Reporting to: Director of Enterprise Consulting

Who You Are: The ideal candidate should possess exceptional analytical, communication, and relationship building skills; and is excited to join a fast-growing benefits brokerage and work with senior team members to help deliver exceptional consulting service and experience to Bennie’s customers.

The Enterprise Senior Benefits Analyst should exhibit the core attributes of the Bennie consulting team:

  1. Possess a growth mindset to drive the business upward and forward.
  2. Take a proactive approach to value creation and delivery for customers, colleagues, and partners.
  3. Seize the consultative opportunity in every interaction with customers, colleagues, and partners.
  4. Maintain a curiosity about the industry, Bennie’s customers, and Bennie’s business.
  5. Bring relentless intensity to the creation of value.
  6. Take ownership of one’s impact and influence on customers, colleagues, and partners
  7. Work collaboratively with customers, colleagues, and partners.
  8. Act with compassion in every interaction, every time.

Responsibilities include:

  • Partnering with Consultants to create customer deliverables like open enrollment presentations, benefit guides, cost modeling exhibits, contribution strategy models, and renewal analysis decks.

  • Assisting Consultants with complex enterprise customer onboarding tasks and plan implementation workflows.
  • Supporting enterprise compliance reporting and data audits (e.g., Form 5500 filings, ACA reporting, RxDC disclosures, and ERISA plan compliance).
  • Coordinating carrier, ben admin, & other vendor reporting that supports Bennie Data Operations team.
  • Assisting in the development and standardization of customer delivery that support scalable enterprise customer service.
  • Continual partnership with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Operations) to communicate customer needs and help them develop solutions for efficient customer service.
  • Developing relationships with industry partners.

Requirements:

  • Demonstrated Proficiency in MS Excel (vlookups/xlookups, pivot tables, complex financial modeling) and working knowledge of Word and PowerPoint.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI productivity tools and comfort with prompts that support efficient work processes.
  • 1-2 years of experience in employee benefits consulting, healthcare analytics, or carrier underwriting, with exposure to large-group/enterprise accounts.

Nice to Have:

  • Life & Health Producer’s License.
  • Certification in data analysis or MS Excel (e.g., Advanced Excel, SQL, or BI tools like Tableau/PowerBI).

  • Comfort leading work across both platform foundations and applied data use cases, with the judgment to prioritize effectively across competing stakeholder needs

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing, building, and operating complex data pipelines, both batch and streaming, using tools such as Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, Apache Beam, Google Dataflow, or equivalent

  • Multiple years of experience governing data infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform

  • Proven expertise in leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex data pipelines using SQL and Python

  • Solid understanding of best data modeling techniques (e.g. dimensional modeling, star schema, data normalization)

  • Deep understanding and practical experience in data access patterns, storage solutions, caching, replication, and optimization techniques

  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Direct experience leading the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices as they apply to both data pipelines and ML systems

  • Proven expertise leading the full MLOps lifecycle: model deployment, versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, and rollback strategies in a production environment

  • Experience supporting AI/ML use-cases such as personalization, classification, ranking, recommendations, etc.

  • Willingness to be hands-on and participate in code reviews and an on-call support rotation (currently monthly)

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications, and own projects from inception through successful completion

  • Strong people leadership skills, including coaching senior ICs, giving clear feedback, growing careers, and building an inclusive, accountable team culture

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where you may need to zoom between strategic planning, stakeholder management, and hands-on technical decision-making.

  • Self-motivation and a deep sense of pride in your team's and your own work

  • Comfort with ambiguity and an instinct for moving quickly while maintaining high standards.

  • Humility, empathy, and open-mindedness – a commitment to a collaborative, ego-free environment

  • Passion for the outdoors

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with geospatial data, maps, tiling, graph databases, and/or routing

  • Experience working in a multi-cloud environment (GCP + AWS)

  • Skilled at managing infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform)
