jobs.title: Applications Engineer - Membrion
jobs.excerpt: About MembrionMembrion is a growing clean technology company transforming how industries manage wastewater.
jobs.description:
About Membrion

Membrion is a growing clean technology company transforming how industries manage wastewater. Our proprietary electro-ceramic desalination (ECD) technology helps industrial customers treat challenging wastewater streams, recover valuable resources, and reduce the environmental and financial costs of water treatment. Working across industries including semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage, and consumer packaged goods, we're bringing innovative treatment solutions into real-world industrial operations.

Are you an engineer who loves solving problems that don't have obvious answers?

We're looking for an Applications Engineer who can turn complex customer challenges into practical, technically sound treatment solutions.

Working closely with our Sales, Technology, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams, you'll evaluate customer wastewater processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop integrated treatment solutions that balance technical performance, cost, and operational realities.

Our projects typically range from $500,000 to $5 million, and no two applications are quite the same. You'll need to think creatively, understand how different processes and equipment work together, and develop solutions that can be successfully integrated into existing industrial facilities.

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the details, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of problems through to resolution. You'll have the independence to manage your work, the support of an experienced technical team, and the opportunity to see your solutions put into practice.

What You Will Do

Understand the Customer Application

•Gather and evaluate wastewater analyses, operating data, treatment objectives, site constraints, and existing infrastructure through customer discussions, records, and site inputs.

•Identify data gaps, likely root causes, ECD applicability, and technical risks; define the additional information or testing needed to advance the opportunity.

•Establish a traceable design basis that clearly distinguishes verified data, assumptions, and uncertainties.

Develop Integrated Treatment Solutions

  • Develop creative, practical treatment concepts that integrate ECD with appropriate pretreatment and downstream processes, considering existing customer equipment, infrastructure, and operational constraints.
  • Prepare process flow diagrams, mass balances, preliminary P&IDs where appropriate, and equipment and membrane sizing.
  • Evaluate treatment alternatives based on performance, recovery, utility requirements, capital and operating costs, and sensitivity to changing feed conditions.
  • Translate bench-scale and pilot results into practical design inputs, collaborating with Technology and Engineering to address system integration, safety, constructability, and operability before customer commitments.

Prepare Credible Technical Proposals

  • Prepare technical scopes, system descriptions, process drawings, equipment information, and supported performance expectations, with clear assumptions and exclusions.
  • Create customer proposals that balance customer technical requirements with project execution planning and risk mitigation.
  • Support Sales in customer technical discussions by explaining design choices, treatment tradeoffs, and the value of the proposed solution.
  • Check consistency across calculations, drawings, costs, scope, and performance claims; incorporate review feedback and maintain clear decision and revision records.

Deliver Reliably and Improve Future Applications

  • Manage assigned milestones across multiple opportunities, communicate progress proactively, and escalate missing inputs or technical blockers early.
  • Provide Engineering and Customer Success with clear and complete handoff documentation covering the design basis, scope boundaries, decisions, and unresolved items.
  • Use and improve approved calculators, templates, and workflows. Capture validated application learnings and share recurring customer needs with Product and the broader team.

Requirements

Qualifications:

We're interested in Applications Engineers who bring strong technical judgment, curiosity, and a practical approach to solving problems. While experience in industrial wastewater treatment is particularly valuable, we recognize that relevant skills can be developed through different engineering backgrounds and career paths.

  • Experience in applications engineering, process engineering, or a related technical role, ideally involving industrial water or wastewater treatment.
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • An understanding of industrial processes, equipment integration, and the operational requirements of treatment systems.
  • Knowledge of water chemistry, mass balances, treatment performance, fouling, scaling, and operating cost considerations.
  • Ability to develop and review engineering calculations, process flow diagrams, technical specifications, and proposal documentation.
  • Sound engineering judgment, including the ability to recognize incomplete information, challenge assumptions, and identify when further technical validation is required.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and commercial colleagues.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach to work, with the ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of deliverables.
  • Comfort working in a collaborative, predominantly remote environment where communication, initiative, and follow-through are essential.

Experience That Would Be Particularly Valuable

  • Direct experience with industrial wastewater treatment systems, particularly membrane processes such as UF, NF, RO, or related technologies.
  • Experience designing, sizing, or specifying packaged process equipment, including skid-mounted or containerized systems.
  • Hands-on experience with equipment commissioning, field startup, operational troubleshooting, or supporting equipment integration at customer facilities.
  • Experience preparing technical proposals, process flow diagrams, preliminary P&IDs, or CAPEX/OPEX evaluations.
  • Experience with industrial applications in semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage, or consumer packaged goods.
  • A background in chemical, environmental, mechanical, or related engineering disciplines.

We value practical experience and demonstrated capability over any particular educational pathway. Candidates with transferable experience and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You...

  • Love solving complex technical problems, especially when the answer isn't immediately obvious.
  • Take initiative, work independently, and follow problems through to resolution.
  • Can balance technical detail with practical commercial and operational considerations.
  • Enjoy collaborating with people from different technical and commercial backgrounds.
  • Want to see your engineering work translate into real-world environmental and operational impact.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in recognizing the experience, expertise, and contributions of our team. We offer a competitive compensation package and the opportunity to be part of a growing company working on meaningful environmental challenges.

  • Base Salary: $90,000–145,000 USD annually, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.
  • Work Arrangement: Predominantly remote, with opportunities to collaborate in person with colleagues and customers.
  • Travel: Approximately 25–30%, including customer site visits and occasional travel to our Seattle facility.
  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental and vision coverage through CAMPS Health Trust, starting the first of the month after you join, with no long waiting period. Also includes life and AD&D insurance, optional additional life coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program.

Why Membrion?

Solve problems that matter. Industrial wastewater treatment is a complex challenge, and the solutions aren't always obvious. At Membrion, we're developing technology that helps industries treat difficult wastewater streams, recover valuable resources, and reduce their environmental impact. Your engineering work will have a tangible, real-world purpose.

Work with genuinely innovative technology. Our electro-ceramic desalination (ECD) technology is opening up new possibilities for industrial wastewater treatment. You'll work on challenging applications where conventional approaches don't always deliver, combining established engineering principles with creative thinking to develop better solutions.

See your ideas become reality. This isn't a role where your work ends with a calculation or a drawing. You'll help develop solutions that become real equipment, integrated into operating industrial facilities. You'll have opportunities to see your work in action and understand the impact of your engineering decisions.

Have the freedom to figure things out. We're a growing company, and we value people who take initiative, ask good questions, and find ways forward. You'll have the autonomy to own your work, the support of experienced colleagues, and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution without layers of bureaucracy.

Work with people who care about getting it right. We're a collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and commercial professionals who bring different perspectives to the same challenges. We value curiosity, accountability, practical problem-solving, and people who are willing to roll up their sleeves and help each other succeed.

Our Core Values

  • See What Isn't Obvious
  • Relentlessly Flow Like a River
  • Obnoxiously Reliable
  • All in This Together
  • Better Each Day

jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
The Digital Design Engineer will be responsible for leading the design and development of IP PCS and custom interfaces. This role requires a deep understanding of SoC design principles, strong leadership skills, and the ability to drive cross-functional teams towards successful project completion.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Review SerDes and UCIe standards and architecture documents to develop analog sub-block specifications.
  • Identify and refine circuit implementations to achieve optimal power, area, and performance targets.
  • Propose design and verification strategies that efficiently use simulator features to ensure the highest quality design.
  • Participate in complex block and/or chip planning and architecture studies.
  • Implement mixed-signal blocks using Verilog.
  • Engage in behavioral modeling activities using Verilog/SystemVerilog language.
  • Continuously document and improve design and verification environments/plans and overall procedures.
  • Drive the development of high-performance silicon chips that power next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to the success of cutting-edge UCIe/Ethernet/PCIe/DPHY/CDPHY/MPHY/DP/HDMI products, enhancing their performance and reliability.
  • Ensure that our designs meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
  • Collaborate with a team of experienced engineers to deliver innovative solutions that address complex technical challenges.
  • Enhance our design and verification processes, continuously improving efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Support the development of industry-leading products that shape the future of technology.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in SoC design and development.
  • Proven track record of leading successful SoC projects from concept to volume production.
  • Strong expertise in RTL design using Verilog or SystemVerilog
  • Proficient in SoC verification methodologies and tools (UVM, SystemVerilog, C/C++, Coco-TB, etc.).
  • Experience with synthesis, place-and-route, and timing analysis.
  • Familiarity with Design-for-Test and Design-for-Debug ideas and architecture
  • Familiarity with embedded software development and hardware/software co-design.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 25 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star:We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely:We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact:Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn’t disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work:We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon
  • Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help
  • Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview (90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min) – values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps – we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied ML Engineer, Care Experience to develop intelligent software capabilities that improve how patients receive support and navigate ongoing care-related experiences through Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting patient onboarding, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and ongoing patient interactions. These processes often involve communication, administrative follow-ups, operational handoffs, and coordination between multiple systems and teams.

You'll help build machine learning and AI-powered features that make these experiences more consistent, efficient, and easier to manage for patients and authorized care teams.

This is a hands-on applied machine learning engineering role that combines large language models, predictive modeling, backend development, and workflow automation. You'll work with approved patient-related information, application events, APIs, and model outputs to develop intelligent features that support care-related operations.

Your work may include intelligent message classification, administrative request routing, AI-assisted communication, workflow prioritization, and systems that help authorized teams identify incomplete or delayed operational tasks.

You'll collaborate with product managers, applied AI engineers, machine learning specialists, and clinical or pharmacy operations stakeholders to understand workflow requirements and translate them into reliable software capabilities.

You'll also help evaluate model accuracy, monitor production behavior, and improve machine learning systems based on real-world performance. You'll need to understand when traditional software rules, predictive models, or large language models are most appropriate for a particular problem.

Because these applications support healthcare-related workflows, accuracy, privacy, appropriate permissions, and human oversight are essential. You'll build systems that support authorized professionals and administrative processes without independently diagnosing patients, recommending treatments, prescribing medications, or making clinical decisions.

This position emphasizes practical engineering, measurable improvements, and responsible deployment. You'll contribute to technical design, build production features, and continuously improve systems based on user feedback and evaluation results.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys applying machine learning to real operational challenges, understands the importance of dependable software in sensitive environments, and wants to help make ongoing care experiences easier to manage.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain machine learning and AI-powered capabilities that support ongoing patient care experiences.
  • Develop intelligent systems for approved patient support and care coordination workflows.
  • Implement machine learning models that classify and organize patient-related administrative requests.
  • Build AI-assisted tools that help authorized teams understand and manage incoming communications.
  • Develop routing and prioritization systems for operational tasks and support requests.
  • Implement intelligent workflow assistance for follow-ups, status updates, and administrative coordination.
  • Build backend services and APIs that connect ML capabilities to existing platform applications.
  • Integrate large language models into approved care-related operational workflows.
  • Develop structured output pipelines that convert model responses into validated application data.
  • Build information retrieval capabilities that surface relevant approved workflow information.
  • Implement AI-assisted summaries for authorized care and operations teams.
  • Develop systems that help identify incomplete administrative workflows or delayed operational handoffs.
  • Evaluate opportunities to apply predictive modeling to approved care experience use cases.
  • Design feature engineering and data processing workflows for machine learning applications.
  • Build automated tests for model outputs, APIs, and application behavior.
  • Evaluate models for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and operational usefulness.
  • Investigate incorrect classifications, unreliable responses, and unexpected model behavior.
  • Improve model configurations, prompts, and application logic based on evaluation results.
  • Implement human review and confirmation steps for sensitive workflows.
  • Ensure ML-powered features respect user permissions and approved data access.
  • Collaborate with product and operational stakeholders to define measurable success criteria.
  • Monitor production model behavior, application errors, and workflow performance.
  • Optimize inference latency, reliability, and operational costs.
  • Work with backend engineers to integrate ML services into production infrastructure.
  • Support controlled deployment and testing of new intelligent care experience features.
  • Document model assumptions, known limitations, and workflow safeguards.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and architecture discussions.
  • Own assigned applied ML features from development through deployment and ongoing improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, applied AI, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience developing and deploying production software or machine learning applications.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with machine learning models and practical model evaluation techniques.
  • Experience building AI-powered applications or integrating machine learning capabilities into software products.
  • Understanding of large language models and modern generative AI development patterns.
  • Experience developing backend services and application APIs.
  • Familiarity with model APIs, structured outputs, and application integrations.
  • Experience working with relational databases and structured application data.
  • Understanding of classification, prediction, or other applied machine learning methods.
  • Familiarity with data processing and feature preparation workflows.
  • Experience writing automated tests for production software.
  • Ability to evaluate model outputs and identify accuracy or reliability problems.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure application design.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous processing and workflow automation.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of model limitations and common AI failure modes.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment.
  • Ability to translate operational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Understanding of responsible data handling and privacy-conscious development.
  • Experience using Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and software quality.
  • Ability to independently own assigned engineering projects.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing machine learning applications for healthcare, telehealth, or patient support.
  • Familiarity with care coordination or patient communication workflows.
  • Experience with message classification, intent detection, or automated request routing.
  • Familiarity with natural language processing and text classification models.
  • Experience using OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation architectures.
  • Experience with embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
  • Experience building AI-assisted summarization or communication tools.
  • Familiarity with predictive models for operational prioritization or workflow completion.
  • Experience with scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or comparable ML frameworks.
  • Experience building human-in-the-loop machine learning applications.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks and model observability.
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js backend development.
  • Experience with React or Next.js applications.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, Drizzle, or comparable development tools.
  • Experience working with AWS or serverless infrastructure.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Familiarity with clinical and pharmacy operational workflows.
  • Experience implementing audit trails and permission-controlled application features.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

jobs.description:
The Shipyard is a leading, independent marketing and communication agency headquartered in Columbus, OH and San Diego, CA that brings together talented individuals across the creative, communications, media and digital landscape. Uniquely designed to Engineer Brand Love through a unifying approach of paid, owned and earned channels, we work together to grow brands that audiences can't help but love.

Our family of brands, Fahlgren Mortine, TURNER and TinyWins, span integrated communications, travel and lifestyle, and digital innovation, giving us the range and depth to deliver for clients locally, regionally and nationally.

Momentum is nothing without the people driving it. See who we are at before you hit apply!

SUMMARY

We are looking for a smart, experienced, and motivated Programmatic Director to join our team.

The Programmatic Director is the senior-most leader of the programmatic practice at The Shipyard. This role exists to set the vision for how Shipyard approaches programmatic advertising — establishing the strategic and technical standard, developing the talent pipeline, driving the growth of client relationships, and ensuring the programmatic team consistently delivers work that is best-in-class.

A great Programmatic Director doesn't just oversee campaigns — they define what great programmatic looks like for the entire team and for the agency. They are a trusted strategic advisor to clients, a visible expert in the programmatic marketplace, and a leader who makes everyone around them better.

At The Shipyard, we know that it's your unique talents, backgrounds, and perspectives that make you who you are, just like our team, who come from various career paths and experiences. We believe we can't be truly diverse without you bringing your most authentic self to the agency.

Studies show that people from marginalized communities may not always apply for positions if they don't meet every single requirement in a job posting. At The Shipyard, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements. We believe that your passion for what we stand for — our values and purpose — is just as important as meeting every checkbox.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Media Knowledge

The Programmatic Director is the foremost programmatic expert at the agency. Your knowledge is not just deep — it is visionary, and you use it to set the direction for how the team thinks, plans, and executes.

  • Possess and actively demonstrate expert, current, and forward-looking knowledge of the full programmatic ecosystem — DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, identity solutions, data clean rooms, AI-driven optimization, emerging programmatic formats, and the evolving privacy landscape — and apply it to set the strategic direction for the programmatic team
  • Define and evolve the standards for how programmatic platforms and technology are used across the team — ensuring rigorous, sophisticated application that consistently delivers competitive advantage for clients
  • Serve as the senior-most steward of client investment within the programmatic practice — ensuring budgets are managed responsibly, billing processes are accurate and timely across every account, and the team treats client spend with the same care they would their own
  • Lead the agency's thinking on programmatic investment strategy, budget allocation, and technology evaluation — setting a high bar for how programmatic campaigns are planned, executed, and measured
  • Serve as the agency's internal and external thought leader on programmatic — bringing a clear, informed, and forward-thinking POV to client conversations, industry discussions, and new business opportunities
  • Proactively identify and evaluate emerging programmatic platforms, technology shifts, privacy developments, and industry disruptions — and translate them into clear strategic implications for clients and the agency
  • Build and maintain the agency's most strategic platform and technology partnerships — negotiating at the highest level to secure preferential access, beta opportunities, and competitive intelligence that benefit clients across the portfolio

Strategic Thinking & Planning

The Programmatic Director sets the strategic vision for the programmatic team and ensures that sophisticated, insight-driven channel strategy is embedded in every campaign across the portfolio. This role creates a programmatic practice that delivers on client solutions so effectively that it attracts spend and growth.

  • Set and own the strategic vision for programmatic advertising across the agency's client portfolio — ensuring every channel plan reflects a sophisticated audience strategy, a defensible inventory and targeting approach, and a measurable commitment to business outcomes
  • Bring a strong, informed point of view to the evolution of the agency’s programmatic strategy frameworks, best practices, and optimization standards – partnering with the VP, Media Investment to ensure consistency, ambition, and continuous improvement across all accounts and team members
  • Lead the development of programmatic strategy for the agency's most complex and high-value accounts — applying the highest level of strategic rigor to multi-channel, full-funnel programmatic challenges
  • Drive a culture of insight-driven strategy across the programmatic team — ensuring data, platform intelligence, and audience research are consistently embedded in how the team plans, optimizes, and learns
  • Identify transformative strategic opportunities for clients — new programmatic approaches, emerging technology applications, advanced measurement capabilities — and bring them forward with a compelling business case
  • Serve as the programmatic strategic anchor in all cross-functional, new business, and client leadership contexts — ensuring programmatic thinking actively elevates the overall media strategy across the agency

Communication

The Programmatic Director is an exceptionally skilled communicator who can move a room, build client confidence, and inspire the programmatic team. Your communication sets the tone for the entire practice.

  • Lead client presentations with authority, strategic depth, and the ability to connect programmatic thinking to business outcomes in a way that earns trust and wins confidence
  • Develop and drive a communication standard for the programmatic team — in presentations, in campaign reporting, and in day-to-day client interactions — that consistently reflects Shipyard's ambition and expertise
  • Communicate complex, multi-faceted programmatic strategies to senior client stakeholders, C-suite audiences, and agency leadership clearly, persuasively, and memorably
  • Represent Shipyard's programmatic capabilities and POV externally — in industry forums, new business contexts, and marketplace conversations — with confidence and conviction
  • Coach and develop strong communicators across the programmatic team, from Coordinators through Associate Directors, ensuring communication excellence at every level

Partnership

The Programmatic Director builds and leads the relationships across the agency’s programmatic practice — with clients, with platform partners, and across the integrated agency team.

  • Serve as the senior client programmatic partner for the agency's highest-value accounts — building deep, trust-based partnerships rooted in strategic value and business impact
  • Manage agency relationships with key DSP platforms, data partners, and programmatic technology vendors — leveraging relationships to build preferential access and identifying opportunities that create meaningful competitive advantage across the client portfolio
  • Partner closely with media planning, analytics, creative, client engagement, and brand planning to drive integrated, outcome-focused work across the agency
  • Build a strong working relationship with the data and analytics team – ensuring programmatic campaigns are grounded in data intelligence and that measurement is built into the work from the start, not bolted on at the end
  • Serve as a senior leader for the programmatic practice in new business, agency growth, and industry contexts — building The Shipyard's reputation as a programmatic leader in the marketplace
  • Model and champion a culture of partnership — across the programmatic team, across the agency, and in the marketplace

Team Development

The Programmatic Director is a committed people leader who builds a strong, capable programmatic team. Building, developing, and retaining great programmatic practitioners is among the most important things this role does.

  • Directly manage the programmatic team, including hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management
  • Build and sustain a high-performing team culture defined by technical excellence, strategic rigor, intellectual curiosity, genuine collaboration, and a commitment to doing great work
  • Develop a strong bench of talent at every level — from Coordinator through Associate Director — ensuring the team is always growing toward the next level of capability
  • Set clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable with fairness, directness, and genuine care for their development
  • Serve as a mentor and career advisor to senior practitioners and Associate Directors, helping them develop the leadership skills and strategic vision to grow into the next generation of programmatic leaders at Shipyard
  • Partner with the VP, Media Investment on workforce planning, talent acquisition strategy, and team structure to ensure the programmatic practice is built for long-term success

WHAT YOU’LL GET

  • The overall target range of base compensation for this role is $135,000 - $150,000. Compensation offered will be determined by additional factors such as location and experience.
  • Open PTO
  • Paid sick time (in applicable states)
  • Flexible work hours
  • Paid holidays + holiday closure between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day
  • Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and disability benefits
  • 401k program with employer matching
  • 6 weeks paid parental leave
  • Employee bonus referrals
  • Dog-friendly offices
  • Company-provided snacks and beverages (yes, beer/wine included)
  • … and lots more!

Requirements

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Patient Experience to help shape the patient-facing experiences that power direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses built on Bask Health.

Bask Health brings together patient onboarding, intake questionnaires, checkout, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and ongoing patient experiences in one platform. We're looking for a designer who can make these complex processes feel simple, intuitive, and trustworthy for the people using them.

In this role, you'll take ownership of designing patient-facing digital experiences, from the moment someone begins a questionnaire through checkout, account management, treatment status, messaging, and ongoing interactions with their telehealth provider.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to understand patient needs, identify friction in existing workflows, and design solutions that improve usability, clarity, and completion rates.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You'll be responsible for the entire design process, including discovery, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, design specifications, and collaboration during engineering implementation.

A major part of your work will involve simplifying complicated experiences. Patients may need to complete detailed questionnaires, provide sensitive information, review important instructions, or navigate multiple steps before reaching their intended outcome. You'll design these interactions to be clear, accessible, and easy to complete.

You'll also help establish consistent design patterns across patient-facing applications. As Bask continues developing new capabilities, you'll contribute to the design system, improve existing components, and ensure that experiences remain cohesive across different merchant storefronts and patient journeys.

Because our platform supports healthcare-related workflows, thoughtful design matters. You'll need to consider accessibility, privacy, clear communication, and appropriate clinical boundaries while creating experiences that patients can understand and use confidently.

You'll collaborate with researchers, content designers, and product stakeholders to validate design decisions through usability testing, customer feedback, and product data. You'll be expected to explain your decisions, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve the experiences you design.

Job Title: Commercial SOC Analyst

Reporting to: Head of SOC

Location: Remote

Hours of Work: 12 Hour shift pattern, day and night shifts including working weekends and public holidays

Future requirement to join on-call rota

We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to join our Remote Security Operations Centre (SOC). You will ideally have some hands-on experience within a commercial SOC environment and a solid understanding of cyber security principles, threat detection, and incident response. We would also welcome applications from individuals who can demonstrate a genuine passion for cyber security, a proactive mindset, and a strong desire to help protect both our customers and our internal environments from evolving cyber threats.

The Role:

You are going to be responsible for triaging, investigating, classifying, and managing cyber security incidents. We collect log data from any sources our customers require reactive monitoring of, along with deploying agents to provide proactive protection.

You will need to be comfortable with managing multiple simultaneous tasks, at different stages, each with their own priorities across different customers. You’ll have a team to support you along with time to develop yourself.

Once you’ve identified an event which requires our customer to be alerted, you’ll follow defined processes to raise this. You will also need to provide our customers with support to help prevent any damage to them and ensure that it doesn’t happen again.

We have Threat Intelligence feeds which will aide you in keeping up to date with the latest tools, techniques, and procedures. You will also use this intelligence to proactively hunt for threats and create or update existing detection rules.

This role, in addition to protective monitoring, will involve Vulnerability Management and asset discovery, including configuring custom scans and dashboards. You will be required to ensure that our vulnerability scanning service remains a valuable asset to our customers by providing contextualised information and analysis. You will have team support to achieve this.

As a team we’re always looking to raise the bar, learn new things and incorporate new technologies and you will too! You’ll share your knowledge with the team and the wider Cyberfort community, contributing to Group blogs and undertaking research related to technology enhancements.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform event triage and incident analysis

  • Provide advice and guidance in the event of a cyber security breach

  • Help maintain documentation owned by the CSOC team including but not limited to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

  • Assist with/own ad-hoc requests (within reason)

  • Remain current on cyber security trends and intelligence

  • Identify opportunities to automate processes within the CSOC

  • Stakeholder and Client Reporting (incident reports and vulnerability management)

Nice to have (any of these):

  • Programming/scripting skills

  • Experience in operational security

  • Experience in Systems administration (Linux/Windows)

  • Experience in open-source threat intelligence

  • General IT practices

  • General security practices and knowledge

  • IT Service Management basics (ITIL)

  • Knowledge of:

    • Cyber threats and vulnerabilities

    • Adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures

    • Incident response and handling methodologies

    • Risk management processes

    • IT architecture and operations (computing, network, storage & cloud)

    • Computer networking concepts and protocols, and network security methodologies

    • Responding to audit and regulatory requirements

    • Familiarization of the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.

  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and/or holidays in the event of an incident response emergency

Why Join Cyberfort

At Cyberfort, we're committed to creating an environment where our people can do their best work, develop their careers and feel part of something meaningful. Alongside a supportive culture and opportunities to grow, we've offer a package that supports your health, wellbeing, finances, development and work-life balance, helping you feel your best both inside and outside of work. Our benefits include:

  • 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, and your birthday day off

  • The option to buy and sell annual leave

  • Hybrid and flexible working opportunities (where applicable)

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies

  • Company pension scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Private Medical Insurance and wellbeing support

  • Professional training, certifications and learning opportunities

  • Employee referral bonus scheme

  • Recognition and reward programmes

  • Electric Car & Cycle to Work scheme

  • Discounts and savings through our employee benefits platform

A place where you can be yourself

At Cyberfort, we believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We know that talent comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible and inclusive for all. If there's anything we can do to support you during your application or interview experience, we'd encourage you to let us know.

We're proud to champion inclusion through our partnerships and commitments, including:

  • Signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant

  • Corporate Members of Neurodiversity in Business

  • A Disability Confident Employer

  • Supporters of the CyberFirst initiative

We're continually learning, listening and evolving to build a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive, grow and make a meaningful impact.

About Cyberfort

Cyberfort helps organisations stay ahead of cyber threats. We work alongside businesses and public sector organisations to strengthen their security, identify vulnerabilities and respond to threats before they become incidents.

Our expertise spans cyber security consultancy, penetration testing and managed detection and response (MDR). From helping customers understand their cyber risks and improve their security posture, to testing critical systems and providing 24/7 threat monitoring, we deliver practical solutions that help organisations operate with confidence.

What makes Cyberfort different is our people. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative, customer-first approach, building trusted partnerships and helping our customers navigate an ever-changing threat landscape.

Our Values

At Cyberfort, how we work is just as important as what we do. Our culture is built around five core values: being curious, working as a team, staying agile, taking ownership, and thinking innovatively.

We’re looking for individuals who are naturally inquisitive, collaborative, and adaptable people who take pride in their work, are open to learning, and are always looking for ways to improve both themselves and the way we deliver for our customers.

APPLY NOW:

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to move quickly through our selection process, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you would like to apply for this role, we'd like to see your CV and a cover letter.

With capabilities spanning technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent, we have the opportunity to take on increasingly complex and meaningful business challenges. Realizing that potential requires people who think beyond the immediate ask, challenge conventional approaches, and bring the initiative and judgment to turn ideas into results.

We have high expectations of ourselves and the people we work alongside. We value individuals who combine intellectual curiosity with commercial ambition, move with urgency, and take personal ownership of outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape client strategies, challenge assumptions, and bring forward new ideas, but you will also be expected to execute with discipline, collaborate effectively, and deliver measurable results. We are building a business that can compete at the highest levels, and we expect our Client Partners to help lead that ambition.

Your focus is on growing and retaining existing enterprise clients. Enterprise Sales Executives acquire new clients and secure the initial commercial engagement. From that point forward, you will own the ongoing commercial relationship, including identifying and closing expansion opportunities, renewals, extensions, and additional agreements. You will also be accountable for client satisfaction, retention, and the continued growth and diversification of your portfolio.

You will be expected to grow and manage a substantial portfolio, with an annualized gross revenue expectation of $10M+ as your portfolio matures. Success will be measured by sustained revenue growth, retention, client satisfaction, account diversification, and your ability to establish Toptal as a valued partner across increasingly important areas of your clients’ businesses. Toptal’s Consumer Products and Services (CP&S) portfolio serves leading consumer brands and retailers across three segments: Consumer Packaged Goods, Retail and eCommerce, and Hospitality and Consumer Services. Retail and eCommerce is one of our priority growth segments, spanning eCommerce, Traditional Retail, Mass Merchandisers, Grocery and Convenience, and Food Service. Our clients face margin pressure, shifting consumer behavior and the need to turn AI into measurable results. Toptal helps them move faster by combining Professional and Managed Services, backed by top talent and AI-first capabilities.

This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement. You will be expected to spend meaningful time in the field, building executive relationships, uncovering opportunities, and advancing commercial growth. Travel is an integral part of this role, not an occasional requirement. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will own the commercial strategy and growth of assigned enterprise client relationships, serving as a strategic partner who understands each client’s business, identifies emerging needs, and proactively develops opportunities to deliver greater value. You will work across client organizations to uncover challenges, shape solutions, and expand Toptal’s role in helping clients achieve their objectives.

This is not a passive account management role. You will be expected to continuously create demand within your accounts, build new relationships, and bring forward ideas that lead to new commercial opportunities. You will have strong partners across Toptal, but you will be personally accountable for driving growth and advancing the commercial relationship.

Understand your clients’ businesses. Develop a deep understanding of client strategies, operating models, industry dynamics, competitive pressures, and emerging priorities. Ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and identify business problems and opportunities where Toptal can deliver meaningful value.

Proactively shape solutions. Bring thoughtful ideas and recommendations to clients, working with Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams to develop differentiated, commercially viable solutions that address their challenges and create measurable business outcomes.

Own portfolio growth and commercial performance. Take direct accountability for revenue growth, retention, expansion, diversification, and the overall commercial health of your assigned client portfolio. Set ambitious growth objectives and execute with the discipline and urgency required to achieve them.

Hunt for opportunities within existing clients. Identify unmet needs, new initiatives, and emerging challenges across business units and functions. Create demand, develop opportunities, and convert those opportunities into new engagements and revenue rather than relying on existing business to sustain performance.

Expand and diversify client relationships. Build relationships across business units, geographies, functions, and executive stakeholders, reducing dependence on individual buyers, engagements, or service offerings.

Lead ongoing commercial engagements. Own renewals, extensions, ancillary agreements, and all subsequent commercial opportunities following the initial new-client signing, including opportunity development, solution positioning, pricing, negotiation, contracting, and close. Build trusted executive partnerships. Establish credibility with senior business and technology leaders through informed perspectives, sound judgment, and a genuine understanding of their priorities. Become a partner clients turn to when navigating important business decisions.

Develop and execute strategic account plans. Build actionable growth strategies informed by client priorities, competitive positioning, whitespace opportunities, buying centers, and long-term revenue potential. Translate those strategies into specific actions, measurable objectives, and commercial results.

Connect client challenges to Toptal’s capabilities. Identify opportunities to bring together technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent in ways that address client needs and broaden the value of our relationships.

Own commercial client health and retention. Maintain a clear understanding of client satisfaction, relationship strength, delivery performance, and emerging risks. Partner proactively with Client Management and Delivery teams to address concerns, protect revenue, and strengthen long-term relationships. Take ownership of the commercial relationship without assuming responsibility for day-to-day delivery execution.

Collaborate across client teams. Work closely with other Client Partners, Industry GMs, Sales Leaders, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Client Management, and Delivery teams to share insights, coordinate account strategies, and develop solutions across complex client organizations. Where multiple Client Partners support an account, operate within clearly defined commercial ownership and a coordinated account strategy.

Lead complex expansion pursuits. Bring together the right expertise to develop compelling proposals, navigate enterprise buying processes, negotiate commercial terms, and close new business within existing accounts.

Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence. Own expansion pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, account planning, and visibility into commercial opportunities and risks. Make informed decisions, maintain momentum, and take accountability for the quality of your execution. Set a high standard for performance and execution. Operate with urgency, preparation, and personal accountability. Bring thoughtful perspectives to client conversations, follow through on commitments, and continuously look for ways to improve client outcomes and commercial performance. Take ownership of challenges, work across teams to solve them, and hold yourself accountable for delivering measurable results.

Represent the voice of the client. Bring client feedback, emerging needs, and market insights into Toptal to help inform our solutions, capabilities, and overall client experience.

We are looking for Client Partners who are genuinely interested in how businesses work, why challenges exist, and how they can be solved. The strongest performers will consistently turn that curiosity into new ideas, stronger relationships, and meaningful commercial growth.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal and develop a strong understanding of our business model, value proposition, capabilities, and expectations for performance.
  • Familiarize yourself with our commercial operating model, account ownership principles, and client engagement processes.
  • Meet the Industry, Practice, Pursuits, Client Management, and Delivery leaders who will support your success.
  • Understand our approach to account planning, opportunity management, forecasting, and commercial execution.
  • Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and renewal processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop a strong understanding of your assigned client portfolio, including business priorities, active engagements, executive relationships, current revenue, and growth potential.
  • Begin engaging client stakeholders to understand their strategic objectives, operating challenges, and emerging priorities.
  • Work with your Industry GM or Sales Leader to develop account strategies and identify priority opportunities for growth.
  • Assess account health, renewal exposure, concentration risks, and opportunities to expand into new business units or service offerings.
  • Establish a regular operating cadence with Client Management and Delivery teams to understand engagement performance, client feedback, and potential growth signals.
  • Begin identifying business problems and opportunities where Toptal’s broader capabilities could deliver additional value.
  • Establish clear priorities and a disciplined operating rhythm that supports proactive client engagement and commercial execution.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Establish credibility with senior client stakeholders through informed, consultative conversations tied to their business priorities.
  • Develop actionable account growth plans that connect client needs and strategic initiatives to specific commercial opportunities.
  • Proactively bring new ideas and potential solutions to clients, collaborating with internal experts to shape compelling approaches.
  • Build and advance a qualified pipeline of expansion opportunities across your assigned portfolio.
  • Lead renewals, extensions, and additional commercial engagements with sound judgment and clear accountability.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of client satisfaction, commercial risks, and opportunities to strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Establish effective collaboration with other Client Partners and cross-functional teams supporting shared or complex accounts.
  • Demonstrate ownership of your commercial objectives through consistent execution, accurate forecasting, and measurable progress against your growth plan.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable portfolio growth through new opportunities, expanded relationships, and additional commercial engagements.
  • Develop a deeper understanding of client business challenges and translate that knowledge into proactive, solutions-led commercial pursuits.
  • Expand executive relationships and increase Toptal’s presence across business units, geographies, and service offerings.
  • Introduce new capabilities and solutions that address emerging client priorities and create additional sources of revenue.
  • Proactively identify and address client satisfaction and retention risks in partnership with Client Management and Delivery.
  • Successfully lead renewals, extensions, and complex expansion opportunities through negotiation and close.
  • Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline and accurate portfolio forecast.
  • Demonstrate consistent progress against ambitious growth objectives, with clear evidence of personal initiative, commercial judgment, and disciplined execution.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver sustained revenue growth and retention across your assigned client portfolio, progressing toward or maintaining a $10M+ annualized gross revenue expectation.
  • Establish deeper, more diversified client partnerships with broader executive engagement and increased strategic relevance.
  • Demonstrate a strong track record of identifying client challenges, proactively shaping solutions, and converting those solutions into new commercial engagements.
  • Expand Toptal’s presence across client organizations through new buying centers, capabilities, and strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain strong client satisfaction and proactively manage risks that could affect retention or growth.
  • Build a repeatable approach to account planning, opportunity development, and solutions-led commercial execution.
  • Be recognized for your ability to combine thoughtful client engagement with commercial ambition, strong execution, and measurable results.
  • Contribute to broader team success through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7–10+ years of experience in enterprise client development, strategic account growth, consulting, or professional services, ideally within technology services, management consulting, or managed services.
  • Demonstrated success growing complex enterprise relationships through a combination of consultative selling, proactive opportunity creation, and strategic account development.
  • Experience managing substantial enterprise client portfolios, ideally with annualized revenue of $5M–$10M+.
  • Strong business acumen and intellectual curiosity, with a demonstrated ability to understand complex client challenges, ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and develop commercially viable approaches to solving them.
  • Proven ability to identify emerging client needs, shape solutions, and create opportunities beyond existing engagements or stated requirements.
  • Experience expanding enterprise relationships across multiple business units, executive stakeholders, geographies, and service offerings.
  • Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives on business strategy, operating challenges, emerging technologies, and industry trends.
  • Demonstrated success originating and closing complex expansion opportunities, including technology, consulting, and managed services engagements.
  • Experience negotiating renewals, extensions, complex service agreements, and additional commercial engagements with enterprise procurement and legal teams.
  • Strong understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and the ability to connect new capabilities to practical client business needs.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans that identify whitespace, deepen relationships, and drive sustained commercial growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify client satisfaction risks, navigate difficult conversations, and strengthen long-term commercial relationships.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to develop solutions, shape proposals, and advance complex opportunities.
  • Ability to work effectively in shared or coordinated account coverage models, balancing individual commercial accountability with broader client and company objectives.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity prioritization, and account-level revenue planning.
  • A demonstrated commitment to high performance, with the initiative, discipline, and personal accountability to consistently deliver against ambitious commercial objectives.
  • Entrepreneurial drive, creative problem-solving, resilience, and a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing opportunities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and build trusted relationships.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for client meetings, executive engagement, and industry events.
  • Broad experience working with consumer and retail organizations, with a practical understanding of how these businesses operate, the top challenges they face, and how to serve them effectively. Concentrated experience in one or more of our priority sub-segments, such as eCommerce, Traditional Retail, Mass Merchandisers, Grocery and Convenience, or Food Service, is highly preferred.
  • Established executive relationships across retail and consumer brands, including business leaders in digital, merchandising, marketing and supply chain as well as technology leaders.
  • Working knowledge of the retail technology landscape, including commerce platforms, order management, retail data and personalization, and emerging agentic commerce capabilities.
  • A builder’s mindset with a track record of creating something from the ground up, such as a new practice, segment, offering or go-to-market motion, rather than only inheriting and maintaining an existing book.
  • Hands-on ability to shape and personally drive solutions, not only facilitate workshops or coordinate others.

We are looking for Client Partners who bring the curiosity of a consultant, the instincts of a business developer, and the accountability of a business owner. People who see beyond the current engagement, recognize opportunities others might miss, and have the conviction and commercial skill to turn those opportunities into results. You should be energized by ambitious goals, motivated by meaningful client impact, and committed to continually raising the standard of your own performance.   • Work independently with minimal supervision.

Job Summary:

At Workit Health, Medical Assistants (MAs) work in a fast-paced virtual clinic model. The dedication our team members bring to the table reflects our mission-driven culture of making the gold standard of care for addiction more accessible through harm reduction, trauma-informed, low barrier care along with patient-centered support.

  • Communicating and providing support to members over chat, email, and phone using exceptional customer service.
  • Relaying member needs to providers.
  • Corresponding with pharmacies and completing prior authorizations to resolve prescription issues.
  • Maintaining strict confidentiality when handling member information in compliance with Workit Health, HIPAA, and 42 CFR Part 2 guidelines.

  • Active National Medical Assistant Certification required
  • Passionate about providing stellar internal and external customer service and working with diverse populations including Workit staff, members, family members, and vendors.
  • Strong analytical ability.
  • One or more years of healthcare experience and knowledge of medical terminology is preferred.
  • Comfortable asking for support, help, and guidance as needed.
  • Experience in substance use disorder treatment and/or behavioral health care is a plus.
Pay range
$25—$25 USD

Why Workit:

Workit Health is an industry-leading provider of on-demand, evidence-based telemedicine care. Our programs are based in harm reduction, and bring together licensed clinicians who really listen, FDA-approved medication, online recovery groups and community, interactive therapeutic courses, and care for co-existing conditions. Workit Health's patient-centered telemedicine model is improving clinical outcomes and eliminating barriers to treatment, making long-term recovery accessible to individuals who need it, without disrupting their daily lives.

We’re excited to expand our team as our impact and coverage areas continue to grow. Our team members are dedicated and passionate about our mission of making exceptional, judgment-free care for addiction more accessible.

We believe everyone deserves respectful, effective treatment for substance use disorder at the moment they're ready for it. We're looking for driven and compassionate individuals who share this goal. Join us in reducing stigma, saving lives, and changing the way addiction is treated in America.

Remote (St. Louis, MO area)

You’ll call these clients, set appointments, and meet virtually to help them find the best insurance plan for their needs and budget. Some agents even start part-time and transition to full-time.

A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.

Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.

Handle customer inquiries and resolve complaints.

Participate in regular Zoom training sessions.

Previous experience in sales, customer service, or a related field is a plus.

Familiarity with CRM platforms is helpful.

You know how to build rapport and trust with clients.

You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.

We’re seeking individuals who are ambitious, coachable, passionate about helping others, and driven to achieve greatness. If you’re ready to take control of your future and create a career you can be proud of, we’d love to connect.

This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.

Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Ready to Build Your Future with Us?

If you're ready to make a difference—not just in your own life, but in the lives of others—apply today. We can’t wait to see how you define success.

  • Provide support for the accounting and controls team through data gathering and reporting.

  • Collaborate with team members on financial data research and visualization efforts to inform strategic business decisions.

  • Support the continued modernization and automation of customer purchasing and invoicing systems.

  • Exercise substantial personal responsibility and autonomy.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree—in finance, marketing, or business preferred.

  • 2+ years of experience in finance or marketing technology.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager, AI & Data to develop product positioning, execute go-to-market initiatives, and help customers understand Bask Health's AI-enabled capabilities, data intelligence tools, and technical platform features.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

As a Technical Product Marketing Manager, you'll help translate complex AI and data functionality into clear, accurate messaging that communicates what our products do and how customers can use them.

You'll work closely with product managers, software engineers, AI engineers, data stakeholders, sales, customer success, and company leadership to develop customer-facing product communications.

This role requires someone who is comfortable learning technical software, asking detailed questions, and understanding how product features work beyond their marketing descriptions.

You'll develop messaging for AI-enabled experiences, data intelligence capabilities, analytics tools, workflow automation, and related platform functionality.

You'll help prospective and existing customers understand how these tools can support business operations, improve access to information, and simplify repetitive workflows.

You'll also support positioning for new AI and data features as they are developed and introduced to customers.

A major part of this role will involve communicating technical product value without overstating what AI systems can reliably accomplish.

You'll collaborate with engineers and product teams to understand feature functionality, supported use cases, technical requirements, and limitations.

You'll help explain how AI-enabled tools work, what customers should expect from them, and where human review or additional verification may be necessary.

You'll conduct customer research to understand how businesses evaluate AI-powered software and data products.

You'll explore customer concerns related to accuracy, reliability, usability, implementation, and the practical value of AI and analytics tools.

You'll use those insights to improve product messaging and develop customer education materials.

You'll help coordinate technical product launches, prepare launch briefs, and ensure internal teams have accurate information about new capabilities.

You'll develop technical product overviews, sales presentations, feature descriptions, demonstrations, and other customer-facing resources.

You'll partner with sales teams to understand the technical questions and objections customers raise when evaluating AI and data products.

You'll use that feedback to create enablement materials that support more effective product conversations.

You'll also collaborate with customer success teams to help customers understand and adopt new AI and analytics capabilities.

You'll research competing AI-enabled SaaS platforms, business intelligence tools, and workflow automation products to identify opportunities for differentiation.

You'll help maintain consistent technical terminology across product marketing materials and customer communications.

Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll work with appropriate internal reviewers when product messaging touches clinical, patient, pharmacy, or compliance-sensitive workflows.

You'll support the measurement of product marketing effectiveness through launch outcomes, customer feedback, feature adoption, and relevant engagement metrics.

We're looking for someone who combines technical curiosity, strong writing skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently execute product marketing projects in a rapidly evolving software environment.

What You'll Do

  • Develop positioning and messaging for Bask Health's AI and data capabilities.
  • Translate technical AI and analytics functionality into clear customer benefits.
  • Create messaging frameworks and value propositions for technical products.
  • Support go-to-market planning for AI-enabled and data-related features.
  • Coordinate technical product launch activities across internal teams.
  • Partner with product managers to understand feature functionality and customer needs.
  • Collaborate with AI engineers to validate technical product information.
  • Work with data stakeholders to understand analytics capabilities and supported use cases.
  • Develop messaging for AI-powered product experiences and workflow automation.
  • Support positioning for business intelligence and data exploration capabilities.
  • Create customer-facing explanations of AI functionality, limitations, and appropriate use cases.
  • Develop messaging for conversational analytics capabilities, including BaskQL where applicable.
  • Conduct customer research to understand AI adoption needs and technical concerns.
  • Gather customer insights from sales and customer success teams.
  • Research competing AI-enabled SaaS platforms and analytics products.
  • Maintain competitive positioning and technical differentiation materials.
  • Develop technical product presentations, feature overviews, and sales enablement resources.
  • Create messaging that addresses common technical questions and objections.
  • Support website and landing page content for AI and data capabilities.
  • Partner with customer success teams on technical product education and adoption.
  • Develop tutorials and educational materials for new AI and analytics features.
  • Support customer onboarding communications for relevant technical capabilities.
  • Coordinate technical reviews of customer-facing product claims.
  • Help maintain consistent AI and data terminology across communications.
  • Track product launch deliverables and coordinate stakeholder feedback.
  • Help define and measure technical product marketing performance indicators.
  • Analyze customer feedback and feature adoption trends.
  • Recommend improvements to technical product messaging and educational materials.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in product marketing, preferably within B2B SaaS, AI software, analytics platforms, or technical technology companies.
  • Experience developing positioning and messaging for technical software products.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market planning and product launches.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS products and customer journeys.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled software and common technical limitations.
  • Familiarity with analytics, data intelligence, or workflow automation products.
  • Ability to learn complex technical functionality and explain it clearly.
  • Experience creating technical product marketing and sales enablement materials.
  • Strong written communication and technical storytelling skills.
  • Experience conducting customer or market research.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and technical purchasing considerations.
  • Familiarity with competitive research and product differentiation.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers and engineers.
  • Ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering with sales or customer success teams.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines.
  • Experience developing customer-facing technical product materials.
  • Familiarity with product onboarding and adoption concepts.
  • Ability to incorporate customer feedback into messaging improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate technical communication.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a rapidly evolving software environment.

Nice to Have

  • Product marketing experience at an AI or machine learning software company.
  • Experience marketing analytics or business intelligence products.
  • Familiarity with large language models and generative AI applications.
  • Understanding of AI agents and workflow automation.
  • Experience positioning conversational analytics or natural-language data tools.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and AI-assisted search.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation, reliability, and quality considerations.
  • Experience working with APIs and technical integrations.

  • Familiarity with operational analytics and merchant intelligence tools.
  • Experience marketing white-label or embedded software products.
  • Experience supporting technical product launches in growing companies.

Solo.io is reimagining infrastructure for cloud and AI. We unite secure, seamless cloud connectivity with AI-ready, agentic infrastructure, and leading enterprises worldwide trust us to securely connect their applications, services, and AI workloads across any environment.

About the role.

Solo.io is hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to drive pipeline across our Central and West regions. You'll be the main Marketing partner for regional Sales. That means deciding which accounts and audiences to reach, building the programs that engage them, and making sure engagement turns into pipeline.

The role combines ABM, field and community events, and sales activation. One week you might run an executive dinner; the next, a developer meetup, an ABM campaign for named accounts, or the plan for a major industry event. You'll work closely with Sales, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and the open-source community teams.

This role may require occasional travel. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Solo does not provide sponsorships at this time.

Own regional growth

  • Work with Central and West Sales leaders and AEs to build regional plans tied to pipeline goals, priority accounts, and territory whitespace.

Run account-based programs
