Lead field and community programs

Measure and optimize

  • Report on account engagement, pipeline created and influenced, and how far opportunities progress.
  • Keep the regional calendar, budget, and results visible to Sales and Marketing leadership.

Job Requirements:

  • 4–7+ years in B2B growth, demand generation, field marketing, or ABM, ideally in enterprise tech or SaaS.

The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Marketing Operations Manager runs Marketo as the core marketing automation platform, optimizes the marketing technology stack, data governance and campaign execution across the organization, and owns CaPDB, Versaterm's competitive and market intelligence data in Salesforce. This role ensures that marketing systems, workflows and reporting are efficient, scalable and aligned with the company's go-to-market strategy. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing and Analytics to strengthen data integrity and turn account intelligence into targeted campaigns and pipeline.

In addition, this role provides day-to-day guidance and support to junior team members, helping to prioritize work, share best practices and foster team development.

What You Do

CaPDB Data Ownership and Market Intelligence (new)

  • Own CaPDB end to end as the named data owner: data standards, quality, refresh cadence and documentation.
  • Define and publish what "complete" means for a strategic account, including confirmed CAD and RMS product (not just vendor family), contract start and end dates, satisfaction, key contacts and last verified date.
  • Build and maintain the weekly Salesforce completeness report by tier, account owner and field, and review it with Sales leadership.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Salesforce Admin on field cleanup, picklists, vendor mapping, duplicate accounts and data loads.
  • Plan and run data enrichment programs, including vendor and outsourced calling partners, Gong and rep-sourced intel, and automated purchase and contract data sources. Set scope, scripts and quality checks, and review output on a regular schedule.
  • Maintain the renewal and competitive view of the account base so Growth Marketing can time Marketo campaigns to contract end dates.
  • Work with Sales leadership and account owners on a clear split of who confirms and updates which fields, and report ownership gaps.
  • Support Product Marketing and Growth Marketing with segmented lists for competitor, renewal and product-gap campaigns.

Funnel Operations and Optimization

  • Design and implement lead scoring, routing and lifecycle stage definitions in Marketo and Salesforce in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Maintain and enforce SLA compliance across MQL, SAL and SQL handoffs.
  • Identify bottlenecks and conversion gaps across the funnel and propose data-driven solutions.
  • Provide guidance to team members on funnel management best practices and support execution consistency.

Marketing Systems Ownership

  • Act as the Marketo power user and platform owner: manage programs, channels, templates, smart lists, tokens and scoring, and keep the Marketo-Salesforce sync reliable.
  • Sync CaPDB account, competitor, product and renewal fields from Salesforce into Marketo so we can segment audiences and trigger campaigns by competitor, product gap and contract end date.
  • Collaborate with the GTM Systems team on system enhancements and architecture scalability.
  • Evaluate new tools and platforms to support account-based marketing, campaign automation and customer engagement.
  • Offer support and informal coaching to team members on system usage and troubleshooting.

Data Governance, Attribution and Reporting

  • Ensure marketing data quality, campaign attribution and lead-source tracking are accurate and reliable.
  • Partner with Analytics to build dashboards that measure pipeline contribution, channel ROI and marketing effectiveness, including CaPDB coverage and pipeline influenced by account intelligence.
  • Support data audits, segmentation strategies and compliance reporting.
  • Review team outputs for accuracy and consistency, providing feedback as needed.

Campaign Execution Enablement

  • Define best practices, templates and workflows to standardize campaign operations.
  • Conduct QA testing for all outbound marketing programs, including Marketo email, nurture and renewal campaigns.
  • Provide training and support to campaign managers and content marketers.
  • Act as a go-to resource for team members, helping to unblock issues and ensure smooth execution.

Program and Change Management

  • Lead cross-functional projects (for example tech rollouts, compliance updates and operational audits).
  • Develop documentation and training resources for new processes or tools, including the CaPDB playbook.
  • Monitor KPIs and iterate on strategies to drive continuous improvement.
  • Help coordinate project work across the team, ensuring clear ownership and timely delivery of key tasks.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation or revenue operations roles within a B2B SaaS or technology environment, with some prior experience providing mentorship, guidance or informal leadership.
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM, including custom objects, reports, dashboards, data loads and field and picklist management, and with Marketo, including programs, smart lists, scoring, tokens and the Marketo-Salesforce sync.
  • Proven experience owning data quality: defining standards, measuring completeness, cleaning and deduplicating records, and getting other teams to maintain data.
  • Experience managing outside vendors or outsourced data programs, including scoping, quality checks and performance review.
  • Strong understanding of lead management processes, funnel metrics and campaign attribution models.
  • Experience with data management, reporting and visualization tools (for example Tableau, Power BI or Salesforce dashboards).
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, including Sales leadership and Revenue Operations.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a focus on process improvement and operational excellence.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights.
  • Experience in account-based marketing (ABM) and revenue attribution frameworks is an asset.
  • Experience with competitive intelligence, public sector or public safety technology markets, or contract and renewal data is an asset.
  • Experience providing informal mentorship, guidance or onboarding support to junior team members or peers.
  • Comfortable offering feedback, sharing best practices and helping to coordinate work across team members when needed.

Note: This position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. jobs.description:
Prominence Advisors is actively seeking a Senior Epic Dorothy/Comfort Consultant (Home Health & Hospice) to join our team.

Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare and life sciences technology and consulting firm dedicated to helping leading organizations do more with their data. With deep expertise across the full ecosystem — spanning providers, payers, and life sciences — we turn complex data into actionable insight.

We deliver a full spectrum of services, including advisory, analytics, optimization, and IT staffing. Our work helps organizations operate more efficiently, improve patient outcomes, and deliver measurable financial impact through smarter use of data. Recognized as a 2x Best in KLAS organization, we partner with more than 120 health systems and 40 life sciences organizations, including 7 of the top 10 U.S. News & World Report-ranked institutions.

Through our life sciences brands, Tegra Analytics and WLH Consulting & Learning Solutions, we extend these capabilities to pharmaceutical and biotech organizations — combining data, consulting, and learning to advance commercial excellence.

By connecting strategy, data, and execution, we help organizations translate data into clarity, strategy into action, and vision into measurable results. At our core, we are a people-first, values-driven organization that believes strong teams and trusted partnerships are what ultimately make healthcare and life sciences smarter.

Job Summary

Prominence is looking for a Senior Epic Dorothy/Comfort Consultant with deep experience in Epic Home Health (Dorothy) and Epic Hospice (Comfort) to lead a current-state assessment and gap analysis for one of the nation's leading health systems. This role will evaluate how Dorothy and Comfort are built and used day to day, compare the current state against Epic Foundation System design and industry best practice, and deliver a prioritized roadmap of optimization opportunities. Helping our customers get more value from their Epic investment by uncovering unused functionality, workflow gaps, and practical next steps that improve clinician experience, operational efficiency, compliance, and financial performance.

  • Lead a structured current-state assessment of Epic Dorothy and Epic Comfort, including review of build and workflow documentation, policies and procedures, open tickets and enhancement requests, operational KPIs, and known pain points.
  • Facilitate virtual stakeholder interviews with home health and hospice leadership, intake, scheduling, field clinicians, the hospice interdisciplinary team (IDT), revenue cycle, and IS application teams.
  • Conduct screen-share workflow walkthroughs with frontline users to understand how the applications are used in practice.
  • Review system build against Epic Foundation System design, identifying licensed but unused functionality and Epic release adoption gaps.
  • Document handoff points and workflow impacts between Epic and adjacent third-party systems, such as workforce and time and attendance platforms.
  • Catalog gaps by workflow area and score each by impact (operational, financial, clinician experience, and compliance risk) and effort to resolve.
  • Lead validation working sessions with client project leadership and key stakeholders to confirm findings.
  • Build a prioritized next-steps action list organized into quick wins, near-term (~90-day), and longer-term strategic items, with a suggested owner for each (IS, operations, Epic, or partner).
  • Help define follow-on remediation options and scope to inform future phases of work.
  • Prepare and deliver an executive readout that translates findings into clear, actionable recommendations for clinical, operational, and IS leaders.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Epic Dorothy (Home Health) and Epic Comfort (Hospice), including build, implementation, optimization, or application support.
  • Current Epic certification or proficiency in Dorothy and/or Comfort.
  • Deep working knowledge of Epic Foundation System design and Epic-recommended workflows for home health and hospice.
  • Demonstrated experience leading current-state assessments, gap analyses, or optimization reviews of Epic applications.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end home health and hospice operations, including referral and intake, scheduling, field clinician documentation, plan of care, hospice IDT, and billing.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder interviews and workflow walkthroughs with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and IS audiences.
  • Ability to evaluate findings by impact and effort and turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to develop and deliver executive-level presentations to non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to work independently and deliver results in a fully remote consulting environment.

Desired Qualifications

  • Prior consulting experience delivering Epic assessments or optimization engagements across multiple health systems.
  • Knowledge of home health and hospice regulatory and compliance requirements, such as CMS Conditions of Participation, OASIS, PDGM, HOPE, and hospice benefit periods.
  • Familiarity with home health and hospice revenue cycle workflows in Epic, including billing and claims.
  • Experience with Epic integrations and handoffs to third-party workforce management or time and attendance systems (e.g., Infor).
  • Knowledge of recent Epic releases and new Dorothy and Comfort functionality, with experience driving release adoption.
  • Experience defining remediation scope, estimates, or phased roadmaps to support follow-on project planning.
  • Familiarity with Epic reporting tools (Reporting Workbench, Radar, SlicerDicer) to identify reporting gaps.
  • Clinical background (e.g., RN, PT, OT, SLP, or MSW) in a home health or hospice setting.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Professional: Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism by treating others with respect, keeping commitments, building trust within the team, working with integrity, and upholding organizational values (“Do Great Work and Move Mountains”).
  • Organized: Capable of managing a fast-paced, time-boxed assessment across multiple workflow areas, stakeholder groups, and deliverables, ensuring smooth project flow.
  • Self-Motivated: Adept at independently driving an engagement from kickoff to executive readout, meeting milestone deadlines, and monitoring work quality with minimal oversight.
  • Highly Adaptable: Quickly acclimates to a new client environment, an unfamiliar build, and diverse clinical and operational teams.
  • Analytical: Objectively evaluates build and workflows against best practice, getting to root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Consultative: Builds credibility quickly with clinicians, operational leaders, and IS teams; asks the right questions and listens to understand.
  • Communication: Effectively conveys clear and concise messages that resonate with audiences ranging from frontline clinicians to executive sponsors, both in written and verbal forms.
  • Proactive: Anticipates potential issues, such as access delays or stakeholder availability, addresses concerns before they escalate, and effectively raises them when necessary.
  • Team-Oriented: Collaborates closely with Prominence Epic subject matter advisors and client project leadership, and thrives in a team-based environment.

Hours Worked

This role is part of our active pipeline for upcoming client engagements and is contingent on project availability, with timing aligned to client demand.

Benefits

Prominence is dedicated to hiring the best and brightest minds in healthcare and maintaining a culture that rewards our employees for following their passion. We are excited to offer the following benefits for this position:

  • Competitive Salaried and Hybrid Compensation Plans
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, HSAs, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Dependent & Health Savings Accounts
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation/Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Training & Development Fund
  • Work From Home
  • Charitable Giving to Causes You Believe In

Employment Eligibility

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

The world’s most talented professionals come from every background. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, veteran or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, Prominence will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

Partnership Eligibility

Our partnerships are extremely important to us. This online application is not intended for anyone who is currently under a non-compete agreement or has an arrangement that precludes employment at Prominence. We appreciate your help in respecting our partners.

EverPro - Software Development Engineer in Test, Joist – REMOTE (Canada)

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.


We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, to focus on our Joist product. Joist, an EverCommerce solution group and member of the EverPro suite of products, is an end-to-end vertical software platform for small & medium-sized trades contractors. We have a simple mission: Make Contractors Heroes. Joist provides web and mobile applications for small business contractors to estimate, invoice, record, and process payments, and manage projects from anywhere. From humble beginnings, we're now helping over 1 million contractors across North America, the UK, and Australia, making us one of the largest trades platforms in the world, and we have major growth planned!


Responsibilities:

You are someone who cares deeply about quality and providing the best possible customer experience. You derive satisfaction from automating processes and reducing toil for yourself and others. You will contribute to solutions from inception to deployment, and everything in between. The solutions you and your team build must not only work for Joist today, but also support rapid iteration and innovation as we grow. Your work is going to be nothing less than redefining the home services industry, and your tool belt is full of tools that assist with software delivery, testing, automation, and more.

Providing a Testing Mindset: You understand that quality is not owned by one person, but by the entire team. You are able to grow skills in quality control in the people around you and provide feedback on how to improve as a team.

Automation: As an engineer, you know the power that automated processes can bring to help teams ship with confidence. You will lead efforts to build and contribute to various testing and release automation frameworks that enable our teams to move quickly. You build tools and maintain frameworks, not just tests.

Teamwork: Many of the problems we encounter require insight from many parts of the business. Your ability to coordinate and communicate with your peers is essential to our success.

Fast Feedback Loop: You thrive in fast release cycles and help speed up the feedback loop from code change to confident release.

AI and Agentic Quality: You use AI and agentic workflows (e.g., Claude) in quality and software development.

Passion: Hard problems are not solved overnight. It takes a special kind of attitude and hunger to disrupt an entrenched industry. Your passion is what you share with every teammate at Joist. Passion for technology, passion for working as a team, passion for change, and passion for building an industry revolutionizing product.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5 to 7 years of professional industry experience working in SDET roles with agile product development teams
  • Experience with modern testing tools and frameworks, including BrowserStack, WebdriverIO, Appium, Playwright, and more. Skilled in full-stack test automation across Web, Mobile, and API layers, with a focus on building scalable and reliable quality solutions.
  • Knowledge or understanding of iOS, Android ecosystem
  • Automation mindset: you build tools and maintain frameworks, not only write tests
  • Hands-on experience with agentic and AI tools in software development, such as Claude, codex etc
  • Experience working in fast release cycles
  • Significant experience in performing detailed root cause analysis up and down the software stack using a variety of debugging tools
  • The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about deeply technical topics in an easy-to-understand way
  • Ability to unblock themselves and others by asking the right questions and effectively collaborating with all stakeholders (Product, Design, Customer Support, and others)
  • You can deal with ambiguity and are experienced in helping to generate refined acceptance criteria for development work

Nice to have's:

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code for use in cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Heroku or GCP
  • Experience doing Accessibility testing
  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or in a similar field. While not a requirement, it helps to have a common baseline of understanding of CS principles when working with other technical people.

Where:
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Robust wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • Flexible time off
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with 4% company match

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $100,000 to $120,000 CAD per year. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

At FutureLearn, part of Global University Systems (GUS), we’re passionate about the power of lifelong learning. We help learners from all over the world progress in their careers – and invest in their futures.

We’re not here just to teach new skills (although we do that well), we want to help transform lives. FutureLearn is looking to build our teams with people who share our passion for lifelong learning, career empowerment and education for all. If that sounds like you, get in touch. You could help us achieve our biggest goal yet – becoming the world’s best AI-powered, career-based learning platform and OPM.

What’s the opportunity?

The Admissions Officer is responsible for the accurate and timely processing and assessment of student applications, ensuring that applicants meet the relevant academic, admissions and eligibility requirements before an admissions decision is made.

The role will primarily support postgraduate admissions, including the assessment of UK and international applications, verification of academic and supporting documentation, assessment of fee status where applicable, and accurate maintenance of student records.

This is an administrative and decision-making role within a fast-paced Higher Education environment, where strong attention to detail, sound judgement, regulatory awareness and effective collaboration are essential.

You will be expected to apply established institutional policies and admissions criteria consistently, identify discrepancies or potential issues, and escalate complex or exceptional cases appropriately.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Reporting regularly to the Admissions Manager and providing clear updates on delegated tasks, workload and application volumes.

  • Processing and assessing postgraduate applications in line with institutional admissions policies, programme entry requirements and agreed procedures.

  • Reviewing academic qualifications, professional experience and supporting documentation to determine whether applicants meet the relevant admission criteria.

  • Assessing applications from both UK and international applicants, including reviewing overseas qualifications and relevant supporting evidence.

  • Checking applications for completeness, accuracy and consistency, identifying discrepancies, missing information or potential concerns and taking appropriate action.

  • Making admissions decisions within delegated authority and established guidelines, including issuing appropriate offers or escalating cases requiring further consideration.

  • Applying academic, English-language and other programme-specific entry requirements consistently.

  • Verifying and authenticating official academic and identity documentation in accordance with established procedures.

  • Assessing UK fee status where required and applying the relevant Home/Overseas fee-status criteria and institutional procedures.

  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of Higher Education fee assessment regulations in England, including relevant UKCISA guidance and applicable government regulations.

  • Ensuring that all application and student information is recorded accurately and promptly within the relevant Student Records System, CRM and/or admissions platforms.

  • Maintaining accurate electronic student records and ensuring that appropriate supporting documentation is retained in accordance with institutional policies and GDPR requirements.

  • Managing a caseload of applications effectively, prioritising work according to deadlines, intake dates and business requirements.

  • Identifying recurring issues, process gaps or data-quality problems and escalating these to the Admissions Manager.

  • Collaborating closely with Student Recruitment, Student Support, Awards, Finance, Compliance and other relevant teams to ensure an efficient and consistent admissions process.

  • Maintaining and continuously developing knowledge of admissions policies, programme requirements, institutional procedures and relevant UK Higher Education regulations.

  • Contributing to process improvements designed to increase efficiency, accuracy, compliance and the overall applicant experience.

  • Supporting audits, quality assurance activities and internal reviews of admissions processes where required.

  • Handling confidential applicant and student information appropriately and in accordance with GDPR, data protection and institutional policies.

Essential skills, knowledge and experience

  • Demonstrable previous experience in a Higher Education Admissions role, with specific experience of postgraduate admissions.

Vice President of Business Development, Clinical Research | Remote, USA Panoramic Science | Powered by Panoramic Health About Panoramic Science Panoramic Science is the clinical research division of Panoramic Health, a physician-led healthcare organization committed to advancing patient care through innovative clinical research. Our growing, multi-site research network partners with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and contract research organizations (CROs) to conduct industry-sponsored clinical trials and advance treatments across cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic (CVRM) therapeutic areas. We are building a high-performing, scalable clinical research network focused on strong site execution, strategic industry partnerships, and data-driven growth. Position Overview Panoramic Science is seeking a strategic, commercially driven Vice President of Business Development, Clinical Research to lead enterprise-wide commercial strategy and accelerate growth across our multi-site clinical research network. As a member of the Panoramic Science leadership team, the Vice President will own the commercial vision and be accountable for network-wide study awards, bookings, revenue growth, and long-term enterprise value. This executive will lead the development of strategic sponsor and CRO partnerships, expand portfolio-level relationships, and build a high-performing business development function that drives sustainable growth across the network. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in clinical research business development, established executive-level relationships across biopharmaceutical companies and CROs, and a demonstrated ability to translate commercial strategy into measurable financial results. This leader will also bring a rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, performance optimization, and executive reporting. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Commercial Strategy & Growth

Develop and own the multi-year commercial strategy and annual growth plan for the clinical research network, aligned with organizational priorities and long-term value creation. Drive accountability for network-wide bookings, study awards, and revenue growth, including repeat business and strategic partnerships across all sites. Establish commercial priorities across sponsors, CROs, therapeutic areas, and clinical trial programs based on revenue potential, strategic alignment, and operational feasibility. Identify new market opportunities, therapeutic areas, and capabilities that support network expansion and long-term commercial growth. Partner with the President and executive leadership team on budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and long-range business planning.

Strategic Partnerships & Market Positioning

Own senior executive relationships with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CRO partners, serving as the network's primary commercial representative. Originate, negotiate, and secure portfolio-level partnerships, preferred site network relationships, and multi-study awards. Strengthen sponsor and CRO engagement to increase study opportunities, improve award conversion, and establish Panoramic Science as a trusted, high-performing research partner. Define and communicate the network's commercial value proposition, leveraging performance data, site capabilities, patient populations, and operational outcomes to differentiate the organization in the marketplace. Represent Panoramic Science in executive sponsor meetings, scientific conferences, and industry forums to expand visibility and strengthen strategic relationships.

Commercial Operations, Analytics & Performance

Establish and oversee the business development operating model, including CRM infrastructure, standardized processes, pipeline management, and commercial performance reporting. Drive enterprise-wide adoption of CRM tools, such as Salesforce, to improve visibility into sponsor engagement, study opportunities, award outcomes, and revenue forecasts. Define and own key business development performance indicators, including pipeline value, win rates, sales cycle times, sponsor concentration, bookings, and revenue forecasts. Use quantitative analysis and market intelligence to optimize sponsor targeting, commercial resource allocation, conversion rates, and overall business development effectiveness. Deliver executive- and board-level reporting that communicates commercial performance, growth trends, risks, and opportunities to support strategic and investment decisions.

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as a key member of the Panoramic Science leadership team, ensuring commercial priorities align with organizational strategy and operational capabilities. Partner with senior leaders across operations, feasibility, finance, regulatory affairs, and site leadership to align study opportunities with site capacity, capabilities, and execution readiness. Translate sponsor and CRO feedback, competitive intelligence, and market trends into actionable operational improvements and strategic investment priorities. Establish standardized business development processes, tools, templates, and playbooks that promote consistency, accountability, and scalability across the network. Foster cross-functional collaboration to improve study award conversion, strengthen sponsor satisfaction, and support long-term partnership growth.

Team Leadership & Development

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing business development team aligned with enterprise growth objectives. Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and accountability measures while coaching team members to improve commercial effectiveness. Develop a culture of disciplined pipeline management, data-driven decision-making, relationship development, and continuous improvement. Ensure business development resources are deployed effectively against the network's highest-value commercial opportunities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 10+ years of progressive experience in clinical research business development, including leadership of commercial strategy within a multi-site research network, academic research organization, or comparable life sciences business. Demonstrated success building and leading business development or commercial teams and contributing to senior-level organizational strategy. Proven track record of owning bookings and revenue targets and driving study awards, portfolio-level partnerships, and sustained revenue growth. Established executive-level relationships with biopharmaceutical companies, pharmaceutical sponsors, and CROs. Deep familiarity with cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic (CVRM) clinical trials and sponsor/CRO decision-making dynamics. Strong expertise in CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, including pipeline management, forecasting, analytics, and performance reporting. Highly analytical and metrics-driven, with the ability to translate commercial data into strategic priorities and measurable business outcomes. Experience presenting commercial performance, growth plans, and forecasts to executive leadership, boards, and/or private equity stakeholders. Excellent executive communication, negotiation, relationship management, and presentation skills. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and scale commercial processes within a growth-oriented organization.

Why Join Panoramic Science?

Shape enterprise growth: Lead the commercial strategy for a growing clinical research network and directly influence its long-term success. Build high-impact partnerships: Develop strategic relationships with leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CRO organizations. Lead at the executive level: Partner with organizational leadership on growth strategy, commercial performance, and investment priorities. Build and develop a high-performing team: Establish the commercial infrastructure, processes, and talent needed to support continued expansion. Advance clinical research: Help expand access to clinical trials across cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic therapeutic areas.

Join Panoramic Science and help shape the next phase of clinical research growth through strategic partnerships, commercial leadership, and a commitment to advancing patient outcomes.

Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Denmark

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Denmark. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

jobs.excerpt: SummaryWe’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead penetration testing across Guidewire’s products.
jobs.description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead penetration testing across Guidewire’s products.

In this role, you’ll shape and run a pen testing program that combines hands-on testing, third-party vendor engagements, and AI-assisted tooling. You’ll ensure every product is tested before release, findings are validated and fixed, and our products meet customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, setting the direction for how security testing scales with the business as a Staff Security Engineer.

As needed, you’ll also support broader Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) activities, such as vulnerability triage and incident coordination.

Job Description

What you’ll do

Primary responsibilities

Penetration testing

  • Plan and perform penetration tests of Guidewire web applications, APIs, cloud services, and integrations to identify critical vulnerabilities before release and in production.
  • Test tenant isolation, cross-tenant data access and authorization boundaries in multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Lead security testing of AI/ML-powered product features, including LLM applications, APIs, and inference endpoints. Identify issues such as prompt injection, data and model leakage, insecure RAG implementations, and abuse vectors.
  • Validate, reproduce and risk-rate findings using industry-standard metrics such as CVSS, and give engineering teams clear, actionable remediation guidance.
  • Retest fixes and confirm closure before findings are marked resolved.
  • Develop pen testing tooling, scripts and automation, and evaluate AI-assisted and autonomous testing tools to scale coverage and repeatability.

Pen testing vendor management

  • Own the pen testing schedule across the product release lifecycle, from early access through general availability (including continuously delivered products), ensuring every product is tested prior to key release milestones.
  • Decide when and how products need testing based on risk, release scope and compliance requirements.
  • Define testing scope, rules of engagement, environments, and access for each vendor engagement.
  • Align product teams, implementation partners and vendors on their pen testing responsibilities, including environment readiness and access.
  • Manage vendor relationships end-to-end: onboarding, statements of work, kickoff, status tracking, quality reviews of reports, and issue escalation.
  • Manage the pen testing budget, including vendor costs, forecasting and utilization.
  • Review vendor reports for accuracy and completeness, remove false positives and consolidate findings into the vulnerability management process.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and coverage, recommending methodology or vendor changes as needed.

Compliance and reporting

  • Ensure pen testing meets compliance obligations for Guidewire products, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and customer contractual requirements.
  • Maintain pen test evidence, attestation letters and executive summaries for auditors and customers.
  • Track remediation of pen test findings against SLAs and report status and risk to product, engineering, and security leadership.
  • Define and report program metrics such as test coverage, on-time completion, finding age, and SLA compliance.
  • Respond to customer security questions about pen testing practices and results.

Secondary responsibilities (as needed)

When PSIRT needs extra capacity, you will support the broader incident response program:

  • Triage internally and externally reported security issues, verify them across product versions, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Coordinate with external security researchers, reporting organizations, and customers on reported vulnerabilities.
  • Support security releases with engineering and sustaining teams, including security-focused code and design reviews.
  • Validate findings from SAST, DAST, SCA and container scanning tools, and help improve PSIRT and vulnerability management processes.

What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of application or product security experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on penetration testing of web applications, APIs, and cloud-hosted services.
  • Proven experience managing third-party pen testing vendors, including scoping, scheduling and report review.
  • Hands-on experience testing applications hosted on AWS, including IAM and multi-tenant architectures.
  • Working knowledge of compliance requirements for pen testing, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.
  • Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and common product vulnerability classes.
  • Hands-on experience with pen testing tools such as Burp Suite, along with SAST, DAST and vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Experience risk-rating vulnerabilities with CVSS.
  • Scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar) to build testing tools and automation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear pen test reports for engineers, executives, and customers.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence people at all levels, as well as vendors and external partners.

Nice to have

  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GPEN, GWAPT, CSSLP, or CISSP.
  • Experience testing AI/LLM applications in production.
  • Bug bounty participation or published security research.
  • Knowledge of the security research community.
  • Development experience in Java, C++ or Python.
  • Experience in a PSIRT or product incident response role.
  • Experience with insurance, financial services, or other regulated SaaS products.

About Guidewire


Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.


For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.


Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

jobs.excerpt: Who is Boulevard?  Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses.
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. It’s an individual contributor role with wide influence: you won’t manage people, you’ll lead through technical judgment, clear communication, and trust, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Partnerships, and Product Marketing. We’re small enough that your work is visible every day.

What you’ll do here:

  • Set the technical strategy for Boulevard’s API and app ecosystem, making sure it supports company goals and partner needs.
  • Work across engineering teams to align on direction and drive the right implementation, without formal authority over those teams.
  • Lead platform-level changes that cross team boundaries: gain agreement, plan the rollout, and see the work through.
  • Find the gaps between what the platform provides and what business priorities require, and turn them into clear, scoped, prioritized proposals.
  • Learn what partners and integrators need and bring those needs into the platform roadmap.
  • Write and review design documents and architecture decisions, explaining trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Write code and ship high-impact work, setting the standard for quality, observability, and security.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching, and remove blockers so teammates can do their best work.
  • Define and monitor system health metrics for the API platform, address technical debt before it affects reliability or performance, and help guide incidents from response to resolution and improvement.

What you’ll need to thrive:

  • Experience as a Staff-level or senior engineer who has led large, cross-team technical initiatives.
  • Experience building and scaling external-facing API products. GraphQL experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs.
  • Experience designing and operating systems at scale, including enterprise-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, Go, or Elixir. Elixir experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • Influence without authority and sound technical judgment: you gain alignment through clear reasoning and trust, and you anticipate scale, maintenance, and operational cost.
  • Business and partner awareness, and clear communication: you connect technical decisions to business priorities and partner needs, and adapt your message to your audience.
  • A mentor’s mindset, ownership, and forward thinking: you help other engineers grow, move work forward when the path is unclear, state risks openly, and set long-term direction while delivering value in the short term.
  • A plus: experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

How we’ll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $193,900 - 225,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.
  • 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.
  • 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.
  • Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.
  • $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.
  • And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice.

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Outside Employment Disclosure
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. jobs.description:
ABOUT POWER FACTORS

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Solutions Architect for renewable energy management to help spearhead Power Factors’ continued growth. This role ultimately accountable for driving revenue growth by acting as the trusted technical advisor and facilitating complex technical engagements throughout the sales cycle and translating complex business challenges in the renewable energy sector into compelling, well-scoped solution that accelerate time-to-value and lay the foundation for long-term customer success.

The Solutions Architect is responsible for engaging with prospects and customers as technical advisor, knowing our customers business intimately and understands the unique challenges and aspirations of each of them. The individual brings a consultative mindset and strong customer facing competencies besides relevant experience in the renewables industry, specifically in BESS, Solar PV and Wind asset management for utility scale and deeply understanding the systems architecture that support IPPs, investors and other stakeholders managing renewable operational assets and often with a background within or involving contact with relevant IPPs.

The Solutions Architect is an entrepreneurial, cross-functional role that requires multiple skill sets and involves significant interaction and coordination with our prospects and customers and Power Factors’ internal stakeholders like Product, Technology, and Customer Success.

Key Responsibilities:

Presales Support:

o Lead technical presentations, product demonstrations, prospect’s trainings and proof-of-value (POV) engagements aligned to each prospect's specific pain points and desired outcomes.

o Respond to RFPs and RFIs with accurate, differentiated, and commercially aware technical content.

o Evaluate feasibility of client requests during the sales process and provide clear guidance on solution pathways, trade-offs, and constraints.

o Define the solution scope for each prospect, including integration architecture, data flows, and any configuration or customization required.

o Collaborate with Account Executives to develop tailored proposals for enterprise and strategic accounts and with well-defined and executed competitive moats.

o Contribute to SA team tooling, playbooks, and demo environments to raise the baseline quality of all engagements.

Technical Leadership and Customer Engagement:

o Lead technical discovery sessions and solution workshops with customer stakeholders at all levels (operational, IT, executive).

o Act as the primary technical point of contact throughout the sales cycle, managing expectations and building credibility.

o Deliver solution design documentation and reference architectures for complex engagements.

o Serve as technical liaison between customers and Power Factors' Product, Technology, and Professional Services teams.

o Stay current with renewable energy trends, SaaS/IoT architectures, SCADA/DAS platforms, and competitive landscape.

Solution Design & Scoping:

o Conduct rigorous discovery to understand each customer's unique operational environment, data sources, integration requirements, and success criteria.

o Design integration approaches connecting Power Factors applications with client systems (SCADA, historians, ERP, CMMS, etc.).

o Identify, document, and manage technical risks, gaps, and dependencies for each opportunity.

o Coordinate with Professional Services on delivery assumptions underpinning commercial proposals.

Customer-First Mindset & Communication

o Tailor customer-facing collaterals —decks, RFP responses, POV reports — to each audience and engagement context.

o Tailor demos addressing both non-technical (asset owners, operations managers, executives) and technical (IT) audiences.

o Ensure a seamless, high-quality buying experience that reflects Power Factors' brand and builds long-term trust.

o Partner with customer stakeholders to ensure their requirements and feedback are accurately captured and acted upon

Product Feedback & Market Intelligence

o Aggregate and communicate product gaps, feature requests, and market signals from customer engagements to the Product team.

o Contribute to roadmap discussions by providing a market-wide perspective, not just individual customer needs.

o Attend industry events and trade shows as a Power Factors technical brand ambassador.

o Support Product Marketing with competitive moats, battle cards and marketing launches.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

We believe you enjoy working in a purpose-driven organization and that you thrive in an environment where you need to find creative solutions to challenging problems in a fast-changing context. This also means that you are effective at managing multiple creative tasks of varying complexities, work well under pressure, and are driven by continuous learning and growth. Specifically, we are looking for someone with the following creative skillset:

  • Bachelor’s or Master's in a technical field, e.g., Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering; Master’s degree is considered an asset
  • Minimum five (5) years of relevant experience in the renewable energy industry with experience in technical product/project management, business process development, software development, IoT/networking
  • Work experience using and configuring Web-based IoT, SaaS, and IPaaS data platforms, including DAS platforms, SCADA systems, enterprise databases and historians, OSIsoft PI, and other cloud platforms, e.g., Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services
  • Relevant work experience in navigating the renewable energy landscape, including utilities, EPCs, third-party O&M organizations, asset owners, asset managers, and hardware and software vendors
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly jump into complex problems and navigate competing priorities to drive solutions using analytical and decision-making skills and priority management
  • Excellent, clear, concise written and oral communication skills in English. The ability to present in other languages is considered an important asset
  • Ability to connect with all relevant audiences within an organization with the right message and level of detail
  • Process-oriented with a growth mindset; ability to perform as an individual contributor and as a project coordinator; as such, you can work autonomously, facilitate teamwork between multiple stakeholders, and escalate as required
  • Proven track record of high performance in a fast-paced environment

LIFE @ POWER FACTORS

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

WHY JOIN US

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

This role is a foundational hire for HealthEdge's growing Strategic Finance function, supporting the BPaaS business and the broader Finance organization. The Analyst partners closely with, and reports directly to, the Director of Strategic Finance & Corporate Development, taking ownership of the recurring analysis, modeling and reporting that underpin how HealthEdge communicates financial performance to its leadership, its Board and the investment community.

This is a builder's role, not a support role. The right person is a strong modeler and clear communicator who wants real ownership early, thrives in an environment with limited inherited infrastructure, and is energized by turning ambiguous, high-stakes problems into repeatable, well-documented processes. As the function scales, this individual has a clear path to expanded scope and increasing responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investor Engagement & External Reporting

    • Serve as the day-to-day owner of the analytical and reporting engine behind HealthEdge's investor communications.

    • Maintain and enhance the investor data model used to update the investment community on financial performance, ensuring accuracy, consistency and readiness across reporting cycles.
    • Prepare investor-facing reporting packages and supporting analysis, partnering with the Director and Investor Relations to translate financial results into a clear performance narrative.
    • Own the recurring production and version control of these deliverables so that each cycle requires minimal rework.
  • Board Reporting & Financial Analysis

    • Produce the analysis and materials that inform Board and executive-level decision-making.

    • Build and refine Board reporting materials, including slide creation, financial analysis and supporting exhibits.
    • Develop competitive and market positioning analysis to contextualize HealthEdge's performance against relevant benchmarks.
    • Synthesize complex financial information into concise, executive-ready formats.
  • Long-Term Product Economics Modeling

    • Partner with the Director to develop revenue and margin models at the customer level.

    • Help build and maintain long-term economic models that project future revenue, cost structure, margin and unit economics.
    • Develop scenario and sensitivity analysis to test how contract structures, growth assumptions and cost drivers shape long-term economics.
    • Translate evolving business models into structured, well-documented modeling frameworks that mature as products scale.
  • AI Adoption in Finance

    • Help lead the adoption of AI and automation across the Finance organization.

    • Identify and pilot AI and automation opportunities that reduce manual effort in reporting, modeling and data aggregation.
    • Help build and document scalable, automated workflows that expand the team's analytical capacity.
  • Special Projects

    • Support high-priority, cross-functional special projects as needed.

    • Provide financial modeling, analysis and research to support strategic initiatives across the enterprise.
    • Partner with business, advisory and operational teams to deliver timely, decision-ready analysis.

    Qualifications

    Required

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field, or a Master's in Finance (MSF).
    • 0 – 3 years of relevant work experience in finance, accounting, FP&A, investment banking, consulting or a comparable analytical role.
    • Strong financial modeling skills and fluency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present financial information clearly.
    • High attention to detail, strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

    Preferred

    • Demonstrated interest in healthcare and/or technology.
    • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building repeatable processes from scratch.
    • Curiosity about AI and automation tools and how they can be applied to finance workflows.

    Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

    Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

    FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

    Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

    • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
    • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
    • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
    • May require travel dependent on company needs.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

jobs.title: Design System Manager
jobs.excerpt: BoldNuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera.
jobs.description:
Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 450.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

El Rol:

El Design System Manager define y lidera la estrategia del design system de Bold, para que diseñadores, ingenieros y agentes de AI construyan productos consistentes, accesibles y muy intuitivos a partir de una única fuente de verdad.

Lidera un equipo multidisciplinario de UX, UI e ingeniería. Su reto es que el sistema exista en Figma y en código, sincronizado de punta a punta, que su adopción en la organización sea medible y que sus componentes y reglas sean legibles tanto para personas como para agentes de AI.

Responsabilidades:

Estrategia y visión

  • Definir la visión, el roadmap y las prioridades del design system de Bold, alineados con los objetivos de producto y de negocio.

  • Establecer principios, gobernanza y criterios de contribución: qué entra al sistema, quién decide y cómo se versiona.

  • Diseñar el sistema para que lo consuman personas y agentes de AI por igual: tokens, componentes y documentación estructurados, semánticos y legibles por máquina.

Liderazgo del equipo

  • Gestionar y desarrollar al equipo de design system: diseño UX, diseño UI e ingeniería de desarrollo.

  • Planificar capacidad, priorizar el backlog y asegurar entregas con calidad y consistencia.

  • Coordinar con los equipos de producto, diseño e ingeniería (web y app) como socio, no como área de soporte.

Librería de componentes

  • Crear y mantener la librería de componentes en diseño (Figma) y en código, con paridad entre ambas.

  • Garantizar accesibilidad, rendimiento, responsive y documentación de uso (UI y UX) en cada componente.

  • Gestionar tokens de diseño (color, tipografía, espaciado, motion) como base común de ambos mundos.

Adopción medible

  • Lograr que los diseñadores UX construyan prototipos con los componentes UI del sistema.

  • Lograr que los ingenieros front de web y app construyan los productos con el código de los componentes.

  • Definir y seguir métricas de adopción (por ejemplo, % de pantallas y productos que usan componentes del DS, cobertura de componentes, desviaciones, tiempo de entrega) y usarlas para priorizar mejoras.

  • Dar soporte, formación y comunicación continua para impulsar el uso en toda la organización.

Flujo de trabajo end to end diseño a código

  • Ser dueño del flujo completo: toda actualización de UI o UX en el DS debe reflejarse en el repositorio de componentes en código.

  • Implementar pipelines de versionado, publicación y pruebas (incluidas pruebas visuales y de accesibilidad) que permitan a los productos actualizarse a nuevas versiones de forma automática.

  • Gestionar cambios importantes, deprecaciones y comunicación de versiones para no romper los productos.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

👨🏽‍⚕️ Auxilio de salud.

🚀 Bono anual por cumplimiento de objetivos empresariales (acciones o dinero).

🤝 Contrato a término indefinido.

💲 Salario competitivo.

👩🏿‍💻 Trabajo remoto 100%.

📚 Apoyo económico para educación.

🌎 Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial.

🏖️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones.

Requirements

Experiencia requerida

  • 3 a 6 años o más en product management, ingeniería front-end o design systems, con al menos 2 años liderando equipos.

  • Portafolio o casos que muestren resultados medibles de adopción y de impacto en velocidad o consistencia.

Habilidades técnicas

  • Dominio de Figma: componentes, variables, tokens, variantes y librerías compartidas.

  • Conocimiento sólido de front-end: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React y desarrollo de librerías de componentes (también deseable conocimiento de desarrollo móvil).

  • Gestión de tokens y su automatización del diseño al código (por ejemplo, Style Dictionary o Tokens Studio).

  • Pipelines de CI/CD, versionado semántico, publicación de paquetes y pruebas (unitarias, visuales y de accesibilidad).

  • Documentación de componentes (por ejemplo, Storybook) y accesibilidad (WCAG).

  • Comprensión de cómo trabajan los agentes de AI con sistemas de diseño: documentación y metadatos legibles por máquina, MCP, reglas y guías que un agente pueda seguir para generar UI correcta.

Gestión y liderazgo

  • Liderazgo de equipos multidisciplinarios de diseño e ingeniería, con capacidad de desarrollar y dar feedback.

  • Pensamiento estratégico y de producto: tratar el design system como un producto interno con usuarios, roadmap y métricas.

  • Definición y seguimiento de métricas de adopción y calidad, con decisiones basadas en datos.

  • Gestión de gobernanza y procesos de contribución en organizaciones con muchos equipos.

Aptitudes y habilidades blandas

  • Influencia sin autoridad: capacidad de convencer a equipos de producto, diseño e ingeniería de adoptar el sistema.

  • Comunicación clara con perfiles de diseño y de ingeniería, y habilidad para negociar prioridades.

  • Mentalidad de servicio, colaboración y orientación a resultados.

  • Criterio para equilibrar consistencia y flexibilidad, y calidad frente a velocidad.

  • Curiosidad y adaptabilidad frente a la evolución rápida de la AI y de las herramientas de diseño.

Deseable

  • Experiencia en fintech, pagos o productos con alto volumen transaccional.

  • Experiencia previa habilitando herramientas de AI o agentes en flujos de diseño y desarrollo.

  • Experiencia con marcos de trabajo multimarca o multiplataforma.

En Bold, el talento no tiene etiquetas. Fomentamos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y accesible para todos, garantizando un proceso de selección equitativo. Si necesitas algún ajuste razonable para participar en el proceso, por favor infórmanos al postularte.
