jobs.description:
ubject Matter Expert - Infrastructure as Code & DevOps Automation

Position Summary

We seek an experienced IT Automation Specialist to lead infrastructure automation initiatives across our enterprise environment. As a subject matter expert, you will design, implement, and maintain scalable automation solutions using industry-leading tools including Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible, AWX/Tower, and advanced DevOps platforms. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking to drive infrastructure modernization and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and OpenTofu for cloud and on-premises infrastructure provisioning
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and roles for configuration management, application deployment, and system patching across heterogeneous environments
  • Architect and optimize Ansible Tower/AWX implementations for enterprise-scale automation, including RBAC, credential management, and workflow orchestration
  • Lead adoption of agentic AI capabilities to automate decision-making processes and reduce manual operational overhead
  • Establish the best automation practices, standards, and frameworks; conduct code reviews for infrastructure automation projects
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex automation issues; provide technical documentation for knowledge transfer to other teams
  • Integrate automation solutions with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring systems, and ticketing platforms
  • Document technical architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures for all automation systems
  • Evaluate and recommend new automation tools and technologies that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Cloud, Infrastructure, Security) to embed automation across IT operations

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of IT infrastructure and systems administration experience
  • Expert-level proficiency with Terraform and/or OpenTofu; demonstrated ability to manage complex infrastructure states
  • Advanced expertise in Ansible; proven experience in designing and maintaining Ansible Tower or AWX in production environments
  • Strong Python programming skills; ability to write custom modules, plugins, and automation scripts
  • Deep understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code best practices
  • Experience with public cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and hybrid/on-premises infrastructure
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities with demonstrated experience resolving production incidents
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing and managing agentic AI solutions for IT operations automation
  • Experience with advanced Ansible Tower features (workflows, dynamic inventory, LDAP/SAML integration)
  • Familiarity with configuration management databases (CMDB) and ServiceNow integrations
  • Knowledge of GitOps methodologies and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Certifications such as HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate, Ansible Specialist, or equivalent cloud/infrastructure certifications

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. During this program, you will explore how artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs, and graph analytics can be used to better understand patient journeys and address complex epidemiology and real-world evidence questions—ultimately supporting our mission to serve patients.

  • Design and develop a prototype knowledge graph representing longitudinal patient journeys, including relevant relationships among patient characteristics, treatments, clinical events, and outcomes.

  • Use AI-assisted tools and methods to support project development—for example, accelerating knowledge graph design, data mapping, code development, documentation, and quality review—while applying appropriate human oversight, validation, and responsible AI practices.

jobs.excerpt: BriefWe are looking for an experienced Quality Cell Lead to define, lead, and continuously improve quality engineering and testing practices across multiple engineering cells.
jobs.description:
Brief

We are looking for an experienced Quality Cell Lead to define, lead, and continuously improve quality engineering and testing practices across multiple engineering cells. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on embedding quality throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring that quality is engineered into products from the outset rather than verified only at the end. You will own the overall quality and test strategy, establish consistent standards and best practices, and ensure comprehensive testing coverage across the platform. Working closely with Technical Leads, Product Owners, and engineering teams, you will oversee functional testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, performance testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing. A key aspect of the role is supervising and improving AI-agent-driven testing capabilities, including automated test generation, defect detection, test execution, and continuous quality monitoring. The ideal candidate combines strong software testing expertise, quality management experience, technical problem-solving skills, and a forward-thinking approach to AI-enabled software delivery.

Company Details

Our client is a well-established UK-based digital retail and financial services organization with a strong focus on technology, customer experience, and innovation.

The business is undertaking a significant technology transformation program involving a new website, order management, customer service, and credit platform capabilities. The technology team is responsible for delivering the credit platform, while working closely with Financial Services business teams to support regulatory, operational, and business readiness.

The program is moving through a staged customer cohort go-live from October through February, creating a need for strong delivery leadership, stakeholder coordination, governance, and readiness management.

This is an opportunity to join an established technology transformation program at a critical stage, working across technology and business teams to ensure successful and controlled delivery.


Responsibilities

    Define, own, and maintain the overall quality assurance and test strategy across engineering cells, ensuring consistent standards, methodologies, and coverage across the platform.
    Establish and maintain quality requirements, testing standards, best practices, and engineering guidelines that support reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable software delivery.
    Ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle, promoting early testing, defect prevention, continuous validation, and risk-based quality practices.
    Lead functional testing activities across development stages, ensuring that test coverage aligns with functional requirements, technical specifications, and business priorities.
    Oversee user acceptance testing planning and execution, ensuring that test scenarios, environments, entry criteria, exit criteria, and reporting processes are appropriately defined and managed.
    Supervise AI-agent-driven testing capabilities, including automated test generation, regression testing, defect detection, test execution, and test coverage maintenance.
    Identify and implement opportunities for agent-led testing and continuous testing, including improvements to testing tools, frameworks, workflows, and AI prompts.
    Work hands-on where necessary to develop, improve, debug, and maintain test automation frameworks, testing tools, and quality engineering solutions.
    Collaborate with Technical Leads, Product Owners, and engineering cell members to ensure quality requirements are understood, prioritised, implemented, and validated.
    Ensure clear ownership and alignment of acceptance criteria, recognising that Product Managers own business acceptance criteria while the Quality Cell Lead owns technical acceptance criteria.
    Define and monitor quality metrics, test coverage, defect trends, automation performance, and testing effectiveness across engineering cells.
    Establish measurement objectives and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into quality performance, testing efficiency, and areas requiring improvement.
    Lead quality reviews, assess testing outcomes, identify process gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve consistency and engineering standards.
    Ensure appropriate integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, load, and stress testing is implemented and maintained for critical APIs and services.
    Improve test data availability and test environment readiness, reducing delays caused by missing data, configuration issues, or unreliable environments.
    Identify, track, and reduce testing-related technical debt, including flaky tests, outdated frameworks, missing automation, and gaps in regression coverage.
    Assess software deliverables against agreed technical quality and service acceptance criteria, identifying risks that could affect operational readiness or production releases.
    Provide authoritative guidance on testing methodologies, quality management techniques, test automation, and appropriate tools and frameworks.
    Maintain a quarterly quality and testing roadmap, alongside a lower-confidence six-month forecast aligned with engineering delivery objectives and platform evolution.
    Monitor emerging technologies, testing methodologies, AI capabilities, and quality engineering tools, assessing their potential benefits, risks, and opportunities for adoption.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of organisational quality policies, standards, processes, and engineering practices.
    Support and guide engineering teams in applying quality standards consistently while ensuring that day-to-day work allocation remains with the respective cell leads.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Quality Engineering and Testing Performance

    Quality roadmap:Maintain a quarterly quality and test roadmap and a lower-confidence six-month forecast aligned with engineering delivery goals and platform evolution.
    API and critical-service test coverage:Monitor the percentage of critical API endpoints and services covered by functional, integration, and end-to-end tests.
    Test automation execution rate:Measure the percentage of test cases executed automatically versus manually across environments and CI/CD pipelines, including agent-authored tests.
    Defect detection and resolution:Track mean time to detect and resolve defects, covering issues identified before and after production release.
    Defect leakage rate:Measure the percentage of critical defects that escape into production compared with those identified during testing.
    Consistency of quality standards:Assess adherence to quality frameworks, testing standards, tooling requirements, and review practices across engineering cells.
    Performance and load testing coverage:Track the percentage of critical services with implemented and maintained load, stress, and performance tests.
    Test data and environment readiness:Measure the percentage of test cycles delayed by unavailable or invalid test data, environment misconfiguration, or infrastructure issues.
    Testing technical debt:Track and reduce flaky tests, outdated testing frameworks, missing automation, and outstanding test coverage improvements.
    AI-led testing effectiveness:Monitor the reliability, coverage, maintainability, and effectiveness of AI-generated tests and agent-led testing workflows.
    Service acceptance readiness:Ensure critical deliverables are evaluated against agreed technical quality and operational acceptance criteria before release.
    Continuous improvement:Demonstrate measurable improvements in test reliability, automation, defect prevention, and the consistency of quality practices across engineering cells.

Qualifications

    Proven experience in software quality engineering, QA, or software testing in a senior or lead role.
    Strong experience defining test strategies, quality standards, and testing frameworks.
    Hands-on expertise in functional, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
    Experience with test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous testing.
    Knowledge of performance, load, and stress testing for critical services.
    Experience with quality metrics, defect management, test coverage, and service acceptance.
    Strong understanding of software development fundamentals, code reviews, and requirements management.
    Experience using AI coding agents and AI-driven testing tools for test creation, execution, and defect detection.
    Ability to validate AI-generated tests for accuracy, reliability, and coverage.
    Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
    Ability to provide technical leadership, work hands-on, and drive continuous quality improvements.
    Fully remote:Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering teams in a remote environment.

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Freight Operations

Keep Pickup and Delivery Appointments on Track

We are hiring a Freight Dispatcher — Appointment & Delivery Coordination to support U.S. trucking operations with a focus on pickup and delivery scheduling, facility requirements, shipment coordination, and driver communication.

This position may be a strong fit for transportation professionals, including experienced or former CDL-A drivers, who understand how appointment times, facility procedures, driver Hours of Service, travel time, and changing freight conditions affect successful pickups and deliveries.

Previous employment specifically under the title of Freight Dispatcher is not required. Applicants must have relevant U.S. trucking, transportation, logistics, fleet, or closely related operational experience.

  • Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments with authorized shippers, receivers, brokers, and transportation personnel.
  • Confirm appointment dates, times, reference numbers, and applicable facility requirements.
  • Verify receiving hours, check-in procedures, loading or unloading requirements, and applicable shipment instructions.
  • Identify appointment conflicts before they affect the driver or shipment.
  • Communicate appointment changes promptly to drivers and authorized operations personnel.
  • Maintain accurate appointment information throughout active freight movements.
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete scheduling information.

Trip & Schedule Evaluation

  • Review travel distance, driver location, available Hours of Service, and appointment requirements.
  • Determine whether proposed pickup and delivery schedules are operationally realistic.

Driver, Broker & Facility Communication

  • Communicate verified appointment changes and shipment updates.
  • Maintain professional telephone, email, and digital communication.
  • Escalate service, safety, documentation, broker-verification, or scheduling concerns when appropriate.

Freight & Load Support

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate communication histories and operational notes.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent information requiring follow-up.

  • Freight dispatch support
  • Fleet operations
  • Carrier operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Logistics operations
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Appointment scheduling

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As an Associate Product Designer, you'll work with experienced designers, product managers, and engineers to help improve how users interact with Bask Health's products.

This is an entry-level product design role intended for recent graduates and designers beginning their professional careers. We're looking for someone with strong design fundamentals, curiosity about how software works, and the motivation to develop their skills through hands-on product work.

You'll contribute to user interface design, user experience improvements, wireframes, prototypes, and visual design tasks across different parts of the platform.

You'll also contribute to Bask Health's design system by using established components, maintaining visual consistency, and helping document reusable patterns.

You'll participate in design reviews, incorporate feedback, and refine your work through multiple iterations.

You'll have opportunities to learn from usability research, customer feedback, and product analytics to better understand how users interact with the platform.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to approach patient-facing and operational experiences with appropriate attention to clarity, accessibility, privacy, and accuracy.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Content Strategist to help define how content is structured, written, managed, and maintained across Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As our platform grows, clear and consistent product content becomes increasingly important. Different users interact with different parts of the software, but they should encounter terminology, instructions, and interface patterns that feel connected and understandable.

As a Product Content Strategist, you'll help establish the content principles, standards, and systems that make this possible.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining product content strategy, UX writing, content design, information architecture, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll work on both the long-term structure of our content and the practical details of how that content appears in product experiences.

You'll develop and maintain terminology standards, voice and tone guidelines, reusable interface content patterns, and content governance practices. You'll help teams make consistent decisions about how features are named, how workflows are explained, and how users receive guidance.

Your work will span merchant-facing, patient-facing, and internal software experiences. You'll consider how content supports business configuration, patient onboarding, questionnaires, subscriptions, administrative settings, and other workflows.

You'll collaborate closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, UX writers, researchers, and operational stakeholders to ensure content decisions are integrated into product development rather than treated as a final editing step.

You'll also help improve how product content is organized and maintained. This includes identifying duplicate or inconsistent terminology, documenting reusable patterns, and recommending approaches that allow content to scale as new features are introduced.

Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, some product language involves sensitive or specialized information. You'll work with appropriate subject matter experts to ensure content standards support accuracy, privacy, and approved clinical and pharmacy workflows.

You'll use research findings, usability feedback, product analytics, and content reviews to identify opportunities for improvement. You'll help teams understand where inconsistent language or poorly structured information creates unnecessary friction.

You'll also support the development of content processes that improve collaboration between design, product, engineering, and operational teams.

jobs.title: Video Editor (Short-form social, paid ads, UGC) - LATAM
jobs.excerpt: About LumiMedsLumiMeds is a fast-growing U. S. -based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

About the Role

LumiMeds is hiring a video editor to cut short-form video across three streams: educational content from our licensed healthcare creators, UGC from real customers and paid creators, and paid social ads. You'll take a clinician's 90-second explanation of how GLP-1s work and make it land. You'll turn a customer's iPhone testimonial into a Meta ad that converts. On spec, on time, and on the right side of compliance.

This is not a generalist editing role. You'll be cutting healthcare content in a tightly regulated category (compounded medications, metabolic health, HRT). Every cut, every overlay, every text card has to be both watchable and compliant. Paid ads in this space get extra scrutiny from Meta, TikTok, and the FTC, so you'll work closely with our social media manager, healthcare creators, and compliance reviewer to make sure everything ships clean.

The right person is fast, opinionated about what makes short-form work, and fluent with modern AI editing tools. You're also detail-oriented enough to catch when a stray B-roll clip, an AI voiceover, or a misplaced caption could create a compliance problem. No healthcare background required (we'll train you), but you do need to care about getting it right.

What You'll Do

Educational content (organic)

  • Edit 12–16 short-form educational videos per month (15–90 seconds) from self-shot creator footage for Instagram Reels and TikTok
  • Add captions, lower thirds, callouts, on-screen text, and B-roll where it strengthens the message

Paid ads

  • Cut 8–15 paid ad variations per month for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube: hook-led, conversion-focused, built for testing
  • Produce multiple variants of each concept (different hooks, CTAs, and first-3-second openers) so the media team can run proper creative tests
  • Iterate quickly on winning ads: recut hooks, swap B-roll, refresh creative when fatigue sets in

UGC

  • Edit UGC submissions from real customers and paid UGC creators into polished short-form content that still feels native and authentic (not over-produced)
  • Stitch multi-clip UGC into cohesive narratives (problem, product, result framing, within compliance bounds)

Across all streams

  • Use AI tools strategically to speed up production (auto-captioning, transcript-based editing, B-roll generation, voice cleanup) without letting AI shortcuts compromise accuracy or compliance
  • Apply LumiMeds brand standards consistently: fonts, colors, logo placement, end cards, disclosure formatting
  • Implement compliance reviewer feedback on cuts and revisions, sometimes across multiple rounds
  • Maintain organized project files and an archive of raw footage, approved B-roll, finished cuts, and ad variant trees
  • Stay current on what's working on Reels, TikTok, and paid social in the health and wellness space

What You Won't Do

  • You will NOT write scripts or determine clinical content — that comes from our licensed creators and the marketing team
  • You will NOT add efficacy claims, weight-loss promises, or outcome language in captions, on-screen text, or ad copy
  • You will NOT use AI to generate fake clinician footage, deepfake any creator or customer, clone voices, or fabricate B-roll that misrepresents what's being described
  • You will NOT use before/after imagery, testimonial framings, or comparisons to branded products (Wegovy, Ozempic, Zepbound, Mounjaro)
  • You will NOT upload, publish, or push final files live to ad accounts — final files go to the social media manager and media buyer

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 2+ years editing short-form vertical video for social. Portfolio with current work required
  • Demonstrated experience editing paid social ads (Meta, TikTok, or YouTube) — not just organic content. You understand hook-led structure, retention curves, and why ad creative is different from organic creative
  • Strong fluency in at least one of: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Pro
  • Working knowledge of AI editing tools: Descript or similar transcript-based editing, AI captioning (CapCut, Submagic, Opus Clip), AI audio cleanup (Adobe Enhance, Auphonic)
  • Comfort cutting UGC: taking imperfect, multi-source footage and making it work without stripping out the authenticity that makes UGC perform
  • Captioning skills that go beyond auto-generated: accurate, well-timed, well-styled, readable on mute
  • Genuine taste for what makes short-form work: pacing, hooks, retention, when to cut, when to let a beat breathe
  • Willingness to learn FDA marketing compliance basics as they apply to compounded medications and paid health advertising (we'll train you)

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience editing paid DTC ads in healthcare, wellness, supplements, telehealth, or other regulated, performance-driven categories
  • Familiarity with the visual language differences between educational, UGC, and ad content
  • Experience producing ad variant trees (same concept, multiple hooks, CTAs, and openers) for systematic creative testing
  • Experience working with a brand kit and maintaining visual consistency across many cuts
  • Motion graphics chops: clean text animations, simple lower thirds, callout treatments
  • Comfort with audio cleanup (noise reduction, leveling, music ducking)
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly in regulated contexts
  • Working knowledge of Meta, TikTok, and YouTube ad creative specs and policy (especially health and wellness ad policies)

Bonus

  • Color grading skills beyond basic correction
  • Spanish or Tagalog fluency (we're planning bilingual content and matching captioning helps)
  • Experience with AI dubbing or translation tools (ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Rask) for bilingual ad and content workflows
  • Experience editing for accounts or ad accounts in the 100K+ follower or six-figure monthly ad spend range

Logistics

  • Engagement type: Full-time (W-2)
  • Location: Fully remote, U.S.-based preferred (open to Canada/Latin America for the right person)
  • Software: You bring your own. We'll cover any LumiMeds-specific tools, plugins, or AI tool subscriptions
  • Start date: As soon as the right person is found

What Working With Us Looks Like

  • Footage and briefs drop into a shared folder: educational footage from creators, UGC from customers and paid UGC creators, raw assets for ad concepts
  • Each project comes with a brief: format, platform, aspect ratios needed, hook variations to produce, compliance considerations flagged upfront
  • You cut, deliver a first version (or variant set), and post to a review thread
  • You revise (usually 1–2 rounds for organic, sometimes 3+ for ads where compliance is stricter)
  • Final files get approved, you upload to the delivery folder, marketing and media buying take it from there
  • Weekly check-in during high-volume ad pushes; monthly check-in (30 min) otherwise

How to Apply

Send the following to :

  • A short note (3–5 sentences) on why this role interests you
  • Your reel or 3–5 links to recent work, ideally a mix of organic short-form, UGC edits, and paid ads
  • At least one example of a paid ad you edited, with a sentence on what platform it ran on and what the goal was
  • A sentence or two on which AI tools you actually use in your workflow and what for
  • Your rate expectations (per-video, per-variant, or monthly retainer)
  • Software you cut on
  • If you have it: an example of a piece you edited for a regulated category and a sentence on what constraints you were editing under

We review applications on a rolling basis. Expect to hear back within 2 weeks if there's a fit.

Why This Role Exists

LumiMeds runs three video streams that all live or die on the same craft: educational content that earns trust, UGC that proves real people use the product, and paid ads that bring new patients in the door. They look different, they perform on different metrics, and they each have their own compliance traps. We need one editor who can move between all three without losing the plot.

AI tools have made parts of this faster than ever. They've also made it easier than ever to ship something polished, plausible, and quietly wrong — especially in paid ads. We need someone who can use modern tools to move fast, and never let the polish drift into territory that compromises the brand, the creators we work with, or the audience's trust.

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values.

Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours.

Minimum of 12-15 years of progressive experience in SAP security, identity and access governance, enterprise applications, or related technology risk disciplines, including experience leading SAP S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, releases, or large-scale transformation programs. Experience managing global teams and third-party delivery partners preferred.

Complexity:

Demonstrated expertise and leadership in:

About HealthEdge

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale – and Atlassian is at the center of how work gets done across the organization.

Role Overview

The Atlassian Administrator is a hands-on platform administration role responsible for the day-to-day configuration, maintenance, and user support of HealthEdge's Atlassian environment, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. Working within the Atlassian Products team and reporting to the Manager, Atlassian Products, you will be a key execution resource for platform requests, project configuration, user management, and basic automation – ensuring that thousands of users across the organization can work effectively in Atlassian tools every day.

This is a great role for someone with solid Atlassian fundamentals who wants to deepen their platform expertise in a complex, high-scale environment. You'll work closely with Senior Atlassian Administrators, Architects, and the team manager, taking on well-defined configuration tasks and growing toward more advanced solution design and automation work over time. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, this role will grow to include working with AI-native features like Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo — making content governance and platform hygiene directly connected to AI quality.

What You'll Do

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Administer Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence in a cloud environment
  • Create and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, permission schemes, notification schemes, and screens under the guidance of senior team members
  • Configure and manage JSM service desk projects including request types, queues, SLA configurations, and portal settings
  • Manage Confluence spaces, page permissions, templates, and basic macros to support team knowledge management
  • Perform user and group management including account creation, license assignments, group membership, and access reviews

  • Contribute to and maintain Atlassian knowledge base articles and how-to documentation for end users

Governance & Housekeeping

  • Perform routine platform hygiene tasks including inactive user cleanup, stale project reviews, and unused field or scheme audits
  • Assist with license usage tracking and reporting to support renewal planning
  • Follow and help enforce Atlassian governance standards for project naming, permissions, and configuration consistency
  • Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access and configuration

Project & Team Support

  • Assist Senior Administrators and the team manager with larger configuration projects, migrations, and platform improvement initiatives
  • Participate in testing and validation of Atlassian upgrades, app changes, and configuration rollouts
  • Document changes accurately in accordance with team change management practices

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Jira and Confluence administration experience in a corporate environment
  • Working knowledge of Jira Software project types, workflows, permission schemes, and issue configuration
  • Experience configuring and supporting Jira Service Management (JSM) service desk projects
  • Familiarity with Confluence space administration, page permissions, and content organization
  • Experience with native Jira automation rules
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills – platform hygiene and accuracy matter in this role
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively
  • Familiarity with Atlassian Marketplace apps (ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Atlassian Intelligence or Rovo
  • Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
  • Experience working with Atlassian Cloud (vs. Data Center/Server only)

Preferred

  • Atlassian certification (ACP-120 Jira Administration or equivalent)
  • Experience working in a global, multi-time zone organization

Within 90 days, you are independently handling the majority of day-to-day Atlassian support requests, have a solid working knowledge of HealthEdge's project and space structure, and are contributing to platform hygiene initiatives. Within six months, you are building and maintaining automation rules confidently, your queue work is consistently within SLA, and stakeholders are getting reliable, well-configured solutions from you. Within a year, you have grown your platform depth meaningfully, are contributing to larger configuration projects, and are beginning to take on more complex solution design work with senior team support.

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team within Business Technology, focused on making Jira, JSM, and Confluence work well for thousands of users across a complex global organization.   • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience administering leave of absence programs, disability benefits, and employee benefits, working with multi-state leave programs and regulatory requirements, calculating disability benefits, salary continuation, and leave-related payroll transactions, working with fully insured and self-insured benefit plans, and coordinating with third-party leave and disability vendors.
  • Experience using Workday HRIS and leave management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of FMLA, ADA, state leave laws, paid family leave programs, and related employment regulations.
  • Working knowledge of employee benefits, benefit eligibility, and leave-related benefit administration.
  • Knowledge of PTO administration and leave integration practices.
  • Ability to interpret complex leave laws and apply them in a practical business environment.
  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills with the ability to perform disability, payroll, and leave calculations.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills with the ability to counsel employees and leaders on sensitive situations.
  • Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Effective problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex employee relations and leave scenarios.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Power BI Adoption LeadMost Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped — and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.
  • Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.
  • Design and personally deliver structured training — workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.
  • Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.
  • Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide — standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions — and hold the organisation to it.
  • Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.
  • Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.
  • Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting — and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Power BI technical depth — you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.
  • Adoption & change leadership — you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.
  • Training & enablement — you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.
  • Governance & operating model — reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

  • Microsoft Fabric — architecture, capacity and medallion/lakehouse patter
  • Power Apps, ideally integrated with Power BI.
  • Sensitive, confidential or regulated data; Azure exposure; PL-300 and/or

Interview process

Shortlisted candidates will prepare a maximum of two PowerPoint slides on their approach to enterprise Power BI adoption, and demo a Power BI dashboard they personally designed and built on a dataset of their choice — covering the business problem, auorytelling, accessibility and how they would drive ongoing usage. Format and style are entirely your own.

To apply: send a CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation .

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Sales Development Representative at Legion, your mission is to expand our business by actively prospecting into accounts and showcasing the exceptional value our platform offers. We are seeking a driven individual with a passion for sales and strong business acumen to contribute to our growing Sales team. This role provides an opportunity to develop your sales skills and accelerate the growth of an exciting company that is revolutionizing the future of work for the 2.7 billion-person strong deskless workforce.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITY

ABOUT LEGION

Legion is on a mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, and we’re looking for best-in-class talent to drive this mission.Legion is a fully remote, mission-driven company focused on turning hourly jobs into good jobs. It’s a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture. You’ll have the opportunity to learn, interact directly with seasoned product executives, grow your skills, and enhance your career while helping solve important problems and achieve Legion’s mission. Our industry-leading, intelligent automation is powered by Legion’s Workforce Management (WFM) platform, which maximizes labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously . In a recent Forrester Total Economic Impact study, Legion WFM was proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion has been recognized for its innovative, modern approach to transforming workforce management – Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, JMP Securities’ Hot 100 List of the Best Privately Held Software Companies, recognized for its industry leading AI technology by with back to back AI Breakthrough and Artificial Intellegence awards, and named a Gartner Cool Vendor. This is more than a traditional editing role. You’ll transform raw footage into polished, platform-optimized videos that strengthen brand awareness, improve engagement, and support business growth.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Product Engineer, Clinical & Pharmacy Workflows to help build intelligent software features that improve how clinical and pharmacy-related processes operate across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses through technology that connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce systems. These workflows involve structured information, administrative tasks, operational coordination, and interactions between multiple teams and applications.

You'll help develop AI-powered capabilities that make these processes easier to manage, reduce repetitive administrative work, and provide useful information to authorized users.

This is a hands-on product engineering role that combines large language models, backend development, frontend application development, APIs, and workflow automation. You'll work with existing application infrastructure and modern AI technologies to build features that integrate directly into clinical and pharmacy-related tools.

Your work may include AI-assisted administrative summaries, workflow navigation, document information extraction, operational task support, and intelligent assistance for approved clinical and pharmacy coordination processes.

You'll collaborate with product managers, engineers, clinical stakeholders, and pharmacy operations teams to understand real workflows and translate those requirements into practical software solutions. You'll contribute to technical design, implement features, evaluate AI outputs, and improve applications based on user feedback.

Because these systems operate in healthcare-related environments, accuracy, privacy, auditability, and appropriate human oversight are essential. You'll design AI features that support authorized professionals rather than replacing their judgment. Systems must not independently diagnose patients, prescribe medications, make clinical determinations, or perform regulated pharmacy decisions without appropriate professional review and authorization.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys building useful products, understands how to integrate AI into real workflows, and can balance speed of development with the reliability and safeguards required for sensitive operational systems.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain AI-powered features for clinical and pharmacy-related applications.
  • Integrate large language models into approved healthcare operational workflows.
  • Develop AI-assisted tools that help authorized users navigate complex administrative processes.
  • Build features that summarize relevant operational information for clinical and pharmacy teams.
  • Implement AI-powered information extraction from approved documents and structured records.
  • Develop contextual assistance for clinical and pharmacy workflow management.
  • Build backend services and APIs that support AI-enabled operational features.
  • Develop user-facing interfaces for AI-powered workflow assistance.
  • Integrate AI functionality with existing patient, clinical, and pharmacy-related systems.
  • Implement structured model outputs and validation for downstream application workflows.
  • Build retrieval capabilities that surface relevant information from approved internal sources.
  • Develop tool-calling functionality that interacts with authorized application services.
  • Implement safeguards that prevent unauthorized actions or access to restricted information.
  • Build human review and confirmation steps for sensitive or consequential workflows.
  • Support AI-assisted administrative coordination without automating regulated professional decisions.
  • Work with product and operational stakeholders to understand workflow requirements.
  • Translate complex business processes into clear, maintainable application functionality.
  • Develop automated tests for AI features, APIs, and application behavior.
  • Evaluate model outputs for accuracy, completeness, relevance, and consistency.
  • Investigate incorrect responses, extraction errors, and unexpected AI behavior.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval configurations, and application logic based on evaluation results.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and auditability for AI-powered workflows.
  • Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive patient and operational information.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on architecture, integration, and security decisions.
  • Optimize AI response latency, reliability, and infrastructure usage.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and implement dependable fixes.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and cross-functional discussions.
  • Own assigned AI product features from implementation through testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably including AI-powered application development.
  • Experience building and deploying production software applications.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Hands-on experience integrating APIs into production applications.
  • Familiarity with large language models and modern generative AI development patterns.
  • Experience building AI-powered features or applications.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and structured model outputs.
  • Experience developing backend services and application APIs.
  • Familiarity with frontend application development and modern web frameworks.
  • Experience working with relational databases and structured application data.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure application design.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous workflows and service integrations.
  • Ability to translate operational requirements into working software features.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Familiarity with automated testing, debugging, and code review practices.
  • Understanding of the limitations and failure modes of large language models.
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and identify accuracy or reliability problems.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of data privacy and responsible handling of sensitive information.
  • Ability to design application features with appropriate permissions and human oversight.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment.
  • Experience using Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively with product managers and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Ability to independently deliver assigned engineering projects.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building software for healthcare, telehealth, pharmacy, or clinical operations.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Experience developing AI-assisted administrative or operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation architectures.
  • Experience with document parsing, information extraction, or structured data extraction.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
  • Experience building AI applications with tool calling or function calling.
  • Familiarity with human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js backend development.
  • Experience with React or Next.js applications.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, Drizzle, or similar development tools.
  • Experience working with AWS services or serverless infrastructure.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Familiarity with clinical documentation or healthcare workflow systems.
  • Understanding of pharmacy operations, prescription processing, or fulfillment coordination.
  • Experience integrating with EHR, pharmacy management, or healthcare-related systems.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Experience implementing audit trails and permission-controlled workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks and model observability.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Leidos has an immediate opening for a Mid-Level Network Migration Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help modernize and secure the Army's global enterprise network, supporting critical communications and mission operations worldwide.

In this remote role, you'll work with experienced network engineers and technical teams to support network migrations, routing and switching, SD-WAN connectivity, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization.

    • Juniper
    • Palo Alto
    • Dell Networking

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer-facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with geographically dispersed teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts to support migration activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.

At Leidos, you'll work on a mission that directly supports the U.S. Army's ability to communicate and operate around the world.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Applied AI Engineer to help develop, test, and improve AI-powered software features across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools. Position Summary

To advanceTeach For All’s 25-year vision of developing collective leadership for educational equity, we are seeking a Product Manager, Global Learning & Knowledge Platforms to steer our internal digital learning and knowledge infrastructure. Reporting directly to the Head of Product, this role oversees a dual-track product portfolio bridging core software product delivery and strategic vendor governance.

The primary focus will be our proprietary knowledge-sharing platform, the Partner Learning Portal, where you will lead user research, roadmap development, prioritization, and feature delivery, while partnering with the Head of Product on emerging generative AI initiatives.

The remaining focus will involve key adjacent global learning products, such as enterprise LMS platforms, alumni and teacher networks, or global data extensions, depending on organizational priorities. Across this portfolio, you will balance hands-on product delivery, user-centered decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic vendor management.

About the Team

You will join a dynamic, cross-border product and technology team dedicated to leveraging global connectivity to accelerate educational impact for students. You will report directly to the Head of Product, who provides overarching strategic direction, organizational alignment, and coaching- you will experience high autonomy owning day-to-day discovery and product delivery. Our team thrives on human-centered design, cross-cultural collaboration, and harnessing emerging technologies to connect educators across diverse international contexts.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate cross-functionally with global program teams, internal stakeholders, the technology team, and platform content leads to align on project goals and platform needs.

  • Portal Product Ownership: Lead end-to-end product delivery and roadmap management for the Partner Learning Portal, overseeing backlog prioritization, feature updates, UX improvements, and platform maintenance to ensure high user engagement.

  • AI Experimentation & Delivery: Execute the Portal AI strategy by collaborating with the Head of Product to translate overarching vision into user experiments, prototypes, and actionable feature roadmaps alongside specialized engineering partners and content leaders.

  • Technical & Strategic Alignment: Partner closely with internal engineering teams as well as external development vendors, and software providers to ensure feature delivery aligns with global technology strategy and budget allocations.

  • Adjacent Network Tool Partnerships: Manage vendor relationships and integration architectures for separate learning and knowledge-sharing network tools, (e.g., LMS platforms, fellow or alumni connectivity tools, or global data extensions).

  • Content Integration & Support: Collaborate with content owners and Learning Experiences teams to embed effective knowledge-management practices across established platforms, while guiding content strategies for new learning products to maximize discoverability and engagement.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Maintain alignment with the Head of Product across feature discovery, technical specifications, vendor contracts, and strategic resource allocation.

Qualifications

  • Product Management Experience: 5+ years of experience leading digital products, internal knowledge platforms, or digital learning ecosystems end-to-end.

  • Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis: Demonstrated ability to uncover root needs beyond surface feature requests and design systemic solutions across technology, process, and organizational alignment.

  • Autonomy & Execution: Self-directed leader capable of converting broad organizational goals into tactical roadmaps and measurable deliverables.

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills, adept at writing clear requirements and facilitating collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Technical Specs & Vendor Management: Proven background drafting technical specs and managing relationships with external software vendors and development partners.

  • Human-Centered Design: Strong grounding in human-centered design, user discovery, and iterative product enhancements based on user feedback.

  • Data-Informed Decision-Making: Proficiency in leveraging quantitative metrics and qualitative insights to guide roadmap decisions and assess feature performance.

  • Emerging Technology Curiosity: Active curiosity in emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automated tagging, modern search) and their application to user challenges (hands-on AI coding not required).

Additional desirable skills/experiences (not required)

  • Prior experience scoping, testing, prototyping, or launching AI-assisted feature sets.

  • Familiarity with Teach For All’s network structure, partner model, or global context.

  • Professional fluency or proficiency in Spanish, French, Arabic, or other network languages.

What Teach For All Offers:

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress

  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond

  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs

  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements

  • And much more!

Application Instructions

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

Compensation

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Travel and Hours

All work is delivered virtually. Up to 10 % of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement

What Success Looks Like

Interview Process

With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at​

Position Summary

This role contributes to business process design, requirements definition, and system configuration for enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, and NetSuite, and plays a critical role in delivering scalable, well-integrated solutions across the application landscape.

This position serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders and subject matter experts by identifying improvement opportunities, translating business needs into effective system solutions, and ensuring day-to-day system health, usability, and adoption across supported platforms. Brings a continuous-improvement mindset to the role, using automation and AI tools to help teams work more efficiently and get the most value from their systems.

Job Duties

Business Analysis & Process Enablement

  • Facilitate business process assessments and improvement initiatives across customer-facing, revenue-supporting, and finance-related functions, with a focus on efficiency, automation, scalability, and data quality
  • Develop clear, high-quality business requirements, functional specifications, and support documentation that accurately capture business intent.

Business Systems Administration & Execution

  • Configure and maintain workflows, automation, permissions, data standards, and system integrations to support day-to-day business needs. Using Claude Co-Work, MCP’s and additional A.I. tools to perform and automate this work.

Data, Reporting & Operational Insights

  • Analyze Jira reports and dashboards that show how well the Business Systems team is meeting its support SLAs to the business.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, and other business data solutions that align data assets with functional business needs.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define operational KPIs and reporting.

Project Delivery, Testing & Partner Support

  • Manage assigned projects from intake through kickoff, delivery, go-live, and post-launch adoption, owning scope, schedule, status, and stakeholder communication.
  • Facilitate and participate in System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test case development, coordination with business users, issue triage, and validation of outcomes against business requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Salesforce CRM: Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) in an analyst, project, or power-user capacity, including a working knowledge of objects and fields, workflows and automation. Administrator experience is required. Salesforce Administrator certification desired; Platform Developer preferred.
  • ERP: Experience supporting an ERP system (NetSuite, or comparable platforms such as Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics), with an understanding of order management, billing, accounts receivable, and revenue recognition.
  • Quote-to-Cash / Lead-to-Cash: Strong understanding of SaaS business operations and the end-to-end quote-to-cash or lead-to-cash process, including how data flows between Marketing Platforms, CRM, CPQ, billing, and ERP. Experience managing a CPQ application is preferred.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to communicate with executives, business users, and technical teams.
  • Project management: Proven track record delivering business systems or software implementation projects from kickoff to go-live, with working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and traditional waterfall methodologies, risk management, and status reporting.

  • Requirements: Skilled in eliciting and documenting requirements, writing user stories, and producing functional specifications and process maps; adept at using AI to draft concise requirements without unnecessary verbosity.
  • Facilitation: Strong facilitation skills, with experience leading requirements workshops and cross-functional meetings with stakeholders at multiple levels.
  • Testing: Hands-on experience with system integration testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) practices, including test planning and validation.
  • Data: Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, with experience interpreting data to build reports and dashboards; SQL knowledge is helpful.
