jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations to help build, maintain, and improve the technical connections between Bask Health's telehealth platform and pharmacy systems.

In this role, you'll combine hands-on software engineering with practical integration work involving prescription workflows, pharmacy operations, and fulfillment processes. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and operational teams to understand how pharmacy systems exchange information and develop reliable solutions that support those workflows.

You'll build APIs, backend services, and integrations that help move prescription-related information between connected systems. Your work may involve prescription transmission, order processing, status updates, pharmacy routing, fulfillment tracking, and troubleshooting issues across different platforms.

This is a software engineering position rather than a pharmacy operations or technical support role. You'll write production-quality code, investigate complex integration problems, and help ensure pharmacy-related workflows are accurate, secure, and dependable.

You'll also help identify recurring integration challenges and develop reusable technical solutions that improve how Bask connects with pharmacy partners and related services.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex integration problems, communicates clearly with technical and operational stakeholders, and understands the importance of reliability when working with healthcare-related systems.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain integrations between Bask Health's platform and external pharmacy systems.
  • Work with engineering, product, and pharmacy operations teams to understand technical integration requirements.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and integration functionality using TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Support technical workflows involving prescription transmission, pharmacy routing, and order processing.
  • Build integrations that exchange prescription-related information between connected applications.
  • Develop functionality for tracking pharmacy order status and fulfillment updates.
  • Integrate external pharmacy services using REST APIs, webhooks, and other supported communication methods.
  • Implement data mapping and transformation between Bask's platform and pharmacy systems.
  • Build reliable processes for synchronizing prescription and fulfillment information.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues involving prescription data, API requests, and integration failures.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve pharmacy-related application services.
  • Work with SQL databases and application data to support integration workflows.
  • Develop automated processes that reduce repetitive pharmacy integration tasks.
  • Implement validation to help ensure accurate data exchange between systems.
  • Build appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, and failure recovery processes.
  • Support secure authentication and authorization for pharmacy integrations.
  • Help maintain appropriate controls for sensitive healthcare information.
  • Monitor integration reliability, processing failures, and data synchronization issues.
  • Develop tools that improve visibility into pharmacy integration activity and system status.
  • Support technical discovery and implementation planning for new pharmacy connections.
  • Collaborate with pharmacy stakeholders to understand operational requirements and technical limitations.
  • Develop reusable integration components that support multiple pharmacy partners.
  • Write automated tests for important pharmacy integration workflows.
  • Document API requirements, data mappings, integration behavior, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of assigned pharmacy integration projects from development through deployment and maintenance.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, integrations engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a comparable hands-on technical role.
  • Strong programming experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or services using Node.js or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building integrations between software applications and third-party services.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and common integration patterns.
  • Experience developing and maintaining production software.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous processing and event-driven workflows.
  • Experience working with SQL databases and relational data.
  • Understanding of data mapping, transformation, and synchronization between systems.
  • Experience debugging and troubleshooting API and integration issues.
  • Ability to translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and secure API communication.
  • Understanding of application validation, error handling, and reliability.
  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, or troubleshooting tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern deployment practices.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience writing tests and maintaining software quality.
  • Strong attention to detail when working with structured data and interconnected systems.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues independently.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers, product managers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple technical priorities.
  • Ability to document integration requirements and implementation decisions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ownership of assigned projects.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Integration Engineer, or Healthcare Software Engineer.
  • Experience integrating pharmacy management systems or prescription processing platforms.
  • Familiarity with electronic prescribing and prescription transmission workflows.
  • Understanding of pharmacy fulfillment, dispensing, and order management processes.
  • Experience working with pharmacy partners or healthcare technology vendors.

In practice, you will:

  • translate target architecture into a sequenced rationalisation roadmap,
  • coordinate cross-domain and group-wide migrations from the architecture perspective,
  • stay actively involved in global programme and domain roadmaps to identify risks, dependencies and exceptions to target architecture,
  • influence decisions and roadmaps across domains and markets without having to own delivery directly.

Your impact will extend beyond a single product or application. You will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology transformation and global roadmaps, turning target architecture into concrete migration, rationalisation and decommissioning decisions.

If you enjoy making sense of complex technology landscapes, creating structure and then helping turn that structure into real change, we would like to hear from you.

You could be a great fit if...

You bring 6+ years of commercial experience in business analysis, software engineering, solution architecture or a related field.

Most importantly, you have participated in at least one cross-team system migration or decommissioning initiative on a global scale, end to end. You understand what it takes to move from architecture and planning to navigating dependencies across systems, teams and markets.

You will act as the gate through which every piece of creative passes before it reaches client Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) reviewers and again before it goes live. You'll review ads, landing pages, emails, social content, and video for MLR regulatory compliance, brand and design standards, and copy accuracy. Additionally, you’ll operate hands-on inside Veeva Vault PromoMats—managing claims, annotations, references, and submission packages—while building and refining the quality standards the creative team works against to raise the bar across the healthcare portfolio.

While your primary authority is quality and compliance, you’ll also support the creative production workflow by maintaining deliverable trackers, coordinating feedback cycles with client stakeholders, and trafficking tasks between the creative team and client POCs. As the Creative Project Manager and Account PM lead delivery management at scale, you will keep the creative lane organized and moving while ensuring nothing ships that shouldn’t.

  • Post-Approval Launch QA: Final quality proof of approved assets — landing pages, ads, emails, creative — before they go live, confirming that approved content was implemented correctly and no errors were introduced in production.

jobs.description:
About the team

Zillow's Broker and Agent Sales team provides software, media solutions and business consultation to growth-oriented real estate brokerages, teams and agents. We connect with our clients through insight and energy, as true partners in their business.

Dotloop is the market leader in real estate transaction management: a digital workspace where brokers, transaction coordinators, agents and their clients collaborate through the buying and selling process. Interactive forms, e-signatures, storage and compliance live in one place, so a brokerage can run every deal through dotloop instead of piecing tools together.

About the role

As a Sales Consultant on the dotloop SMB team, you will win new business with small and mid-sized brokerages, real estate teams and agents. You will start without an assigned book, build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, run discovery and full product demos over Zoom, and close deals that change how a brokerage runs its business. This is a consultative, full-cycle sale with no script: the product touches every transaction, deals take anywhere from a few weeks to a few months, and the biggest objection is usually resistance to change, so you will need strong discovery, quick thinking and a well-managed pipeline to close consistently. You will join a close-knit, remote team that celebrates wins, coaches hard and holds each other accountable, with a path to grow into our mid-market team.


You will get to

  • Prospect brokers, team leads, transaction coordinators and admins through calls, email and text, running a high-activity outbound day (about 75 to 100 activities and at least one demo a day).
  • Run discovery to understand each prospect's business, decision-makers and timeline, then deliver full 30-minute screen-share demos of dotloop over Zoom, positioning yourself as a real estate technology expert.
  • Own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to closed sale, typically 7 - 90 days, and keep a stacked pipeline so deals close consistently.
  • Qualify new prospect lists every day and build toward about 250 qualified accounts in active pipeline within your first 90 days.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline to meet or exceed monthly revenue goals and daily, weekly and monthly activity metrics.
  • Work across several sales systems every day, including Salesforce, Gong, Sonar, Hubspot and Zoom; keep your data clean, and speak up when systems don't connect.
  • Share what you hear in the market about competitors, trends and customer needs with sales leadership and sales operations.
  • Represent Zillow at industry events and team gatherings a few times a year.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $24.80 - $39.60 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $23.60 - $37.60 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation and equity awards. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.

Who you are

  • 2+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience.
  • A proven hunter who sources and builds their own pipeline, not only closing appointments someone else set, and can talk through activity, pipeline and attainment numbers.
  • Experienced with consultative sales and deals that take one to twelve months to close, not only high-volume transactional sales.
  • Coachable, accountable and motivated by your own goals and the team's.
  • Adaptable and energized by change.
  • Organized, with strong time management and attention to detail.
  • A confident presenter by phone, video and in person who gets to the point and thinks on their feet without a script.
  • Comfortable working remotely and willing to travel up to 10% of the time for in-person team gatherings and retreats.
  • Real estate experience is helpful but not required.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. We are a specialist project management consultancy supporting the development and delivery of major energy and infrastructure projects across England, Wales and Scotland.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Planning & Consents Project Manager to lead consenting work-streams for complex infrastructure projects from early concept and feasibility through application, examination, determination, pre-construction and Final Investment Decision (FID).

Working as part of integrated client and project teams, you will develop consenting strategies, coordinate multidisciplinary inputs and manage the programmes, risks, interfaces and stakeholders required to secure project approvals.

This is a project management and coordination role rather than a purely technical planning position.   • Manage planning consultants, legal advisers and other specialist suppliers

Requirements

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Bambara-English Phone Interpreter


Job Title: BambaraInterpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.50 - $0.65 per minute


We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:


The Bambara Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Bambaraand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inBambara and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

    • Kaspersky products.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.

jobs.description:
The Patient Journey Director CEERJ enables journey from first symptom to diagnosis, referral and appropriate care outcomes faster, clearer and fairer for people living with C3G/IC-MPGN and severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) across CEERJ.

The role is driven by a genuine passion for improving the patient journey. It identifies where patients are delayed, missed or lost, partners with country medical and commercial teams to understand why, and turns those barriers into practical, compliant and measurable initiatives. This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

The role operates in a fast-moving, changing environment. The holder works in an agile way: sets few clear priorities, adapts quickly as launches, access and evidence evolve, and turns insight into executive-ready plans that are communicated clearly to the Brand Teams, Leadership Teams and Core Medical Team.

Main responsibilities:

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

Partner with countries to map and clear barriers & opportunities. Work alongside country leaders and field teams to map country-specific barriers (awareness, testing access, laboratory and biopsy pathways, referral fragmentation, expert centre availability, non-pharmaceutical therapy optimization opportunities)

Build & resource executive plans. Develop concise, prioritized patient journey improvement projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and KPIs. Resource and adjust them rapidly as conditions change. Report progress to senior leadership in Core Medical Team, CEERJ LT and Brand Team forums.

Lead projects and matrix teams: drive relevant Patient Journey projects and allocated matrix teams from kick off to close out ensuring clear planning, budgeting, delivery and reporting on time and within budget

Lead integration of medical devices and enabling platforms. Lead integration of Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics and pipeline tools into patient journey frameworks across CEERJ. Ensure stakeholder value, country readiness and compliant use. Track adoption, escalate barriers and propose solutions.

Generate and act on patient journey insights. Interact with external community to enable systematic collection and synthesis of insights from HCPs, KOLs, diagnostic initiatives, patient organisations and country teams. Turn them into clear recommendations that change plans and decisions.

Mastery of the landscape. Keep current knowledge of C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG science, diagnostic pathways, competitive and customer landscape, Tier 1 KOLs and patient advocacy groups, and related areas such as PNH and haemophilia.

  • University degree such as M.D., Pharm. D., or PhD preferably with biological sciences background.
  • Academic, clinical or industry experience in therapeutic areas such as nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology or immunology
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in commercial field role or medical affairs at a local level from larger country, with recognized success internally and externally. Experience in Patient Access, Community Engagement or Diagnostics will be a plus
  • Strong business acumen and presentation / communication skills across all levels of organization within and outside country
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver results on time and within budget
  • Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point and other Microsoft Office programmes
  • Working knowledge of EFPIA regulations and compliance requirements with demonstration of highest ethical standards
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Highly motivated and self-driven with ability to think innovatively & strategically, skillfully plan, manage and prioritize multiple projects independently; demonstrates resilience and flexibility
  • Ability to work independently, while still maintaining a team and corporate approach to the function
  • Proactive, open minded, experienced leader, able to identify and carry out strategic initiatives with high patient impact in launches and life-cycle management
  • Strong business and scientific acumen, leadership skills, project management and scientific communication skills.

Additional requirement

  • Frequent regional and international travel is required, approximately 40% of working time.
  • Availability for external meetings, congresses and internal meetings outside standard hours with advance notice.
  • Valid driver's license may be required depending on local role set-up.
  • The role may be home-based or hybrid depending on country, local employment set-up and business requirements.
  • All activities must comply with applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, internal SOPs and Sobi policies.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day.

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of rare disease patients and our edge comes from our team of people.

Sobi offers the opportunity to work at an international pharmaceutical company focused on specialty pharmaceuticals meeting the high medical needs of rare disease patients and providing treatment and services to them. Our employees come from a variety of backgrounds within research, healthcare, industry and the academic sphere.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior UX Researcher to help Bask Health better understand how people interact with our software and support research that improves usability across the platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Junior UX Researcher, you'll help investigate how users navigate digital experiences, complete tasks, interpret information, and respond to different product designs.

This is an early-career research role focused on developing practical skills in usability testing, user interviews, research planning, observation, and qualitative analysis.

You'll work alongside experienced researchers, product designers, product managers, and engineers to understand user problems and identify opportunities to improve the product experience.

Your work may involve merchant onboarding, administrative dashboards, patient questionnaires, account settings, checkout experiences, and other workflows across the platform.

You'll help prepare research plans, develop interview questions, organize usability testing sessions, and document research findings.

You'll also have opportunities to participate in moderated usability studies, observe how users interact with prototypes, and identify areas where people encounter confusion or difficulty.

A key part of this role will be learning how to ask useful research questions, avoid leading participants, and distinguish observations from assumptions.

You'll support the analysis of qualitative research findings by organizing notes, identifying recurring patterns, and helping develop clear summaries.

You'll work with product designers to understand how research findings influence interface decisions.

You'll collaborate with product managers to learn how research priorities connect to product goals and development timelines.

You'll also work with engineers to understand how technical constraints and implementation decisions affect the user experience.

You'll become familiar with research tools, participant recruitment processes, research documentation, and the methods used to evaluate digital products.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to conduct research with appropriate attention to participant consent, privacy, sensitive information, and the boundaries of clinical workflows.

You'll receive guidance on research methodology and have opportunities to take increasing ownership of clearly defined research tasks as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious about human behavior, enjoys understanding how people use technology, and is motivated to develop into a strong UX researcher.

What You'll Do

  • Support UX research initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with planning and organizing usability studies.
  • Help develop research questions and study objectives.
  • Prepare interview guides and usability testing materials.
  • Support moderated user interviews and research sessions.

  • Take structured notes during research sessions.
  • Help document user behaviors, challenges, and feedback.
  • Assist with participant recruitment and screening through approved processes.
  • Support usability testing for merchant-facing software.
  • Help evaluate patient onboarding and questionnaire experiences.
  • Research how users navigate dashboards and administrative interfaces.
  • Assist with task-based usability evaluations.
  • Help identify confusing interactions and workflow friction.
  • Organize qualitative research notes and observations.
  • Support the identification of recurring themes and patterns.
  • Help prepare research summaries and presentations.
  • Collaborate with product designers to understand usability findings.
  • Work with product managers to understand research priorities.
  • Participate in product discovery and design review discussions.
  • Assist with prototype testing and concept evaluation.
  • Help evaluate interface comprehension and navigation clarity.
  • Learn how product analytics can complement qualitative research.
  • Support accessibility and inclusive research practices.
  • Follow appropriate research ethics, consent, and privacy procedures.
  • Maintain organized research files and documentation.
  • Contribute to reusable research templates and study materials.
  • Take ownership of assigned research tasks while seeking guidance when needed.

Requirements

  • Early-career candidate with 0–2 years of relevant experience in UX research, user research, human-computer interaction, behavioral research, or a related field.
  • Internship experience, academic research, freelance projects, or substantial independent research projects may be considered.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain research observations clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers.
  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking clarification.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.

  • Motivation to develop professionally as a UX researcher.

Nice to Have

jobs.description:
Description

Centralized monitoring is an integral part of risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.

The Principal Central Monitor is responsible for leading the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses essential for centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock. The Principal Central Monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level.

More specifically, the Principal Central Monitor must:

  • Lead effort on the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses within the area of specialty, including complex and collaborative approaches with other functions.
  • Lead the development and setup of study-specific tools, analyses, and centralized monitoring plans, ensuring that the monitoring approach is aligned with study risks, critical data, and critical processes.
  • Act as the strategic and technical lead for centralized monitoring across multiple studies and for function-wide initiatives, providing direction on complex analyses, resolving escalated issues, and establishing consistent approaches and standards.
  • Assist in creating tools, techniques and processes for automating risk-based monitoring tasks (data integration automation, data retrieval automation, data mapping automation, and automated report generation).
  • Act as mentor as well as train new team members and junior staff.
  • Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site level and track evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
  • Represent centralized monitoring in cross-functional study risk assessment meetings and provide expert guidance on identification, evaluation, prioritization, mitigation, and ongoing review of study risks.
  • Provide input to leadership as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.

Job Description

Agilent Technologies is seeking a strategic and operational leader to own the business vision, improvement roadmap, value governance, and business operating model for delegated Commercial processes.


In this role, you will partner closely with the commercial leadership teams, commercial operations, marketing, and IT to translate business strategy into scalable Salesforce solutions, modern go-to-market frameworks, AI-enabled capabilities, and disciplined agile delivery. You will establish and drive a cohesive roadmap that elevates commercial productivity, data integrity, revenue execution, and organizational effectiveness, balancing executive stakeholder engagement with hands-on operating-model leadership.

The ideal candidate combines deep commercial process expertise, Salesforce fluency, cross-functional influence, and change leadership with the ability to build and lead a high-performing, specialized team in a global matrix environment.


Business accountability and IT governance

This position sits within Commercial Operations and contributes to the continuous improvement of agreed commercial processes enabled by Salesforce. The role is accountable for its assigned business outcomes, delivery responsibilities, and compliance with enterprise controls.

The business pod owns business requirements, value-based prioritization, functional acceptance, adoption, and benefits measurement within its delegated scope. Qualified pod members may design, configure, develop, test, and document solutions in authorized environments using IT-approved standards and tools.


IT retains accountability for enterprise technical architecture, cybersecurity and identity controls, privileged access, environment and deployment controls, production change and release authorization, and production service operations, in coordination with applicable enterprise control owners.

Business acceptance does not authorize production deployment. Production configuration, code, integrations, security settings, and material data changes must follow the applicable IT-controlled change process. Execution may be delegated through documented, role-based authorization; control ownership and required independent review remain in place. Individuals may not independently approve and release their own changes.


The role will work with the designated IT platform and delivery leads through a shared backlog, agreed delivery arrangements, and defined escalation paths.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Roadmap & Operating Model

  • Define and execute a strategic roadmap that aligns Salesforce and integrated systems investments with commercial priorities.
  • Bridge strategy and technical delivery to own business accountability from problem definition through adoption and measured benefits, working with IT’s technical and service owners.
  • Establish business prioritization, acceptance, and readiness governance within the IT-owned release framework, including OKRs and decision rights, to ensure technology investments deliver transparent commercial impact.
  • Partner with commercial leadership to design performance metrics and operating mechanisms that increase accountability, visibility, and efficiency across the revenue engine.
  • Identify and drive opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate commercial processes as they are operationalized in Salesforce.
  • Set portfolio direction and resolve larger trade-offs on behalf of Commercial stakeholders.

Executive Partnership & Cross-Functional Governance

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to commercial executives on Salesforce-enabled process improvement, operational performance, and investment prioritization.
  • Translate complex business and technology considerations into clear recommendations, trade-off analyses, and actionable decisions for senior leadership.
  • Strengthen partnership models between Commercial Operations, IT, and other enterprise functions within a global matrix organization.
  • Build and develop a high-performing commercial systems capability that elevates delivery quality and stakeholder trust.

Process Excellence, Data Quality & Financial Stewardship

  • Sponsor data-quality outcomes and business reconciliation that keep Salesforce a trusted source of commercial truth.
  • Lead initiatives that improve process standardization and end-to-end commercial execution.
  • Optimize technology spend while protecting required capabilities, quality, and service levels; partner with Finance and Procurement on budgeting, forecasting, and commercial technology financial management.
  • Champion rigorous change management, stakeholder engagement, process documentation, and user adoption for new workflows and system capabilities.
  • Design and deliver structured train-the-trainer programs and knowledge transfer processes that equip Tier 1 and Tier 2 support leaders and their teams to confidently support new capabilities from day one of release.
  • Embed agile ways of working, continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and operational accountability across the team and stakeholder community.

Digital Transformation & AI Innovation

  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies that improve commercial decision-making and productivity.
  • Sponsor, prioritize, and validate approved AI use cases

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.

  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

jobs.title: Google Ads Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Thanks for stopping by! We’re Doctor Care Anywhere: (DCA) is the UK’s largest private provider of telehealth services. The Company works with insurers, healthcare providers and corporate customers to serve patients with a range of digitally enabled telehealth services on its proprietary platform.

DCA is committed to delivering the best possible patient experience and clinical care through digitally enabled, joined up, evidence-based pathways. DCA’s strategic ambition is to be the UK market leader in digitally enabled primary care, helping to meet the health needs of patients and payors in a challenging and fast changing environment.

What we are looking for? We are looking for Digital Prescribing Pharmacists who are able to commit to a minimum of 16 hours a week to provide virtual consultations via our intuitive platform, delivering high quality care to our patients.

Working as an autonomous non-medical independent prescriber, you will assess, diagnose and manage a wide range of primary care conditions, including minor ailments, long-term condition monitoring, medicines optimisation and complex polypharmacy reviews. This role is well-suited to individuals with a strong foundation in general practice or community primary care settings. In particular, experience diagnosing and managing minor illnesses would be beneficial.

Salary based on 40 hours FTE: £55,000

Salaried Sessions: We offer fixed shifts and sessions (minimum of 16 hours a week) that can be divided throughout the week based on your preferred hours, along with optional additional 'ad-hoc' shifts, from 8am-8pm across the week

Requirements

Clinical Practice

  • Conduct independent, autonomous consultations (video, telephone and asynchronous) for patients presenting with minor ailments and undifferentiated primary care conditions.
  • Assess, diagnose and manage acute presentations including URTIs, UTIs, skin conditions and ear, nose and throat conditions within agreed clinical scope.
  • Issue prescriptions independently as a qualified non-medical independent prescriber (NMP), in line with GPhC standards and DCA's prescribing governance framework.
  • Ability to review clinical information and prescribe asynchronously for a range of primary care conditions.
  • Refer appropriately to GPs, ACPs, or specialist services where presentations fall outside autonomous scope.

Medicines Safety & Governance

  • Adhere to DCA's clinical governance framework, including compliance with CQC standards and regulated activity requirements.
  • Contribute to medicines safety reviews, significant event analyses (SEAs) and audit activity as required.
  • Maintain accurate and contemporaneous clinical records using DCA's digital clinical systems, ensuring documentation meets medico-legal standards.
  • Support antibiotic stewardship initiatives and rational prescribing programmes across the clinical workforce.
  • Participate in regular clinical supervision, peer review, and quality assurance activities.

Education & Multidisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively within DCA's multidisciplinary clinical team, providing pharmacist expertise and medicines support to GPs, ACPs, and other clinicians.
  • Contribute to service improvement projects, clinical pathway development and digital innovation initiatives.
  • Attend DCA education and MDT events and engage with training opportunities in digital health at DCA.

Safeguarding

  • To promote a culture of patient – centred and good professional practice relating to the safeguarding of adults, young person’s and children at risk
  • To actively implement safeguarding protocols for children, young persons, and vulnerable adults and to know who to refer to and how to escalate concerns about radicalisation
  • To ensure that provisions in relation to all Mental Health Legislation including the Mental Health Act 2007, Mental Capacity Act 2005), are implemented in accordance with the legislative requirements, Codes of Practice requirements and National and Government Guidance

Education/Training/Experience

  • MPharm degree (or equivalent) with current registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC).
  • Qualified Independent Prescriber (IP) (1 year minimum independent prescribing experience) with annotation recorded on the GPhC register. Must be able to prescribe autonomously from day one.
  • Minimum 2 years' post-qualification experience working in a primary care setting (GP practice, PCN, community pharmacy with primary care contract, or equivalent).
  • Completed the CPPE Care Pharmacy Education Pathway
  • Demonstrable experience in autonomous management of minor ailments and undifferentiated primary care presentations without GP supervision
  • Experience conducting remote patient assessments (phone and video) (Desirable)

Knowledge/Skills

  • Proficiency with clinical IT systems (ideally with Jira and Teams/Slack).
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage deadlines
  • Commitment to patient-centred care and ongoing professional development.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to proficiently document patient consultations according to organizational policy and national guidelines
  • Ability to recognize individual learning needs and actively seek professional development opportunities in line with local and national frameworks (e.g., GPhC revalidation requirements).
  • Ability to act as a professional role model, demonstrating organizational values and behaviours.
  • Skill in sharing knowledge and evidence-based insights to support team development and quality care
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • A patient-centred approach ensuring high levels of patient satisfaction and clinical care.

Benefits

Why you want to work here:

We understand the importance of good health and happiness for our patients and our team is just the same. At our Doctor Care Anywhere, you're not just an employee; you're a valued member of our team. We believe in giving you the freedom to supercharge your career with us while feeling completely supported. Here's what you can look forward to when you join us:

🩺 Private Medical Insurance: We've got you covered including Opticians & Dental appointments!

👩‍⚕️ Doctor Care Anywhere subscription: For you and 5 of your family and friends, Get ready to enjoy health consultations on the go!

🏝️ 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays (FTE): You've earned it! Enjoy time off to recharge, explore, and make incredible memories.

🧘‍♂️ Buy' up to 5 days of additional annual leave (FTE) as part of our focus on health and wellbeing

🌳 Company Pension scheme planting a money tree for your future

🌈 Charity Days: Join us in giving back to the community! We're all about making a difference together.

👶 Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Pay: Extra support during this special time.

🚴 Bike2Work Scheme: We love an eco-friendly commute!

🏡 Remote Working: Work where you're comfortable.

🚀 Development Opportunities: Get ready to grow, learn, and make strides in your career!

🌍 30-Day Work Abroad Allowance Take your laptop overseas and work for up to 30 days a year.

Plus, if you're in a clinical role, you'll enjoy some extra perks like:

Insurance: For any DCA related work you will be covered with medical indemnity.

Your Hours, Your Way: Enjoy flexible hours that work around your other commitments with the ability to split sessions.

Instant Help: Get live support during your shift via instant messaging.

Top-Notch Training: Learn from the best with high-quality training and guidance from experienced clinicians.

Top Marks: We're all about quality and security – ISO9001 & ISO27001 accredited.

The Senior Manager, Global Procurement Strategy will work directly with the VP of Data Center Procurement to shape, drive, and scale the global procurement strategy supporting IREN's expanding data center portfolio.

This role blends strategic thinking with strong analytical rigor — translating business priorities, market intelligence, and performance data into the frameworks, plans, and materials that guide procurement decisions across regions. Operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, the Senior Manager will play a central role in building procurement into a scalable, globally consistent function, while acting as a trusted right hand to the VP on strategic priorities, executive communications, and cross-regional coordination.

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Global Procurement Strategy & Planning
  • Partner directly with the VP to develop, refine, and operationalize the global procurement strategy across data center categories and regions.
  • Translate strategic priorities into structured plans, frameworks, and roadmaps that regional and category teams can execute against.
  • Track progress against strategic initiatives and flag risks, gaps, or resourcing needs to leadership.
Expansion & Scaling Support
  • Support the design of procurement processes, governance, and tools needed to scale as IREN enters new markets and grows its data center footprint.
  • Coordinate readiness activities for new-market entry — supplier landscape assessment, category strategy input, and process standardization.
  • Identify where regional practices diverge and drive alignment toward a consistent global operating model.
Market & Business Intelligence
  • Research and synthesize market conditions, supplier capacity, competitive benchmarks, and category trends relevant to global expansion.
  • Build business cases, cost/benefit analyses, and comparative assessments to support key sourcing and strategic decisions.
  • Monitor spend, savings, and pipeline data across regions to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Executive Reporting & Communication
  • Prepare board- and leadership-ready materials, briefing documents, and presentations for the VP on strategy, performance, and expansion progress.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting on global procurement KPIs, category performance, and strategic initiative tracking.
  • Represent the VP's office in select cross-functional forums, ensuring alignment and follow-through on action items.
Cross-Functional & Regional Coordination
  • Act as a connective point between global strategy and regional/category execution teams (Sourcing, Category Management, Site Operations, Project Management).
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, HSE, and Technical teams to align procurement strategy with broader business and project timelines.
  • Support governance cadences (QBRs, leadership reviews, strategy check-ins) across geographies.
Process & Capability Development
  • Help standardize procurement strategy templates, planning tools, and reporting frameworks as the function scales globally.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and data visualization to improve strategic decision-making.
  • Contribute to building institutional knowledge and best practices as new team members and regions come online.

Key Responsibilities:

Required:
  • 5–8 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, management consulting, or a related strategy/analytics role.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior leadership with strategic planning, business cases, or executive-level reporting.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience building executive-facing presentations and materials.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced, high-growth, evolving environment.

  • Familiarity with ERP/procurement systems (e.g., Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).

  • Background in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or a chief-of-staff-style function.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own AI-driven short-form video creative for a well-established clinical skincare brand with a strong presence across Southeast Asia.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own AI-driven short-form video creative for a well-established clinical skincare brand with a strong presence across Southeast Asia. You will start from a script or outline for each video, storyboard it from the brand's product and video catalog, and turn it into finished social content in the style beauty brands are producing with AI today, matched to the brand's look. Sometimes the starting point will be a vague concept, and you will turn that into a finished video too.

This role sits closer to a creative director or creative manager who also makes the work than to a pure editor. The brand team is short on capacity, which is why they are hiring overseas, so they need someone self-sufficient who does not need babysitting. You will study the brand's website and Instagram on your own, pick up its look and voice quickly, and get it right the first time. Constant rework costs time and AI generation credits, so a fast read on the brand matters. If you are fluent in AI video editing, have the tools you need, and can take a loose idea to a polished, on-brand video without hand-holding, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • Work on content for a globally recognized skincare brand with an active and growing Southeast Asian social media presence
  • High-ownership creative role with real autonomy over concept, storyboard, and finished output

What You'll Work On

Creative Direction and Storyboarding

  • Start from a script or outline for each video and develop it into a clear concept and storyboard
  • Take a vague video concept and turn it into a finished video without waiting for detailed direction
  • Storyboard from the brand's product and video catalog so every video is grounded in real products and existing brand assets
  • Study the brand's website and Instagram on your own to understand its look, tone, and audience, and apply it correctly the first time

AI Video Production

  • Produce AI-driven short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other platforms in the style beauty and skincare brands are publishing now, matched to the brand's look
  • Use AI video and image tools fluently across ideation, generation, editing, and finishing
  • Cut, reformat, and enhance assets into finished, platform-ready content with motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound design
  • Produce approximately 100 finished videos per month consistently and on schedule
  • Do not use AI to generate human faces, skin, or realistic human imagery of any kind; all human and skin visuals must come from brand-provided assets

Quality, Efficiency, and Self-Management

  • Get the brand right the first time to avoid constant rework that burns time and AI generation credits
  • Work with your own AI tools and platforms and keep your workflow current as new tools emerge
  • Run your own projects with minimal supervision and flag asset gaps or brief issues early
  • Organize files and deliver finished videos in the correct formats for each platform

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Fluency in AI video editing and generation tools, with a portfolio of AI-driven short-form content
  • Proven ability to take a vague concept and turn it into a finished, on-brand video
  • Creative direction instincts including concepting, storyboarding, and the taste to make confident creative decisions
  • Ability to study a brand's website and social presence and quickly absorb its look and voice
  • Self-sufficiency: you need little training and do not need babysitting
  • Your own AI tools and platforms, ready to use from day one
  • Strong short-form editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar platforms
  • Understanding of the limits on AI use, including no AI-generated human faces or skin
  • Speed and efficiency at high volume without sacrificing quality
  • Organized and reliable with consistent on-time delivery
  • Available to work during Southeast Asia business hours

Nice to Have

  • Beauty, premium skincare, or makeup experience, since those candidates tend to know how to tell the story
  • Experience creating AI content for beauty or consumer lifestyle brands
  • Mandarin language skills for supporting Chinese-language content production
  • Familiarity with Southeast Asian social media audiences and platform trends
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic animation for social media content
  • Background producing content for Instagram Reels or TikTok at scale

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link showing at least 4 to 6 finished AI-driven short-form videos, ideally in a beauty or premium consumer style
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your AI video workflow and tools, and walking through one video you took from a vague concept to a finished piece, including your storyboard and creative decisions

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short homework assignment: take a loosely defined video concept and turn it into a finished video.

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a self-sufficient creative who can turn a loose idea into an on-brand AI video without hand-holding, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare clinic setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare clinic setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi’s technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a Senior Product Designer on our Patient Journey team, you’ll own the patient-facing flows that turn first-time visitors into patients who start and stay in treatment. Your design decisions show up directly in our conversion and retention numbers, not just in the mockups.

You’ll be the dedicated designer for the Patient Journey squad, partnering daily with a product manager, frontend and backend engineers, QA, and a data analyst, and reporting to our Director of Product. You own patient-facing flows end to end, from early prototype through validation to a shipped, measurable result in a HIPAA-regulated, AI-first environment where both speed and clarity matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own patient-facing conversion flows end to end, from framing the problem through prototyping, validation, and shipped design.
  • Design flows that clearly communicate MEDvidi’s care model and move patients toward the next step, anticipating their real questions and objections.
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to break “too hard / too long” down into shippable tests that launch in weeks.
  • Dig into product analytics and user research yourself to tie every design decision to a concrete metric: conversion, activation, or retention.
  • Use AI tools to prototype quickly, iterate with your PM, and validate ideas against real users before anything goes to build.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • Senior-level product design experience (5+ years) with a strong track record of owning user-facing B2C conversion flows.
  • Demonstrable conversion ownership: you can point to a specific flow where you owned a metric, know the before/after numbers, and can explain your own contribution versus seasonality or marketing.
  • Outcome-driven: comfortable pulling your own data (Amplitude, GA, Metabase, or similar) and running or reading research, rather than waiting for hand-offs.
  • Ownership mindset: you break engineering constraints down to the atoms, negotiate scope, and ship meaningful tests fast.
  • AI as a working tool: fluent with at least one prototyping/AI tool (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Cursor, Claude, or similar) and clear-eyed about where AI should and shouldn’t be used.
  • Fluent Russian and solid working English (B2+)

Would be a plus

  • Experience with regulated or healthcare/telehealth products (HIPAA, NIST).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.
