jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, merchant success is about helping businesses make the most of the platform. We value strong relationships, clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of helping merchants succeed.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Merchant Success Manager to help Bask Health's merchants successfully launch, operate, and grow their businesses using our platform.

This role is responsible for managing long-term relationships with merchants and helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through product adoption, operational improvements, and ongoing support.

You'll serve as a primary post-sale relationship owner for a portfolio of merchants, including entrepreneurs, direct-to-consumer operators, and businesses building telehealth experiences.

Our merchants use Bask Health to manage important parts of their businesses, including storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, and pharmacy-related processes.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how these different platform capabilities connect to the merchant's overall business.

You'll help new merchants navigate onboarding, understand available features, and establish workflows that support their business goals.

You'll work closely with merchants as they move from initial setup into active operations and ongoing growth.

As a senior member of the team, you'll manage merchants with more complex needs, higher business impact, or greater operational requirements.

You'll build relationships with merchant founders, business owners, operators, and other key stakeholders.

You'll learn how each merchant acquires customers, manages its online storefront, handles the customer journey, and evaluates business performance.

You'll use that understanding to provide practical recommendations for improving platform adoption and operational efficiency.

You'll proactively identify opportunities for merchants to make better use of available platform features.

You'll help merchants understand how storefront configuration, questionnaire experiences, checkout workflows, and other capabilities affect their operations.

You'll work with internal teams when merchants encounter technical issues, product limitations, or workflow challenges.

You'll coordinate with product, engineering, customer support, and relevant operations teams to resolve issues and keep merchants informed.

You'll be expected to take ownership of escalations and maintain clear communication until issues are appropriately addressed.

You'll monitor merchant engagement, product usage, and account health to identify potential risks.

You'll proactively reach out to merchants who may be struggling with adoption, experiencing operational challenges, or showing signs of disengagement.

You'll develop retention plans that address merchant concerns and support long-term relationships.

You'll participate in or own renewal discussions within Bask Health's approved commercial processes.

You'll also identify opportunities for merchants to expand their use of the platform when additional capabilities align with their business needs.

You'll work with sales and leadership on commercial expansion opportunities when appropriate.

You'll conduct merchant business reviews to discuss progress, adoption, operational challenges, and future priorities.

You'll use available performance data and customer feedback to guide your recommendations.

You'll maintain accurate records of merchant interactions, account health, renewal timelines, and follow-up commitments.

You'll also help identify recurring merchant issues and recommend improvements to onboarding materials, support processes, and customer success playbooks.

You'll share merchant feedback with product and engineering teams to help inform future improvements.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to recognize when an issue should be handled by the appropriate clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or technical team rather than providing guidance outside your responsibilities.

You may also support the development of internal merchant success processes and share best practices with less-experienced team members.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant merchant account ownership, not a formal people-management position.

We're looking for someone with strong post-sale customer success experience and recent, substantive experience supporting e-commerce merchants or merchant-facing software platforms.

You should understand how online businesses operate and be comfortable discussing merchant challenges, customer journeys, retention, and growth.

You'll need to be proactive, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable managing multiple merchant relationships.

Success in this role means helping merchants adopt the platform effectively, resolve challenges, maintain healthy accounts, and build sustainable businesses.

  • Own a portfolio of merchant accounts throughout the post-sale customer lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned merchants.
  • Build strong relationships with merchant founders, business owners, and operational stakeholders.
  • Lead merchant onboarding and coordinate successful transitions from sales.
  • Help merchants understand and adopt relevant Bask Health platform capabilities.
  • Develop merchant success plans aligned with business goals.
  • Understand merchant business models, storefront operations, and growth priorities.
  • Guide merchants through platform setup and operational adoption.
  • Support merchants in understanding storefront and checkout capabilities.
  • Help merchants identify opportunities to improve their platform workflows.
  • Monitor merchant engagement, product usage, and account health.
  • Identify merchants at risk of churn and develop proactive retention plans.
  • Own or coordinate renewal preparation and customer discussions.
  • Identify opportunities for merchant account expansion.
  • Collaborate with sales on appropriate commercial growth opportunities.
  • Conduct regular merchant business reviews.
  • Discuss adoption, operational performance, challenges, and next steps with merchants.
  • Manage complex merchant escalations and coordinate internal resolution.
  • Work with product and engineering teams to address technical issues.
  • Coordinate with pharmacy and operations teams when merchant issues involve relevant workflows.
  • Communicate clearly with merchants during troubleshooting and escalation processes.
  • Gather merchant feedback and share product improvement opportunities.
  • Identify recurring challenges in merchant onboarding and adoption.
  • Recommend improvements to merchant success playbooks and processes.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, account notes, and follow-up commitments.
  • Track merchant renewal timelines and account risks.
  • Help merchants understand new platform features and product updates.
  • Support merchants through changes in available platform capabilities.
  • Use available account data to guide recommendations and prioritize outreach.
  • Share best practices with other merchant success team members.
  • Collaborate across teams to improve the overall merchant experience.
  • Take ownership of merchant outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant customer success, merchant success, account management, or closely related post-sale experience.
  • At least 2 full years of genuine post-sale customer success ownership.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, or expansion.

The Senior Director, People Operations leads Ciena’s global HR technology, HRIS, and employee-services functions (People Connect). This leader owns the HR technology roadmap, modernizes the HR tech stack, and drives responsible adoption of AI and automation.

The role ensures employees and managers receive efficient, consistent, high-quality support across the employee lifecycle. It requires strategic HR-operations expertise, technology and product management skills, process-improvement discipline, and strong change leadership.

HR Technology and HRIS

  • Own the global HR technology strategy, roadmap, architecture, budget, vendors, and delivery governance.

Employee Services and Shared Services

  • Design an employee-services model that balances global consistency, local relevance, self-service, and high-touch support.

  • Use process mapping, journey design, and continuous improvement to reduce friction, rework, and resolution time.
  • Manage service metrics (case volume, first-contact resolution, resolution time, backlog, quality, satisfaction, cost per case, self-service adoption).

  • Influence executives, regional leaders, and partners with data; manage competing priorities.

  • Process-improvement expertise (Lean, Six Sigma, service design) and practical experience scaling AI, automation, chatbots, or RPA.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced fire protection professional with a strong background in fire and life safety plan review to join Aoka. Plans Examiners review architectural and fire protection plans for compliance with the International Fire Code (IFC), International Building Code (IBC), applicable NFPA standards, and local amendments, helping ensure buildings are designed to protect occupants and first responders. This is a flexible, remote, part-time role paid at $40 to $50 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

Work is assigned on an as-needed basis depending on project availability, and you can accept assignments based on your workload. There are no guaranteed minimum hours.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review architectural and fire protection plans for compliance with the IFC, IBC, applicable NFPA standards, and local amendments
  • Evaluate fire sprinkler, standpipe, and fire pump submittals, including hydraulic calculations (NFPA 13, 13R, 13D, 14, and 20)
  • Review fire alarm and detection system plans, including device layout, notification, and battery calculations (NFPA 72)
  • Verify means of egress, including occupant load, exit capacity, travel distance, and exit signage and lighting
  • Assess fire-resistance-rated construction, fire barriers, opening protectives, and penetration firestopping
  • Review fire apparatus access, hydrant placement, fire flow, and special hazards such as hazardous materials, kitchen hood suppression, and smoke control
  • Prepare clear, accurate review comments and required corrections in VertexPlans
  • Coordinate with designers, contractors, developers, fire marshals, and building officials to resolve review comments
  • Use VertexPlans for project tracking, documentation, communication, and report submission
  • Consistently meet established turnaround times while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Strong technical command of the IFC, IBC, and NFPA 13, 14, 72, and 101
  • Working knowledge of Texas fire code adoption and local fire marshal requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort using digital plan review and reporting tools
  • Ability to manage a flexible schedule and meet review deadlines independently

Education and Experience

  • Active ICC or TCFP Fire Plans Examiner certification required
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in fire plan review
  • Prior experience performing fire plan reviews for municipalities preferred
  • Availability to work part-time on an as-needed basis remotely

Physical Requirements

  • Extended periods of working on a computer to review plans and prepare comments
  • Ability to review detailed drawings and documents on screen for long periods
  • Ability to communicate by phone, email, and video with project teams

Why Work With Us

  • Competitive pay of $40 to $50 per hour, based on experience and qualifications
  • Dollar-for-dollar company match up to 5% of employee contributions (subject to plan eligibility)
  • Work remotely with flexible, project-based assignments
  • Accept assignments based on project availability and your workload
  • Work alongside experienced engineers, code officials, fire marshals, and development professionals
  • Meaningful work helping shape safer communities through fire and life safety

About Aoka

Aoka is a government services provider offering full building department support to more than 80 cities across Texas and several beyond the state. Our services include planning and zoning, building and fire plan review, civil plan review, and building, fire, and health inspections. At the federal level, we support HUD and OHP programs. Aoka gives agencies the expertise and capacity to keep projects moving, enforce codes consistently, and protect public safety. Our proprietary software, VertexPlans, streamlines plan reviews, inspections, and reporting—ensuring faster turnaround times and better communication for our clients.

Our Values: Continuous Improvement | Diversity of Thought | Empathy | Focus

Our Vision: Using technology to reshape construction.

Apply Now to Join Our Team!

Aoka is an equal opportunity employer (EEO), providing fair employment to all applicants and employees.

Job Title

Associate Director, Occupier Sustainability RFP & Sales

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Job Description Summary

The Associate Director (AD) is an experienced sales and proposal professional with 10+ years of experience in sales for energy management, facilities management, sustainability consulting, real estate services or professional services business development. This person will work in close partnership with Occupier Sustainability leadership and will be the primary driver of RFP and proposal support and sustainability sales across our Americas Occupier business, which includes sustainability work primarily within large facilities management contracts. This role manages the RFP process end-to-end, turns input from subject matter experts into a cohesive, compelling pitch, and sells our portfolio of sustainability services to existing and prospective Occupier accounts. The AD will identify and convert cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts, support sales pitches, and build repeatable tools and processes that improve win rates and accelerate growth for the sustainability business.


Job Description


RFP and Proposal Management

  • Manage the RFP, RFI and RFQ process end-to-end for Occupier sustainability pursuits (primarily for integrated facilities management): qualify opportunities, develop the response plan and timeline, assign owners and drive to on-time, compliant submissions
  • Write, edit and refine proposal content, including executive summaries, technical approach, scope of services, pricing narrative, credentials and team bios, so that each response is clear, persuasive and tailored to the client
  • Synthesize input from sustainability, energy, engineering, facilities management, project management and transactions experts into a cohesive, differentiated pitch with clear win themes
  • Develop and maintain a library of proposal content, including case studies, credentials, references and templates, and keep it accurate, current and on brand
  • Prepare pursuit teams for finalist presentations and orals, including pitch decks, Q&A preparation and rehearsals
  • Track pursuit outcomes, run win/loss debriefs and apply lessons learned to improve future responses

Sales and Account Growth

  • Sell the full range of our sustainability consulting services across the Occupier network, such as decarbonization and net-zero roadmaps, energy and utility management, greenhouse gas inventories and sustainability reporting, and building certifications
  • Partner with Occupier account leaders and facilities management, and project management teams to identify whitespace and convert cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts
  • Understand client contract structures, sustainability goals and reporting requirements, and translate them into tailored service proposals and compelling value propositions
  • Support discovery conversations, sales pitches and scoping discussions with client sustainability, real estate and procurement stakeholders, in coordination with Occupier Sustainability leadership and other subject matter experts
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities in the CRM, and provide accurate pursuit forecasts and status updates to leadership
  • Strategically reinforce the company’s market presence through targeted industry networking, conferences and presentations

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Occupier Sustainability leadership to set pursuit priorities, shape win strategies and align on pricing and positioning
  • Coordinate with subject matter experts, marketing, legal, pricing and finance to secure inputs and approvals on proposals and contracts
  • Build relationships across the business (account management, project management, FM, procurement etc.) to keep sustainability top of mind in client conversations

Special Projects

  • Conduct market research, continually refine our understanding of the competitive landscape and identify opportunities and risks for the Occupier sustainability business
  • Develop sales and pursuit tools, such as service one-pagers, pitch templates, pricing guides and playbooks, so the broader network can sell sustainability services effectively
  • Develop pursuit and sales performance KPIs and reporting for executive leadership, such as pipeline, win rate, response turnaround and revenue
  • Review and refresh processes and strategies as necessary to optimize resources, win rates and client outcomes

Required Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience; Business Administration, Engineering or sustainability-related major preferred
  • Expertise in energy management and sustainability
  • Requires 10+ years of professional experience
  • Desired: experience and knowledge of energy and facilities management within commercial real estate

Key Competencies

  • Interpersonal skills
  • Oral and written communication skills
  • Conflict management
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Managing through Change
  • Business Acumen
  • Financial Acumen
  • Relationship Management
  • Partnership Development
  • Change Management
  • Ability to influence stakeholders
  • Decisiveness, accountability, ownership
  • Action-oriented

Requirements

  • Travel 25-30% time for client sales.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a B2B Paid Media Senior Manager to our Marketing team in Brazil!

This role joins the Revenue Marketing team and focuses on our largest market, Brazil. You will lead our digital marketing initiatives across paid channels and use AI to increase demand generation, lead generation, awareness, and engagement for Wellhub. You will report to the Global Paid Media Director and work closely with the marketing, paid media, and creative teams. You will also manage end-to-end execution of ABM/hyper-targeted, awareness, lead gen, and full-funnel campaigns on LinkedIn, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and more. The role is hands-on: you will design campaigns, analyze performance, and optimize strategy. You will also build, motivate, and lead an in-house Paid Media team in Brazil. The work centers on high-priority strategic projects with visibility to senior leadership.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own the Paid Media strategy for Brazil and its role in the overall marketing strategy, in partnership with regional marketing leadership.
  • Drive the region's targets (cost per MQL, CPA, ROAS, lead and MQL quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and B2B pipeline and revenue), focusing on profitable results at scale and on lead quality over volume.
  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution across Google and Microsoft Ads (Bing), paid social (Meta and LinkedIn), retargeting, display, and DV360 for SMB and Enterprise audiences.
  • Build retargeting and lookalike audiences from our HubSpot database, and connect ad platform data to the CRM so we can measure quality through MQL, SQL, and pipeline.
  • Run growth experiments, full-funnel B2B campaigns, attribution analysis, and A/B tests, including user-generated content ads and static ad testing on paid social.
  • Embed AI in daily work, from campaign analysis and audience discovery to creative testing, reporting automation, and forecasting. Claude is our primary tool, and you will use our AI Library and internal Paid Media tools. Design the tests that show when platform AI features (Performance Max, AI Max, Meta Advantage+, LinkedIn predictive audiences) beat manual setups.
  • Bring a strategic view that goes beyond what AI suggests: analyze results and propose hypotheses of your own.
  • Establish how the team uses AI responsibly (data privacy, brand safety, quality checks, human sign-off). Build AI-enabled workflows, prompts, and agents, and share them with other regions through the team's AI Library.
  • Lead, motivate, and develop the in-house team in Brazil. Coach them to build AI fluency and measure the gains in speed, efficiency, and performance.
  • Partner with marketing, creative, data analytics, and sales (including SDRs), and build trust with senior stakeholders. Report results, keep everyone aligned with the Regional Marketing team, and represent Paid Media in global and regional forums, including our bi-weekly global Paid Media meeting.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • This role is fully remote and open to candidates based in Brazil. All team members may join occasional in-person meetings or offsites, about once or twice per quarter.
  • A B2B paid media leader with at least 7 years of hands-on experience driving growth and strategy through paid channels.
  • A results-driven marketer with a proven record of managing budget and goals at scale, who looks past CPL and CPA to lead quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and pipeline.
  • A people leader with experience managing paid media team members and leading B2B paid media strategy.
  • A multi-channel B2B expert with proven success on Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn, including audience segmentation.
  • Experienced with a CRM such as HubSpot, and aware of how tracking and conversion setup affect campaign optimization.
  • A curious, test-and-learn builder with hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) and platform AI features, and the judgment to know when to trust AI output and when to check it.
  • An analytical thinker with strong skills in Google Sheets or Excel (models, forecasts, pivot tables) and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio.
  • A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who solves problems and works well both independently and in a team in a fast-growing company, across time zones (UK, Brazil, US, Argentina).
  • A confident communicator with advanced English (written and spoken) and presentation skills. English is mandatory, as our global team works in English.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B paid media (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), advanced English, and experience managing paid media teams are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build the data foundation that Lyric's products run on.Data Platform team owns the canonical data model for Lyric's core healthcare data domains, the framework that ingests, transforms, validates, and serves that data across a multi-tenant platform, and the quality guarantees our consuming teams build against. Our stack is Snowflake, Airflow, dbt, and Python.

This is a hands-on building role. You will design and deliver pipelines within our unified framework, implement the canonical data model in production, build validation and observability into the data path rather than around it, and help consuming teams get what they need without a bespoke build every time. You will work closely with our Principal Data Engineer, who sets architectural direction, and you will be expected to contribute to that direction.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and own data pipelines in our unified framework using Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake.

  • Implement the canonical data model in production, working within the architecture set by the Principal Data Engineer and contributing to it based on what implementation reveals.

  • Build automated validation and data quality checks into pipelines at defined stages, so that defects are caught before they reach consumers.

  • Instrument pipelines for observability, including freshness, lineage, and failure alerting.

  • Contribute to self-service capability that allows consuming teams to declare the data they need and receive it as governed output rather than a custom build.

  • Partner directly with consuming teams across invoicing, analytics, and reporting to understand their requirements and translate them into data they can rely on.

  • Migrate and consolidate existing data workloads onto the unified framework without disrupting the consumers depending on them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation for pipeline and data quality incidents, and in the incident reviews that make fixes permanent.

  • Hold a high engineering bar: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation that stays current.

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Strong Snowflake experience, including streams and tasks, warehouse sizing and performance tuning, SQL optimization, and working knowledge of RBAC, clustering, and micro-partitions.

  • Production experience with dbt and Airflow, including how to structure models and DAGs so that someone else can maintain them.

  • Strong programming expertise in Python and deep SQL proficiency.

  • Solid data modeling skills, with experience designing schemas that serve more than one consumer and the judgment to know when a requirement belongs in the shared model versus a consumer-specific extension.

  • Experience building testing and data quality validation into pipelines rather than checking data after the fact.

  • Disciplined engineering practices: version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD applied as a matter of course.

  • Ability to work directly with non-engineering consumers of data, understand what they actually need, and communicate constraints and tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred

  • Experience modeling data that changes over time: event history, corrections and restatements, and the difference between point-in-time and as-of reporting.

  • Familiarity with Datadog or comparable observability tooling applied to data pipelines.

  • Experience building internal tooling or platforms that other teams use directly.

jobs.excerpt: About SwimplySwimply is the marketplace that lets homeowners rent out their private pools, hot tubs, courts and backyards by the hour.
jobs.description:
About Swimply

Swimply is the marketplace that lets homeowners rent out their private pools, hot tubs, courts and backyards by the hour. Thousands of hosts across the United States and Canada use Swimply to share space they already own with families and small groups in their community.

Because hourly backyard rentals are new, most local codes were written before they existed. Towns, counties, health departments and homeowners associations regularly try to fit Swimply into rules written for hotels, public pools, home businesses or overnight short-term rentals. We are building a dedicated regulatory function to manage those matters at scale and to move the rules in our favor, state by state.

You will own the day-to-day operation of the program and work directly with our General Counsel, our CEO, our Head of Operations and the outside lobbyists and local counsel we retain.

The Role

The Regulatory Affairs Manager runs Swimply's regulatory program end to end. Half of the job is operational: every notice a host or the company receives is logged, answered and tracked to a close. The other half is strategic: finding the bills, partners and officials that let us fix the rules for a whole state at once instead of town by town.

What You Will Do

Run the notice program

  • Own the regulatory intake: the regulatory inbox, the host reporting form and escalations from the Host Success team.
  • Log every cease-and-desist letter, notice of violation, HOA demand and listing takedown in the regulatory tracker, by state, city, issuing agency and legal theory.
  • Sort each matter by the theory being used against us: public pool classification, home occupation or zoning, short-term rental rules, business licensing and tax, or HOA covenants.
  • Send the approved standard response to the host or code officer, and follow up until the matter is closed or escalated.
  • Escalate to the General Counsel within one business day anything involving a subpoena, a records demand, a lawsuit, criminal exposure or a threat to a whole market.
  • Publish a weekly regulatory report for the CEO and General Counsel: new notices, open matters, trends and recommended next steps.

Change the rules, state by state

  • Track bills and ordinances in our priority states, starting with New Jersey, New York, California and Texas, and flag any short-term rental or health-code bill our language could be added to.
  • Keep our model state bill and model city ordinance current.
  • Prepare the testimony, one-pagers, fact sheets and talking points our lobbyists and executives use with legislators and staff.
  • Reach out directly to selected city planning, code enforcement and health departments to explain our safety standards before a problem starts.
  • Manage outside firms and budget.
  • Day-to-day manager for our lead lobbying firm, state lobbyists and local zoning counsel: scopes, weekly updates, deadlines and invoices.
  • Build and maintain a bench of zoning counsel and lobbyists in each problem state, ready for when a matter escalates.
  • Own the regulatory budget against the plan the board approves, and give leadership a clear cost-versus-outcome view before any new engagement is signed.

Build allies

  • Represent Swimply in short-term rental coalitions, state chambers of commerce, realtor associations and pool and spa industry groups.
  • Recruit and prepare hosts to speak at hearings and council meetings.

Keep us compliant

  • Handle lobbying registrations and periodic disclosure filings at the state and city level.
  • Support Finance on offers to collect and remit local taxes in jurisdictions that confirm our legality in writing.
  • Research permit, occupancy and licensing requirements for new products and new markets, including Canada, and brief the General Counsel and product teams.
  • Pull and organize platform data when counsel needs it to respond to a government request.

Requirements

Required

  • 5 to 8 years in government affairs, public policy, regulatory operations or local government.
  • Hands-on experience with how state legislatures and city councils actually move a bill or ordinance: committees, staff, hearings and timing.
  • Experience managing outside vendors such as lobbying firms or consultants, including scopes and budgets.
  • Clear, plain-English writing. You can turn a zoning code section into a one-page explanation a homeowner or council member understands.
  • A system for high volume. You keep dozens of open matters across many states moving without losing one.
  • Calm, professional manner with code officers, health inspectors, HOA boards and frustrated hosts.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Policy or government affairs work at a sharing-economy or marketplace company, such as short-term rentals, space rentals, ride-share or car-sharing.
  • Experience as a legislative or council staffer, or in a city planning, zoning, code enforcement or public health department.
  • Existing relationships in New Jersey, New York, California or Texas.
  • Prior registration as a lobbyist, or experience handling lobbying disclosure filings.
  • Familiarity with pool safety, public health or short-term rental regulation.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreDecentralized Masters is an investment education and research company.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Decentralized Masters is an investment education and research company. We went from two co-founders to 160+ people and 4,500+ paying members in four years, bootstrapped and profitable. Our business is built on continuity: high-ticket and low-ticket programmes that are membership-based, with payment plans, renewals, upsells and a paid newsletter. We have never taken outside capital. Our growth is still heavily direct-response: paid media on Facebook, YouTube and Google feeds the webinars, calls and offers that fund everything we do.

Our vision is to become the gold standard in investment education and research.

Read This Before You Go Further

This is a hands-on leadership role with real numbers attached. You work directly with the VP of Acquisition, own the performance of paid media day to day, and are accountable for cost per qualified call, CAC, allowable acquisition cost and payback. You lead and optimize a team rather than build one from scratch, and you are expected to stay close to the data and the creative.

We move at an uncomfortable pace. If you need consensus before you test, or you have never owned an acquisition budget, this is not the right seat.

Why This Role Exists

Acquisition is the cash engine of Decentralized Masters, and low-ticket is the basis of the group's future growth. High-ticket and low-ticket are both continuity-based, membership-focused products, so a customer's value depends on retention, upsell and renewal as much as on the first sale. A change of a few points in cost per qualified call, close rate or retention is worth millions of dollars a year.

The Director of Acquisition gives the VP of Acquisition a senior operator who runs paid media and funnel performance every day, so the VP can focus on channel strategy, partnerships and the wider acquisition mix.

Concretely, you will:

  • Run paid acquisition across Facebook, YouTube, Google and emerging channels, at budgets exceeding $1M per month.
  • Scale both high-ticket and low-ticket funnels profitably.
  • Find and fix the leaks between first impression, booked call or first purchase, show, close, upsell and renewal.
  • Set and hold allowable acquisition costs from retention, upsell and renewal data.
  • Build the creative, testing and analytics rhythm that finds the next winning angle before the current one fatigues.
  • Lead and optimize the paid media and funnel team.
  • Work with the VP, sales and compliance so growth is effective and defensible in a financial, investment-related category.

What You Will Own

1. Paid Acquisition Performance (Primary)

  • Develop, execute and optimize paid strategy across Facebook, YouTube, Google Ads and emerging channels.
  • Decide where the next dollar goes within the VP's channel strategy, and cut what does not work quickly.
  • Own creative strategy: new angles, formats, hooks and targeting tactics, so performance does not decay as audiences saturate.
  • Support organic and affiliate channels with paid amplification and tracking, working with the VP.
  • Build and maintain external working relationships with media partners, advertisers, financial and direct response publishers, list brokers and other vendors.

2. Funnel & Campaign Performance: High-Ticket and Low-Ticket

  • Write, rework or source copy that drives conversions across ads, landing pages, webinar and application steps, and low-ticket offers, and coach the team to do the same.
  • Create, manage and scale campaigns for both high-ticket and low-ticket funnels with consistent monthly revenue growth.
  • Own the low-ticket paid engine as the foundation of future growth, including its handoff into the rest of the offer ladder.
  • Run a structured A/B testing program across ad copy, visuals, landing pages, webinar and application steps, low-ticket offers and calls to action.
  • Identify good, mediocre and bad copy, and write or source alternatives that drive conversions.
  • Work with sales leadership so lead quality, show rates and close rates are measured end to end and fed back into targeting.
  • Own retargeting and lead nurture through the funnel and customer journey.

3. Unit Economics, Retention & Budget

  • Own CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, ROAS,CPL, cost per qualified call, contribution margin lead scoring, and cash payback by funnel, offer, channel and cohort.
  • Understand retention rate, upsell rate and renewals for high-ticket and low-ticket continuity products, and use them to set allowable acquisition costs.
  • Manage the timing between media spend today and payment-plan collections, together with finance.
  • Keep spend within guardrails and run processes for budgetary control and accountability of all paid media spend. Report on every campaign.

4. Team & Collaboration

  • Lead and optimize the paid media and funnel team, including media buyers, creative strategists and analysts.
  • Work with the VP of Acquisition, the in-house marketing team and external experts, and train the team in advanced acquisition techniques.
  • Run a weekly operating rhythm: scoreboard, test review, creative review and spend decisions.
  • As capacity allows and at the direction of the VP of Acquisition, apply your acquisition and copywriting skills to other businesses in the group (for example Future Finance and Legacy). Your primary accountability stays with Decentralized Masters.

5. Compliance & Risk

  • Own advertising compliance for paid media across platforms and claims: FTC and platform policies, and the specific constraints of financial and investment-related offers.
  • Manage platform concentration risk, account health and ad account redundancy.

Requirements

What You Must Bring

Required

  • 7+ years in performance marketing or growth, including 3+ years leading a paid media team with full accountability for acquisition numbers.

The Principal Enterprise Solution Architect is a senior technical leader who partners with IT and business stakeholders to define technology roadmaps, drive architectural strategy, and lead the design of enterprise-wide solutions. The role carries significant influence over architectural practices, standards, and decision-making across the IT ecosystem, and requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, integrate knowledge across multiple technical disciplines, and deliver innovative, strategic outcomes. Assignments are received as objectives rather than detailed instructions, and the role owns full leadership of projects and initiatives with broad organizational scope. Decisions made in this role carry significant business impact, making sound judgment, stakeholder alignment, and technical rigor essential.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Strategy & Roadmap Development

  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders to define domain technology roadmaps aligned with business and IT goals.
  • Align technology strategy with broader business objectives.
  • Contribute to the creation of target architecture and roadmap for the complete IT ecosystem.

Architecture Leadership & Governance

  • Lead enterprise architecture and solution delivery initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Facilitate architecture reviews and technical decision-making forums.
  • Establish architecture standards, modeling conventions, design patterns, and coding best practices across the organization.
  • Influence common architectural practices organization-wide.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Translate business requirements into integrated, end-to-end technology solutions.
  • Define solutions for multiple concurrent business initiatives and support their implementation.
  • Synchronize system, data security, quality, scalability, and performance (non-functional) requirements across solutions.
  • Drive architectural initiatives and perform in-depth technical analysis.

Risk, Evaluation & Decision Support

  • Perform architecture risk assessments and develop mitigation plans.
  • Support build-versus-buy decisions with structured evaluation frameworks.
  • Evaluate new technologies and industry trends for organizational relevance.
  • Support technology evaluation and vendor/tool selection processes.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and technology assessments to validate solution approaches.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Mentor engineering and architecture team members on architectural best practices and technical growth.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally, exercising influence without direct authority to drive alignment.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you’ll need to be successful:

Education/Certifications (typical, adjust as needed)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
  • Relevant architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect) a plus.

Experience & Expertise

  • Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, solution design, and technology strategy, typically gained through progressive senior technical roles.
  • Demonstrated subject-matter expertise across multiple technical disciplines (e.g., application architecture, data architecture, integration, cloud, security).
  • Proven track record leading large-scale, complex architectural initiatives with broad organizational scope.
  • Experience conducting technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and build-versus-buy analyses.
  • Knowledge of non-functional requirements (security, scalability, performance, quality) and system integration principles.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority across cross-functional and business teams.
  • Strategic thinker capable of resolving ambiguous, complex problems with innovative solutions.
  • Skilled at integrating knowledge across multiple domains to produce sound, business-aligned outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and risk-assessment capabilities.

Leadership

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior and mid-level architects/engineers.
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy against objective-based assignments.
  • Sound judgment given the significant business impact of architectural decisions.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; and copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work. All of this frontline work is powered by a trusted knowledge base that provides the right information, processes, and systems for every interaction. We also build the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

A Knowledge Engineering leader who is ready to turn our clients' customer service knowledge into a strategic asset. You lead the complete knowledge engineering scope on our most strategic and complex service programs, building a single, trusted source of truth for service knowledge that grounds AI agents, supports service agents, and gives customers consistent answers across every channel. You set strategy and architecture end to end, from ontologies and knowledge graphs to the governance that keeps knowledge accurate as products, policies, and customer needs change.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop knowledge engineers into leaders, define what staying at the forefront means for the discipline, and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee knowledge engineering across multiple programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as answer accuracy, first-contact resolution, handle time, and knowledge reuse.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Own the strategy and architecture for a single source of truth for service knowledge, consolidating knowledge bases, documents, product and policy data, and case history into a governed knowledge graph and semantic layer.
  • Set the standards for how service ontologies and taxonomies are designed, evaluated, and maintained across programs.
  • Make knowledge the trusted foundation for AI, defining how it grounds virtual agents, agent-assist copilots, and analytics agents, in partnership with AI Solution Engineering and Enterprise AI Architecture leaders.
  • Establish knowledge governance and operating models with clients, including ownership, review cycles, content lifecycle, access rules, and feedback loops that turn knowledge gaps found in service interactions into new content.
  • Shape knowledge around how customers and service agents actually look for answers, translating customer experience journeys and conversation designs into knowledge structures that support them.

Business Development:

  • Lead Accenture sales and pre-sales efforts, shaping service knowledge and data transformation programs that turn one project into a lasting partnership.
  • Make and defend the business case for the semantic layer and knowledge graph solution at the executive level, connecting knowledge quality to service outcomes and cost-to-serve.
  • Develop trusted-advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders, including service, customer experience, and knowledge management leaders.
  • Drive thought leadership on knowledge as the foundation for AI in customer service, positioning Song as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow teams of knowledge engineers, helping them grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Lead the creation of reusable assets that advance the discipline beyond any single engagement, such as service ontologies, knowledge models, curation pipelines, and accelerators.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.

Here's what you'll need:

  • Minimum 6 years of experience with knowledge graph and semantic technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL), as part of 10+ years in data, AI, search, or information architecture.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, and knowledge graph curation.
  • Minimum 4 years designing and developing knowledge graph solutions and graph-based ML models (functional and technical).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementations for AI applications (especially LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases.
  • Minimum of 5 years experience leading knowledge, data, or AI transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how knowledge quality moves them.
  • Minimum 6 years of managerial experience leading people, with the ability to explain the value of the semantic layer and knowledge graphs to senior business and technology stakeholders, and a proven track record in sales and/or pre-sales, delivering data transformation programs, and developing teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (12 years working experience).

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with service knowledge management platforms such as Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow Knowledge Management, eGain, or Zendesk.
  • Experience establishing Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or similar knowledge management practices at enterprise scale.
  • Experience with GraphRAG or other knowledge-grounded retrieval for AI agents.
  • Practical experience with NLP and/or search techniques, prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch and tools for building ETL pipelines, such as Apache NiFi or Airflow.
  • Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.
  • External client-facing consulting experience.
  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

Office Manager & Production Coordinator

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Office Manager & Production Coordinator to support Titan Roof's California operations.

This role combines permit coordination, customer communication, invoicing, production scheduling, job documentation, and day-to-day administrative support. You’ll work closely with project managers and field crews to keep projects organized, compliant, and moving forward from signed contract through project close-out.

What You’ll Own

Permit Pulling

  • Manage the full permit process for roofing projects across Titan Roof's California service area.
  • Track permit applications and follow up with local municipalities.
  • Ensure every job is fully compliant before work begins.

Customer Coordination

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for homeowners and commercial clients.
  • Answer inbound calls and respond to customer inquiries.
  • Keep customers informed throughout the production cycle.
  • Escalate issues requiring field decisions to the appropriate project manager.

Invoicing & Billing

  • Generate, send, and track invoices using QuickBooks.
  • Reconcile payments and maintain accurate records.
  • Flag outstanding balances to the appropriate team member in a timely manner.

Production Scheduling Support

  • Work alongside project managers and field crews to coordinate job timelines.
  • Confirm material deliveries.
  • Identify and flag scheduling conflicts before they affect crews on the ground.

Job & Document Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records in JobNimbus.
  • Keep photos, contracts, notes, and permit documentation organized.
  • Ensure the team has a reliable single source of truth for every active job.

Administrative Operations

  • Handle day-to-day office tasks, including filing and data entry.
  • Manage internal communication and administrative needs.
  • Support the smooth operation of the California team.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience in an office manager, production coordinator, or administrative coordinator role.
  • Experience within construction, roofing, or a related trade is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with JobNimbus or a comparable construction CRM for job tracking and documentation.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks for invoicing, payment tracking, and basic financial record-keeping.
  • Experience pulling building permits or coordinating permit applications.
  • Understanding of municipal permitting in California or a comparable jurisdiction.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Confidence representing Titan Roof professionally on calls with customers, city offices, and contractors.
  • Ability to manage multiple open projects simultaneously.
  • Strong prioritization and record-keeping skills with minimal supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You follow through without needing reminders and take ownership of tasks until they are completed.
  • You communicate proactively when something is delayed, behind schedule, or unclear.
  • You are highly precise with permit numbers, invoice amounts, job addresses, customer names, and other project details.
  • You remain calm and organized when multiple priorities require attention at the same time.
  • You know how to triage tasks, take clear notes, and keep work moving.
  • You are comfortable coordinating across teams and time zones through phone, email, and JobNimbus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Permit applications are tracked, followed up on, and completed before work begins.
  • Customers receive timely and professional communication throughout the production cycle.
  • Invoices and payments are accurately processed and tracked.
  • Project schedules, materials, and potential conflicts are proactively coordinated.
  • JobNimbus records remain accurate, complete, and up to date.
  • Project managers and field crews have the information they need to execute jobs smoothly.
  • Administrative tasks are completed reliably without constant follow-up.

Typical Day

Your morning starts by reviewing JobNimbus for new jobs, updated project statuses, and tasks that came in overnight.

You’ll check outstanding permit applications, send required follow-up documentation to city offices, and update project records accordingly. Mid-morning often brings inbound customer calls, where you’ll answer scheduling questions, provide project updates, and escalate anything requiring a field decision to the project manager.

Before midday, you may process new invoices in QuickBooks and reconcile recent payments.

Afternoons are typically focused on production coordination, confirming crew schedules, flagging material needs, and making sure upcoming jobs have everything in place before work begins.

You’ll work closely with Titan Roof's project managers and field leadership, with most coordination taking place asynchronously through phone, email, and JobNimbus notes.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

Life at BMS

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:


RayzeBio, a Bristol Myers Squibb company, is seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Advertising and Promotion Regulatory Affairs.

This role will provide regulatory leadership for U.S. promotional and commercial communications and serve as a senior Regulatory Reviewer on the Promotional Review Committee (PRC). The Director will partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Legal, Compliance, Market Access, Corporate Communications, and Regulatory Operations to enable compliant, accurate, balanced, and effective communications for RayzeBio products and disease states.


Job Responsibilities


Promotional Review Committee and Governance

  • Participate actively in PRC meetings and Veeva PromoMats workflows, providing timely, clear, and documented regulatory comments and decisions.
  • Partner with Medical and Legal reviewers to resolve comments, align on compliant alternatives, and escalate material regulatory risks through established governance when needed.
  • Provide regulatory leadership for launch readiness, including development of core claims, launch materials, field training, websites, congress materials, speaker program materials, digital communications, and patient or caregiver materials.
  • Support the development and maintenance of PRC procedures, standards, job aids, review criteria, and governance practices.
  • Promote consistent application of regulatory standards across brands, channels, audiences, and material types.

Regulatory Submissions and Compliance

  • Lead or oversee the regulatory assessment, preparation, quality review, and submission of promotional materials to FDA, including Form FDA 2253 submissions, as applicable.
  • Coordinate with Regulatory Operations and the PRC Coordinator to ensure required Health Authority submissions are completed and documented before distribution, when applicable.
  • Monitor FDA guidance, policy developments, enforcement letters, advisory comments, and industry trends that may affect RayzeBio communications.
  • Communicate labeling changes and emerging regulatory expectations that may require revision, reapproval, withdrawal, or replacement of promotional materials.
  • Support responses to Health Authority inquiries involving advertising, promotional labeling, or product communications.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Leadership

  • Advise Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Legal, Compliance, Corporate Communications, and other stakeholders during early concept development and throughout the material lifecycle.
  • Balance regulatory risk, scientific support, intended audience, and business objectives while maintaining high standards for compliance and patient protection.
  • Develop and deliver training on advertising and promotion requirements, PRC expectations, FDA enforcement trends, product labeling, and compliant communication principles.
  • Coach and mentor Regulatory Affairs colleagues who support promotional review activities.
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs in cross-functional launch, brand, and governance forums and communicate complex regulatory considerations to senior leaders.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in life sciences, pharmacy, health sciences, or a related field; an advanced scientific, legal, or regulatory degree is preferred.

  • Strong working knowledge of FDA advertising and promotion requirements, prescription drug labeling, promotional labeling, and relevant FDA guidance and enforcement practices.
  • Experience supporting product launch and lifecycle communications is strongly preferred.
  • Oncology, specialty product, and/or radiopharmaceutical experience is preferred.
  • Experience with Veeva PromoMats or a comparable promotional material review and approval system is preferred.

  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple reviews, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
Head of Sales & Distribution – WealthTech & Investment Technology | Remote

Company: Artha
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Industry: WealthTech / Investment Technology
Function: Sales, Distribution & Go-to-Market Leadership

About Artha

At Pavago, one of our clients, Artha, is hiring a Head of Sales & Distribution to build and lead its commercial strategy across RIAs, family offices, and institutional investors.

Artha is a portfolio intelligence platform built for financial advisors, wealth managers, family offices, and institutional investors. Its technology helps investment professionals understand how portfolios may behave as market conditions change, identify potential risks and their underlying drivers, and evaluate portfolio decisions through scenario analysis and optimization.

Artha is already live in market, with paying customers, institutional use, and integrations across the wealth-management ecosystem. The platform was built by a team with decades of experience across investment management, portfolio construction, ETFs, financial technology, product, and engineering.

The product has been built. The next chapter is about building distribution around it.

The Opportunity

This is a zero-to-one commercial leadership role for someone who has built before—not someone looking simply to manage an established sales organization.

You won’t inherit a mature inbound funnel, SDR organization, or finished sales playbook. Instead, you’ll work directly with Artha’s founders and product leadership to determine how the platform goes to market, sharpen the commercial story, identify scalable channels, and personally turn opportunities into customers.

Initially, this will be a highly hands-on role. You’ll:

  • Open doors and leverage your existing network
  • Personally prospect and generate pipeline
  • Run discovery and product conversations
  • Develop strategic relationships
  • Test positioning and messaging
  • Build direct and partnership-driven distribution channels
  • Manage opportunities through the sales cycle
  • Personally close business

What you learn from the market will directly influence Artha’s positioning, product roadmap, partnerships, and broader go-to-market strategy.

As the commercial motion becomes repeatable, you’ll have the opportunity to build the organization around it.

What You’ll Own

Sales & Distribution Strategy

  • Build and execute Artha’s sales and distribution strategy across:
    • Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs)
    • Family offices
    • Institutional investors
  • Determine the customer segments and use cases with the strongest commercial potential
  • Identify the messages and channels generating the strongest market signal
  • Develop a repeatable commercial model capable of scaling beyond founder-led selling
  • Help define Artha’s ideal customer profile and go-to-market priorities

Hands-On Sales & Pipeline Generation

  • Personally source new opportunities and open doors
  • Leverage and expand relationships across the wealth-management and investment ecosystem
  • Conduct prospecting and outbound business development
  • Run discovery conversations
  • Deliver compelling product and commercial presentations
  • Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle
  • Navigate objections and complex stakeholder conversations
  • Build and manage qualified pipeline
  • Personally negotiate and close meaningful business

This is a leadership role, but you will be selling.

Strategic Distribution & Partnerships

  • Develop both direct-sales and partnership-driven distribution
  • Build strategic relationships with:
    • Wealth platforms
    • Custodians
    • Technology providers
    • Asset managers
    • Other ecosystem partners
  • Identify partnerships capable of expanding Artha’s market reach
  • Evaluate strategic distribution opportunities based on commercial potential
  • Develop relationships into scalable distribution channels

Positioning & Commercial Narrative

  • Own the commercial narrative alongside Product, Investments, and Marketing
  • Translate sophisticated investment technology into a clear and compelling commercial story
  • Help develop and continuously refine:
    • Positioning
    • Sales collateral
    • Outbound messaging
    • Product demonstrations
    • Objection handling
    • Customer use cases
  • Use real market conversations to sharpen Artha’s messaging
  • Ensure the sales narrative resonates with sophisticated investment professionals

Sales Operations & Commercial Infrastructure

  • Establish a disciplined sales process from the ground up
  • Build CRM structure and pipeline-management standards
  • Define qualification criteria and sales stages
  • Establish KPIs and commercial reporting
  • Develop forecasting processes
  • Create a consistent sales operating cadence
  • Maintain visibility into pipeline quality, progression, and revenue opportunities
  • Build the commercial infrastructure required to support future scale

Market & Product Feedback

  • Bring structured customer and prospect feedback into Product
  • Identify recurring customer needs, objections, and use cases
  • Help Product understand where the strongest commercial demand exists
  • Translate market feedback into actionable insights
  • Work directly with founders, investment professionals, product leaders, and engineers
  • Help inform product priorities based on commercial opportunities

Commercial Leadership

  • Represent Artha at industry events, conferences, and strategic meetings
  • Establish credibility with senior stakeholders across wealth management and investment technology
  • Develop Artha’s commercial presence in the market
  • As repeatability is established, build and lead the broader commercial organization
  • Create the foundation, processes, and playbook future sales and distribution hires can scale

Requirements

  • Meaningful experience selling WealthTech, investment technology, portfolio solutions, asset-management solutions, or related financial products
  • Deep familiarity with the wealth-management and investment ecosystem
  • Established relationships across RIAs, family offices, and/or institutional investors
  • Proven track record of personally generating pipeline and closing meaningful business
  • Experience building or helping build a zero-to-one commercial motion
  • Experience developing sales strategy where a mature playbook or inbound engine did not already exist
  • Experience with both:
    • Direct sales
    • Strategic distribution partnerships
  • Ability to shape positioning, messaging, collateral, and sales processes based on market feedback
  • Ability to translate sophisticated investment products and technology into a simple, compelling commercial narrative
  • Comfortable selling directly to sophisticated investment professionals and decision-makers
  • Strong pipeline management and commercial discipline
  • Comfortable working directly with founders, investment professionals, product leaders, and engineers
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity
  • Willingness to remain highly hands-on in prospecting, discovery, relationship development, and closing

Especially Valuable Experience

Experience with any of the following is particularly valuable:

  • Portfolio construction
  • Model portfolios
  • TAMPs
  • Custodial platforms
  • Investment analytics
  • Advisor technology
  • Wealth-management platforms
  • Asset-management solutions
  • Institutional investment technology
  • Financial advisor technology ecosystems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have built commercial motions before, rather than only managed established sales teams
  • Have a meaningful network within wealth management and investment technology
  • Know how to create pipeline without relying on a mature inbound engine
  • Can personally open doors and convert relationships into commercial opportunities
  • Are equally comfortable discussing sophisticated investment concepts and closing business
  • Can identify patterns across early customer conversations and turn them into a repeatable sales strategy
  • Understand both direct selling and strategic distribution
  • Want significant influence over positioning, customer strategy, partnerships, and product direction
  • Are comfortable working closely with founders in an early-stage environment
  • Can move between high-level commercial strategy and hands-on execution
  • Are entrepreneurial, analytical, and commercially minded
  • Want to build the sales organization—not simply inherit one

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day could include prospecting into target RIAs or family offices, leveraging your network to open a conversation with an institutional investor, running discovery with a potential customer, or presenting Artha’s portfolio intelligence platform to investment professionals.

You may then work with Product and Investments to refine positioning based on what you’re hearing in the market, review the pipeline and forecast, develop a strategic distribution relationship with a wealth platform or custodian, and prepare for an industry meeting or conference.

Early on, much of your time will be spent directly in the market. As patterns emerge, you’ll turn those learnings into a repeatable commercial process and scalable distribution model.

In short: you’ll build Artha’s commercial engine while personally proving how it works.

What Success Looks Like

Your first priority will be learning—Artha, its customers, the market, and why prospects engage or don’t.

From there, success means:

  • Sharpening Artha’s ideal customer profile and commercial narrative
  • Materially increasing qualified market conversations
  • Establishing a disciplined and measurable sales process
  • Determining which segments, channels, messages, and use cases show the strongest commercial signal
  • Building qualified pipeline
  • Converting pipeline into revenue
  • Developing meaningful strategic distribution relationships
  • Creating a repeatable distribution model
  • Reducing dependence on individual relationships and founder-led selling
  • Building the commercial foundation required for future scale

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified market conversations generated
  • Qualified pipeline created
  • Pipeline-to-revenue conversion
  • New customers closed
  • Revenue generated
  • Sales-cycle progression and velocity
  • Strategic distribution relationships established
  • Direct-sales channel performance
  • Partner-driven pipeline and opportunities
  • CRM and forecasting discipline
  • Identification of repeatable customer segments and use cases
  • Commercial messaging effectiveness
  • Development of a scalable sales and distribution model

Why Artha, Why Now

Artha isn’t asking you to sell an idea that still needs to be built.

The technology is live. The investment expertise is established. There are real customers, institutional use, and industry integrations. The platform addresses an everyday challenge for investment professionals: understanding what changing markets could mean for their portfolios.

What hasn’t been built yet is the commercial engine capable of taking Artha to a much larger market.

That’s the opportunity.

You’ll join early enough to have genuine influence over positioning, customer strategy, partnerships, product, and the future commercial organization, while working with an established platform and experienced team.

For someone who has spent years in wealth management or investment technology thinking, “I know how I’d build this if I had the opportunity,” this role provides that opportunity.

Compensation

Base Salary + Significant Performance-Based Incentive Compensation + Equity Opportunity

Compensation will reflect the seniority of the role and the expectation that this person will both build and personally execute Artha’s commercial strategy.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Interview with Pavago
  4. Artha Founder / Leadership Interview
  5. Final Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced wealth-management or investment-technology commercial leader who has built sales motions from the ground up, personally generated and closed meaningful business, and developed relationships across RIAs, family offices, institutional investors, and strategic distribution partners, we’d love to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to take a proven investment technology platform and build the commercial engine around it from zero to one.
