Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach.

This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team.

What they're looking for

If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development.

You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy.

If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you.

The Details

As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas:

  • Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement.
  • User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals.
  • User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences.
  • Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing.
  • Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development.
  • Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation.

Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution
  • Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering
  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment
  • Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment
  • Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key

What to Expect from the Process

This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available.

Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit.

This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of.

The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients.

This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration.

Jouw ambitie

Wil jij werken aan uitdagende spoorprojecten en een directe bijdrage leveren aan de duurzame mobiliteit van Nederland? Jouw rol

Als projectmanager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de realisatie van projecten voor o.a. ProRail. Je zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt: van de voorbereiding en uitvoering tot en met de afronding. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek, planning, financiën en stakeholders, en weet teams te motiveren om samen de beste resultaten te behalen.
Wat je zoal doet

✅ Leiden en coördineren van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

✅ Afstemmen met opdrachtgevers zoals ProRail en andere stakeholders;

✅ Bewaken van planning, budget en kwaliteit;

✅ Signaleren van kansen en risico’s en hier proactief op inspelen;

✅ Zorgen voor een veilige en efficiënte uitvoering van het werk.

Requirements

Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit jij op je plekJe maakt onderdeel uit van de vakgroep Projectmanagement. De verschillende vakgroepen kenmerken zich door de drive om succes te hebben en gezamenlijk de projecten tot een goed einde te brengen. Wanneer je vragen hebt of tegen problemen aanloopt, dan staan je collega's klaar om je te helpen. Samen wordt er gekeken naar een ideale oplossing. Samenwerking en collegialiteit kenmerken de sfeer binnen Dura Vermeer Railinfra.

🔹 Een technische HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in civiele techniek of elektrotechniek;

🔹 Ruime ervaring in een verantwoordelijke projectmanagement functie in de bouw of rail- infra;

🔹 Kennis van contractvormen zoals UAV-GC;

🔹 Een proactieve en oplossingsgerichte mindset;

🔹 Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een talent voor samenwerken en stakeholdermanagement;

Wat wij bieden

✔ Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 7.025,- tot € 8.781,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!;

✔ 43 vrije dagen volgens de Rail CAO, volop ruimte voor een goede werk-privébalans;

✔ Een leaseauto en alle tools die je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen;

✔ Uitgebreide ontwikkelmogelijkheden: trainingen, opleidingen en doorgroeikansen;

✔ Een team van gedreven professionals met wie je samen de mooiste spoorprojecten realiseert;

Maak impact op de spoorsector!

Wil jij een sleutelrol spelen in de realisatie van belangrijke spoorprojecten? Dan komen we graag met je in contact! Solliciteer direct of neem voor meer informatie contact op met Jeffrey Smit, bereikbaar via 06-41176005 of Of neem contact op met onze directeur; Jaap van der Star. Hij kan je meer vertellen over de inhoud van deze functie. Je kan hem bereiken op 06-53599848

jobs.excerpt: About the roleDivision 50 runs outbound sales development for our clients — companies across many different industries who hire us to fill their calendars with qualified meetings.
jobs.description:
About the role

Division 50 runs outbound sales development for our clients — companies across many different industries who hire us to fill their calendars with qualified meetings. As a UK Cold Calling SDR, you sit on the phones every day calling into the UK market on behalf of those clients. You learn each client's product, ideal customer, and pitch, then dial their target accounts, get past the brush-off, and book qualified meetings their closers actually show up for.

This is a phone-first role. You are not selling Division 50's own services — you represent our clients. The work changes as our client roster changes, so you ramp fast on new products and industries and keep your numbers steady through the switch. This is fully remote, working UK business hours.

What you'll do

  • Make high-volume cold calls into the UK market on behalf of Division 50 clients across different industries (B2B SaaS, professional services, home services, healthcare, finance, and more)
  • Learn each client's offer, ideal customer profile, and objection patterns quickly, and adapt your pitch to whoever you're calling that week
  • Open cold calls that start with a brush-off, hold the line, and turn them into booked, qualified meetings
  • Qualify prospects against each client's criteria before you book, so the meetings that land on a closer's calendar are real
  • Log every dial, conversation, and booked meeting in the CRM so the client and your manager can see the activity
  • Follow up on warm inbound leads for clients who run them — qualify, and book the meeting (this is a plus, not the core of the job)
  • Hit daily dial and weekly meeting-booked targets, and keep them steady even when you switch to a new client or industry

What we're looking for

  • Proven cold-calling experience dialing into the UK market — you've spent your day on outbound phones and have the call volume to show for it
  • A track record of booking qualified B2B meetings from cold dials, with real numbers (dials per day, meetings per week)
  • You ramp fast on a new product or industry and can sound credible on the phone after a short briefing
  • You handle the early brush-off — "not interested," "send me an email," "we're not looking" — and keep the conversation alive
  • Clear, confident spoken English and a natural phone manner UK prospects respond to
  • Disciplined with CRM hygiene and daily activity targets
  • Comfortable with a smaller base + high uncapped commission tied to booked meetings

Nice to have

  • Experience qualifying warm inbound leads as well as cold outbound
  • Time spent in an agency, BPO, or outsourced-SDR setting where you carried multiple client accounts at once
  • Familiarity with dialers, sales engagement tools, and CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar)
  • Experience calling into more than one industry or buyer type

About us & how to apply

Division 50 is a B2B lead generation and marketing agency. We run appointment-setting and outbound SDR programs for clients across many industries, alongside paid ads, SEO, and social media management. This SDR role sits inside our client-fulfillment team — the people who actually pick up the phone and book the meetings our clients pay us for.

To apply, complete the short application and screening questions. Strong applicants move to a conversation with Raffi, our AI recruiter, where we'll go deep on your cold-calling background. We hire for outbound skill and consistency, not industry pedigree.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer, eCommerce
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: Therabody® is the wellness tech leader with a mission to inspire and enable everybody to feel, perform and look their best.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Therabody® is the wellness tech leader with a mission to inspire and enable everybody to feel, perform and look their best. Therabody’s product ecosystem includes category-creating innovations in wellness, performance and beauty products, proprietary software and digital content. Not only is it part of our brand ethos to help others, but we are also defining the cutting edge of wellness technology while winning accolades such as Fast Company’s Brands That Matter, Oprah's Favorite Things and the TIME Best Inventions 2025 award.

We’re committed to continuous innovation and surround ourselves with specialists, thought leaders, and experts - inside and outside of the office. If you thrive in creative environments, are concerned with big, innovative ideas, love to collaborate, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are driven to succeed, get in touch with us. Together we can push the limits of what can be achieved for everybody.

Who We’re Looking For:

We’re looking for a freelance UX/UI Designer to drive the creation of engaging, high-converting shopping experiences on Therabody.com. You’ll work hands-on across the full purchase journey—product discovery, browsing, cart, checkout, and post-purchase—translating briefs and business goals into thoughtful, user-centered designs. This is a collaborative, execution-focused role where you’ll partner with our product, engineering, ecommerce, and brand teams to ship work that looks great and performs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design of the Therabody.com shopping experience across product detail pages, collection and category pages, search and discovery, cart, checkout, and post-purchase — for a global, multi-market storefront.
  • Set the ecommerce design direction: define the UX patterns, interaction standards, and quality bar that web PMs and engineers build against.
  • Frame the problem before designing the solution — synthesize analytics, session replay, research, and merchandising input into a clear point of view on where the experience is losing customers and what to do about it.
  • Partner with the product and analytics teams to build and prioritize an experimentation roadmap; design the variants, define what a win looks like, and read the results honestly — including when your design lost.
  • Extend and steward Therabody’s design system for commerce surfaces: contribute reusable components, document usage, and eliminate one-off patterns rather than adding to them.
  • Work directly with front-end engineers on specs, handoff, and design QA — you are accountable for what actually ships, not just what was designed.
  • Design within the realities of our commerce platform (Shopify), and make deliberate trade-offs between what is ideal, what is buildable, and what is worth building now.
  • Bring design into scoping and roadmap conversations early, so that sequencing, feasibility, and customer impact are weighed together rather than after the fact.
  • Run lean, fast research and usability testing to validate direction — and know when a five-user test is enough and when it isn’t.
  • Raise the level of design practice across the team through critique, mentorship, and example.

About You

  • 7+ years of product or UX design experience, with deep, demonstrable focus on ecommerce — ideally DTC, consumer hardware, or subscription commerce.
  • A history of leading significant design work as an individual contributor — setting direction, aligning partners, and raising the quality bar through craft and clear thinking.
  • A portfolio that shows real ecommerce depth: product pages, discovery and comparison flows, cart and checkout — with the reasoning, constraints, and outcomes behind the work, not just the final screens.
  • Expert in Figma, including building and maintaining component libraries, variables, and design systems at scale. Fluent with AI-assisted design tooling and clear-eyed about where it accelerates work and where it produces plausible-looking noise.
  • Comfortable working in analytics and behavioral tools — GA4, FullStory, or similar — well enough to pull your own data, form a hypothesis, and defend it.
  • Deep familiarity with Shopify or comparable commerce platforms, and a practical understanding of their UX constraints, theme and app ecosystem, and checkout limitations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can walk an executive audience through a recommendation, the trade-offs you considered, and the risks you accepted — and hold your position under scrutiny.
  • Exposure to conversational or AI-assisted shopping experiences, product finders, or guided selling.
  • Experience designing for app and web as a connected ecosystem rather than separate surfaces.

We are seeking a Sr. Software Product Manager to lead our software-enabled hardware journey. Our devices have long earned customers' trust; we are building the software layer that extends that value across the workflow.

In this role, you will lead the way in defining and delivering software products our customers love. You will act as a bridge between our established hardware product organization and the software capabilities we are building around it. You will help define where software workflow solutions belong on the overall product roadmap, balance investment between bold feature innovations and the steady improvement of the core platform. You will establish software product management best practices needed to succeed— from product definition to sales enablement to customer implementations. This role is based in the U.S. and works closely with product, engineering, sales, and customer success teams around the world.

Who You Are

  • Experienced software product leader with a strong history of building workflow software that interacts with hardware devices.
  • Pragmatic bridge builder who can translate between hardware engineering culture and software product thinking
  • Strategic thinker who can balance bold new software initiatives against the discipline required to sustain a core platform.
  • Structured operator who can stand up new best practices — for product definition, sales, and implementation
  • Effective global collaborator, comfortable working across time zones, functions, and cultures

Key ResponsibilitiesSoftware Roadmap Strategy & Integration

  • Partner with hardware product management, engineering, and executive leadership to integrate software workflow solutions into the company-wide product roadmap.
  • Assess where software creates the most customer and business value and translate that into a prioritized software roadmap.
  • Define and defend prioritization tradeoffs between strategic feature innovations and ongoing core platform improvements.
  • Build the business case for software investment, including ROI, adoption, and consideration of business models influenced by hardware.
  • Work with Product Planning team to explore bold innovative solutions and markets.
  • Work closely with hardware Product Managers where software creates value alongside devices in customer workflows.

Product Definition & Best Practices

  • Establish repeatable best practices for defining successful software workflow products and success metrics suited to hardware-adjacent software.
  • Create and maintain process and templates for defining and delivering value in each release.
  • Work very closely with Product Owners align on customer value, definition, scoping, and prioritization of feature backlog.
  • Champion a consistent software product release cycle that complements existing hardware NPI release plans.
  • Lead prioritization cadence to communicate software roadmap priorities, needs, and tradeoffs to leadership.

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement

  • Partner with sales and commercial teams to define and refine ideal customer profiles and the sales process for hardware/software combined solutions.
  • Develop sales enablement materials, pricing frameworks, and tiered offerings that reflect customer needs.
  • Coach and enable the sales organization to position and sell workflow software alongside hardware.

Customer Implementation & Success

  • Work closely with and coach customer success and sales engineering teams on pre-sale nurturing and post-sale implementations, ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Identify and resolve common points of friction in onboarding, adoption, and change management.
  • Gather customer feedback and usage data to continuously improve product definition and implementation practices.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • 7+ years of software product management experience, including direct experience managing workflow software products.
  • Demonstrated experience leading software products through transformational growth cycles.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, particularly for combined hardware/software solutions
  • Experience building or scaling software product management best practices.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and time zones.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, domestically and internationally.

Preferred

  • MBA or equivalent strategic experience
  • Experience in a medical device, industrial, or other hardware-first industry undergoing digital product transformation.
  • Familiarity with IoT, connected devices, or embedded systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers use and love our software products. Adoption and business outcomes are accelerating due to your leadership.
  • Bold software workflow solutions are integrated into the company's core product roadmap and portfolio prioritization process.
  • A clear, well-understood framework exists for balancing strategic innovation with core platform investments.
  • Sales and customer implementation teams have documented, repeatable best practices for hardware/software solutions.
  • The organization has a strong, reusable foundation for future software product development.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Fluke Health Solutions

Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. And Victoreen instruments are the trusted source for radiation monitoring systems and quality assurance for nuclear power professionals.At FHS, we believe in your potential — your ability to learn, grow and contribute in meaningful ways. And we believe in giving you the opportunity, accountability, and visibility to do just that.

About the Role:

Our client is seeking a Compliance Officer to design, oversee, and continuously improve compliance programs that ensure adherence to laws, regulations, and internal policies. This role is essential for protecting the organization from legal and reputational risks while enabling business leaders to operate with confidence. The Compliance Officer acts as the bridge between regulation and operations, ensuring policies are clear, enforced, and monitored.

Responsibilities:

  • Policy Development & Maintenance: Draft, update, and enforce compliance policies across departments (finance, HR, IT, operations). Ensure documents are accessible, understood, and consistently applied.
  • Risk Assessment: Conduct risk assessments across business units. Identify areas of exposure, document findings, and recommend controls.
  • Monitoring & Auditing: Implement compliance monitoring programs and conduct regular internal audits. Track findings in GRC tools (Archer, ServiceNow, or similar).
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or industry-specific regulations. File required reports and maintain audit-ready documentation.
  • Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver training programs for employees on compliance obligations, code of conduct, and regulatory updates.
  • Investigations: Conduct internal investigations into compliance issues. Document findings, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Reporting: Deliver compliance dashboards, monthly/quarterly reports, and risk summaries to executives and boards.
  • Collaboration: Partner with finance, legal, HR, and IT to ensure compliance is integrated into all business processes.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

  • Expert at balancing compliance requirements with operational practicality.
  • Strong investigative and analytical skills.
  • Trusted communicator across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Proactive in identifying risks before they become issues.

Required Experience & Skills (Minimum):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Finance, or related field.
  • 3–5 years in compliance, audit, or risk management.
  • Proficiency with compliance monitoring and reporting tools.
  • Knowledge of at least one regulatory framework (SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).

Ideal Experience & Skills:

  • Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or similar.
  • Experience in finance, healthcare, SaaS, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with risk management frameworks (COSO, ISO 31000).
  • Experience leading compliance training and building reporting dashboards.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Compliance Officer’s day revolves around protecting the organization by embedding compliance into everyday business activities. You will:

  • Review and update compliance policies to reflect changes in laws or internal operations.
  • Monitor controls and run audits across departments to test adherence.
  • Assess risks by analyzing business activities, spotting gaps, and prioritizing remediation efforts.
  • Conduct or oversee investigations into potential violations, documenting evidence and outcomes.
  • Train employees and managers by delivering compliance sessions or publishing new guidelines.
  • Report findings to executives, providing concise summaries that highlight risks, corrective actions, and progress.

In essence: Compliance Officers ensure the organization operates within the law, avoids costly penalties, and maintains a culture of integrity and accountability.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs):

  • Zero missed regulatory filing deadlines.
  • All compliance audits completed on schedule.
  • Timely closure of compliance issues (tracked against SLA).
  • 100% employee participation in required compliance training.
  • Clear, actionable compliance reporting delivered to leadership.

ベックマン・コールター・ライフサイエンスでは、今日の研究室において時間が最も重要な要素であることを認識しています。救命治療薬をより早く患者に届けるため、煩雑な手作業のワークフローを自動化することで時間を節約するため、そして誤った結果や複雑な結果に対処する時間を節約するためです。

私たちは時間を共有するパートナーとして、自動化の力によって重要な課題への回答を加速させます。私たちは科学者による科学者のためのイノベーションを開発しており、3,300人を超えるグローバルな同僚の多くは研究室出身です。

これは、1935年の創業以来、人々の生活のスピードに合わせて意義のあるイノベーションを提供してきた、私たちの長年培ってきたアプローチの一環です。そして、これはまだ始まりに過ぎません。共に力を合わせ、時間と才能を結集して、未来の人々の健康と発展に貢献していきましょう。

あらゆる可能性を可能にするダナハー・ビジネス・システムについて学びましょう。

Automation Product Managerは、日本市場におけるAutomation製品群（Biomek、Echoおよび関連ソリューション）の市場戦略、ポートフォリオ成長、および市場展開計画をリードします。

本ポジションは、日本市場における製品戦略、需要創出、製品ライフサイクルマネジメント、新製品導入および事業計画の策定・実行をリードするとともに、グローバルチームや国内の関連部門と連携しながら顧客価値の最大化と事業目標の達成を推進します。

本ポジションはマーケティング本部に所属し、東京を拠点とするリモートワークポジションです。

この役割では、以下の業務を行います:

  • 市場機会を特定し事業計画を支援するため、市場分析、顧客セグメンテーション、競合分析、ポジショニングおよびマーケティング戦略立案をリードする。
  • 新製品および新アプリケーションの上市計画を策定・実行し、グローバル製品マネジメントチームと連携しながら製品導入を成功に導く。
  • 市場分析、競合分析、顧客インサイト、販売予測、価格戦略およびポートフォリオマネジメントを通じて事業成長を推進する。
  • 顧客の声（VOC）を収集・分析し、日本市場のニーズをグローバルチームへ発信することで、製品ロードマップや事業戦略の形成に貢献する。
  • Commercial Marketingと連携し、顧客インサイト、市場分析、ポジショニングおよび価値提案を提供することで、需要創出および市場展開活動を支援する。
  • 営業担当者および販売代理店向けに、製品・アプリケーション・営業活動に関するトレーニングを企画・展開し、営業力強化を支援する。
  • Sales、Field Applications、Service、Commercial Marketing、RA/QA、Supply Chain、Global Business Unitなどの関係部門と連携し、事業目標達成および顧客満足向上を推進する。

この仕事の必須条件は以下の通りです:

  • ライフサイエンス、バイオテクノロジー、化学、工学、薬学または関連分野の修士号以上を有すること。
  • ライフサイエンス業界において、5年以上のプロダクトマネジメントまたはプロダクトマーケティング経験を有すること
  • 理化学機器、ラボオートメーション、または関連ソリューションに関するマーケティング戦略、市場開発施策、および新製品上市計画の立案・実行経験を有し、顧客の研究ワークフローおよびアプリケーションを理解できること。
  • 市場データ、財務データおよび事業データを活用した分析・意思決定能力を有すること。
  • 日本語および英語による優れたコミュニケーション能力（口頭・文書）を有すること。

出張要件

業務上、国内外への出張が発生します（10〜15%程度）。

歓迎要件

  • ラボオートメーション、リキッドハンドリング、細胞解析、細胞培養、自動化ワークフローに関する知識または実務経験。
  • KOLマネジメント、市場開発、製品導入活動の経験。
  • MBAまたは同等のビジネス教育・研修経験

リモートワークモードに関して

ベックマン・コールター ライフサイエンスでは、より良く、持続可能な労働力を設計できると信じています。適格な役割に対する柔軟なリモートワークの利点を認識し、勤務形態に関わらず充実したキャリアを提供することにコミットしています。このポジションでは、自宅からリモートで働くことができるリモートワークの形態が可能です。このリモートワークの形態に関する追加情報は、面接者から提供されます。ベックマン・コールター ライフサイエンスで働くことが提供する柔軟性と挑戦を探求してください。

今すぐ勝利のチームにご参加ください。共に、未来の科学技術が現実にもたらす影響を加速させていきましょう。当社は世界中の顧客と連携し、科学の力を生活に活かすソリューションを構築して、顧客の極めて複雑な課題の解決を支援します。

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform Experience & Insights
jobs.excerpt: Who we areHungerRush is a leading provider of integrated restaurant solutions.
jobs.description:
Who we are

HungerRush is a leading provider of integrated restaurant solutions. HungerRush 360 is our flagship cloud POS system that makes it easier to delight guests, drive loyalty, and manage restaurants from anywhere. The all-in-one system integrates digital ordering, delivery, customer engagement, restaurant management, and payment processing with flexible software designed to give operators more insight into their customers, more control over their operations, and more power to profitably grow their business.

Position overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the reporting, analytics, and cross-product experience layer of HUB, spanning point-of-sale, the HUB Dashboard, and the Mobile HUB app, the primary tool for managing a business on the go. You'll balance the distinct needs of SMB operators, franchise owners, and corporate multi-brand stakeholders within one coherent experience, operating as an empowered product leader accountable for outcomes, not output, in close partnership with Design and Engineering.

This is a modernization, transformation, and 0-to-1 role. The platform is mid-evolution, with real legacy constraints and a company-wide focus on platform stability. Success means untangling hard, constrained problems, sequencing complex changes well, and knowing when to simplify or retire functionality rather than add to it. The strongest candidates are puzzle-solvers who find that energizing, not limiting.

Key responsibilities

Product Operating Model & Continuous Discovery

  • Operate as part of an empowered product team accountable for outcomes: success means problems solved, not features shipped.
  • Run continuous discovery, staying in regular direct contact with operators, franchise owners, and corporate brand teams to validate problems before committing engineering investment.
  • Partner in a product trio with Design and Engineering leads, sharing ownership of the roadmap and its tradeoffs.
  • Actively look for opportunities to simplify, consolidate, or retire legacy functionality, treating subtraction as a deliberate product tool.

Commercial Ownership

  • Understand the pricing and packaging implications of platform capabilities, factoring commercial tradeoffs into roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Sales and Commercial teams to position and package new capabilities in ways that support the business model.

AI-Native Product Practice

  • Use AI tools throughout the discovery-to-delivery workflow, from research synthesis to spec drafting and prototyping, to move faster without sacrificing rigor.
  • Identify and champion opportunities to build AI-powered capabilities directly into HUB, turning numbers into automated recommendations for operators.
  • Define the data foundation strategy, quality, structure, and governance, that enables reliable reporting today and AI-driven insights tomorrow.

Platform & Experience Ownership

  • Own the reporting and business insights capability set across every channel of the platform.
  • Own the HUB Dashboard and HUB on-the-go (Mobile) end-to-end, staying deep enough to demo it, train an operator, and troubleshoot a live issue directly.
  • Ensure HUB feels like one unified product, even where individual modules (configuration, menu, loyalty, coupons) are owned by other teams.

Persona-Balanced Product Design

  • Design experiences for SMB operators, franchise owners, and corporate brand stakeholders, engaging directly with each to understand their distinct needs and levels of oversight.
  • Prioritize and own a roadmap that scales from single-location simplicity to multi-brand, multi-unit complexity.

Data Integrity & Financial Accuracy

  • Own the accuracy of metrics that feed financial and franchise-facing calculations.
  • Ensure consistent reporting logic across surfaces so operators and franchise partners trust one source of truth, and refine live reporting based on usage data once features ship.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Communication

  • Partner directly with Engineering leadership on architectural decisions, shaping technical direction alongside execution.
  • Coordinate with other product teams and departments, representing this role in cross-team planning and leading product marketing efforts and go-to-market for owned products.
  • Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and progress to Product leadership, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, rallying the team around the vision and strategy, not just status updates.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of proven experience as a Product Manager in the SaaS industry, preferably within restaurant Tech or POS domains
  • Experience operating within an empowered product team model (Marty Cagan's Product Operating Model), owning outcomes and running continuous discovery as an equal partner with Design and Engineering.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for modernization and transformation work, with proven experience evolving a legacy or fragmented platform, including simplifying or retiring functionality as well as launching 0-to-1 capabilities.
  • Fluent with AI tools in daily product work (research, spec generation, data analysis, prototyping), and able to identify where AI belongs inside the product itself.
  • Experience defining a data foundation strategy that supports both reporting accuracy and downstream AI development.
  • Working understanding of pricing, packaging, and how product investment decisions connect to commercial outcomes.
  • Ability to design for multiple distinct user types within one cohesive product experience.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineering on data architecture and system dependencies.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proven track record delivering successful products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in restaurant technology, POS, or another vertical SaaS platform.
  • Familiarity with franchise business models and multi-brand or multi-unit operator needs.
  • Experience designing for multiple personas, such as franchisor/franchisee or admin/end-user.
  • Experience shipping an AI-powered feature or capability in a live, customer-facing product.

Additional Information 

This position is open to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States, without sponsorship, either now or in the future. At this time, and in the foreseeable future, HungerRush is not able to support assistance with additional visa sponsorship, regarding this specific position.

jobs.excerpt: Sales and Technical Strategy• Define and lead the technical sales strategy for SecurSpaces across strategic accounts, priority industries, or regions.
jobs.description:
Sales and Technical Strategy

  • Define and lead the technical sales strategy for SecurSpaces across strategic accounts, priority industries, or regions.
  • Partner with Account Executives and sales leadership on account planning, qualification, opportunity strategy, executive engagement, and technical close plans.
  • Provide technical leadership for complex, global, regulated, or precedent-setting opportunities where requirements, architecture, ownership, or customer buying processes may not yet be clearly defined.
  • Conduct multi-persona discovery with engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, security, infrastructure, and EUC stakeholders.
  • Identify and quantify customer challenges including VDI costs, WSL limitations, environment fragmentation, compliance requirements, tool sprawl, slow onboarding, credential exposure, data exfiltration, and unmanaged AI or agent execution.
  • Identify emerging customer patterns and translate them into new SecurSpaces use cases, solution plays, and go-to-market motions.
  • Deliver tailored demonstrations, workshops, architecture sessions, and technical briefings that connect SecurSpaces capabilities to measurable outcomes such as time-to-first-commit, onboarding time, build performance, evaluation cycle time, infrastructure utilization, VDI cost reduction, and security posture.
  • Develop and present executive-level value narratives and business cases, including TCO and ROI analysis and comparisons with existing VDI, AVD, Dev Box, local development, and alternative CDE platforms such as GitHub Codespaces, Gitpod, and Coder.
  • Intervene in strategic or stalled opportunities to identify technical and organizational blockers and establish a credible path to customer decision and closure.

Strategic and Technical Authority

  • Serve as a recognized SecurSpaces technical authority for Citrix field teams, partners, and senior customer stakeholders.
  • Advise customer executives—including CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, Heads of Engineering, and Platform Engineering leaders—on developer environment, developer security, and agentic-computing strategy.
  • Lead architecture decisions for complex SecurSpaces deployments involving multiple business units, regions, cloud environments, security domains, or regulatory requirements.
  • Design secure development architectures using SecurSpaces workspaces, templates, policy controls, credential protection, network isolation, and Zero Trust access through technologies such as Secure Private Access and NetScaler.
  • Develop architecture patterns spanning cloud development environments, platform engineering, privileged operational environments, AI/ML workloads, and governed agent execution.
  • Design governed environments for AI-assisted development and agent execution, including credential brokering, workspace-level network controls, MCP and tool governance, agent identity, policy enforcement, auditability, and controlled access to enterprise systems.
  • Connect SecurSpaces architectures to enterprise cloud, Kubernetes, identity, networking, CI/CD, security operations, data platforms, and internal developer platform strategies.
  • Resolve complex technical and organizational issues by aligning architecture, security, operating-model, business, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Represent SecurSpaces in strategic customer advisory sessions, executive briefings, partner engagements, industry events, and technical forums.

Evaluation and Customer Adoption

  • Provide technical leadership for SecurSpaces’ most strategic evaluations and proofs of concept, including multi-region, regulated, platform-wide, and cross-portfolio opportunities.
  • Establish clear success criteria, test plans, exit criteria, executive decision frameworks, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
  • Coordinate evaluation activities across Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, partners, and customer teams.
  • Ensure evaluations demonstrate measurable business and technical value rather than focusing exclusively on feature validation.
  • Translate Zero Trust, DLP, data residency, least-privilege, audit, and regulated-workload requirements into SecurSpaces configurations and deployment patterns.
  • Guide customers through operating-model decisions, including Citrix-managed deployments in the customer’s cloud and customer-managed deployment models.
  • Advise customers on networking, ingress and egress controls, proxy architectures, SSO and identity integration using OIDC or SAML, governance, observability, and operational responsibility.
  • Lead the technical close plan, including architecture validation, security approval, value confirmation, success-story development, customer references, and handoff to delivery and Customer Success.
  • Ensure that lessons from strategic customer engagements are converted into reusable institutional knowledge and field guidance.

Organizational and Cross-Team Leadership

  • Define and scale repeatable technical sales methodologies, reference architectures, discovery frameworks, evaluation patterns, competitive guidance, security patterns, and value-assessment models.
  • Develop reusable assets such as demonstration environments, workshop content, discovery guides, architecture diagrams, technical validation plans, ROI calculators, RFP/RFI responses, and objection-handling guidance.
  • Mentor and provide technical leadership to Solutions Specialists, Sales Engineers, solution architects, Customer Success teams, and partners without requiring direct management authority.
  • Review and improve the quality of major SecurSpaces architectures, proposals, evaluations, and technical close plans across the field.
  • Establish communities of practice and effective mechanisms for transferring SecurSpaces expertise across regions, portfolio teams, and partner organizations.
  • Partner with Citrix portfolio teams—including NetScaler, Secure Private Access, DaaS, and endpoint solutions—to create integrated architectures and joint customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate with strategic cloud, identity, security, developer-tool, and platform partners to develop integrated solutions and accelerate adoption.
  • Provide leadership during high-priority customer escalations involving architecture, product capabilities, security requirements, or deployment strategy.

Product and Market Influence

  • Synthesize customer, partner, market, and competitive signals into recommendations that influence SecurSpaces product strategy, roadmap priorities, packaging, positioning, and go-to-market investment.
  • Identify systemic product or adoption gaps across multiple customers and develop evidence-based proposals with Product Management and Engineering.
  • Incubate new solution plays and validate them with lighthouse customers before scaling them through the Citrix field organization.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape across CDEs, VDI, cloud workstations, developer platforms, AI coding environments, and agent execution platforms.
  • Contribute to SecurSpaces thought leadership through customer advisory work, industry forums, publications, technical content, or conference participation.
  • Help evolve SecurSpaces guidance for DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, SBOM and SCA integration, credential management, AI governance, and agent security.

Qualifications

  • Typically 15 or more years—or equivalent demonstrated impact—in enterprise technical sales, solution architecture, platform engineering, security, infrastructure, or developer technologies.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex and strategically important enterprise opportunities involving multiple technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence strategy and decisions across multiple organizations, regions, business units, or partner ecosystems without relying on formal authority.
  • Track record of creating technical methodologies, architectures, solution patterns, or go-to-market assets adopted beyond the individual’s own accounts.
  • Experience advising executive stakeholders while maintaining technical credibility with architects, engineers, security teams, and platform operators.
  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of senior specialists, architects, partners, or cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous and emerging markets and convert incomplete customer requirements into scalable solution and go-to-market strategies.
  • Practical understanding of cloud development environments and modern developer workflows, including GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket; CI/CD; IDEs; containers; Kubernetes; cloud platforms; and artifact registries.
  • Strong knowledge of Zero Trust architecture, secure private access, identity and access management, OIDC, SAML, network ingress and egress, proxies, Layer 7 controls, DLP, least privilege, and secrets management.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps, policy as code, SBOM, SCA, software supply-chain risk, and approaches for applying security controls without creating unnecessary developer friction.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, AI coding agents, MCP-based tool integration, agent identity, AI governance, and the security implications of autonomous tool execution is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent executive storytelling, technical presentation, whiteboarding, and written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, proposals, business cases, and RFP/RFI responses.
  • External credibility through customer advisory work, conference participation, publications, industry communities, or equivalent thought leadership is preferred.
  • B.S. or M.Sc. in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, autonomous, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Customer and Contract Administration

  • Set up and maintain maintenance agreements within internal systems
  • Prepare, send, and follow up on maintenance agreements and related customer documentation
  • Ensure receipt of signed customer documents and agreements
  • Create and update customer accounts and information within internal systems
  • Communicate required customer account or contract changes to the Finance department and other internal teams
  • Assist with customer renewal follow-ups and administrative requests

Operational Support

  • Support the administrative processing and follow-up of customer orders, software license activations, maintenance agreements, hardware requests, and related operational activities
  • Coordinate and follow up on RMAs completion
  • Assist with customer account administration, service requests, account changes, and operational follow-ups

Billing and Finance Support

  • Prepare commission-related reports and supporting documentation for Finance Assist with weekly overtime and on-call tracking processes
  • Support monthly operational and finance administrative requirements

Reporting and Administrative Coordination

General Administrative Support

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in
  • English mandatory and French (nice to have)

Assets

jobs.title: Engineer, Engineering and Security Integration
jobs.excerpt: Our CompanyThe North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.
jobs.description:
Our Company

The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

Your Impact

The Engineering and Security Integration team at NERC is expanding its capabilities and expertise in the area of transmission level modeling, studies, and specialized studies. This Engineer role provides technical support and leadership to the BPS in support of critical reliability initiatives of the ERO Enterprise. The role will also work cross-departmentally and across the ERO Enterprise on various engineering challenges facing the electricity sector. The role will be responsible for supporting event analysis of new grid technologies, developing industry recommended practices and guidance, studying and assessing emerging risk issues, and supporting senior leaders in the development of strategic initiatives to tackle grid transformation issues. This position will work with industry stakeholders and across the ERO Enterprise in a collaborative manner to drive positive impact related to the reliable, resilient, and secure BPS. This includes all aspects of planning, designing, and operating the BPS under rapid change in its resource mix. This position reports to the Manager of Engineering and Security Integration and final title is dependent on relevant expertise up to Senior Engineer.

Your Role

  • Coordinate and lead technical activities for NERC industry stakeholder groups, particularly the System Planning Impacts of Distributed Energy Resources Working Group.
  • Engage collaboratively with industry stakeholders to support proactive risk mitigation of emerging technologies or changes to the distribution system related to BPS reliability.
  • Support ERO Enterprise initiatives focused on risk mitigation focused on IBRs, DERs, and computational loads.
  • Work collaboratively with the ERO Enterprise Event Analysis teams to support the analysis of System Disturbances; develop disturbance reports documenting key findings and recommendations, as required.
  • Analyze transmission level modeling and study practices and provide industry with recommendations to address systemic modeling and study issues.
  • Conduct, lead, or support simulations focusing on BPS wide-area reliability issues in the near- and long-term horizon.
  • Support key stakeholders and industry activities, particularly concerning DERs, and engage in industry forums and other industry-leading initiatives to help ensure reliability aspects are addressed proactively.
  • Engage with equipment manufacturers, systems integrators, consultants, national laboratories, academia, research institutes, and other industry stakeholder groups in an effective and efficient manner that provides a safe, inclusive, and diverse environment.
  • Prepare engineering analysis, studies, and assessments on BPS reliability issues and develop reports, guidelines, or other technical documents to support NERC initiatives.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have at a minimum:

  • Understanding of DER technology including IBRs such as wind, solar photovoltaic, battery energy storage, hybrid power plants, HVDC systems, and FACTS devices or synchronous DERs.
  • Conducting root cause analysis of performance issues and developing mitigating actions to address those reliability issues.
  • Understanding of power system fundamentals such as frequency control, balancing, ramping, voltage control, stability, inverter controls, and operation of the BPS.
  • Understanding of NERC Reliability Standards, particularly related to modeling, operations, and protection.
  • General knowledge of transmission planning, power system protection and control, power plant configuration and technologies, and grid operations.
  • General understanding of emerging technologies facing the electricity sector, and willingness to work collaboratively with industry security professionals to integrate security into inverter-based resource facilities.
  • Willingness to think “outside of the box” and work internally and externally with a diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives to develop novel and innovative ideas on difficult topics.
  • Ability to lead stakeholder groups in an effective, efficient, and inclusive manner.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare and publish technical reports and other documents on technical engineering topics.
  • A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

Preferred candidates will also have:

  • 5 or more years of relevant utility expertise in transmission planning or operation departments.
  • Deep understanding and strong expertise in the areas of inverter technology, performance, and grid issues with growing levels of IBRs, DERs, or loads.
  • Detailed understanding and technical expertise of transmission, generation, and load models and studies.
  • Detailed understanding and technical expertise of DER models and studies.
  • Experience developing risk mitigation strategies to improve the performance of the BPS, particularly DER related risk mitigation.
  • Experience leading teams of industry experts in the area of generation integration, performance, modeling, or studies.
  • Experience and ability to tackle major industry-wide challenges and proactively develop initiatives and strategies to address those challenges collectively.
  • Experience coordinating, managing, or leading large teams of industry experts with diverse and conflicting opinions in a safe, inclusive, and collaborative environment.
  • Experience and detailed understanding of the ERO Enterprise processes, particularly related to NERC stakeholder groups, the NERC Standards Process, and other related activities.
  • A master’s degree or higher education in power system engineering with specialization in the areas of transmission planning or protection.

Other

  • A background check will be conducted prior to employment.
  • In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
  • This position has been classified as exempt.
  • The position may be based remotely but must be able to travel to NERC offices or meeting locations if needed. Reimbursement of travel expenses will be in accordance with the company’s travel and expense reimbursement policies.

Our Culture Declarations

  • Everyone at NERC is a leader.
  • We are accountable personally and organizationally to deliver on commitments.
  • We develop ourselves and people in the organization to ensure that NERC realizes its strategic objectives.
  • We are resilient and adaptable to the challenges and needs of the business and our team.
  • We exude a growth mindset and empower teams to take risks.
  • We build collaborative relationships within NERC, the ERO, and the stakeholders of NERC.
  • We exemplify NERC cultural behaviors:
    • Reward high-quality, creative, and innovative work
    • Attract, engage, and retain top talent
    • Value and respect diverse perspectives
    • Provide a safe, inclusive, and collaborative work environment
    • Form strong relationships within the company, and with the ERO Enterprise
  • We demonstrate curiosity in a wide variety of areas and are open to exploring new situations, knowledge, and opportunities for growth and development.
  • We demonstrate an anticipatory mindset, preventing problems and building contingencies where appropriate.
  • We are champions for diversity and inclusion, seeking out and values diverse perspectives.
  • We value well-being, prioritizing collaboration, engagement, and connection among our team.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAt OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Senior Compliance Officer to build and run our global derivatives trade and transaction reporting function. The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation.
Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely.
This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. You will work with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, local Compliance teams and reporting providers, and you will lead regulatory change in this space. Responsibilities for source data, systems, submissions and remediation will be agreed across those teams; you will lead the compliance framework and stay close enough to the process to identify and proactively resolve problems. You will report to the Head of Markets and Product Compliance and support a central function that owns reporting interpretation, scoping, oversight, and remediation for every entity in scope.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interpret and apply derivatives and transaction reporting rules across global regimes, including CFTC Part 45, MiFIR Article 26, EMIR Article 9, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and the ASIC Derivative Transaction Rules (Reporting) 2024, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and outside counsel.
  • Own and maintain entity, product, and transaction-level reporting scoping and eligibility: which entity reports, which products and lifecycle events are in scope, which counterparty role triggers the obligation, and which repository or authority receives the report.
  • Oversee, support, and help maintain the daily reporting process. Monitor submissions against deadlines, including T+1 for MiFIR transaction reports, investigate rejections and breaks, and track each one to resolution.
  • Reconcile reported activity to trading records and repository data, and coordinate corrections and back-reporting with the teams that own the relevant systems and data.
  • Define and maintain the reporting data specification with Engineering and Data, including field-level mapping, reference data such as LEIs, UTIs, UPIs, and ISINs, and the validation rules applied before submission.
  • Build and run the control framework: completeness, accuracy, and timeliness checks, exception management, management information, and records that hold up to regulator and audit review.
  • Drive reporting readiness and remediation. Assess new derivatives products, new entities, and regulatory changes, identify control gaps, agree on owners and deadlines across Compliance, Operations, Product, and Engineering, and track delivery.
  • Escalate material issues. Assess the impact of reporting errors, escalate to senior management, and support notifications to regulators where required.
  • Manage relationships with swap data repositories, trade repositories, approved reporting mechanisms, and reporting vendors, including onboarding, testing, and service issues.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small team, and coordinate with and train local compliance leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support regulator inquiries with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

  • A degree in finance, economics, law, data science, or computer science, or an equivalent professional qualification
  • 7+ years in trade reporting, transaction reporting, or regulatory reporting at an exchange, broker, bank, trading firm, fintech, or digital asset platform
  • Deep working knowledge of at least two of the following regimes: CFTC swap data reporting, MiFIR transaction reporting, EMIR, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting. Hands-on experience with both a US and a European regime is strongly preferred.
  • A sound understanding of derivatives trade lifecycles and the data needed to report executions, changes, terminations and, where applicable, valuations and collateral.
  • The ability to interrogate large datasets, investigate reporting breaks and explain clear requirements to engineers and other business partners. SQL or comparable data analysis skills are highly desirable.
  • Experience building or improving a reporting framework, including procedures, reconciliations, exception management and evidence that can withstand regulatory or audit scrutiny; this may include remediating historical reporting errors, including back-reporting.
  • The judgment to make proportionate risk decisions, escalate material issues and lead delivery across teams without relying on a single team to own every part of the reporting process.
  • Experience with digital asset derivatives, such as perpetual futures and options, and how they map to reporting product classifications

Nice to Haves

  • Experience leading a regulatory reporting change program, such as EMIR Refit, UK EMIR Refit, the CFTC reporting rewrite, or the ASIC 2024 rules.
  • Familiarity with ISO 20022 XML reporting formats.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.description:
The Patient Journey Director CEERJ enables journey from first symptom to diagnosis, referral and appropriate care outcomes faster, clearer and fairer for people living with C3G/IC-MPGN and severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) across CEERJ.

The role is driven by a genuine passion for improving the patient journey. It identifies where patients are delayed, missed or lost, partners with country medical and commercial teams to understand why, and turns those barriers into practical, compliant and measurable initiatives. This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

The role operates in a fast-moving, changing environment. The holder works in an agile way: sets few clear priorities, adapts quickly as launches, access and evidence evolve, and turns insight into executive-ready plans that are communicated clearly to the Brand Teams, Leadership Teams and Core Medical Team.

Main responsibilities:

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

Partner with countries to map and clear barriers & opportunities. Work alongside country leaders and field teams to map country-specific barriers (awareness, testing access, laboratory and biopsy pathways, referral fragmentation, expert centre availability, non-pharmaceutical therapy optimization opportunities)

Build & resource executive plans. Develop concise, prioritized patient journey improvement projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and KPIs. Resource and adjust them rapidly as conditions change. Report progress to senior leadership in Core Medical Team, CEERJ LT and Brand Team forums.

Lead projects and matrix teams: drive relevant Patient Journey projects and allocated matrix teams from kick off to close out ensuring clear planning, budgeting, delivery and reporting on time and within budget

Lead integration of medical devices and enabling platforms. Lead integration of Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics and pipeline tools into patient journey frameworks across CEERJ. Ensure stakeholder value, country readiness and compliant use. Track adoption, escalate barriers and propose solutions.

Generate and act on patient journey insights. Interact with external community to enable systematic collection and synthesis of insights from HCPs, KOLs, diagnostic initiatives, patient organisations and country teams. Turn them into clear recommendations that change plans and decisions.

Mastery of the landscape. Keep current knowledge of C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG science, diagnostic pathways, competitive and customer landscape, Tier 1 KOLs and patient advocacy groups, and related areas such as PNH and haemophilia.

  • Academic, clinical or industry experience in therapeutic areas such as nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology or immunology

  • Proactive, open minded, experienced leader, able to identify and carry out strategic initiatives with high patient impact in launches and life-cycle management

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day.

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

About PrePass & PrePass Safety Alliance

PrePass® is a leading provider of innovative transportation solutions that help commercial fleets operate more efficiently, safely, and confidently. Through intelligent weigh station bypassing, toll management, and compliance solutions, we help fleets reduce administrative complexity, improve operational performance, and keep drivers moving.

PrePass Safety Alliance, the nonprofit provider of PrePass, is a public-private partnership that brings together representatives from state transportation agencies, commercial vehicle enforcement, and the trucking industry. Through this collaboration, members identify shared priorities and help shape policies and programs that advance commercial vehicle safety and highway efficiency.

Together, PrePass and PrePass Safety Alliance combine industry expertise, technology, and public-private collaboration to address real challenges facing commercial transportation and deliver meaningful value to the fleets, drivers, and communities that depend on our nation's highways.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Public Policy & Member Communications will lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategic communications supporting public policy priorities across the PrePass enterprise and member engagement for PrePass Safety Alliance. This role will strengthen how PrePass communicates its policy positions and public affairs activities, while helping the Alliance inform and engage its members, and convey the value of its public-private partnership in advancing commercial motor vehicle safety and efficiency.

Reporting to the Vice President of Government & External Affairs, the Senior Manager will translate complex policy issues, legislative and regulatory developments, grant awards, and related initiatives into clear, timely, and compelling communications. Working under the Vice President’s direction, the role will help shape messaging and serve as the lead writer for enterprise-wide public policy issues and Alliance member communications, including member updates, statements and releases, original articles, policy briefs, talking points, executive remarks, newsletters, social media posts, and other content for cross-functional stakeholders.

Working closely with the Vice President, the Senior Manager will help build the Alliance’s member communications function, including the channels, tools, and processes needed to keep members informed and connected. The role will assess Alliance member communications needs, develop recommendations for the leadership team to review, and implement agreed-upon approaches. In coordination with colleagues who manage member relationships, the Senior Manager will lead content development, establish a regular communications cadence, and support opportunities for member feedback and participation.

The Senior Manager will also maintain the enterprise-wide public policy editorial calendar and coordinate it with marketing’s calendar to support integrated planning and visibility across functions. This will include incorporating planned public affairs activities and content deliverables while maintaining flexibility to respond to emerging legislative, regulatory, and other policy developments.

The Senior Manager will partner with marketing colleagues on design, production, and distribution of content while retaining primary responsibility for the substance, messaging, and writing of PrePass public policy and Alliance member communications, subject to the Vice President’s direction and review. Internal communications support may be provided across the enterprise as it relates to policy priorities and Alliance member activities.

This role is well suited for a strong writer and strategic communicator who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and brings structure and consistency to a fast-moving portfolio. The successful candidate will anticipate communications needs, respond effectively to emerging policy developments, and collaborate across teams to advance PrePass’s public policy priorities and the Alliance’s mission.

Requirements

Experience and Qualifications

  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in communications, public affairs, member engagement, association communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing communications programs, campaigns, or complex workstreams from planning through execution.
  • Experience developing communications for executives, senior leaders, boards, members, policymakers, media, or other high-level stakeholders.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex policy, technical, and organizational information into clear and compelling content for varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across functions such as government affairs, marketing, operations, legal, product, sales, and executive leadership.
  • Experience managing editorial calendars, newsletters, and other digital or stakeholder communications.
  • Experience supporting earned media, including press releases, policy statements, and thought-leadership content.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines, approvals, and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, policy, personnel, or stakeholder information.
  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, public policy, political science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Travel

  • Available to travel approximately 15% annually to support two annual member meetings, industry conferences, and stakeholder engagements.

Compensation

The anticipated salary for this position in the Washington, D.C., metropolitan area is $140,000 annually, based on experience.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.
